We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/describe-dont-decide.

</details>


### [178] [Change the Base, Change the Game: Rethinking Pan-sharpening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32002)
*Jeonghyeok Do,Geunhyuk Youk,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PanBase，一种无需神经网络训练、基于传感器物理特性的更清晰多光谱起点，用于改进全色锐化网络中的残差学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全色锐化网络通常以 4 倍插值的低分辨率多光谱图像为残差学习起点，仅通过残差引入全色细节，导致初始输入模糊；作者质疑为何不以已含空间细节的更清晰图像作为起点。

Method: PanBase 结合全色空间细节与低分辨率多光谱光谱信息，并在传感器特定模糊下保持与 LRMS 观测一致；无需神经网络训练，仅通过闭式校准为每个光谱波段估计 9 个系数。它可通过对现有骨干网络做两处简单修改集成：用 PanBase 替换全局残差跳连基座，并将其作为额外输入拼接。

Result: 在 WorldView-3、QuickBird 和 GaoFen-2 上，使用各骨干原始训练配方和匹配训练预算，PanBase 改善了多数降分辨率和全分辨率指标，并平均实现 4.4 倍更快训练收敛；在 WorldView-2 零样本评估中，独立 PanBase 无需目标传感器拟合或神经细化即可取得有竞争力的重建结果。

Conclusion: 以物理引导的 PanBase 作为更清晰的多光谱起点，可有效增强现有全色锐化骨干的残差学习，提高性能与训练效率，并展现一定跨传感器泛化能力。

Abstract: Many pan-sharpening (PS) networks reconstruct high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by adding learned residuals to 4$\times$-interpolated low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) inputs, incorporating panchromatic (PAN) detail only through these residual corrections. This raises a simple question: Why start with a blurry base when sharp spatial detail is already available? We propose PanBase, a sharper multispectral starting point designed for more effective residual learning. Guided by physical sensor characteristics, PanBase combines PAN spatial detail with LRMS spectral information while enforcing consistency with the LRMS observations under sensor-specific blur. We construct this base without neural network training, estimating only nine coefficients per spectral band through closed-form calibration. Our PanBase can be easily integrated into existing backbones with a global residual skip through two simple changes: (i) replacing the skip base with PanBase and (ii) concatenating it as an additional input. Using each backbone's original training recipe and matched training budgets, PanBase improves most reduced- and full-resolution metrics on WorldView-3, QuickBird, and GaoFen-2, while achieving 4.4$\times$ faster training convergence on average. In zero-shot evaluation on WorldView-2, standalone PanBase achieves competitive reconstruction without target-sensor fitting or neural refinement.

</details>


### [179] [Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31989)
*Tejasvi Kothapalli,Ryan Ressmeyer,Declan Rowley,Gregory D. Horwitz,Jude Mitchell,Alexander C. Huk,Bruno Olshausen,Jacob Yates*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在灵长类自由观看自然场景时，从神经活动中重建图像的新框架，并在猴LGN和V1高密度电极记录上验证，取得跨fMRI、EEG、MEG和电生理等多种脑记录模态的最先进图像重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像重建既可用于脑机接口，也可用于检验大脑对自然图像的先验。以往研究多要求受试者固定眼动，不符合灵长类自然观看行为；本文希望在自由眼动条件下重建完整自然场景图像。

Method: 记录5只猴LGN和V1的高密度电极活动；由于感受野仅覆盖图像小部分，方法将跨眼动、试次和session的神经活动结合。先提出带1/f先验的简单线性方法，再扩展为现代深度学习：将脉冲活动和测得注视位置token化，输入transformer和扩散模型训练解码器以重建完整场景。

Result: 重建质量取决于三个因素：观看时间内整合的神经证据量、眼动追踪准确性以及图像先验选择。该方法在从脑活动重建自然图像方面创下新SOTA，并在fMRI、EEG、MEG和电生理等多种模态上表现领先。

Conclusion: 研究表明可在自由观看条件下从神经活动重建自然图像，并为检验哪种自然图像先验最符合大脑先验提供手段；结合跨眼动、试次和session证据及现代生成模型可显著提升重建性能。

Abstract: Reconstructing images from brain activity has two broad goals. The first is to build brain-computer interfaces. The second is to understand how the brain sees. The eyes deliver incomplete, noisy input, so the brain must fill in the gaps with its expectations of what natural scenes look like. This filling-in relies on the brain's prior over natural images. Image reconstruction lets us test which natural image prior best matches the brain's natural image prior. However, most previous work on image reconstruction relies on an unnatural condition: subjects must hold their eyes still. In reality, primates constantly move their eyes to see the world. We introduce a framework for reconstructing images from neural activity while a primate freely views a static natural scene. We record from five monkeys with high-density electrode arrays in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1). The recorded receptive fields cover only a small part of the image. Thus, we combine neural activity across eye movements, trials, and sessions to reconstruct the full image. We first present a simple linear method with a 1/f prior. We then scale this approach up with modern deep learning. We train a decoder by tokenizing spiking activity and measured gaze; these tokens are fed into a transformer and diffusion model to reconstruct the full scene. Three factors determine reconstruction quality: the amount of neural evidence combined over viewing time, the accuracy of eye tracking, and the choice of image prior. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing natural images from brain activity, across brain recording modalities: fMRI, EEG, MEG and electrophysiology.

</details>


### [180] [HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32021)
*Yuncheng Zhang,Songtao Jiang,Yitian Tang,Zijie Meng,Zihan Xu,Xuxiang Ren,Jian Wu,Hualiang Wang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HuluOPD，一种仅用无标签提示即可将多个异构医学专家视觉语言模型统一蒸馏到一个轻量级 VLM 的在线策略蒸馏方法，并在五个医学影像专科上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学专家视觉语言模型通常依赖私有数据、架构各异且难以统一部署；分别部署多个大模型成本高，因此需要在不访问专家训练数据、不要求共享架构和参考答案的情况下实现统一。

Method: 提出 HuluOPD 在线策略蒸馏配方：轻量模型对每个提示生成回答，由该提示对应模态的专家模型监督；采用 continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss 处理架构和 tokenizer 不一致问题。构建 HuluOPDCorpus（914k 无标签提示）和 HuluOPDBench（47k 留出测试项），覆盖超声、病理、OCT、眼底摄影和牙科影像五个专家及 90 多个公开数据集。

Result: 在统一协议下评估 132k 测试项（含第三方基准）。参数量为五个专家总参数 10% 的单一模型保留 94% 的问答性能，参数量为 2% 的模型保留 89% 的性能。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次证明无需专家训练数据或共享架构即可统一异构医学专家视觉语言模型，为低成本部署多专科医学 VLM 提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

</details>


### [181] [Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32011)
*Adonay Demewez Gebremedhin,Mohamad Alansari,Wessam Shehieb,Muzammal Naseer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DistractAttack，一种利用背景干扰物对 SAM2 类可提示视频跟踪器进行持续对抗攻击的白盒方法，并通过反事实干扰物搜索提升攻击的长期有效性与迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM2 等可提示视频跟踪器依赖强时序一致性，在视频理解与跟踪中应用广泛，但其对抗鲁棒性仍待研究。现有攻击多关注局部掩码退化或短期时序特征破坏，较少探索长期动态和竞争物体干扰；同时观察到 SAM2 在跟踪不确定时会暴露可利用的干扰物线索。

Method: 提出 DistractAttack 白盒攻击，利用背景干扰物持续破坏目标跟踪。核心为反事实干扰物搜索（CDS）：并行传播干净轨迹与受攻击轨迹，发现合理的竞争区域，并识别在扰动下逐渐更有效的区域；随后随时间累积证据，削弱目标支持并促进循环替代预测或目标消失预测。

Result: 在视觉目标跟踪（VOT）和视频目标分割（VOS）上，针对视频级和单次扰动进行大量实验。视频扰动下，DRE 提升至最近基线的 4.4 倍，NRE 提升至 7.3 倍；攻击还能有效迁移到不同模型规模和跟踪器变体的黑盒设置中。

Conclusion: 基于背景干扰物和反事实搜索的持续攻击能显著削弱 SAM2 类跟踪器，并具有较强迁移性，揭示了此类可提示视频跟踪器在长期时序动态和干扰物竞争下的对抗脆弱性。

Abstract: Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\times$ and NRE to $7.3\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

</details>


### [182] [DynaCue: Comparing Motion and Timing Between Groups of Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32014)
*Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出现有视频时序一致性评分可能忽略运动偏好差异，提出DynaCue两样本置换检验，综合运动、帧连续性和外观线索来比较视频组间差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VideoScore的时序一致性评分虽能区分部分Pika视频，但无法检测同提示替代视频间的运动偏好差异，说明单一评分可能遗漏与运动偏好相关的关键差异。

Method: DynaCue是一种两样本置换检验，无需预先选择单一线索，结合光流局部变化（考虑片段常规活动前后）、帧差与冻结计数衡量的中断，以及运动和外观评分，用于组间视频比较。

Result: 在五项影响播放连续性、位移或节奏的受控干预中，DynaCue均检测到组间差异；在三个真实生成视频数据集的小样本重采样比较中，每个数据集至少80%比较检测到差异，而其他方法在至少一个数据集上检测率不超过60%。

Conclusion: DynaCue能更稳健地检测视频组间时序一致性和运动偏好差异，优于现有单一评分或其他评估方法。

Abstract: A score that distinguishes videos with different temporal-consistency ratings can miss differences associated with motion preference. VideoScore's temporal consistency score distinguished higher- from lower-rated Pika videos in 95% of comparisons with 15 videos per group, yet could not detect the difference between preferred videos and their same-prompt alternatives in any of the 200 comparisons of 41 VideoGen-RewardBench pairs. We introduce DynaCue, a two-sample permutation test that combines complementary measurements of motion, frame continuity, and appearance to compare groups of videos without choosing a single cue in advance. DynaCue measures local changes in optical flow both before and after accounting for each clip's usual activity, captures interruptions through frame differences and freeze counts, and incorporates scores for motion and appearance. In controlled experiments, DynaCue detected group differences across five interventions affecting playback continuity, displacement, or rhythm. In real-world evaluations of generated videos where viewers rated temporal consistency or chose which of two videos they preferred for its motion, DynaCue detected group differences in at least 80% of resampled comparisons on each of the three datasets at the smaller sample sizes studied. Every other method evaluated on all three had a detection rate of 60% or less on at least one dataset.

</details>


### [183] [ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32147)
*Xiangwei Wang,Jianyuan Lin,Peng Wang,Saman Halgamuge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ARS-VLM，一种面向视觉语言模型（VLM）多模态推理的纯前向零阶后训练框架，通过视觉对齐的增强随机搜索避免反向传播、优化器状态和参考模型开销，并缓解标准 ES/ARS 的 patch 网格过拟合与灾难性遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶强化学习如 GRPO 虽广泛用于 VLM 后训练，但反向传播、优化器状态和参考模型带来沉重内存与系统开销；纯前向零阶方法如 ES/ARS 可避免这些开销，但尚未用于 VLM 推理，且直接应用会出现 patch 网格过拟合和灾难性遗忘。

Method: 提出 ARS-VLM：1）从双线性配对的跨网格视图中提取对比视觉基，使扰动集中于共享视觉信号并抑制 patch 偏移伪影；2）用软子空间先验锚定浅层视觉融合层、释放深层推理层，在无参考模型下限制策略漂移；3）在配对视图上对扰动打分，并在 top-k 选择中丢弃视图脆弱方向。

Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 的多模态推理任务上评估。8B 模型上，ARS-VLM 用 20 步达到 61.0% 验证准确率，而 GRPO 需 150 步（优化步数少 7.5 倍），并避免 vanilla ARS 和 ES 的后期 OOD 崩溃；在七个 OOD 视觉推理基准上，单视图微平均准确率为 75.41%，全参数 GRPO 为 75.31%。

Conclusion: ARS-VLM 表明纯前向零阶后训练可在显著降低优化步数和系统开销的同时，实现与全参数 GRPO 相当甚至略优的 OOD 泛化，并提升 VLM 后训练的鲁棒性。

Abstract: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

</details>


### [184] [Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32017)
*Shaoan Xie,Fan Feng,Peiyuan Zhu,Peter Spirtes,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Agent-State LAM，通过学习紧凑的智能体状态表示与潜在动作模型，减少视觉背景和智能体外观等无关因素对潜在动作推断的干扰，并提升动作恢复、下游控制和世界模型预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在动作模型从无标注视频中学习动作式潜在变量，但当动作推断与转移预测所用的表示空间将智能体不断变化的物理状态与背景、持续外观等视觉上下文纠缠在一起时，推断出的潜在变量可能编码与动作无关的信息。

Method: 提出 Agent-State LAM，联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示和建模状态转移的潜在动作；将密集视觉特征聚合到共享空间用于动作推断与前向预测；引入空间匹配时间判别（SMTD），通过冻结局部视觉特征进行空间灵活匹配，使状态区分源帧与邻近帧，并强调最强局部特征匹配以降低背景和持续外观等共享线索的影响。

Result: 在带干扰的控制任务和六个真实机器人视频数据集上，实验显示该方法在动作恢复、下游控制和世界模型预测方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过让潜在动作建模聚焦于智能体不断变化的物理状态而非共享视觉上下文，Agent-State LAM 能学习更有动作相关性的潜在表示，并改善机器人视频中的动作推断、控制与预测表现。

Abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

</details>


### [185] [ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32183)
*Jiawei Gu,Linjie Li,Yiming Liu,Yunzhuo Hao,Huichen Wang,Guanzheng Chen,Zhichao Peng,Luxin Xu,Xinyu Zhang,Li Luo,Disen Lan,Zican Hu,Mingyang Song,David Valente,Alex Jinpeng Wang,Yafu Li,Ganqu Cui,Zhengyuan Yang,Qizhe Xie,Yejin Choi,Ranjay Krishna,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ThinkMorph-SSL 两阶段训练方法，利用图像自身作为监督信号，训练模型进行图文交错的多模态推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练模型生成中间图像并用于推理的能力通常依赖难以收集的任务特定演示，因此需要减少对人工演示的依赖。

Method: 采用两阶段训练：第一阶段将图像着色、去噪等视觉预任务转化为无指令的交错推理轨迹，让模型描述受损或变换图像、生成恢复或规范图像并解释结果；第二阶段使用自动构建的演示进行问题驱动的指令微调。

Result: 在相同指令微调预算下，加入预任务推理训练的模型优于仅做指令微调的模型；完整方法在12个基准上平均比基座模型提升11.33个准确率点。

Conclusion: 来自图像的监督可以建立交错推理所需的视觉技能，并改善模型从任务特定演示中的学习效果。

Abstract: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.

</details>


### [186] [Beyond Before-and-After Images: Evaluating Temporal Grounding in a Lightweight VLM for Disaster Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32022)
*Shubh Garg,Pratham Arora,Debabrata Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文对轻量级视觉语言模型InternVL3-2B在灾害双时相遥感影像上的时间 grounding 进行受控诊断，发现模型对真实前时相影像内容和时间顺序的利用很有限，但仍能区分不同事件的前时相影像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时相卫星影像对灾害评估至关重要，但VLM可能表面回答变化问题，实际主要依赖后时相影像或提示中的时间表述，因此需要诊断其是否真正利用预期时间证据。

Method: 在DisasterM3数据集上构建受控诊断，使用1,659对光学/SAR影像、41个事件、9类灾害、事件不重叠划分和9,031个推理问题；比较仅后时相、真实前后对、后时相重复两次、反转顺序、以及无关前时相影像等输入条件。

Result: 真实前后对仅比重复后时相控制高0.5个百分点，95%配对bootstrap CI为[-0.2,+1.2]；反转顺序改变-0.2个百分点，CI为[-0.8,+0.5]，说明无明显真实前时相内容收益且对时间顺序不敏感。但真实对比无关事件前时相高2.5个百分点，CI为[+1.6,+3.4]，表明模型并非完全忽略第一幅影像。状态转移和多跳问题仍困难，光学与SAR表现不同。

Conclusion: 当前协议下未发现真实前时相影像内容带来可测量收益，时间顺序敏感性也较弱；地球观测时间基准应报告答案是否依赖预期证据，而不仅是准确率。时间场景图是待验证的下一步方向，而非已验证方案。

Abstract: Bi-temporal satellite imagery is central to disaster assessment: deciding what was damaged requires comparing a pre-event scene with its post-event counterpart. A vision-language model (VLM) can nonetheless appear to answer change questions while relying mainly on the post-event image or on the prompt's temporal framing. We present a controlled diagnostic of temporal grounding and apply it to one lightweight VLM, InternVL3-2B, on DisasterM3: 1,659 optical and SAR image pairs from 41 events and nine disaster types, in event-disjoint partitions, with 9,031 reasoning questions. We compare post-only input, the true pre/post pair, the post image repeated twice, reversed image order, and an unrelated pre-event image. The true pair scores $+0.5$ accuracy points above the repeated-post control (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[-0.2, +1.2]$), and reversing the order changes accuracy by $-0.2$ points ($[-0.8, +0.5]$). Under this protocol we therefore find no measurable benefit from the content of the true pre-event image and little sensitivity to temporal order. The model is not blind to the first image, however: the true pair scores $2.5$ points above a pair whose pre-event image comes from another event ($[+1.6, +3.4]$). State-transition and multi-hop questions remain hard, and optical and SAR inputs show different profiles. We outline temporal scene graphs as a testable next step, not a validated solution, and argue that temporal benchmarks for Earth observation should report whether answers depend on the intended evidence, not only how often they are right.

</details>


### [187] [Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32423)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Manar Eyad,Yara Alzahrani,Fatimah Albesher,Duaa M. Tahir,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Factorized Context Attention（FCA），一种无需训练的块稀疏注意力方法，将 grid probing 的“外部模拟注意力”模式原生化，以一次性编码和批量前向实现长上下文理解，同时保持精度与覆盖范围并显著降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文输入在一次前向中会变慢、精度下降并受上下文窗口限制；稀疏注意力虽高效但仍受后两项限制；grid probing 能恢复精度并扩展覆盖，但每个局部/跨步片段都需重复编码，计算成本高。

Method: 作者指出 grid probing 本质上是通过提示从模型外部复现的“模拟注意力”。FCA 以原生块稀疏注意力运行相同模式：将输入一次性编码为 KV cache，把所有片段作为掩码序列在一次批量前向中读取，并使用阶梯位置调度使每个片段处于模型训练过的位置范围内。

Result: FCA 在长视频理解、长上下文文本推理和图像 grounding 上以 grid probing 的一小部分成本达到相近精度与覆盖范围；在长视频上比单次前向提升约 10 分，在长篇小说上提升 9 至 14 分；可在超过一千帧的视频和四倍窗口长度的文本中找到“针”；对同一输入的后续提问耗时仅为 grid probing 的十分之一。

Conclusion: 原生注意力可以在不承担 grid probing 重复计算成本的情况下获得其收益，并且可直接用于现有的冻结语言模型和视觉语言模型。

Abstract: Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.

</details>


### [188] [View Management with Gaussian Placement and Opacity Regularization for Online 3DGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32025)
*Dong Hwi Kim,Park Sangwon,Chaehyeon Song,Ayoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对在线3DGS-SLAM地图因参数多、视角少而易过拟合的问题，提出同时增加有效监督并控制地图模型复杂度的实时建图方法，从而提升在线地图的外观与几何质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS与SLAM结合可在线构建逼真地图，但现有方法沿用传统SLAM设计，仅在用于定位的关键帧上训练，并用不确定的前端深度正则化几何，忽略了3DGS地图参数量大而每个区域视角稀疏所导致的过拟合问题；同时每增加一个视角或高斯都受实时预算限制。

Method: 论文从两方面改进：一是逐步将非关键帧图像纳入建图更新，并按不同帧组提供的监督信息分配有限更新，以在保持地图结构的同时增加视角；二是用边缘引导初始化在图像细节需要处放置新高斯，并提出自参考不透明度正则化（SOR），利用累积渲染证据且不增加额外渲染开销，抑制持续出现在地图衍生表面参考前方的低透明度过高高斯。

Result: 这些设计在实时预算内同时改善了在线地图的外观和几何质量。

Conclusion: 通过增加非关键帧监督并控制3DGS地图复杂度，可以缓解在线3DGS-SLAM地图对稀疏输入的过拟合，从而在实时约束下获得更好的在线建图效果。

Abstract: The realistic rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has drawn interest from real-time applications that require maps to be built online. This led to coupling 3DGS with SLAM, providing camera poses and initial Gaussians for the map. However, the map is still optimized with designs inherited from conventional SLAM, which train only on keyframes selected for localization and regularize geometry with uncertain frontend depth. These designs overlook the model complexity of a 3DGS map: with millions of parameters but few views of each region, the map overfits to sparse inputs. Resolving this is challenging, as every view and Gaussian added to the map competes for the same real-time budget. We close this gap from both sides. To add views while keyframes preserve the structure of the map, we progressively admit non-keyframe images as mapping updates complete and allocate the limited updates across different groups of frames according to the supervision each group provides. To control the model complexity of the map, edge-guided initialization places new Gaussians where image detail requires them. To complement the uncertain frontend depth, Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization (SOR) uses accumulated rendering evidence, at no extra rendering cost, to suppress the opacity of Gaussians that persistently contribute in front of a map-derived surface reference. Together, these designs improve both the appearance and the geometry of online maps within the real-time budget.

</details>


### [189] [Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32029)
*Jongseong Bae,Ha Young Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ReCast，一个由自车轨迹引导的 Transformer 占用世界模型，通过基于动作诱导的几何对应关系提升未来场景预测对指定轨迹的忠实性，并引入反事实动作忠实性基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有占用世界模型在反事实动作下未必能忠实遵循指定轨迹；驾驶数据集中替代轨迹覆盖稀疏，模型只能从观测到的场景-轨迹组合中隐式学习自车运动的空间效应，容易将动作效应与场景-轨迹相关性纠缠。

Method: 提出 ReCast：解耦历史编码与未来解码，利用相对自车变换对齐可变形交互，将未来预测 grounding 到自车视角帧间由动作诱导的几何对应关系，同时保留非刚性场景演化灵活性；并构建覆盖分布内、尾部及分布外轨迹的反事实动作忠实性基准。

Result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，ReCast 在标准预测性能上具有竞争力，同时提升反事实预测表现，尤其在分布外轨迹下增益更明显。

Conclusion: 通过显式利用自车轨迹引导的几何对应关系，ReCast 能更忠实地响应反事实自车动作，并提升分布外轨迹下的未来占用预测可靠性。

Abstract: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

</details>


### [190] [ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32316)
*Chanseul Cho,Dongwoo Kim,Noori Bae,Seungjae Moon,Seongsu Lee,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文审计了19个多图像基准，发现大量题目可由单图或问题本身直接答对，即存在“单图捷径”；作者构建了需跨图推理的ASTERISM基准，并提出CICA训练方法以抑制捷径奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多图像基准本应测试多模态大模型跨图像整合证据的能力，但许多题目仅凭一张图即可回答，导致评估和强化学习奖励可能鼓励单图捷径而非真正的跨图推理。

Method: 审计约33k个题目，并用两阶段单图过滤器识别单图可解题；从19个基准中筛出需多图信息的题目构建ASTERISM，发布49k训练集ASTERISM-Train和人工校验的困难子集ASTERISM-Lite；提出跨图像信用分配CICA，作为RLVR扩展，将奖励信用分配给真正需要多图信息的token。

Result: 24.2%的题目可由一张图或问题本身解决；在这些题上，MLLM从单图获得的准确率中位数为全图相对纯文本增益的78%。MLLM即使单图不足也会走捷径，错误答案重复单图答案的比例显著高于随机。ASTERISM含18.7k题，其中2.0k题被修正或重写；ASTERISM-Lite上最强闭源MLLM得68%。现有RLVR目标提升有限，而CICA在三个开源MLLM上提升ASTERISM分数2.6至6.0分，超过通用和视觉专用RL目标增益的两倍。

Conclusion: 多图像基准普遍存在单图捷径，评估和训练都需显式抑制；ASTERISM提供了经过审计的跨图推理评测，CICA能减少训练中对单图捷径的奖励并显著提升跨图推理表现。

Abstract: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

</details>


### [191] [MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32462)
*Yifan Dai,Daili Hua,Bohan Zeng,Yuran Wang,Jialing Liu,Bozhou Li,Chengzhuo Tong,Yang Shi,Kai Zeng,Liu Yang,Xinyu Liu,Shujie Li,Yiyan Ji,Bingyin Mei,Yushuo Guan,Yuanxing Zhang,Fangcheng Fu,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MAGPIE，将多参考图像生成中的目标构图表示为可执行的 Blender 3D 场景程序，并通过编码智能体检查与修正该程序，最终以代理渲染作为视觉规划来指导图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多参考图像生成方法虽能保持主体外观并进行组合控制，但目标场景中主体之间的规划关系往往没有被显式实例化，难以在图像合成前检查、修正和细化。

Method: MAGPIE 用简化 3D 场景和可执行 Blender 程序表示目标构图；编码智能体将场景实例与参考图像关联，检查几何与渲染视角是否符合指令，并修订程序。最终代理渲染作为图像生成器的视觉计划，并利用 MAGPIE-Instruct-3K 训练生成器在遵循计划的同时从参考中提取各主体外观。

Result: MAGPIE 在 DreamOmni2 和 SconeEval 上提升了 Qwen 与 FLUX。使用 FLUX 时，在 DreamOmni2 上的总体成功率比原始骨干模型提高 28.21 个百分点，并在 SconeEval 评测模型中获得最高总体得分。

Conclusion: 将组合关系显式转化为可检查、可修订的 3D 视觉规划，可有效提升多参考图像生成的构图可靠性和主体外观保持能力。

Abstract: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

</details>


### [192] [STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32472)
*Yi Zou,Zhuang Yan,Yudong Zhang,Xu Wang,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 STAR，一种视觉 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，通过反事实双世界 rollout 和空间注意力引导的目标重建，提升视觉语言模型对局部关键证据的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型常依赖全局上下文和语言先验，忽视决定答案的局部视觉细节；仅看单图正确率无法保证模型真正依赖局部证据，且不同 token 对视觉校正的需求随空间注意力状态而变化。

Method: STAR 结合独立反事实双世界 rollout 与空间注意力引导的目标重构：通过局部图像编辑构造问题与背景相同但答案决定事实不同的成对世界，共享学生模型独立采样轨迹以暴露上下文捷径；教师对比真实裁剪与均值颜色裁剪确定视觉校正方向，并用学生图像注意力与教师质心空间参考的差异自适应控制 token 级目标对数概率重建。

Result: 在六个细粒度基准上，STAR 使 Qwen3.5 各规模平均准确率较初始化最多提升 8.04 个百分点，达到 OPSD 最终准确率的速度快 4.7 倍，并可泛化到域外推理任务。

Conclusion: STAR 无需辅助注意力损失或测试时工具开销，即可增强模型对局部关键视觉证据的利用，并提升跨规模、跨基准及域外推理表现。

Abstract: Vision-language models often rely on global context and language priors while overlooking answer-determining local details. Privileged visual on-policy self-distillation supervises full-image student rollouts using a frozen teacher that views high-resolution evidence crops. Yet our cross-scale diagnostics show that models retain over half of their full-image accuracy when local evidence is completely masked, indicating that single-image correctness does not guarantee reliance on local evidence, while the need for visual correction also varies across tokens with their spatial attention states. We propose STAR, a visual on-policy self-distillation framework combining independent counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided target reconstruction. Local image editing constructs paired worlds with identical questions and backgrounds but distinct answer-determining facts, where a shared student samples trajectories independently to expose contextual shortcuts under image-consistent prefixes. Within each world, the teacher contrasts real and mean-color crops to determine the visual correction direction, while the divergence between student image attention and a teacher-centroid spatial reference adaptively controls token-wise target log-probability reconstruction. Without auxiliary attention losses or test-time tool overhead, STAR improves Qwen3.5 across scales by up to 8.04 percentage points in average accuracy over initialization across six fine-grained benchmarks, reaches OPSD's final accuracy $4.7\times$ faster, and generalizes to out-of-domain reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [193] [BodyWeave: Native Body-Conditioned 3D Garment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32034)
*Junyi Zhang,Yuanchuan Wang,Qichao Wang,Wenzhe Qian,Shizhuo Cheng,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BodyWeave 提出一种以 3D 人体为原生条件的服装生成与适配统一框架，可生成高几何保真、低穿模且具备 PBR 材质属性的 3D 服装，并构建了 GarmentWeave3D 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缝纫版方法难以复现不熟悉的设计和精细细节，而 image-to-3D 生成器虽具备丰富形状先验，却通常缺乏显式的 3D 人体上下文，难以同时保证服装设计与目标体型姿态适配。

Method: 基于 3D 生成先验，在几何生成全程以人体为空间参考：Global Body Adapter 引导服装在共享坐标中的位置和范围，Local Body Attention 利用邻近人体几何细化表面，Surface Penetration Loss 监督解码表面以减少人体穿插；生成几何进一步条件化材质合成以产生 PBR 属性。构建 GarmentWeave3D，含 293K 对齐服装—人体观测和 114K 同设计跨体型配对。

Result: 在域外 Artist-Created Garments 上取得高几何保真度和低人体穿插；跨体型评估显示能准确适配新穿着者并保持一致的服装—人体间距；外观比较表明面料复现较忠实。

Conclusion: 将人体作为原生 3D 条件可统一服装生成与拟合，在未见设计、跨体型适配和材质外观方面均表现有效。

Abstract: Generating 3D garments for digital characters requires preserving a reference design while adapting the garment to the target body's shape and pose. Sewing-pattern methods can struggle to reproduce unfamiliar designs and fine details, while image-to-3D generators offer rich shape priors but typically lack explicit 3D body context. We present \textbf{BodyWeave}, a framework that unifies garment generation and fitting through native 3D body conditioning. Building on 3D generative priors, BodyWeave uses the body as a spatial reference throughout geometry generation: a \textbf{Global Body Adapter} guides garment placement and extent in the shared coordinate frame, while \textbf{Local Body Attention} guides surface refinement using nearby body geometry. A \textbf{Surface Penetration Loss} supervises decoded surfaces to reduce body intersections, and the resulting geometry conditions material synthesis to produce garments with physically based rendering attributes. To support learning across designs and wearers, we construct \textbf{GarmentWeave3D} with 293K aligned garment--body observations, including 114K same-design cross-body pairs. Evaluations on out-of-domain \textbf{Artist-Created Garments} demonstrate high geometric fidelity and low body penetration. Cross-body evaluations demonstrate accurate adaptation to new wearers with consistent garment--body spacing, while appearance comparisons show faithful fabric reproduction. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/bodyweave-page/

</details>


### [194] [Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32042)
*Xin Kang,Jiahui Huang,Jiawei Ren,Sipeng Zhang,Yu Chen,Weihua Zhang,Junjie Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Instant LiDAR 是一种无需逐场景优化的前馈式 LiDAR 重建流水线，可在数分钟内将多帧 LiDAR 扫描重建为可复用的高斯资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 重建需对每个场景进行数小时优化，导致大规模资产库构建和维护成本高昂，难以支撑闭环自动驾驶仿真。

Method: 提出 Instant LiDAR，结合测量锚定的高斯预测、采样感知的高斯尺度以及多帧融合：以 LiDAR 回波为几何先验，自适应调整高斯空间支撑，并合并重叠预测为覆盖驾驶日志的紧凑资产。

Result: 相比 NuRec，在 Physical AI 上重建速度约快 46 倍，在 Waymo 上约快 70 倍，并在 Waymo 上取得可比的下游 3D 检测精度。

Conclusion: Instant LiDAR 能快速、可扩展地构建可复用 LiDAR 高斯资产，适用于闭环自动驾驶仿真，并缓解非均匀采样、有限视场、稀疏空洞和冗余基元等问题。

Abstract: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.

</details>


### [195] [SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32045)
*Jiajian Ma,Yihao Qiao,Ke Chen,Kaiyue Feng,Wushuang Rui,Abhishek Jha,Aarti Darji,Yiqiu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SegPFN，一种无需训练的图像上下文分割框架，将上下文分割转化为基于冻结视觉特征的表格分类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练上下文分割方法依赖人工设计的推理流程，参考信息组合不够灵活；而分割特定训练的学习式方法可能损害对未见域的泛化能力。因此作者探究：预训练的上下文学习器能否在无需分割特定训练的情况下，根据标注参考推断目标图像中要分割的内容。

Method: SegPFN 将图像上下文分割重新表述为对冻结视觉特征的表格分类。具体使用冻结的表格先验数据拟合网络（PFN），以带标签的参考图像块作为上下文，对目标图像中的图像块进行分类。作者在 11 个数据集上，与主要现有上下文分割方法进行了全面基准测试，覆盖语义、部件和个性化分割任务。

Result: SegPFN 相比最强整体基线将平均 mIoU 提升 4.7 个百分点，并在五种任务-样本设置中的四种取得最高平均 mIoU。分析还表明，困难负样本参考图像块有助于提升细粒度目标判别能力，联合条件化使 SegPFN 能有效利用多张参考图像。

Conclusion: SegPFN 为免训练图像上下文分割提供了一种简单有效的范式，说明预训练上下文学习器无需分割特定训练即可根据标注参考完成分割。

Abstract: In-context segmentation (ICS) uses one or a few annotated reference images to specify what to segment in a target image. Existing training-free ICS approaches typically rely on manually designed inference procedures, which may limit how flexibly reference information is combined. Learned in-context inference offers an adaptive alternative, but acquiring this capability through segmentation-specific training can compromise generalization to unseen domains. We therefore ask: can a pretrained in-context learner infer what to segment from annotated references without segmentation-specific training? We introduce SegPFN, a training-free framework that reformulates ICS as tabular classification over frozen visual features. A frozen tabular prior-data fitted network (PFN) uses labeled reference patches as context to classify patches in the target image. We comprehensively benchmark SegPFN against major existing ICS methods across 11 datasets spanning semantic, part, and personalized segmentation. SegPFN improves overall mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) by 4.7 points over the strongest overall baseline and achieves the highest average mIoU in four of five task-shot settings. Further analyses show that hard-negative reference patches improve fine-grained target discrimination, while joint conditioning enables SegPFN to use multiple references effectively. These results show that SegPFN offers a simple and effective paradigm for training-free in-context segmentation.

</details>


### [196] [DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32035)
*Yuhang He,Harrison Zhang,Fanrong Li,Chang Liu,RuQing G. Xu,Perkz Zheng,Zhenhua Wang,Rajeev Rao,Mengdi Wang,Sharan Chetlur,Jun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DeCo-Attention，一种面向视频扩散 Transformer 的低精度注意力算法与系统协同设计，通过补偿 FP4 下 Q/K 的舍入误差，在保持生成质量的同时显著加速长序列注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 中自注意力随 token 数呈二次增长，成为生成时间瓶颈；现代 GPU 的 FP4 矩阵乘可加速注意力，但 Q、K 的 4-bit 舍入误差会被 softmax 中的指数放大，并主导注意力误差。

Method: DeCo-Attention 无需训练，按每个注意力头做特征分解，沿少数主方向补偿 Q、K 的舍入误差，并将轻量补偿项作为额外通道拼接到 Q、K，使 FP4 矩阵乘在计算注意力分数时自行纠错；同时对 softmax 进行优化以将 FP4 计算收益转化为实际加速。实现上 QK 使用 FP4，其余注意力在 GB300、VR200 上用 FP8，在 RTX PRO 6000 上全 FP4。

Result: 在 Wan2.2 上，对应内核比 BF16 注意力快 2.13x、2.49x、2.82x，整体生成快 1.55x、1.68x、1.80x；在四个视频生成模型上，FP8 配置的 LPIPS 与已有 8-bit QK 方法相当，全 FP4 配置的 LPIPS 低于已有全 4-bit 内核。

Conclusion: 通过算法与系统协同补偿低精度 QK 误差并优化 softmax，DeCo-Attention 能在视频生成中实现显著加速，同时保持或提升感知质量，说明 FP4 注意力在实际生成任务中可行且有效。

Abstract: Self-attention over tens of thousands of tokens dominates the generation time of video diffusion transformers, because its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. The FP4 matrix products of modern GPUs can speed up attention, but the 4-bit rounding of the queries Q and the keys K introduces large errors. We show that the exponential in softmax amplifies the error of their product QK, which therefore dominates the attention error. We propose DeCo-Attention, a co-design of algorithm and system for low-precision attention. DeCo-Attention is training-free and compensates the rounding error of Q and K along a few principal directions found by a per-head eigendecomposition. The lightweight compensation terms are appended to Q and K as extra channels, so the FP4 matrix product corrects its own rounding error while it computes the attention scores. Once the products run in FP4, the softmax bounds the kernel, and we optimize the softmax so that the gain of FP4 computation translates into realized speedup. With QK in FP4, we implement DeCo-Attention with the rest of attention in FP8 on GB300 and VR200 and in FP4 on RTX PRO 6000. On Wan2.2, these kernels run 2.13x, 2.49x, and 2.82x faster than BF16 attention, and the whole generation runs 1.55x, 1.68x, and 1.80x faster. On four video generation models, the FP8 configuration achieves LPIPS comparable to prior 8-bit QK methods, and the fully FP4 configuration lower LPIPS than prior fully 4-bit kernels.

</details>


### [197] [SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32054)
*Qirui Zhong,Quande Liu,Yang Chen,Cheng Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出生成式手术世界模型 SurgGenesis，利用潜空间学习手术状态转移，作为可扩展的手术数据引擎，以缓解手术场景理解中的数据稀缺和长尾类别不平衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术视频标注依赖稀缺的临床专业知识，罕见手术事件样本不足，导致手术场景理解受数据稀缺和长尾分布限制；因此需要可扩展的数据生成方法。

Method: SurgGenesis 基于大规模视频扩散模型，通过三阶段渐进式 LoRA 策略依次注入内窥镜视觉先验、流程语义和空间运动线索，以避免灾难性遗忘；并从未来感知和动作忠实可用性两方面评估生成数据。

Result: 未来感知方面，通过GT潜变量预测差距和时间跨度分析验证模型能预测真实未来状态；动作忠实方面，生成片段包含指定手术三元组，并能重平衡长尾事件，在下游分割、三元组识别和3D重建中带来动作特定增益。

Conclusion: 条件化生成的手术未来片段可补充传统长尾采样，SurgGenesis 不仅追求视觉保真，更作为动作忠实、具未来感知能力的手术数据引擎支持下游手术场景理解。

Abstract: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

</details>


### [198] [LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32067)
*Sirui Liang,Xuanlong Yu,Longfei Liu,Xiaodong Cun,Xi Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LoopDVR 框架，通过跨层复用 Transformer 块，将预训练密集视觉识别模型转换为参数高效的循环网络，在保持计算结构的同时显著减少参数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接减少网络宽度或深度会破坏原有结构；而朴素地共享参数又会削弱不同深度学到的特有变换，因此需要一种兼顾参数效率与表示能力的参数共享方案。

Method: 基于层间表示差异选择参数共享组，保留最终 backbone 块独立以构建多尺度特征；用各组末端层预训练权重初始化共享块，并在每层加入独立 Loop Adapter 保留深度特定变换；再将视觉表示蒸馏到循环 backbone，并与循环 decoder 结合进行任务特定训练。

Result: 在多种密集识别任务上取得更优的精度—参数权衡；相比参考模型参数量减少约 28% 且精度具有竞争力；LoopDet-S 仅用 7.0M 参数达到 50.9 box AP。

Conclusion: LoopDVR 能有效将预训练 Transformer 密集视觉识别模型转化为参数高效的循环网络，在紧凑模型场景下具有明显效果。

Abstract: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

</details>


### [199] [When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32982)
*Ang Qi,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉语言模型的失败驱动修复，指出仅在留出失败样本上的准确率会误导：许多挖掘出的失败其实是标签错误，且问题措辞存在规律性捷径。作者提出VFR方法，并在多类评测中发现修复虽有效，但会破坏否定和多图关系能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在模型自身失败样本上微调是直接修复手段，但用留出失败准确率衡量成功不可靠：人工审计100个失败发现37个是标签错误；仅看问题的分类器在73.2%的留出失败对上答对，说明失败样本共享措辞规律。

Method: 采用验证式失败驱动修复VFR：类型化最小对失败挖掘、由三个LLM评委在不见存储标签的情况下验证、答案优先的纠正目标、带回放的LoRA微调；并评估留出失败、独立标注无条件对、改写问题和What'sUp数据。

Result: VFR修复82.8%留出失败（基座10.0%），独立标注无条件对总体准确率从87.4%升至92.4%，空间关系从66.7%升至96.8%；否定留出失败修复88.9%，但无条件对否定准确率从88.7%降至79.7%。无验证时无条件对降至80.8%，低于基座87.4%；无失败选择时单种子总体92.0%但修复降至73.4%。两图关系准确率从74.3%降至49.6%（仅回放48.4%），多图回放部分且不均地逆转；空间问题改写保持部分增益87.3%对基座62.0%，但改写使留出空间修复从92.9%降至76.8%；What'sUp标题选择完美，但 yes/no 对从84.5%降至26.4%。

Conclusion: 仅看留出失败准确率不足以证明修复成功；验证和失败选择很关键。VFR能带来显著修复和空间关系提升，但会引入否定捷径并损害多图关系，需更全面的独立评测。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

</details>


### [200] [BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33135)
*Nadav Magar,Amir Hertz,Ariel Shamir,Or Patashnik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 BriConstrain，一种约束解码方法，用于让预训练语言模型生成无碰撞、连接有效的 LEGO® 装配，并在两种格式上显著提升有效构建率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能根据文本生成 LEGO® 装配，但生成结果常出现零件碰撞或未连接问题；传统的拒绝重采样会丢弃已解码 token，且不能保证得到有效构建。

Method: BriConstrain 在采样前约束语言模型的下一个 token 概率，引导其生成有效放置。由于积木放置有效性依赖动态构建状态，无法编译为固定语法，需动态检查。方法通过约束零件“如何连接”而非“哪些零件相连”来缩小搜索空间：基于模型预测的当前零件和希望连接的父零件，利用预计算几何 oracle 枚举连接方式并过滤碰撞选项，再将下一 token 分布偏向剩余有效候选。

Result: 在 BrickNet 和提出的 Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format（ICLF）上评估：BrickNet 无碰撞构建率从 31% 提升到 91%，ICLF 从 15% 提升到 65%；同时在两种格式上均优于拒绝采样，解码成本约为其 60%。

Conclusion: BriConstrain 能有效提升 LEGO® 装配生成的几何有效性和连接有效性，并在保证更高质量的同时降低解码成本。

Abstract: Language models can generate LEGO$^\circledR$ assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model's predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model's choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model's next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO$^\circledR$ formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.

</details>


### [201] [Not the Scalar, but Its Evolution: Robust Source Attribution for Generated Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32074)
*Chao Wang,Zijin Yang,Yaofei Wang,Yuang Qi,Weiming Zhang,Kejiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向潜在生成模型（LGMs）生成图像的来源归因框架 SpCon，利用重建残差能量随重复重建的频率分辨演化作为稳定线索，在常见后处理与平台处理下提升来源归因可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LGMs 广泛部署后，生成图像来源归因对版权审计和数据治理至关重要，但实际场景中图像常经后处理或平台处理。现有基于重建的归因方法将重建响应压缩为单一全局标量，丢弃通道-频率结构，导致图像内容与后处理变化掩盖来源证据，传播后归因困难。

Method: 作者发现后处理下更稳定的来源判别线索是：同一重建算子重复应用时残差能量的频率分辨演化，并称其为 Spectral Contraction。基于此构建 SpCon：仅访问目标模型 VAE，通过两次确定性重建获得相邻残差，构造频率分辨的相对能量变化表示，并对每个来源-条件对在有限拟合参考组件上聚合 Student-t 响应密度。方法支持三种设置：Target-Only（仅目标模型参考）、External-Reference（外部域外来源参考）和 Known-Reference（已知域内竞争模型参考）。

Result: 在七个 LGMs 的 35 个条件上，TO、ER、KR 的平均 AUROC/AP 分别为 0.8786/0.6344、0.9404/0.7886、0.9652/0.8626，均优于最强基线 0.8154/0.5277；在三个社交平台上分别达到 0.8581/0.5507、0.9369/0.7549、0.9734/0.8773。

Conclusion: SpCon 表明频率分辨的残差能量演化是后处理下更稳定的来源判别线索，仅依赖目标模型 VAE 即可实现较强来源归因，并在多种参考可用性设置和社交平台传播场景中优于现有基线。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of latent generative models (LGMs) makes generated image source attribution essential for copyright auditing and data governance, yet practical attribution should remain reliable under common post-processing and platform-induced processing. Existing reconstruction-based attribution methods summarize an image's reconstruction response to a single global scalar, such as the reconstruction error or the ratio of two consecutive errors. These summaries discard channel-frequency structure, allowing image content and post-processing variation to obscure source evidence and making attribution after spreading difficult. We instead uncover a more stable source-discriminative cue under post-processing: the frequency-resolved evolution of residual energy across repeated applications of the same reconstruction operator. Motivated by this insight, we characterize a phenomenon we term Spectral Contraction and use it to build SpCon, a source-attribution framework that accesses only the target model's VAE. SpCon obtains adjacent residuals through two deterministic reconstructions, builds a spectral-contraction representation from their frequency-resolved relative energy change, and aggregates Student-t response densities for each source-condition pair over a finite set of fitted reference components. The same representation supports three settings according to non-belonging reference availability: none (Target-Only, TO; belonging references only), external out-of-domain sources (External-Reference, ER), or known in-domain competitors (Known-Reference, KR). Across seven LGMs, TO, ER, and KR attain average AUROC/AP of 0.8786/0.6344, 0.9404/0.7886, and 0.9652/0.8626 over the 35 conditions, all outperforming the strongest baseline (0.8154/0.5277), and achieve 0.8581/0.5507, 0.9369/0.7549, and 0.9734/0.8773 on the three social platforms.

</details>


### [202] [DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33153)
*Binfei Ji,Zhiwen Cao,Anqi Yang,Prem Seetharaman,Shuo Yang,Ratheesh Kalarot,Yingyan Celine Lin,Mingze Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DiaCap，一个用于综合对话字幕生成的音视频大语言模型，可为视频中每句话生成转写文本、时间戳和说话人视觉描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 话语句子时间定位与音视频说话人日志高度耦合，因此需要将二者统一到单个模型中处理。

Method: DiaCap 采用两阶段训练：先在 22.5 万条精选片段上用密集标注每句话的合成字幕训练；再在 2900 条人工校正片段上通过强化学习微调，使用直接评估时间定位、说话人分组和说话人绑定的细粒度反馈。评估使用扩展了句子级时间戳和字幕脱敏的 DiaDemBench。

Result: DiaCap 及端到端变体 DiaCap-E2E 均取得强结果；DiaCap 在音视频说话人日志上与 Gemini 4 Argon 相当，并在时间戳准确率上明显更优（76.59 对 42.76 TIME）；在多语言和分钟级长视频上保持较强日志能力，并可迁移到音视频问答。

Conclusion: 统一建模时间定位与音视频说话人日志可有效提升综合对话字幕生成，并展现出良好的鲁棒性和迁移能力。

Abstract: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.

</details>


### [203] [Rethinking Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32096)
*Minchan Kang,Kyeonghye Park,Seoyoung Cho,Junhee Lee,Daeshik Kim,Yucheol Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的训练后量化（PTQ），指出低比特权重-激活量化性能下降的根源在于离群值主导共享量化范围，并提出 Rotate-and-Refine Quantization（RRQ）方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法虽不断改进校准策略，但在低比特权重-激活量化下仍有明显性能退化。作者发现量化误差集中在少数离群值上，这些离群值主导了逐通道权重和逐 token 激活的共享范围，导致大多数数值分辨率不足甚至被映射为零。

Method: 作者将关注点从校准优化转向量化表示，提出 RRQ 作为简单有效的 LVLM PTQ 基线，结合局部 Hadamard 变换、分组量化以及高效的分组感知执行。

Result: 在 8 个多模态任务和多种量化设置下，RRQ 显著优于基线，并降低推理时间和内存占用。在 W4A4 设置下，8B 模型保留超过 96% 的全精度性能，32B 模型保留超过 99%，而基线方法低于 8%。

Conclusion: RRQ 表明，改善量化表示比单纯细化校准更能缓解 LVLM 低比特 PTQ 的性能退化，可作为简单有效的强基线，并已公开源码。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large vision-language models (LVLMs) by calibrating quantization parameters on a small dataset without retraining. However, despite increasingly sophisticated calibration strategies, prior methods suffer substantial performance degradation under low-bit weight--activation quantization. To understand this degradation, we locate where quantization error is concentrated and examine the corresponding weight and activation distributions. We observe that a few outliers dominate the ranges shared by per-channel (PC) weights and per-token (PT) activations, leaving insufficient resolution for most values and mapping many of them to zero. These findings motivate a shift in focus from calibration refinement to the underlying quantization representation. We therefore present Rotate-and-Refine Quantization (RRQ) as a simple, effective baseline for LVLM PTQ, combining local Hadamard transforms with group quantization and efficient group-aware execution. Across 8 multimodal tasks and diverse quantization settings, RRQ substantially outperforms baselines while reducing inference time and memory usage. At W4A4, it retains over 96\% of full-precision performance on 8B models and over 99\% on a 32B model, compared with less than 8\% for these baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/RRQ

</details>


### [204] [GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32097)
*Enqi Liu,Zhi Gao,Liu Liu,Lifeng Fan,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 GUI-PRISM，一种混合动作解码器，用于 GUI 智能体直接预测动作类型和结构化参数，同时保留开放式文本生成，从而在提升动作预测准确率的同时显著降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体多依赖视觉语言模型以自回归方式生成文本动作，推理延迟较高；而现有空间解码方法主要关注目标定位，难以完成完整 GUI 动作预测。

Method: GUI-PRISM 采用字段特定查询从共享多模态特征库中提取与动作相关的语义和空间信息，并通过条件查询建模动作组件间依赖关系，再利用门控残差交叉注意力结合细粒度多模态信息进行预测。

Result: 在 ScreenSpot-v2 上达到 95.1% 准确率，比最强 head-based 空间解码方法高 2.0 个百分点，并实现 3.8 倍推理加速；在 AndroidControl-v2 和 MM-Mind2Web-v2 上，完整动作准确率分别提升 4.8 和 0.7 个百分点，推理分别加速 2.7 倍和 3.9 倍。

Conclusion: GUI-PRISM 能有效完成 GUI 动作类型与参数的直接预测，在保持语言生成能力的同时兼顾准确率和推理效率，优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\times$ and 3.9$\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>


### [205] [PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32099)
*Seongrae Noh,RyunHa Lee,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究隐藏用户偏好下的个性化室内3D场景合成：系统多轮展示渲染图，用户仅给出简短自由反馈与满意度，系统需从局部反馈推断整体品味并调整全屋各设计属性。提出PreferenceScene，在320个实例、10类房间的基准上优于五个改编的文本到场景基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到场景方法虽能根据简短指令生成带家具的3D房间，但用户偏好很难完全用文字表达，往往需要看到具体房间后才能指出喜欢与不喜欢之处；且偏好涉及表面、灯光、织物、家具及布局共同营造的整体氛围，系统必须能改动房间每个部分。

Method: 提出PreferenceScene：用大语言模型显式维护房间每个设计属性的用户偏好估计，每轮根据反馈推断其背后品味并修订整体估计（包括反馈未提及部分）；场景实例化模块将每个估计值构建为房间的独立部分，使各部分均可跟随偏好调整。采用模拟用户和基于渲染的评估器，在含320个实例、10种房型的基准测试集上评估。

Result: PreferenceScene对隐藏偏好的匹配优于五个适配同一交互的已发表文本到场景基线，且匹配度随轮次提升；即使基线直接获得偏好信息，PreferenceScene仍更优；视觉语言模型将其场景评为最真实、最实用。

Conclusion: 多轮交互中显式建模并全局修订用户偏好，再按属性实例化场景，可有效实现隐藏偏好下的个性化室内场景合成，并优于现有文本到场景方法。

Abstract: Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. It must also be able to change every part of the room, because a preference concerns not only single objects but the look and atmosphere that surfaces, lighting, textiles, furniture and their arrangement create together. We present PreferenceScene, in which a large language model keeps an explicit estimate of the user's preferences for every design attribute of the room and, after each turn, infers the taste behind the feedback and revises the whole estimate, including the parts that the feedback does not mention. A scene instantiation module builds every estimated value as its own part of the room, so that each of these parts can follow the user's preferences. We evaluate on the test set of a benchmark with 320 instances in ten room types, with a simulated user and a render-based evaluator. PreferenceScene matches the hidden preferences better than five published text-to-scene baselines adapted to the same interaction, and its match rises with every turn. It even surpasses them when they are given the preferences directly, and a vision-language model rates its scenes as the most realistic and functional.

</details>


### [206] [Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32094)
*Yang Bai,Yingzhi Xia,Ling Lin,Jun Cheng,Lin Fu,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Clinical3D-Bench医院空间推理模拟基准，包含373个病房布局、3368道八类问题，评估35个多模态大模型，并给出Clinical3D-45K训练集和GeoJeV方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准对医院场景中相似设备追踪、患者相对方向判断和通道宽度判断等空间推理能力覆盖不足。

Method: 构建基于逼真第一人称视频的模拟基准，答案由3D场景计算，并用配对场景状态检验模型是否随证据变化；由医生审核布局；构建44,750题训练集进行微调；提出GeoJeV，让模型重建场景记忆、选择3D操作及参数，并将证据加入选项评分。

Result: 最佳开源和专有模型宏平均准确率分别为45.7%和53.6%，答案先验为40.8%，医生子集为79.0%；32个开源模型中27个在患者相对方向题上低于40%；微调使两个模型超过最佳专有模型16-20个百分点；直接输入3D地图几乎未被利用；GeoJeV取得所有评估模型最高准确率并缩小与医生差距。

Conclusion: 当前MLLM在医院空间推理上仍明显弱于医生，患者相对方向尤其薄弱；有效利用3D计算比直接提供3D地图更关键，GeoJeV与领域微调能显著提升性能。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

</details>


### [207] [RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32102)
*Enqi Liu,Zhi Gao,Liu Liu,Lifeng Fan,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出隐式框架RISE，将动作相关推理融入隐式状态表示，以提升GUI智能体的下一动作预测准确性，并在多个基准上取得领先表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI智能体训练常依赖显式推理，容易过度依赖特定推理模式，而非可泛化的动作相关信息。

Method: RISE通过三种互补监督目标学习隐式表示：完整思维链状态对齐、动作分布对齐、推理到动作边界对齐，从而将动作相关推理编码进隐式状态并指导GUI动作预测。

Result: RISE在OSWorld-G上达到70.6%准确率，在对比的8B模型中取得最优，较主干模型提升4.3个百分点；在两个不同主干和六个基准上的实验验证了其在GUI定位和动作预测上的有效性。

Conclusion: 将动作相关推理隐式整合到状态表示中，可有效提升GUI动作预测性能，并展现出较好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate user instructions and screenshots into executable actions. To learn executable actions, existing approaches often rely on explicit reasoning during training, which encourage over-reliance on specific reasoning patterns rather than generalizable action-relevant information. In this paper, we propose an implicit framework, RISE, which integrates action-relevant reasoning into implicit state representations to guide GUI action prediction. To this end, action-relevant reasoning is captured through three complementary supervision objectives: full-CoT state alignment preserves information across the reasoning process, action-distribution alignment encodes action preferences, and reasoning-to-action boundary alignment captures the representation immediately before action generation. In this case, our RISE effectively learns informative implicit representations, thereby improving the accuracy of next-action token prediction. RISE achieves 70.6\% accuracy on OSWorld-G, establishing state-of-the-art performance among compared 8B models with a 4.3-point gain over its backbone. Results across two distinct backbones and six diverse benchmarks further demonstrate its effectiveness in GUI grounding and action prediction. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>


### [208] [RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32152)
*Zhuoying Yang,Jiachen Ni,Yichen Guo,Xiaoshan Wu,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出用于评估机器人世界模型生成视频物理合理性的五项指标，并构建智能体评估框架 RoboProbe 与基准 RP-Bench，以检测生成视频中的物理违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成视频常用于机器人动作提案与执行前评估，但当前视频生成器常产生物理上不合理的交互；仅依赖视觉语言模型的高层语义理解难以进行有证据支撑的时空物理推理，未检测的物理违规会导致对动作可行性和安全性的错误判断。

Method: 结合分割、跟踪、3D 几何或外观比较等时空证据与针对性 VLM 推理，设计五项定律特定指标：接触保真度、物体持久性、固体性、机器人形变和物体形变；在此基础上提出协调指标执行并通过受限动作选择性细化评估的智能体框架 RoboProbe；构建 RP-Bench，包含 761 个人工标注生成视频和 130 个真实演示，覆盖 12 个机器人数据集的 239 个操作任务。

Result: 在 RP-Bench 上，五项指标的 AUROC 均超过 0.85，并优于所评估的学习型评判器、先前评估器以及仅使用帧的 Gemini 基线；将指标应用于五种视频生成器后，发现不同模型在物理违规类型和频率上呈现明显差异。

Conclusion: 该指标套件与 RoboProbe 框架能够有效评估机器人世界模型生成视频的物理合理性，揭示不同生成器的物理违规模式，为可靠机器人规划中的动作评估提供支持。

Abstract: Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions. Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

</details>


### [209] [The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32116)
*Hao Zhou,Ziyang Xu,Chenhan Jin,Hao Qin,Shengze Xu,Tieyong Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究流式视频生成中切换场景并保持原主体时，缓存历史既维持主体又残留旧场景物体的问题，提出无训练方法 Molt Forcing。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频生成切换场景时，缓存历史有助于保持主体，但也会持续保留应消失的旧场景物体；现有 KV flush 和 attention sink 重计算仍无法去除旧物体，而直接替换为目标场景历史虽能去旧物却会改变主体。

Method: 通过对文本条件、去噪步骤、局部窗口和 attention sink 进行控制干预，分析缓存视觉历史保留旧内容的原因；提出 Molt Forcing：从冷启动的目标场景重建场景历史，同时选择性保留原始缓存中的主体 tokens，无需训练。

Result: 在 16 个场景族上，Molt Forcing 去除旧场景物体的可靠性至少与 Echo-Forcing 硬切相当，同时生成主体与切换前外观更接近。

Conclusion: 该方法能够解耦场景历史与主体身份，在流式视频生成中实现场景切换时去除旧场景内容并保持原主体外观。

Abstract: Switching scenes while preserving the original subject in streaming video generation exposes a conflict: cached history helps maintain the subject but also sustains old-scene objects that should disappear. Through controlled interventions on text conditioning, denoising steps, the local window, and the attention sink, we identify how cached visual history keeps this obsolete content. When the original frames remain in the cache, KV flush and sink recomputation still leave old-scene objects in the generated videos. Replacing this history with target-scene history largely removes those objects, but also changes the subject, reducing face similarity to the pre-switch subject. We then propose Molt Forcing, a training-free method that rebuilds scene history from a cold-start target scene while selectively retaining subject tokens from the original cache. Across 16 scene families, Molt Forcing removes old-scene objects at least as reliably as an Echo-Forcing hard cut while keeping the subject much closer to its pre-switch appearance.

</details>


### [210] [An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32114)
*Hien Minh Tran,Thi-Thu-Hien Pham,Le Duy Tan,Hieu Xuan Nguyen,Tuong-Anh Mai-Phan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个结合深度学习与解剖推理的自动化心脏CT表型分析框架，用于冠脉分割、冠脉钙化、PCAT和EAT定量，并在多个公开数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠CCTA分割不能保证测量在解剖上一致，因此需要可解释、标准化的自动框架来支持心脏CT队列的定量表型分析。

Method: 框架将深度学习与解剖推理结合：利用图几何、分支身份和周围结构定义血管特异性PCAT采样及替代性EAT区域，并无需专家心包轮廓即可生成训练目标；另有模块在非增强CT上量化冠脉钙化。在ImageCAS、ImageCAS-X、COCA、Visual Lab和MultiD4CAD五个公开数据集上进行分组件评测。

Result: 在ImageCAS-X Test-160上，管腔分割Dice为0.9133、clDice为0.940，超过已发表CAS-Net点估计；四折ImageCAS中四模型集成优于单一ResEnc-L；800对扫描显示全血管与管腔参考的PCAT衰减测量不同；外部EAT评估显示体积强相关且空间重叠良好。

Conclusion: 显式解剖规则使测量可解释、可检查；该框架为处理心脏CT队列及量化冠脉钙化、PCAT和EAT提供标准化流程，支持人群级分析和跨研究比较，代码已公开。

Abstract: Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) depicts coronary anatomy and cardiac fat, but segmentation alone does not ensure anatomically consistent measurements. We propose an automated framework that combines deep learning with anatomical reasoning for quantitative cardiac phenotyping. Its anatomical measurement module uses graph geometry, branch identity, and surrounding structures to define vessel-specific pericoronary adipose tissue (PCAT) sampling and a surrogate epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) compartment. The latter also generates training targets without requiring expert pericardium contours. A companion module quantifies coronary calcium on non-contrast CT. Component-wise benchmarking was conducted on five public datasets: ImageCAS, ImageCAS-X, COCA, Visual Lab, and MultiD4CAD. On ImageCAS-X Test-160, lumen segmentation with validation-selected post-processing achieved a Dice score of 0.9133 and a clDice score of 0.940, exceeding the corresponding published CAS-Net point estimates. In the four-split ImageCAS evaluation, the four-member ensemble outperformed the single ResEnc-L model. Analysis of 800 paired scans showed that PCAT attenuation measurements differed between whole-vessel and lumen references. External EAT evaluation showed strong volume correlation and good spatial overlap. Explicit anatomical rules make the resulting measurements interpretable and inspectable. In practice, the framework provides a standardized pipeline for processing cardiac CT cohorts and quantifying coronary calcium, PCAT, and EAT for population-level analysis and comparison across studies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HarryTRAN207/CardiacCT-Research

</details>


### [211] [Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32206)
*Qing Zhang,Xuesong Li,Zhaoyuan Yang,Changlin Song,Xinyu Tian,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在物体被移动后仍伸向训练位置的现象，称为“Seeing Is Not Reaching”，识别出场景捷径和指令捷径，并提出无需训练的Pathway-Separated Guidance（PSG）来增强视觉 grounding、抑制捷径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA本应继承视觉-语言模型的视觉 grounding，但实际常到达物体的训练位置而非当前位置。作者希望判断这种 grounding 是未被使用，还是被其他通路覆盖。

Method: 分析六种VLA，分别掩蔽图像介导的 grounding 通路和直接的指令到动作通路；提出PSG，通过放大 grounding 并抑制指令捷径来改善行为，无需训练或外部目标位置。

Result: 在π0.5中，即使物体名称注意力跟随移动目标，指令捷径仍存在。掩蔽 grounding 通路会消除对移动目标的到达，而掩蔽直接通路会增加。LIBERO-PRO Object位置扰动下，PSG将目标到达率从22.0%提升到52.6%，任务成功率从16.6%提升到40.8%，并基本保持原任务性能。

Conclusion: 视觉 grounding 已经能够指导动作，但常被通过直接通路起作用的指令捷径覆盖；PSG可在不训练的情况下增强 grounding 并抑制捷径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location.
