In $π_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

</details>


### [212] [GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32335)
*Weicong Zhang,Yuan Huang,Yu Zheng,Lin Chenxiao,Yingying Li,Lilong Fan,Liangdong Zhuang,Yufan Chen,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Jiaming Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GOLD-SLAM，一种结合全景相机与 LiDAR 深度先验的全向高斯泼溅 SLAM 系统，在球面域中完成跟踪与建图，并构建 WHOLE 数据集用于更广泛评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景相机可单帧覆盖近整个球面视场，但其覆盖范围与 LiDAR 视场不匹配，给依赖 LiDAR 深度先验的全景高斯泼溅 SLAM 带来挑战；同时增量建图存在新观测表面覆盖不足和漂浮伪影问题。

Method: GOLD-SLAM 在球面域中进行跟踪和建图，利用无 LiDAR 覆盖区域的跟踪视觉特征改进位姿估计；提出深度感知地图扩展与剪枝（DAEP）处理表面覆盖不足和漂浮伪影；采集 UAV 平台上的 WHOLE 数据集，覆盖弱几何、高动态、全向、低光和简单场景；并在 Jetson Orin NX 上评估嵌入式配置。

Result: 在公开基准和 WHOLE 数据集上，GOLD-SLAM 具有有竞争力的渲染质量和优于透视系统的几何精度；相比现有全景基线，平均 PSNR 提升 5.56-9.10 dB，平均 Depth-L1 降低 71.9-83.9%；Jetson Orin NX（16 GB）上可在线运行，但重建质量有所下降。

Conclusion: GOLD-SLAM 能有效结合全景视觉与 LiDAR 深度先验，实现高质量渲染和准确几何重建，并具备在 UAV 等资源受限平台部署的可行性，但需在实时性与重建质量之间权衡。

Abstract: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [213] [VIDE : Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32138)
*Kevin D. Nguetche,Atif Belal,Lilian Hollard,Eric Granger,Marco Pedersoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需训练的视觉内在分布估计框架 VIDE，用于基于嵌入的视频异常检测，通过利用测试视频自身的冻结片段嵌入来校正文本参考和异常方向，从而降低异常偏差与提示选择敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中正常片段可能与异常描述高度相似，产生异常偏差和误报；PRISM 等方法虽利用文本导出的正常参考和异常方向，但这些信息跨视频共享，未适应不同场景中正常活动和异常外观的变化，且得分对提示选择敏感。

Method: VIDE 采用免训练框架：用初始异常分数较低的片段估计正常场景内容，并部分校正文本参考；对类别响应进行重缩放，惩罚跨类别响应过强的片段；用高分片段细化异常方向；对多个提示视图的分数取平均以降低提示敏感性，并融合两个冻结编码器的分数。

Result: 在两个编码器融合下，VIDE 在 UCF-Crime、XD-Violence 和 MSAD 上的 AUC 分别比最佳 PRISM 结果提高 1.5、1.9 和 3.5 个百分点；XD-Violence 上 AP 提高 6.5 个百分点，MSAD 上提高 9.3 个百分点。VIDE 在三个基准上取得所比较免训练方法中最高的 AUC，并在 XD-Violence 和 MSAD 上取得所有比较方法中报告的最高 AUC。

Conclusion: VIDE 通过将文本导出的异常评分自适应到每个测试视频，有效缓解异常偏差和提示选择敏感问题，并在多个视频异常检测基准上优于现有免训练方法，部分基准上达到领先水平。

Abstract: In embedding-based video anomaly detection (VAD), normal clips can have high similarity to anomalous descriptions, an anomaly bias that leads to false positives. Methods such as PRISM mitigate this bias by measuring deviations from a normality reference along anomaly directions. Both the normality reference and the anomaly directions are derived from text and shared across videos, although normal activity and the appearance of anomalies vary across scenes. The resulting scores are also sensitive to prompt selection. To address these limitations, we propose Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation (VIDE), a training-free framework that adapts text-derived scoring to each test video using frozen clip embeddings. VIDE estimates normal scene content from clips with low initial anomaly scores and uses this estimate to partially correct the textual reference. It then rescales category responses, penalizes clips with strong responses across categories, and refines the anomaly directions using high-scoring clips. VIDE averages scores across prompt views to reduce sensitivity to prompt selection and fuses scores from two frozen encoders. With both encoders, VIDE improves AUC over the best PRISM result by $1.5$, $1.9$, and $3.5$ points on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, respectively, and AP by $6.5$ points on XD-Violence and $9.3$ points on MSAD. VIDE yields the highest AUC among the compared training-free methods on all three benchmarks and the highest reported AUC among all compared methods on XD-Violence and MSAD. Our code is included in the supplementary material and will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [214] [EditText: Structure-Aware Generation and Selective Visual Transport for Fine-Grained Text Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32134)
*Zhaobin Chu,Guandong Li,Xin Lv,Zhiwei Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 EditText，一个统一的细粒度文本编辑框架，将目标字符生成与源图像视觉信息迁移相结合，在替换指定文本的同时保持字体、颜色、纹理及未编辑区域视觉一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度文本编辑需要在准确替换指定区域文本的同时，保留源文本外观和未编辑区域的一致性。现有方法在源细节迁移、空间对齐和未编辑内容保持方面仍存在挑战，因此需要统一的目标字符生成与视觉迁移框架。

Method: EditText 使用双条件 Fill 输入：掩码图像和源文本风格参考，二者与目标图像共享空间参考。掩码图像隐藏原始文本并保留未编辑内容作为源画布，风格参考提供新字符生成的外观线索。论文提出 Attention Transport 框架，用 Source Weight 描述分配给条件的注意力，用 Spatial Aggregation Kernel 描述其内部空间注意力分布；对选定的非编辑查询，在保持掩码图像总注意力权重的同时，将其注意力重新分配到空间对应邻域，实现选择性视觉迁移。训练采用多阶段策略，并引入面向局部目标字符结构的 Glyph-aware Structural Loss。

Result: 论文提出 TBench，覆盖字母文字、表意文字和阿拉伯数字，用于评估字符更新、外观保持和未编辑细节保持。在 TBench 上，EditText 取得最先进的非编辑区域 SSIM（0.9769）和全图 LPIPS（0.0460）。

Conclusion: EditText 通过双条件输入、注意力迁移机制和字形感知结构损失，实现了准确的文本替换、源文本外观保持及未编辑细节保留，并在新基准 TBench 上取得领先性能。

Abstract: Fine-grained text editing aims to accurately replace text in a specified region while preserving the source text's font, color, and texture, as well as visual consistency in unedited regions. We present EditText, a unified framework for fine-grained text editing that combines target character generation with visual transport from the source image. The model uses dual-condition Fill inputs: a masked image and a source text style reference, both sharing a spatial reference with the target image. The masked image hides the original text and retains unedited content as a source canvas; the style reference supplies appearance cues that guide new character generation together with the target text. We introduce an Attention Transport framework in which Source Weight describes the attention allocated to a condition and the Spatial Aggregation Kernel describes its internal spatial attention distribution. Accurate transfer of source details depends on attention strength, the retention of details in condition features, and spatially accurate aggregation. For selected non-edit queries, we therefore preserve the total attention weight assigned to the masked image while redistributing its attention toward spatially corresponding neighborhoods, enabling selective visual transport. Multi-stage training, combined with a Glyph-aware Structural Loss on local target character structure, teaches the model to generate accurate text, preserve source text appearance, and retain unedited details. We also introduce TBench, a fine-grained text editing benchmark covering Alphabetic, Logographic, and Arabic numerals, to evaluate character updates, appearance preservation, and the preservation of unedited details. On TBench, EditText achieves state-of-the-art non-edit-region SSIM (0.9769) and full-image LPIPS (0.0460).

</details>


### [215] [Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32135)
*Onkar Jadhav,Tim French*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Med-PODiff，一种基于分块本征正交分解（POD）的扩散框架，用于脑 MRI 超分辨率重建，并可将预测不确定性分解为总、粗尺度与细尺度分量，以评估幻觉风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型用于医学图像重建/超分辨时可能产生难以仅凭重建图像识别的合理细尺度幻觉，因此需要可解释、可量化的不确定性来定位高风险区域。

Method: 在紧凑且可解释的局部 POD 系数空间中进行生成式重建，将低秩解剖变化与细细节残差变化分离；基于不确定性分解定义像素级幻觉风险分数 H_p，突出细细节不确定性主导粗结构不确定性的区域。

Result: 在脑 MRI 上，Med-PODiff 重建质量优于代表性扩散基线，预测区间校准良好；总不确定性检测高误差区域 AUROC 为 0.954，H_p 定位细误差 AUROC 为 0.906。粗/细不确定性具有尺度选择性，受控注入与回顾性 Cartesian k 空间欠采样验证了细细节定位和退化鲁棒性；丢弃的 POD 尾部仅占保留细误差幅度的 3.8%，并提升下游分割一致性且推理时间显著少于像素空间扩散。

Conclusion: Med-PODiff 通过 POD 系数空间扩散和尺度分解不确定性，在保持重建性能的同时提供可解释的幻觉风险评估，并能更高效地支持下游任务。

Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.

</details>


### [216] [ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32649)
*Qingle Liu,Jieming Li,Pei-lin Li,Shenghan Zheng,Ruize Yang,Sunqi Fan,Deyao Hong,Huan-ang Gao,Meng-Hao Guo,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出在线基准 ICLWorld 和统一测试框架 UIverse，评估智能体从数字世界到物理世界的上下文学习能力，覆盖电脑使用与机器人使用，发现前沿模型在电脑任务上表现较强、机器人任务上明显较弱，且存在“识别规则”与“执行规则”之间的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文学习基准多为离线、基于文本或静态图像，存在训练数据污染风险；机器人评估又多局限于方法级消融。因此，缺少统一评估智能体在电脑与机器人场景中从上下文学习新规则并泛化的在线基准。

Method: 构建 ICLWorld 在线基准及 UIverse 统一测试框架，将每个环境转化为用户界面；建立 30 个环境、630 段演示视频（10+ 小时）、160 个任务，任务规则定制且常反直觉，必须从上下文学习；每个任务提供文本或视频三种规则版本，并在回放演示、新实例和未见环境三个层级测试泛化；评估六个前沿模型。

Result: Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 在电脑使用任务成功率分别为 82% 和 76%，机器人使用仅 27% 和 26%；无规则对照成功率至多 8%。GPT-6 Astra 在电脑任务中三种规则版本均成功仅 38%，约为单一规则版本成功率的一半；机器人规则问答正确率达 98%，但任务完成率仅 20%。前沿智能体从视频和文本学习规则效果相近，并能跨环境迁移；较弱智能体依赖文本，演示情境重采样后视频学习成功大幅下降。

Conclusion: 研究表明数字世界与物理世界之间、以及识别规则与据此行动之间存在显著能力差距；ICLWorld/UIverse 为评估智能体在线上下文学习与跨环境泛化提供了统一测试手段。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.

</details>


### [217] [LaWanle: Why Can't Leading Driving Models Make a Simple Turn?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32650)
*Chengzhi Gao,Junzhe Gao,Yongzhi Liu,Weichao Zhuang,Weilong Hu,Taonian Liang,Guodong Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现，在 NAVSIM 上接近人类水平的端到端驾驶模型，在真实感闭环仿真器中却无法稳定完成简单 90 度转弯。作者构建 LaWanle 转弯基准，分析失败原因，并用闭环 DAgger 后训练显著提升转弯通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者惊讶地发现，主流端到端驾驶模型虽在 NAVSIM 上得分接近人类司机，却在闭环真实感仿真器中不能可靠完成简单 90 度转弯，因此希望探究其原因并提升闭环转弯能力。

Method: 构建 LaWanle 基准，从三个仿真器中采集转弯场景，并从多个起点测试同一模型；通过旋转车辆、修正规划航向等扰动分析失败敏感性；再对开源车道保持模型使用闭环 DAgger 后训练其横向路径，并测试跨基准迁移和恢复数据微调。

Result: 同一模型可能从某起点通过、从另一��点失败；进入路口前行驶表现相似，但路口入口几度旋转即可导致失败，而轻微航向修正可挽救约一半失败转弯。仅训练 5% 参数即可将转弯通过率从 19% 提升到 76%，并迁移到另外两个基准且达到领先水平。恢复数据微调能修复训练过的偏差，但与等时长对照相比未提升三个基准上的转弯表现。

Conclusion: 简单 90 度转弯暴露了端到端驾驶模型在闭环仿真中的脆弱性，微小航向误差会显著影响成败；闭环 DAgger 横向路径后训练是有效改进手段，但恢复数据微调未带来转弯泛化提升，所有变体仍远低于人类司机。

Abstract: We were surprised to find that leading end-to-end driving models across major paradigms, despite scoring close to human drivers on NAVSIM, cannot reliably make a simple 90-degree turn in photorealistic closed-loop simulators. To investigate why, we build LaWanle, a benchmark of turns drawn from three such simulators. Driving each turn from several starts, we find that the same model passes it from one start and fails it from another, and that the two drives look alike until they enter the junction. Rotating the car by a few degrees at the junction entry can fail a turn it otherwise passes. Conversely, a slight heading correction to the plans can rescue about half of the failed turns we tested. Such errors arise when a model drives by itself, so we post-train an open-source lane-keeping model with closed-loop DAgger on its lateral path. Training 5% of its parameters is enough to raise its turn pass rate from 19% to 76%. The gain transfers to the two other benchmarks, where the policy also scores among the leading models. Further fine-tuning on recovery data repairs the deviations it is trained on but, against a control trained equally long, improves turns on none of the three benchmarks, and every variant stays far below a human driver.

</details>


### [218] [LiteSTAR: Low-Rank Channel Modulation for Temporally Consistent CVD Video Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32140)
*Peiyang Lin,Sichen Lin,Yipeng Liao,Liqun Lin,Xu Wang,Tiesong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种轻量级视频重着色方法 LiteSTAR，通过低秩状态空间时序滤波和通道自适应解码实现无显式跨帧对齐的时序一致重着色，并发布首个自我中心视频 CVD 重着色基准 EgoCVDSet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 色觉缺陷（CVD）人群规模大，实际重着色需在设备端持续运行；逐帧视频重着色会产生颜色闪烁，而现有方法依赖像素或特征空间中的高成本跨帧对齐。

Method: 观察到颜色闪烁与通道响应变化相关且颜色敏感变化集中在低秩子空间，提出以 LiCaD 为核心的可插拔轻量通道自适应解码器：在低秩状态空间中进行时序滤波并学习过程与观测不确定性，随后调制特征通道以保持时序一致性；LiteSTAR 还采用自适应 patch 路由提升 CVD 用户颜色区分度并避免过度增强。

Result: LiteSTAR 仅 0.05M 参数即在定量与定性实验中取得更优性能；LiCaD 在不同任务和网络架构上表现出较强泛化能力；同时引入首个自我中心视频 CVD 重着色基准 EgoCVDSet。

Conclusion: LiteSTAR 能在轻量条件下实现时序一致且自适应的视频重着色，避免显式跨帧对齐，并具备良好的可插拔性与泛化性。

Abstract: Color Vision Deficiency (CVD) affects a large population worldwide, yet practical recoloring must run continuously on-device. Frame-wise video recoloring produces color flickering, while existing methods rely on costly cross-frame alignment in pixel or feature space. We observe that color flickering correlates with variations in channel-wise responses, with color-sensitive variations concentrated in a low-rank subspace. Based on this observation, we propose Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Recoloring (LiteSTAR), built around LiCaD, a plug-and-play Lightweight Channel-Adaptive Decoder. LiCaD performs temporal filtering in a low-rank state space with learned process and observation uncertainties. It then modulates feature channels to achieve temporal consistency without explicit spatial alignment. LiteSTAR further employs adaptive patch routing to improve color discrimination for CVD users while avoiding unnecessary over-enhancement. We also introduce EgoCVDSet, the first egocentric video benchmark for CVD recoloring. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that LiteSTAR achieves superior performance with only 0.05M parameters. LiCaD further demonstrates strong generalization across different tasks and network architectures. The code, models, and dataset will be released after review.

</details>


### [219] [CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32144)
*Iman Marivani,David Van Hamme,Jan Aelterman,Wilfried Philips*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与Vision Mamba状态空间骨干结合，用于多对比度MRI超分辨率重建，在IXI数据集上取得优于现有方法的重建质量与较高计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有纯数据驱动深度网络虽性能强，但多对比度融合机制多为启发式拼接或黑盒注意力，缺乏理论支撑；基于模型的深度展开网络虽具可解释融合先验，却受限于浅层卷积，难以捕获全局上下文。

Method: 提出CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与Vision Mamba状态空间骨干统一：通过展开稀疏编码融合参考模态中的共同结构先验，并利用Mamba骨干对对比度特定表示进行全局细化，实现可解释的模型引导融合与长程空间建模。

Result: 在IXI数据集上的实验表明，CSC-MAMBA在重建质量上优于现有最先进方法，PSNR最高提升0.62 dB，同时保持较高的计算效率。

Conclusion: CSC-MAMBA有效弥合了可解释的模型引导融合与长程空间上下文建模之间的差距，为多对比度MRI超分辨率提供了一种高性能且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.

</details>


### [220] [Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33010)
*Xuanchen Liu,Hejun Zhang,Boxuan Dong,Ying Wu,Heshuai Li,Wen Gao,Yonghong Tian,Weihao Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，检验机器人操作策略在含镜面反射场景中的表现，发现多种策略成功率显著下降，并分析其失败机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受动物镜像自我认知测试启发，探究机器人策略能否在包含自身或物体反射的真实场景中可靠操作；镜面既可能造成视觉干扰，也可能是物理障碍。

Method: 基于 RoboDojo 构建基准，保持任务目标、成功标准和策略检查点，比较无镜基线、单镜、双镜和镜面桌面条件；评估5种策略，涵盖 Vision-Language-Action 模型、World Action Models 和 agentic policies；并与几何匹配的非反射面板对比，结合轨迹与接触分析、针对性诊断，以及 π0.5 和 FastWAM 真机实验。

Result: 所有镜面条件均降低聚合成功率，三种条件平均下降10.8至56.7个百分点，镜面桌面最高下降62.5个百分点；50%至88%的镜面特有失败没有记录到机器人与面板接触，说明直接碰撞不能完全解释退化；轨迹和接触分析显示对反射物体的幻影瞄准及真实物体空间定位错误；真机实验也显示成功率下降。

Conclusion: 多种机器人策略对反射环境存在共同脆弱性，直接碰撞并非主要原因，未来需将反射感知纳入具身智能评估。

Abstract: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

</details>


### [221] [Let The Pixels Through: Rethinking Long Skip Connections for Scalable Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32151)
*Jiachen Lei,Jiahong Wu,XiangXiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过改进现有像素原生扩散模型设计，提出一种简单的像素扩散Transformer架构，可从头训练并平滑扩展到1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256/512上取得1.62/1.70 FID，并支持文本到图像等多模态生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素扩散模型的训练仍较复杂，依赖经验性训练配方和架构设计，且对超参数选择敏感。作者希望在不依赖复杂技巧的情况下构建强去噪器。

Method: 作者重新审视U-Net中的长跳跃连接，发现其优化收益并非去噪收益所必需，且传统将跳跃分支与主干特征线性组合的方式难以适应不同噪声水平。为此提出两项核心修改：采用非对称长跳跃连接，将输入嵌入中的细粒度信息传递到解码层；在解码层引入adaGLU（类似SwiGLU的MLP块），在嵌入信息加入主分支前进行自适应过滤。由此形成简单的像素扩散Transformer架构。

Result: 该架构从头训练时从小规模基线平滑扩展到1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256和ImageNet-512上分别达到1.62和1.70 FID。它原生支持文本和图像等多模态输入，在文本到图像生成中取得有竞争力的性能，并开源代码。

Conclusion: 通过精炼像素原生设计中的跳跃连接和特征融合方式，可以构建简单、可扩展且多模态能力强的像素扩散Transformer，验证了强去噪器无需复杂经验配方即可实现。

Abstract: Training pixel diffusion models remains less straightforward, owing to the ad hoc training recipes and architecture designs, along with the sensitivity to hyper-parameter choices. We show that strong denoisers can be built by refining existing pixel-native designs from the literature. Specifically, we revisit the long skip connection in U-Net and find that the optimization benefit commonly attributed to it is not necessary for its denoising benefit. We further find that the conventional linear combination of features from the skip and main backbone is inadequate for regimes of various noise levels. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two core modifications. First, we adopt asymmetric long skips, which propagate fine-grained information from input embeddings to decoder layers. Second, we introduce adaGLU, a SwiGLU-like MLP block, in decoder layers to adaptively filter information from the embeddings before being added to main-branch features. The above designs give a simple pixel diffusion transformer architecture. When trained from scratch, it scales smoothly from small-scale baselines up to 1.6B parameters, achieving 1.62 and 1.70 FID on ImageNet-256 and -512, respectively. Besides, it natively supports multimodal inputs, such as text and images, yielding competitive performance in text-to-image generation. We release our codes at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/PiT

</details>


### [222] [DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32176)
*Zihan Huang,Junle Liu,Zhonghao Ye,Yuyi Zhang,Peirong Zhang,Hanlin Li,Yongxin Shi,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出文档外观增强方法 DocPristine，利用冻结的文档视觉编码器提供的文本区域注意力作为内容感知引导，并通过多尺度特征融合与跨窗口注意力提升退化文档的像素恢复质量，同时构建 DocACE 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机拍摄文档常出现高光、阴影和模糊等混合退化，影响可读性和下游文档解析。现有方法依赖可能失真的输入视觉线索，或依赖缺乏空间引导的 LLM 退化诊断，因此需要更可靠的内容感知引导。

Method: 作者发现预训练文档视觉编码器在退化文档中仍关注文本区域，于是提出 DocPristine：自适应融合冻结文档视觉编码器的多层特征，并注入像素恢复网络；具体包括自适应多层特征融合（AMFF）、分层门控条件化（HGC）和移位窗口交叉注意力（SWCA）。同时构建 DocACE，包含合成混合退化训练集 DocACE-Synthetic 和带人工修复真值及文档解析标注的真实测试集 DocACE-Real。

Result: 在三个基准上的综合实验表明，DocPristine 取得最先进的文档外观增强质量，并持续提升下游文档解析性能。

Conclusion: 利用预训练文档视觉编码器的内容感知注意力引导，可有效解决混合退化下的文档外观增强问题，并为后续文档解析提供更高质量输入；代码、模型和数据将公开。

Abstract: Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. To integrate these features into a pixel restoration network, DocPristine combines Adaptive Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (AMFF), Hierarchical Gated Conditioning (HGC), and Shifted-Window Cross-Attention (SWCA). Specifically, SWCA draws on structural cues from neighboring locations across window boundaries to recover fine text details.We also introduce DocACE, with a synthetic mixed-degradation training set (DocACE-Synthetic) and a real-world test set (DocACE-Real) containing manually restored ground-truth images and document parsing annotations. Comprehensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate that DocPristine achieves state-of-the-art appearance enhancement quality and consistently improves downstream document parsing. Code, models, and data will be publicly available.

</details>


### [223] [DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32846)
*Hugo Hadfield,Alperen Degirmenci,Jonathan Tremblay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DOPER 是一个仅用 RGB 的 6D 姿态估计框架，通过共享视觉骨干联合进行目标检测、分割和关键点预测，并利用 PnP 恢复已知物体姿态；在多个数据集上取得 SOTA 检测 AP，并实现实时运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 6D 姿态估计方法常依赖深度输入或学习式姿态精化，且合成到真实域的适应、部分监督和多视图几何约束利用不足；研究希望仅用 RGB 实现准确、实时且可泛化的已知物体姿态估计。

Method: DOPER 共享视觉骨干联合学习检测、分割和关键点预测；从合成训练开始，利用真实观测的部分监督并保留合成关键点标签进行域适应；使用标定多视图观测提供关键点几何约束；推理时可选热图精化，将刚性姿态直接拟合到预测关键点分布以处理模糊对应；并从欠定义 CAD 模型逐步细化物体表示和姿态估计器。

Result: 在 SPEED+ 和 SHIRT 上有效适应光照变化并实现准确时序姿态估计；在 HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D 和 T-LESS 的单视图与多视图配置中取得 SOTA 检测 AP；仅使用 RGB，并在单张 GB300 上达到每个物体模型 35 Hz 的实时性能。

Conclusion: 联合学习目标检测与姿态关键点，并结合真实观测和几何约束，是提升仅 RGB 6D 姿态估计效果的有效途径。

Abstract: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.

</details>


### [224] [SoccerNarrate: Event-Grounded Streaming Soccer Commentary with Macro-Window Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32153)
*Zihan Jia,Zhilin Dai,Zhengming Zhang,Min Yang,Zhenpeng Huang,Jiaqi Li,Caixia Sun,Xi Chen,Liang Li,Junlan Feng,Gangshan Wu,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SoccerNarrate，面向未剪辑整场足球视频的低延迟流式解说，通过数据、训练和评测三方面实现事件驱动的专业足球解说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有片段式足球解说模型在整场视频上存在延迟、重复和同步差的问题；流式视频语言模型虽能低延迟解说，但偏向通用描述，难以及时准确提及进球、红黄牌、换人、越位等关键事件。

Method: 构建SoccerNarrate-Data大规模时间锚定数据集，含词级ASR对齐、质量过滤和实体校准；提出宏窗口偏好对齐（MWPA），基于同一流式前缀比较多步因果 rollout 以对齐完整事件级解说语义，并用事件不匹配的人类解说作为反事实负例；构建基于时间约束事件蕴含的SoccerNarrate-Eval事件中心基准。

Result: 整场比赛实验表明，SoccerNarrate在事件覆盖率和事件对齐精确率上优于强离线与流式基线。

Conclusion: SoccerNarrate有效桥接低延迟流式解说与事件驱动的专业足球解说，在数据、训练和评测层面均取得改进，并开源代码与模型。

Abstract: Existing clip-based soccer commentary models often produce delayed, repeated, or poorly synchronized narration on untrimmed full-match videos. Recent streaming video-language models make low-latency full-match narration feasible, but they often favor general descriptions rather than professional, event-grounded soccer commentary. They may describe nearby actions while failing to mention key events such as goals, cards, substitutions, and offsides correctly and on time. In this paper, we present SoccerNarrate to bridge low-latency streaming narration with event-grounded professional soccer commentary across data, training, and evaluation. First, we construct SoccerNarrate-Data, a large-scale time-anchored dataset with word-level ASR alignment, quality filtering, and entity calibration. Second, we perform macro-window preference alignment (MWPA), which aligns the model with complete event-level commentary semantics by comparing causal multi-step rollouts from the same streaming prefix while keeping second-level inference unchanged. We further use event-mismatched human commentaries as counterfactual negatives to emphasize event semantics over commentary style. Third, we introduce SoccerNarrate-Eval, an event-centric benchmark based on temporally constrained event entailment. Full-match experiments show that SoccerNarrate improves event coverage and event-aligned precision over strong offline and streaming baselines. Code and models are released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SoccerNarrate.

</details>


### [225] [MediaStormBench-CameraLog: Can Multimodal Models Identify a Camera's Log Curve?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32172)
*Ming Ma,Wenhao Hu,Qichao Wang,Yuhao Wang,Junpeng Zhao,Qiyi Wang,Fangrui Zhang,Zhiqian Lai,Shanxin Guan,Haoyi Pei,Hongan Chen,Rui Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MediaStormBench 的多模态基准，并发布首个子集 CameraLogBench，用于测试模型能否在无元数据条件下从画面识别 Log 曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Log 曲线通常只存于元数据，转码和交接中易丢失；调色师需逐一尝试候选曲线，选错会改变整段画面的色调和色彩。仅凭图像恢复曲线很难，因为厂商曲线码值分布接近且与未知曝光耦合。

Method: 基于专业拍摄素材构建基准，测试多模态模型识别 Log 曲线；设置移除正确选项的探针以暴露先验猜测；并基于厂商公开公式设计四项控制：分级负样本、同场景合成帧、上下文规格摘要、免训练公式基线，以解耦语义先验与光度测量。

Result: 在 11 个模型上，真实素材准确率仅略高于始终猜最常见曲线；移除正确选项后模型几乎从不弃答，显示严重依赖场景和品牌先验。提供厂商规格能显著提升校准图识别，但在缺乏光度参考的自然图像上帮助有限，暴露“读规格”与“测像素”之间的差距。

Conclusion: 多模态模型在该任务上仍难以可靠识别 Log 曲线，主要依赖先验而非光度测量；CameraLogBench 揭示了规格理解与像素级测量之间的关键缺口。

Abstract: MediaStormBench is a multimodal benchmark for real-world film and television production, with each subset drawn from MediaStorm's day-to-day work. We release its first subset, MediaStormBench-CameraLog (CameraLogBench), on a common foundational task in footage ingest and initial color grading: identifying the Log curve of a clip without metadata. Cameras record Log footage by compressing a wide range of scene light into code values with a vendor-defined logarithmic curve, and color can be restored correctly only once that curve is known. The curve, however, is recorded only in file metadata, easily lost in transcoding and team hand-offs. A colorist then has to try candidate curves one by one against a waveform scope, and a wrong choice shifts the tones and colors of the whole clip. Recovering the curve from the image alone is challenging, because vendor curves cluster tightly in code value and are coupled with unknown exposure. CameraLogBench is built on professionally shot footage and tests whether multimodal models can identify the curve, with a probe that removes the correct option to expose guessing from priors. Because every candidate curve is strictly defined by a published vendor formula, we derive four controls from one implementation of these formulas: graded negatives, synthetic frames of identical scenes, in-context specification digests, and a training-free formula baseline, which together decouple semantic priors from photometric measurement. Across 11 models, real-footage accuracy barely exceeds always guessing the most frequent curve; when the correct option is removed, models almost never abstain, revealing heavy reliance on scene and brand priors. Supplying the vendor specification sharply improves recognition on calibrated charts but hardly helps on natural images without a photometric reference, exposing a gap between reading a specification and measuring pixels.

</details>


### [226] [LoopFit: Retrofitting Pretrained Diffusion Transformers with Recurrent Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32175)
*Xiaocheng Lu,Haoxi Li,Dazhao Du,Tao Han,Jian Liu,Hao Chen,Bohai Gu,Siyu Yan,Jingcai Guo,Jie Zhang,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 LoopFit，通过循环复用 Transformer 块来增加扩散 Transformer 每个去噪步骤内的计算量，使预训练模型无需重新预训练即可获得更强的迭代细化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增加扩散 Transformer 的采样步数能提升效果，但每个去噪预测的深度不变；循环复用 Transformer 块可在单步内增加计算并进一步细化隐表示。问题在于，预训练模型原本按固定深度学习，如何让额外前向传递纠正局部误差而不破坏已有结构。

Method: LoopFit 利用前次传递的反馈指导每个图像块的细化：Residual Attention Modulation（RAM）用图像块一次传递中的特征变化来缩放和偏移下一次注意力输入；Residual Relay Loss（RRL）在训练中更重视跨多次传递仍持续存在预测误差的图像块；并采用随噪声变化的深度调度，高噪声时用四次传递、低噪声时用一次以加速采样。

Result: 在可比成本下，用四次传递训练的骨干网络通过循环深度比增加采样步数解决更多问题。在 12 个视觉谜题设置中，LoopFit 解决 89.8% 的棋盘，最强基线为 87.8%；主要增益来自迷宫和 frozen lakes 中长路径追踪。

Conclusion: LoopFit 表明循环深度可作为扩散 Transformer 中替代额外采样步数的有效扩展方式，并能在不重复预训练的情况下改造预训练模型，提升复杂视觉推理任务表现。

Abstract: Scaling inference computation offers a way to improve diffusion transformers (DiTs), but taking more sampling steps leaves the depth of each denoising prediction unchanged. Recurrently reusing Transformer blocks increases computation within each step, allowing further refinement of hidden representations. Retrofitting pretrained models enables this capability without repeating pretraining, but requires blocks learned for fixed-depth computation to refine states produced by their own repeated application. The challenge is to use each additional pass to correct local errors without disrupting the structure established by earlier passes. We introduce LoopFit, which uses feedback from earlier passes to guide refinement at each image patch. Residual Attention Modulation (RAM) uses each patch's feature change in one pass to scale and shift its input to attention in the next. During training, Residual Relay Loss (RRL) gives greater weight to patches whose prediction errors persist across passes. A noise-dependent depth schedule speeds up sampling by using four passes at high noise and one at lower noise levels. At comparable cost, backbones trained with four passes solve more problems using recurrent depth than extra sampling steps. Across 12 visual puzzle settings, LoopFit solves 89.8% of boards, compared with 87.8% for the strongest baseline evaluated on all 12. Most of the gain comes from tracing long paths on mazes and frozen lakes.

</details>


### [227] [Query-Guided Visual Minimization for Selective Disclosure to Cloud VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32302)
*Pedram Zaree,Kleomenis Katevas,Vandana Rajan,Nael Abu-Ghazaleh,Hamed Haddadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究查询引导的视觉最小化：在图像发送给云端视觉语言模型前，由本地可信变换仅保留与查询相关的视觉内容，以减少不必要隐私泄露，并提出 QGVM 框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端 VLM 需要上传图像，可能暴露查询并不需要的敏感信息；现有与查询无关的匿名化无法根据查询需求保留或抑制同一敏感内容，因此需要区分视觉相关性与披露必要性。

Method: QGVM 将查询 grounding 与独立的敏感项清单结合，在类型、实例和文本内容层面判断披露必要性，并生成最小化图像供黑盒下游 VLM 使用；评估任务效用、可直接恢复的敏感信息和推断性地理位置泄露。

Result: 在 GPT-6.1 Sol 上，QGVM 的 DoxBench 答案正确率为 85.3%，高于 PGP 的 77.5%；1 公里内地理定位攻击成功率为 5.8%，低于未保护图像的 25.7%；Scene-Privacy 人脸再识别率从 27.7% 降至 4.5%；BIV-Priv-Seg 私有文本恢复率从 33.9% 降至 15.3%；配对查询披露切换正确率为 69.6%，高于仅 grounding 裁剪的 29.1%。

Conclusion: 结果表明区分视觉相关性与披露必要性有价值，QGVM 能在保持任务效用的同时减少敏感披露，但也揭示了选择性视觉披露中的隐私-效用权衡。

Abstract: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) require sending images beyond the user's local trust boundary, potentially exposing sensitive information the query does not need. We study query-guided visual minimization: a trusted local transformation preserves query-relevant visual content and reduces unnecessary disclosure before transmission. Unlike query-agnostic anonymization, it preserves the same sensitive content when the query requires it and suppresses it otherwise. We introduce QGVM, a framework that combines query grounding with an independent sensitive-item inventory, determines disclosure necessity at the type, instance, and text-content levels, and renders a minimized image for a black-box downstream VLM. We evaluate QGVM on complementary benchmarks measuring task utility, directly recoverable sensitive information, and inferential geolocation leakage. With OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, QGVM achieves 85.3% DoxBench answer correctness versus 77.5% for PGP, while a separately prompted Sol geolocation attacker succeeds within 1 km on 5.8% of QGVM images versus 25.7% of unprotected images. On Scene-Privacy, QGVM reduces face re-identification from 27.7% (PGP) to 4.5%. On held-out BIV-Priv-Seg, unnecessary private-text recovery falls from 33.9% (PGP) to 15.3%. To verify that disclosure is query-dependent, we evaluate paired queries that either require or do not require the same sensitive information. QGVM achieves 69.6% correct disclosure switching, compared with 29.1% for grounding-only cropping. These findings highlight the value of distinguishing visual relevance from disclosure necessity, while revealing the privacy-utility trade-offs of selective visual disclosure.

</details>


### [228] [Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32171)
*Seonghyun Jin,Youngmin Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文分析了几何旋转位置编码中频率波段设置未标准化的问题，指出这会改变多视图基准排名，并给出频率波段设置与梯度稳定性的实践指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何RoPE将3D相机几何引入多视图注意力，但其频率波段常沿用2D RoPE默认值或随注意力头维度指数增长，缺乏统一标准，可能导致不公平或误导性的基准比较。

Method: 作者在RealEstate10K新视图合成和双视图深度估计任务上，通过改变模型规模、注意力头维度、频率数量和频率范围进行受控实验，并分析前向旋转平滑与反向深度梯度之间的不对称性。

Result: 在47M模型上RayRoPE可匹配最强基线，但在25M模型上落后1.2 dB；固定模型宽度仅改变头大小时也出现排名反转。48通道下用四个频率填充243倍范围可恢复0.9 dB差距。过窄波段会模糊对应关系，过宽波段会因高频深度梯度未阻尼而损害RayRoPE，仅阻断这些梯度可恢复90–93%的PSNR损失。

Conclusion: 频率波段应标准化报告与匹配；建议在图像坐标中设置波段、在小头中填充频率跨度，并避免无条件的同视图阻尼；前向平滑不能保证反向稳定性。

Abstract: Geometric rotary position encodings (RoPE) incorporate 3D camera geometry into multi-view attention by rotating token features according to viewing rays, depths, and reprojected image coordinates. Each coordinate is rotated across a progression of frequencies--its frequency band--yet existing implementations leave this band to inherited defaults, either retaining standard 2D RoPE's top frequency or letting the frequency span grow exponentially with the attention head dimension. We show that this unstandardized setting can reverse benchmark rankings. In novel view synthesis on RealEstate10K, RayRoPE matches the strongest baseline in the 47M model (144-channel heads), yet trails by 1.2 dB in the 25M model (48-channel heads), and exhibits the same reversal when varying head size alone at fixed model width. Populating a 243x range with four frequencies instead of the 3x default at 48 channels recovers 0.9 dB of that gap. Across view synthesis and two-view depth estimation, overly narrow bands consistently blur correspondence, whereas all three projection-based encodings perform reliably when their top frequency lies within 0.3--3 rotations per 8-pixel patch (10--90 rotations across 256x256 RealEstate10K). At the opposite extreme, overly wide bands degrade RayRoPE through a forward-backward asymmetry: averaging rotations over a predicted depth interval damps high frequencies in the forward pass, yet leaves their gradients with respect to predicted depth undamped. Blocking only those high-frequency depth gradients recovers 90--93% of the lost PSNR, showing that forward smoothing does not guarantee backward stability. Guided by this analysis, we distill practical guidelines--setting bands in image coordinates, populating spans in small heads, and avoiding unconditional same-view damping--and advocate reporting and matching frequency bands in future multi-view benchmarks.

</details>


### [229] [A recursive self-improvement framework for electron microscopy analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32325)
*Yaotian Yang,Sijia Tao,Yuping Zhang,Jiangjie Qiu,Qinghua Zhang,Xiao Chen,Fei Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhyEvo-Mic-RSI框架，将物理先验与专家反馈结合，通过递归自我改进把一次性人工修正转化为可复用、可验证的显微图像分析能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子显微图像中缺陷和界面的局域原子结构解析高度依赖研究者判断，效率低且标准主观，现有模型和脚本难以积累专家知识。

Method: 构建物理引导、专家知情的递归自我改进框架，利用版本化继承更新可执行算子、参数和路由规则；根据图像特征无专家标签选择分析路径，并在固定预算下测试和继承代码更新。

Result: 在原子点缺陷检测上优于更大模型；在10%面积预算内将跨材料界面覆盖率从5.13%提升至72.11%；迁移到未见研究显微图时，通过对齐粒子级测量优化，进一步分离相互接触的纳米颗粒。

Conclusion: 该工作推动计算显微学从独立模型和静态脚本走向可自我进化平台，能够持续积累人类科学专家知识。

Abstract: Resolving local atomic structures such as defects and interfaces from electron microscopy contrast relies heavily on researcher judgement, leading to low efficiency and subjective standards. Here we present PhyEvo-Mic-RSI, a physics-guided and expert-informed recursive self-improvement framework that turns one-off human corrections into reusable, verifiable capabilities by updating executable operators, parameters and routing rules with versioned inheritance. Given researcher-defined tasks, the system selects analysis paths from image features without expert labels, while testing and inheriting code updates under fixed budgets. Combining physical priors with expert feedback improves atomic point-defect detection over larger models and raises cross-material interface coverage from 5.13% to 72.11% within a 10% area budget. Adapting the framework to micrographs from unseen studies further separates touching nanoparticles by aligning optimization with particle-level measurements. This work moves computational microscopy beyond standalone models and static scripts towards self-evolving platforms that accumulate human scientific expertise

</details>


### [230] [SolarFilNet-V4: Multi-Scale Transformer Vision with Physics-Informed Adaptive Post-Processing for Solar Filament Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32193)
*Indra Agustian,Ruvita Faurina*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SolarFilNet-V4，一种面向 GONG H-alpha 全日面观测的太阳暗条分割框架，用于 MAGFiLO 1.0 基准。模型结合 PVT-v2-B1、各向异性曲线条带卷积、双频前馈模块和全分辨率卷积分支，并通过多任务监督与测试时增强提升细长暗条及边缘结构的分割效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太阳暗条是承载于极性反转线上方的冷而致密色球等离子体结构，其失稳可触发日冕物质抛射和严重空间天气灾害。从 2048×2048 的 GONG H-alpha 图像中分割单个暗条很困难，原因包括低对比度、湍流纤维结构、精细倒钩结构以及标注者边界差异。

Method: 方法以轻量级 Pyramid Vision Transformer（PVT-v2-B1）为骨干，引入 k=15 的各向异性曲线条带卷积和双频前馈块（DFFN），以跟踪延伸磁通绳并捕捉细中心脊线；使用 1024×1024 的浅层全分辨率卷积分支保留高频边缘细节并缓解 Transformer 下采样问题。训练采用掩膜、中心线脊线、倒钩边界和像素对比表示的多任务监督；测试时使用 8 折二面体测试时增强（D4）、双线性上采样至原始 2048×2048 网格，并采用活动自适应后处理校准宁静/活动太阳圆盘的形态学连接参数。

Result: 在官方基准上，SolarFilNet-V4 取得折外验证 Panoptic Quality 0.4340 和公共排行榜分数 0.380。模型包含 15.46M 参数，每次前向传播需 224.34 GFLOPs，相比标准 ResNet-34 U-Net 基线参数数量减少 36.8%。

Conclusion: SolarFilNet-V4 通过针对暗条细长、低对比度和精细边界结构的设计，在 MAGFiLO 1.0 基准上实现了有效分割，并保持较轻量的参数规模，为太阳暗条自动分割提供了面向基准的解决方案。

Abstract: Solar filaments are cool, dense chromospheric plasma structures held by magnetic field lines above polarity inversion lines. Their destabilization triggers coronal mass ejections and severe space weather hazards. Segmenting individual filaments from ground-based GONG H-alpha observations (2048 x 2048 pixels) is challenging due to low contrast, turbulent fibrils, delicate barb structures, and annotator boundary variance. In this technical report, we describe SolarFilNet-V4, a targeted segmentation framework developed for the MAGFiLO 1.0 benchmark (Solar Filament Segmentation Challenge 2026). Our method couples a lightweight Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT-v2-B1) backbone with anisotropic curvilinear strip convolutions (k=15) and dual-frequency feed-forward blocks (DFFN) to follow extended flux ropes while capturing thin central spines. A shallow full-resolution convolutional branch operating at 1024 x 1024 preserves high-frequency edge details and mitigates transformer downsampling. We train the network using multi-task supervision over masks, centerline spines, barb boundaries, and pixel-contrastive representations. At test time, we apply 8-fold dihedral test-time augmentation (D4), bilinearly upscale predictions to the native 2048 x 2048 grid, and apply an activity-adaptive post-processing routine that calibrates morphological joining parameters for quiet versus active solar disks. On the official benchmark, SolarFilNet-V4 achieves an out-of-fold validation Panoptic Quality of 0.4340 and a Public Leaderboard score of 0.380. The model contains 15.46M parameters and requires 224.34 GFLOPs per forward pass, reducing parameter count by 36.8% compared to standard ResNet-34 U-Net baselines.

</details>


### [231] [What to Change, What to Keep: Experience-Evolving Agents for Video Recasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32196)
*Shiying Zhang,Yuxia Zhu,Huaze Xue,Shengqi Dang,Yizhen Wu,Yijie Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 RecastAgent，一个在冻结模型权重下运行、由经验引导的智能体框架，用于源条件视频重铸，即将现有视频中的实体和环境转换为新视觉世界，同时保留关键动作与交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频重铸中，协调编辑容易破坏原始事件结构，因此如何在保持源视频结构与语义的前提下实现连贯转换仍具挑战。

Method: 提出 Experience-Guided Planner，在定性视觉评价下选择编辑提示和输入视频状态，支持基于部分进展继续或回退以保留源结构；设计 Experience Accumulation 模块，将完成轨迹蒸馏为带证据关联的条件化原则，记录编辑策略及适用范围；构建包含 67 个源视频、134 个配对规范任务、覆盖 6 个创意类别的基准。

Result: 实验表明 RecastAgent 在 Bernini 和 Ditto 上优于单次生成与智能体重写基线；积累经验可提升在留出测试视频上的表现，并能零样本迁移到 FiVE-Bench 和 VE-Bench 等外部基准。

Conclusion: 经验引导的智能体式视频重铸框架能在不更新模型权重的情况下实现更连贯的源条件视频转换，且积累的经验具有泛化和迁移能力。

Abstract: Video recasting aims to transform the entities and environments of existing videos into new visual worlds while preserving their essential actions and interactions. However, achieving coherent transformations remains challenging, as coordinated edits can disrupt the original event structure. In this paper, we introduce RecastAgent, an experience-guided agentic framework for source-conditioned video recasting that operates under frozen model weights. Our framework employs an Experience-Guided Planner to choose edit prompts and input video states under qualitative visual critique, allowing the agent to build upon partial progress or backtrack to preserve source structure. Across tasks, an Experience Accumulation module distills completed trajectories into conditional, evidence-linked principles that record both an editing strategy and its scope of validity. We additionally construct a benchmark of 67 source videos with 134 paired-specification tasks across six creative categories for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that RecastAgent outperforms single-pass and agentic rewriting baselines across Bernini and Ditto. Furthermore, accumulated experience improves performance on held-out test videos and transfers zero-shot to external benchmarks like FiVE-Bench and VE-Bench.

</details>


### [232] [VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32967)
*Rafay Mohiuddin,Jiaqi Chen,Marc Pollefeys,Hermann Blum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 VidForce，可从第三人称 RGB 视频估计人与物体的交互轨迹及力剖面，并利用有限仪器测量学习物理原型作为先验，在真实视频和机器人部署中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类可通过观察他人交互预判物体运动和所需努力，但让具身智能体从视频获得这种理解仍困难；直接测力需要专用设备且数据量有限。

Method: VidForce 从第三人称 RGB 视频联合估计交互轨迹与力剖面，可选使用 2D 接触点击和文本物体-动作提示；用有限仪器测量学习共享力水平和时间剖面的物理原型作为先验，由视觉与语义线索决定其贡献，并结合几何和视觉-语言特征及联合条件流细化初始跟踪轨迹与力剖面；配对的人类与仪器夹爪记录提供监督，另训练扭矩模型证明可扩展到其他传感量。

Result: 在 Hoi! 数据集留出交互上，VidForce 达到 6.6 cm ATE，峰值力 MAE 和 RMSE 分别为 4.81 N 和 5.92 N，力剖面 RMSE 为 5.52 N；在真实视频中能稳定推断运动与力，并部署到 Spot 机器人，用人类演示估计的轨迹和力剖面驱动机器人操作铰接物体，报告了重复试验成功率。

Conclusion: VidForce 表明可借助有限测力数据和物理原型先验，从视频中可靠估计交互轨迹与力，并能迁移到真实机器人操作任务及其他传感量。

Abstract: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

</details>


### [233] [Part-Set Prototypes for Explainable Mountain Gazelles Sex Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32343)
*Tali Boneh Shitrit,Amir Kedem,Ilan Shimshoni,Anna Zamansky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出一种面向野外细粒度识别的自解释视觉模型“集合原型”，可从数据中直接学习部件数量和无约束空间布局，并在相机陷阱山羚性别分类任务上取得0.878 macro-F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自解释细粒度视觉模型受 rigid geometric constraints 限制，难以捕捉野外图像中多样的语义形状；相机陷阱数据还面临姿态不佳、光照变化、遮挡、动物伪装和环境捷径等挑战。

Method: 提出 set prototypes 通用架构，从数据中挖掘部件基数与无约束空间布局；采用 joint-matching 形式，通过 truncated Sinkhorn competition 将部件同时放置于冻结的 DINOv3 token grid 上，并允许无支持部件 abstain 以避免空间塌缩。

Result: 在山羚性别分类相机陷阱基准上达到 0.878 macro-F1，优于先前架构，并与无约束 linear probe 相当；最强原型定位于角、颈部和身体等具生物学意义的区域，便于生态学家视觉核验决策。

Conclusion: 该公式化方法可自然推广到单一物种之外的多种生态监测挑战，并提升自解释模型在野外细粒度识别中的适用性与可信度。

Abstract: Self-explainable visual models for fine-grained recognition are often hindered by rigid geometric constraints that cannot capture diverse semantic shapes in unconstrained "in-the-wild" imagery. Real-world camera-trap data introduces challenges, including non-optimal poses, lighting variations, occlusions, animal camouflage, and environmental shortcuts. To address this, we introduce set prototypes, a general architecture where both part cardinality and unconstrained spatial layouts are mined directly from data. Our joint-matching formulation places parts simultaneously on a frozen DINOv3 token grid via truncated Sinkhorn competition, allowing unsupported parts to abstain without spatial collapse. We evaluate our approach on Mountain Gazelle sex classification, a camera-trap benchmark, where our model achieves 0.878 macro-F1--outperforming prior architectures and at par with an unconstrained linear probe. The strongest prototypes localize to distinctive biological areas such as horns, neck and body, allowing ecologists to visually verify decisions before trusting the metric. This formulation generalizes naturally to diverse ecological monitoring challenges beyond a single species.

</details>


### [234] [DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32344)
*Zhenghao Lu,Xiaotian Zhang,Songtao Jiang,Yiqun Lin,Siming Fu,Hualiang Wang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出DiCT框架，通过CT视觉语言模型指导X射线视觉语言模型，使模型无需推理时重建CT即可从2D X射线中进行具有CT信息的三维推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X射线诊断需要推断异常的三维位置及其与周围解剖结构的空间关系，但2D投影会丢失空间信息，导致此类推理困难。

Method: 提出三阶段渐进式CT到X射线推理迁移框架DiCT：首先让X射线学生具备初步CT导向推理能力并区分X射线观察与CT想象；随后通过CT引导的在线策略蒸馏，由CT教师选择性指导学生推理轨迹以迁移三维解剖知识；最后将数字重建放射影像上学到的能力适配到真实临床X射线。

Result: 在两个VLM骨干和3D-RAD、ReXVQA数据集上的实验表明DiCT在放射学推理任务中有效；在3D-RAD异常识别任务上较基于CT重建的基线提升1.66个百分点，同时推理计算量降低12.77倍。

Conclusion: DiCT能够将CT模型的三维解剖推理能力迁移给X射线模型，使学生在推理阶段仅凭2D X射线即可获得CT信息化的三维推理能力，并在效果与计算效率上优于CT重建基线。

Abstract: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-policy distillation (OPD), where the CT teacher selectively guides the X-ray student's reasoning trajectories to transfer 3D anatomical knowledge. Finally, manifest the dream adapts the acquired reasoning capabilities from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) to real clinical X-rays. Experiments across two VLM backbones on 3D-RAD and ReXVQA demonstrate DiCT's effectiveness across radiological reasoning tasks, achieving a 1.66 percentage point improvement over a CT reconstruction-based baseline on 3D-RAD Abnormality Identification with 12.77$\times$ lower inference computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT.

</details>


### [235] [MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32198)
*Ruicheng Wang,Linlin Xin,Sicheng Xu,Jianfeng Xiang,Zelong Lv,Yu Deng,Yue Dong,Guangzhong Sun,Tong Zhang,Jiaolong Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoGe-4D 是一个前馈框架，通过成对的全心与自心动态点图的有序查询，统一进行几何与运动预测，实现高效动态场景重建和稠密3D跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从RGB视频重建动态场景的方法要么将重建与跟踪拆分为碎片化流程，要么面临高昂的稠密时空解码成本；同时，监督稠密4D查询需要连续3D对应关系，而原始轨迹存储开销过大。

Method: 提出MoGe-4D：用有序查询将源像素映射到目标时刻的相机坐标系与全局坐标系动态点图，闭式求解相对相机位姿，并服务深度、动态配准和稠密3D跟踪；将场景建模与查询解码解耦，由高容量上下文编码器缓存全局时空特征，轻量查询编码器快速解码稠密点图；构建RigIDTrack合成数据管线，将表面动态压缩为刚性正则化仿射体，以约15%存储开销恢复任意帧精确3D轨迹。

Result: 在多个基准上取得最先进稠密3D跟踪效果，重建性能匹配专用3D基础模型，并显著快于已有4D基线方法。

Conclusion: MoGe-4D通过统一查询式几何与运动预测及高效解码架构，在保证重建与跟踪性能的同时提升运行效率，为动态4D场景理解提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\sim15\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

</details>


### [236] [FlashSegmentator: High-Throughput TotalSegmentator Inference without Loss of Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32208)
*Yosuke Yamagishi,Tomohiro Kikuchi,Shouhei Hanaoka,Takeharu Yoshikawa,Osamu Abe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究开发并评估开源推理管线 FlashSegmentator，在不重新训练、不损失分割精度的前提下显著提升 TotalSegmentator 的分割吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TotalSegmentator 虽广泛用于医学图像分割，但推理吞吐量有限；研究旨在提升其推理效率，同时保持分割准确性和公开可用性。

Method: 使用公开数据集（73 例 TotalSegmentator CT 测试集、30 例 BTCV 腹部 CT、512 例训练集 CT、55 例 MRI），在 GH200、A100、T4 GPU 上比较 FlashSegmentator 与参考实现及 FastSegmentator 的吞吐量，并用 Dice 等效性检验评估分割一致性。FlashSegmentator 引入静态形状编译、流水线、批量滑窗推理和 GPU 后处理。

Result: FlashSegmentator 在 GH200、A100、T4 上每小时分别处理 3782、1810、270 例，为参考实现的 57.7、33.9、6.4 倍，为编译版 FastSegmentator 的 3.20、2.50、1.22 倍；所有 117 个结构 Dice 等效，MRI 吞吐量提升 94 倍且 50 个结构等效；A100 云成本每 1 万例从 997 美元降至 29 美元。

Conclusion: FlashSegmentator 可在数据中心级和入门级 GPU 上显著提高 TotalSegmentator 吞吐量，且与参考实现相比不损失分割精度。

Abstract: Purpose: To develop, evaluate, and publicly release FlashSegmentator, an open-source inference pipeline that increases the throughput of TotalSegmentator without retraining or loss of segmentation accuracy. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study used public datasets: 73 CT examinations from the TotalSegmentator test split (median age, 65 years; 37 male, 35 female, one unknown), 30 abdominal CT examinations from the Beyond the Cranial Vault (BTCV) dataset, 512 training-split CT examinations for concurrent-process analysis, and 55 MRI examinations. FlashSegmentator adds static-shape compilation, pipelining, batched sliding-window inference, and GPU postprocessing. Throughput was compared with the reference implementation (including its lower-resolution modes) and FastSegmentator on GH200, A100, and T4 GPUs. Dice agreement was tested with two one-sided tests (margin, +/-0.01). Results: FlashSegmentator processed 3782, 1810, and 270 examinations per hour on the GH200, A100, and T4 (57.7, 33.9, and 6.4 times the reference implementation and 3.20, 2.50, and 1.22 times compiled FastSegmentator). Dice scores were equivalent for all 117 structures on every GPU (mean difference <= 1.2 x 10^-5; P < .001) and at the examination level on BTCV. In contrast, the lower-resolution modes of the reference implementation processed 181 and 213 examinations per hour on the A100 but reduced mean Dice by 0.116 and 0.241. On MRI, throughput increased 94-fold with all 50 structures equivalent. Estimated A100 cloud cost per 10,000 examinations decreased from 997 to 29 US dollars. Conclusion: FlashSegmentator increased the throughput of TotalSegmentator on data center and entry-level GPUs without loss of segmentation accuracy compared with the reference implementation.

</details>


### [237] [SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32202)
*Sai Karthikey Pentapati,Shashank Nelamangala Sridhara,Birendra Kathariya,Peng Yin,Guandao Yang,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatTok 是一种基于场景重合成的 3D Gaussian splat 学习式编解码器，利用不同高斯基元排列可产生近似相同渲染视图的自由度，在解码端重建新的标准高斯集合，从而实现高压缩比和良好渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D Gaussian splats 支持实时渲染但存储开销大；现有压缩方法要么编码给定高斯基元，要么为每个场景单独优化紧凑表示，未充分利用“高斯基元排列不唯一但渲染视图近似相同”的自由度。

Method: SplatTok 在数千个真实场景上训练：Transformer 将现有 splat 编码为紧凑的、空间锚定的 latent tokens，共享解码器合成一组新的标准高斯基元，且不保持与输入基元的对应关系；表示通过渲染监督而非基元重建学习；压缩时使用量化感知的 latent 搜索，仅优化场景码并保持网络冻结。

Result: 在标准基准上，仅使用输入 splat 的渲染进行 latent 搜索、不使用原始训练图像时，SplatTok 在 PSNR 上与前馈编解码器 FCGS 相当，但文件小 4 至 6.5 倍，对输入 splat 压缩约 75 至 110 倍；使用训练图像时，PSNR 超过逐场景方法 HAC++，文件小 13% 至 41%；单个在 DL3DV 上训练的模型可泛化到未见过的、含数百万高斯点的场景，并支持多种目标码率而无需重训练。

Conclusion: 利用解码端重合成和高斯基元表示的非唯一性，SplatTok 能在保持渲染质量的同时显著降低存储，并具备跨场景泛化和多码率支持能力。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian splats enable real-time rendering but require substantial storage. Existing compression methods either encode the primitives of a given splat or optimize a compact representation independently for each scene. Yet a Gaussian splat is only one realization of a scene: different arrangements of primitives can produce nearly identical rendered views. We exploit this freedom on the decoding side with SplatTok, a learned scene-resynthesis codec. Trained across thousands of real-world scenes, a transformer encodes an existing splat into compact, spatially anchored latent tokens, and a shared decoder synthesizes a new set of standard Gaussian primitives without preserving correspondence to the input. The representation is learned through rendering supervision rather than primitive reconstruction. At compression time, a quantization-aware latent search refines only the scene code, keeping the networks frozen, and closes most of the encoder's remaining error. On standard benchmarks, using only renders of the input splat for the latent search, without the original training images, SplatTok matches the PSNR of the feed-forward codec FCGS with 4 to 6.5 times smaller files, compressing input splats about 75 to 110 times. With the training images, it exceeds the PSNR of the per-scene method HAC++ with 13 to 41% smaller files. A single model trained on DL3DV generalizes to unseen scenes with millions of Gaussians and supports multiple target rates without retraining.

</details>


### [238] [EvoSearch: Self-Evolving Active Perception for Wide-Area Geospatial Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32214)
*Zhenghao Xie,Jing Xiao,Zihao Yu,Wanyi Yu,Liang Liao,Gui-Song Xia,Mi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 EvoSearch，一种自演化主动感知框架，通过协同演化感知策略与探索程序来压缩地理空间搜索轨迹，并构建 GeoSearchBench 基准评估搜索质量与视觉处理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动感知方法在大范围地理空间搜索中轨迹越来越长、成本高；仅以最终答案正确性作为反馈，难以指导保留哪些观测以及何时停止，导致广域搜索效率受限。

Method: 提出 EvoSearch：利用共享证据下已完成分支的质量-成本比较训练感知策略，使其获取有用观测、避免冗余并在证据充分时停止；再利用更新后策略的执行反馈指导探索程序修订，使经验生成适应策略变化的观测需求。同时构建 GeoSearchBench，通过关系搜索和区域搜索评估搜索质量与视觉处理效率。

Result: 实验表明，EvoSearch 在保持整体搜索质量的同时缩短搜索轨迹，并显著减少视觉处理量。

Conclusion: EvoSearch 支持可扩展的广域地理空间主动感知搜索，能够兼顾答案质量与搜索效率。

Abstract: Geospatial search is fundamental to resource surveys and environmental monitoring, requiring the discovery of relevant evidence across large geographic areas and multiple spatial scales. Existing active perception methods adaptively select observation locations and scales to improve search efficiency, yet their search trajectories become increasingly long and costly as the search area expands. A key limitation is that final-answer correctness alone provides little guidance on which observations to retain and when to stop, hindering efficient wide-area search. To address this challenge, we propose EvoSearch, a self-evolving active perception framework that co-evolves the perception policy and exploration program to compress search trajectories while preserving answer quality. Specifically, quality-cost comparisons between completed branches from shared evidence train the policy to acquire useful observations, avoid redundant ones, and stop when sufficient evidence is available. Execution feedback from the updated policy then guides exploration-program revision, adapting experience generation to the policy's changing observation needs. We further introduce GeoSearchBench, a benchmark for evaluating search quality and visual processing efficiency through relational search and region search. Experiments demonstrate that EvoSearch shortens search trajectories and substantially reduces visual processing while maintaining overall search quality, supporting scalable active perception for wide-area geospatial search.

</details>


### [239] [FaceNet versus VGG Features in Wasserstein Distortion for Face Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32220)
*Xinyu Wang,Jona Ballé*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文初步研究用FaceNet特征替代VGG特征构建Wasserstein失真目标，以改善压缩人脸图像的感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Wasserstein失真目标多依赖VGG等通用图像分类网络特征，作者想验证人脸识别网络特征是否更能反映压缩人脸的感知质量。

Method: 在Cool-Chic编解码器中，将基于Wasserstein失真的目标中的VGG特征替换为FaceNet中间特征图，并在20张LFW人脸图像、约0.15 bpp平均码率下比较两种目标。

Result: 初步成对人工评测中，基于FaceNet的重建在72.5%的判断中被偏好，且在20张图像中的16张上获得多数参与者偏好。

Conclusion: Wasserstein失真中的特征网络选择会影响人脸图像感知质量，人脸识别特征是人脸感知压缩的有前景方向。

Abstract: Wasserstein distortion (WD) compares local statistics of deep features and has been used to optimize learned image codecs for perceptual quality, but existing WD objectives rely on features from networks trained for generic image classification, such as VGG. We ask whether features from a face recognition network better reflect the perceived quality of compressed faces. In the Cool-Chic codec, we replace the VGG features in a WD-based objective with intermediate feature maps of FaceNet, and compare the two objectives on 20 LFW face images at a matched average bitrate of about 0.15 bits per pixel. In a preliminary pairwise human study, FaceNet-based reconstructions were preferred in 72.5% of judgments and by a majority of participants on 16 of the 20 images. These results suggest that the choice of feature network inside WD affects the perceived quality of face images, and that face recognition features are a promising direction for face-aware perceptual compression.

</details>


### [240] [Relational Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32227)
*Shin'ya Yamaguchi,Kosuke Nishida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出关系瓶颈模型（RBMs），一种无需训练、即插即用的框架，可将现成LVLM转化为兼具可解释性与高性能的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）虽可解释，但依赖任务特定训练且孤立视觉概念难以建模高阶语义关系；LVLM的思维链（CoT）虽具零样本能力，但生成理由与最终输出缺乏严格因果依赖，影响忠实性。

Method: RBMs包含两阶段：结构化理由生成（SRG）以主语-谓语-宾语三元组建模视觉概念间语义交互；理由 grounding 解码（RGD）通过重要性加权专家乘积聚合理由条件下一词分布，并从解码上下文中严格排除图像输入，以强制理由与输出间的因果依赖。

Result: 在多种基准和LVLM骨干上的广泛零样本评估表明，RBMs在无需任务特定微调的情况下，实现优于CBM基线的可解释性并提升任务性能。

Conclusion: RBMs能够以即插即用方式将任意现成LVLM转化为内在可解释模型，在无需微调下兼顾可解释性与高性能推理。

Abstract: Achieving both interpretable and high-performance inference is a key challenge in deep learning. While Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide inherent interpretability, they are constrained by task-specific training and rely on isolated visual concepts that fail to capture higher-order visual semantic relationships. Conversely, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate zero-shot capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, standard CoT lacks a strict causal dependency between the generated rationale and the final output, compromising faithfulness. To bridge this gap, we propose Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs), a novel training-free framework that transforms any off-the-shelf LVLMs into inherently interpretable models in a plug-and-play manner. RBMs consist of two stages: (i) Structured Rationale Generation (SRG), which explicitly models semantic interactions between visual concepts as subject-predicate-object triplets, and (ii) Rationale-Grounded Decoding (RGD), which enforces a strict causal dependency between the rationales and the final output. RGD aggregates rationale-conditional next-token distributions via an importance-weighted product-of-experts strategy, strictly excluding the image inputs from the decoding context. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across diverse benchmarks and LVLM backbones demonstrate that RBMs achieve superior interpretability while improving task performance over CBM baselines, entirely without task-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [241] [Verify then Steer: Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery for Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32400)
*Jiewen Hou,Guanxiang Qi,Meina Kan,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究视觉-语言导航（VLN）中智能体偏离路线后难以恢复的问题，提出测试时恢复框架PHAR，通过检测“进度幻觉”并回退指令进度来提升现有VLN方法的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN方法在测试时遇到路线偏离后难以恢复。作者从指令进度角度分析，发现智能体会将偏离路线的观察误判为任务进展，导致内部指令进度超前于实际任务阶段，从而妨碍依据早期子指令进行恢复。

Method: 提出PHAR框架，采用“先验证后引导”范式。验证器检查视觉-语言模型残差流表示，识别轨迹上跨模态证据的不匹配，并用分裂共形校准控制误报；触发警报后，引导模块使用上下文赌博机自适应选择指令进度的回退范围，实现在线恢复。

Result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，该框架在测试时提升了多种先进视觉-语言导航方法的可靠性。

Conclusion: PHAR通过显式检测并处理指令进度幻觉，为VLN智能体提供了一种有效的测试时恢复机制，可增强现有方法的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow language instructions to reach a target in an unseen 3D environment. However, existing methods still struggle to recover from route deviations at test time. We investigate this limitation through the lens of instruction progress, and trace it to a phenomenon we term progress hallucination: agents misinterpret off-route observations as evidence of task progress, causing their internal instruction progress to advance beyond the actual task stage and hindering recovery based on earlier sub-instructions. To address this failure mode, we propose PHAR (Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery), a test-time recovery framework following a verify-then-steer paradigm. The verifier examines residual-stream representations of the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to identify mismatch of cross-modal evidence along the trajectories, and uses split conformal calibration to control false alarms. When an alarm is raised, the steering module uses a contextual bandit to adaptively select the rewind extent of instruction progress for online recovery. Through extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, our framework enhances the reliability of multiple state-of-the-art vision-language navigation methods at test time.

</details>


### [242] [Describe, Don't Ask: Caption-Driven On-Policy Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32463)
*Haozhan Shen,Liangbo He,Jun Lan,Huijia Zhu,Weiqiang Wang,Tiancheng Zhao,Jianwei Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CaptionOPD，用固定且与图像无关的多种描述提示替代区域专属问答，通过多视角自描述与特权视图蒸馏，将未标注图像转化为广泛视觉监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态 on-policy 蒸馏依赖为每个区域精心合成的问题-答案对，导致标注成本高、难以扩展到未标注图像；同一区域的所有 rollout 只回答同一问题，监督覆盖面窄；问题预设目标存在，易使学生产生幻觉式回答。

Method: CaptionOPD 使用一组固定的图像无关 caption prompts，涵盖整体描述以及部件、颜色、数量、文字和布局等聚焦描述；对同一区域用不同提示生成 rollout，让 crop-view teacher 监督该区域多个方面；以模型自身作为 crop-view teacher，仅需图像和区域框，无需问题、答案或更大模型标注。

Result: 在相同图像和区域训练条件下，CaptionOPD 在多个细粒度与通用感知基准上优于先前的 OPD 方法。

Conclusion: 通过多方面自描述和特权视图蒸馏，CaptionOPD 避免了区域专属 QA 的瓶颈与预设目标问题，为未标注图像提供可扩展的广泛视觉监督。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often recognize fine-grained details more accurately in a relevant crop than in the full image. Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) methods exploit this by transferring the advantage of a crop-view teacher to a full-image student. However, their supervision relies on region-specific questions curated through an elaborate synthesis pipeline, which brings three weaknesses: (1) every region needs a question--answer pair written exclusively for it, locking training into costly QA curation that is hard to scale to unlabeled images; (2) all rollouts of a region answer the same question, so the teacher supervises only the details it asks about, leaving other visual elements in the region unsupervised; and (3) every question presupposes that its target exists, so the student becomes prone to answering even when the target is absent. In this paper, we study how to turn unlabeled images into broad visual supervision through multi-aspect self-description and privileged-view distillation, and propose CaptionOPD, which replaces tailored questions with a fixed set of image-agnostic caption prompts, ranging from general descriptions to focused captions of parts, colors, counts, text, and layout. The rollouts of a region receive different prompts, so the teacher supervises various aspects of the region. Moreover, because caption prompts mask the model to describe what is visible instead of querying a specific target, they avoid presupposing what the region contains. Using the model itself as the crop-view teacher, CaptionOPD requires no questions, no answers, and no larger model annotations: only images and region boxes. Experiments show that, trained on the same images and regions, CaptionOPD outperforms prior OPD methods across multiple fine-grained and general perception benchmarks.

</details>


### [243] [Progressive Reliable Supervision for Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32474)
*Jing Li,Zhe Zhang,Huateng Sun,Yuhui Yang,Wanli Xue,Xu Cheng,Fan Shi,Jianhua Zhang,Qinghua Hu,Shengyong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究黑盒通用域适应（B²-UniDA），提出渐进可靠监督方法PReS，在无法访问源数据和源模型参数的条件下，利用黑盒源模型、基础模型与目标模型互补知识逐步构建可靠目标监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在B²-UniDA设定下，源数据与源模型参数均不可访问，目标域缺少可靠监督，且黑盒源模型预测可能受源偏差和域偏移影响而不可靠，因此需要建立可靠的目标监督信号。

Method: PReS通过扩散扰动下的语义一致性和黑盒源模型与CLIP的跨模型共识识别可靠已知样本；估计两个预测器的样本级可靠性并自适应融合互补预测以构造伪标签；对可靠已知样本和潜在未知样本采用非对称监督；随适应过程迭代优化伪标签和已知/未知划分，形成闭环。

Result: 在多个基准数据集和多种标签空间关系下，PReS在严格的B²-UniDA设定中取得最先进或极具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 协调黑盒源模型、基础模型和演化中的目标模型可逐步构建并精炼可靠监督，从而有效提升黑盒通用域适应性能。

Abstract: Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation (B$^2$-UniDA) aims to adapt a target model to an unlabeled target domain under arbitrary label-space relationships, while neither source data nor source-model parameters are accessible during adaptation. Under such restrictive information access, reliable target supervision is unavailable, while predictions from the black-box source model can be unreliable due to source bias and domain shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Progressive Reliable Supervision (PReS), which progressively establishes and refines reliable target supervision by coordinating complementary knowledge from the black-box source model, foundation models, and the evolving target model. PReS first identifies reliable known samples by exploiting semantic consistency under diffusion-based perturbations and cross-model consensus between the black-box source model and CLIP. It then estimates the sample-wise reliability of the two predictors and adaptively integrates their complementary predictions to construct reliable pseudo labels. The resulting supervision is exploited asymmetrically to encourage confident and discriminative predictions for reliable known samples while maintaining uncertain yet locally consistent predictions for potential unknown samples. As adaptation proceeds, the emerging target-domain knowledge is further leveraged to refine both the pseudo labels and the known/unknown sample partition, forming a closed-loop process in which supervision construction and target adaptation mutually reinforce each other. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets under diverse label-space relationships demonstrate that PReS achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance under the restrictive B$^2$-UniDA setting.

</details>


### [244] [NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32216)
*Zehua Fan,Qi Jiang,Wei Li,Kai Tang,Yue Jiang,Yujian Li,Bailin Li,Feng Gao,Yan Wang,Kun Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出NativeDrive，一种无编码器的原生多模态自动驾驶框架，通过统一骨干网络同时支持理解与生成，并引入面向驾驶的稠密监督任务来提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需要语义理解与细粒度场景感知以进行精确动作预测。现有VLA模型虽继承语义先验，但低维动作标签提供的结构监督有限；引入视觉生成或视频世界动作模型又会带来与规划关联较弱的 appearance reconstruction 开销。原生多模态模型为在同一骨干内统一理解与生成提供了替代方案。

Method: NativeDrive适配统一多模态骨干进行策略学习，并引入驾驶专用稠密监督任务。Native Action Interface复用理解专家的token预测接口实现离散策略，并适配生成专家实现连续策略；Driving Semantic Editing复用生成专家的编辑能力，在训练中提供稠密场景结构监督，推理时仅运行所选规划策略。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2上，NativeDrive在统一理解与生成模型中取得有竞争力的规划性能；消融实验验证了各组件有效性。

Conclusion: NativeDrive表明，基于原生多模态统一骨干并引入驾驶定制稠密监督，可在不增加推理阶段生成开销的情况下提升规划表现；代码将开源。

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

</details>


### [245] [Relation Before Action: Explicit Relation Modeling for Latent Action Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32226)
*Boning Zhang,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出RELACT关系优先框架，用于从无标注视频中预训练可复用的潜在动作表示；它将转移关系建模与预测性动作抽象显式分离，并在导航、操作和策略适配任务中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
