Motivation: 现有潜在动作预训练方法通常将视觉转移建模与动作推断耦合，直接把成对观测或转移线索映射为潜在动作，导致“刻画转移关系结构”和“抽象为紧凑动作表示”两个任务相互纠缠。

Method: RELACT先构建结构化关系表示R，捕捉视觉元素及其交互随观测的变化；再推断紧凑的、状态条件化的随机潜在动作U，并通过动作条件潜在动力学学习其预测效应。所得动作表示可用于原生控制空间中的基于模型规划，或监督下游具身策略。

Result: 在域内和域外图像目标导航、目标条件操作及下游策略适配等实验中，RELACT提升了预测性动作表示质量，并在规划与控制上取得一致增益。

Conclusion: 关系优先的潜在动作预训练能够有效分离转移关系建模与动作抽象，提升潜在动作表示的预测性与泛化性，并支持规划和控制等下游具身任务。

Abstract: Learning latent actions from unlabeled video sequences offers a promising way to acquire reusable action representations without relying on embodiment-specific control annotations. However, existing latent-action pretraining approaches commonly couple the modeling of visual transitions with action inference, directly mapping paired observations or derived transition cues into latent action codes. This formulation leaves two distinct tasks entangled: characterizing the relational structure of an observed transition and abstracting it into a compact action representation. We propose RELACT, a relation-first framework that explicitly separates transition relation modeling from predictive action abstraction. RELACT first constructs a structured relation representation $R$ that captures how visual elements and their interactions evolve across observations. It then infers a compact, state-conditioned stochastic latent action $U$, whose predictive effects are learned through action-conditioned latent dynamics. The resulting action representation can be grounded in native control spaces for model-based planning or used to supervise downstream embodied policies. Extensive experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain image-goal navigation, goal-conditioned manipulation, and downstream policy adaptation demonstrate improved predictive action representations and consistent gains in planning and control, supporting the effectiveness and generality of relation-first latent action pretraining.

</details>


### [246] [NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32431)
*Chenrui Fan,Qiyang Hu,Luca Scharr,Paolo Favaro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 NRG-Twins 数据集与 NRG-PD 检测器，用于定位生成视频中破坏三维刚性的像素，并提升生成视频的三维一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成视频已很逼真，但缺乏三维一致性，静态内容会缓慢变形或漂移，导致三维重建退化；这些错误过于细微，难以人工标注，因此需要来自生成视频本身的逐像素不一致性数据。

Method: 构建“真实-生成双胞胎”：将真实视频片段与其由关键帧条件生成器重建的视频配对，插入真实关键帧使生成相机近似跟随真实相机路径，再逐像素测量生成视频相对刚性场景沿自身相机路径的偏离角度。发布包含871对双胞胎的 NRG-Twins、构建代码和官方测试集基准；并训练 NRG-PD，从RGB单独预测逐像素偏离角度。

Result: NRG-PD 区分一致与不一致像素的 AUROC 为0.85，优于七种现有一致性和运动分割方法的0.40-0.74；其预测还能改善包含生成内容视频的三维高斯泼溅重建。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了可扩展的数据与基准来测量生成视频的三维刚性破坏，并表明训练出的检测器可用于评估和提升生成视频的三维一致性及下游三维重建。

Abstract: Video generators now produce realistic clips of scenes and objects, which makes generated video an attractive source of 3D content. Yet generated video is not 3D consistent: static content slowly deforms or slides, 3D reconstruction degrades, and the errors are too subtle to label by hand. To make generators 3D consistent, or to build rewards and guidance that push them there, we need data that say where and by how much a generated video breaks rigidity, and these data must come from generated video itself. We obtain per-pixel ground-truth labels from real-generated twins: a real clip paired with its re-creation by a keyframe-conditioned video generator. After inserting real keyframes so that the twin camera roughly follows the real one, we measure per pixel, in degrees, how far the twin departs from a rigid scene seen along its own camera path. We release Non-Rigidly Generated Twins (NRG-Twins), 871 twins, the code that builds them for new generators, and a benchmark with an official test split. A detector trained on these data, the Non-Rigidly Generated Pixel Detector (NRG-PD), predicts the per-pixel angle from RGB alone. It separates inconsistent from consistent pixels with AUROC 0.85, against 0.40-0.74 for seven existing consistency and motion-segmentation methods, and its predictions improve 3DGS of video that contains generated content.

</details>


### [247] [BEACON: Learning Observation-Conditioned Starting Points for Guided Conditional Flow Matching in Microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32406)
*Anirban Ray,Florian Jug*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 BEACON，一种用于引导式条件流匹配的 Best-of-K 自适应学习耦合方法，通过学习以退化观测为条件的基分布来改进荧光显微图像去雾和计算超分辨恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 荧光显微成像常受离焦光、分辨率限制和信号相关噪声影响；现有引导式条件流匹配将每个干净目标与独立标准高斯样本配对，未利用退化观测作为起点，容易产生冲突的速度目标并增加条件速度场学习难度。

Method: BEACON 学习观测条件化的基分布：训练时轻量条件噪声模型为每个退化输入提出 K 个起点，选择流匹配损失最低的候选监督两个网络，并用 KL 项约束提议分布接近高斯先验；推理时只需从学习到的提议中单次采样并沿速度场传输，无需候选选择或干净目标。

Result: 在覆盖显微去雾和计算超分辨的 10 个数据集上，与 13 类基线方法比较，BEACON 在 PSNR、MicroMS-SSIM 与 LPIPS、FID 的所有保真度-感知指标配对中均取得最佳中位感知-失真排名。

Conclusion: 结果表明，观测条件化基分布与自适应耦合能提升引导式流匹配的恢复效果，在保持生物结构意义的同时兼顾保真度与感知质量；代码和预训练模型将以宽松许可证发布。

Abstract: Fluorescence microscopy drives much of modern life science, but accessible imaging setups often yield images degraded by out-of-focus light, limited resolution, and strong signal-dependent noise. Computational restoration can recover high-quality images from such data, enabling cheaper and faster imaging at lower light dose, provided biologically meaningful structures are preserved. Guided conditional flow matching has recently shown strong results for microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution by learning distributions of plausible restorations. However, it pairs each clean target with an independent standard Gaussian sample, so the starting point of every training path does not leverage the degraded observation. This arbitrary noise--target coupling can produce conflicting velocity targets and makes the conditional velocity field harder to learn. We present BEACON, a $BE$st-of-$K$ $A$daptive learned coupling for guided $CON$ditional flow matching, which learns an observation-conditioned base distribution. During training, a lightweight conditional noise model proposes $K$ starting points for each degraded input, and the candidate with the lowest flow-matching loss supervises both networks, while a KL term keeps the proposal close to the Gaussian prior. At inference, a single draw from the learned proposal is transported along the velocity field, requiring neither candidate selection nor the target. We evaluate BEACON on ten datasets spanning microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution against 13 baseline families. BEACON achieves the best median perception--distortion rank for every pairing of a fidelity metric (PSNR, MicroMS-SSIM) with a perceptual metric (LPIPS, FID). Code and pretrained models will be released under a permissive license.

</details>


### [248] [Are We Rewarding the Wrong Module? Module-Specific Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32687)
*HuiSeong Cho,Jun Yeong Park,Yu Rang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出模块特定策略优化（MSPO），用于多模态大模型推理的强化学习训练，将视觉感知学习信号与最终答案结果信号分离，避免视觉编码器、投影器和LLM共用同一优势信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GRPO的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法存在“模块级信用纠缠”问题：即使感知正确性与最终答案正确性不同，视觉编码器、投影器和LLM仍使用相同优势信号联合优化，导致训练信号不匹配。

Method: MSPO为不同模块分配不同学习信号：利用感知检查清单（关于视觉信息的辅助问题）的响应训练视觉编码器；提出置信度感知感知奖励（CaPR），通过对清单准确率阈值化得到感知符号决定奖励方向，并用潜在感知准确率的Beta分布后验置信度缩放奖励幅度；再通过组相对归一化得到视觉优势，并用主任务成功率缩放，用于更新视觉编码器，而投影器和LLM保留基于结果的GRPO更新。

Result: 在七个数学与通用推理基准上的实验表明，MSPO在3B和7B规模上平均优于现有经强化学习调优的模型。

Conclusion: MSPO通过分离感知与结果学习信号，有效缓解模块级信用纠缠，提升了多模态大模型的推理性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted to enhance the multimodal reasoning of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods share a common limitation of Module-Level Credit Entanglement, in which the vision encoder, projector, and LLM modules are jointly optimized using the same advantage signals even when perceptual correctness and final-answer correctness differ. To address this limitation, we propose Module-Specific Policy Optimization (MSPO), a framework that separates perceptual and outcome-based learning signals across model modules. Specifically, MSPO uses responses to perception checklists comprising auxiliary questions about visual information to derive an advantage for training the vision encoder. From these responses, MSPO computes the Confidence-aware Perception Reward (CaPR), using a perception sign obtained by thresholding checklist accuracy to determine reward direction and posterior confidence from a Beta distribution over latent perception accuracy to scale reward magnitude. We then derive the vision advantage through group-relative normalization of CaPR and scale it using main-task success rates. This advantage guides updates to the vision encoder, while the projector and LLM retain outcome-based GRPO updates. Extensive experiments on seven mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MSPO outperforms existing RL-tuned models on average at both the 3B and 7B scales.

</details>


### [249] [Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32900)
*Jiahao Zhang,Xuan Yao,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出运动条件世界模型，将目标运动分布与机器人自运动融入潜在状态转移，用于具身视觉跟踪中的未来视觉状态预测与决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身视觉跟踪中，目标运动不确定且机器人视角变化会共同影响视觉观测，使未来环境状态预测困难，从而限制跟踪决策。

Method: 提出Motion-Conditioned World Modeling，将预测的目标运动分布和机器人自运动纳入潜在状态转移；设计Geometry-Progress模块，通过共享运动模式和路径条件进度分布联合建模几何路径与单步移动距离；利用动作诱导的坐标变换将预测路径表达在下一机器人坐标系中；以未来视觉特征重建通过条件转移分支监督运动预测器；联合运动似然、特征重建和专家动作监督进行优化。

Result: 在三个具身跟踪基准上，使用轻量0.5B骨干网络取得更好的跟踪性能和跨环境泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将显式运动表示与未来观测预测相结合，可让跟踪策略融合视觉上下文与预测运动线索，从而提升具身视觉跟踪效果与泛化性。

Abstract: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.

</details>


### [250] [ST-SfM: Spatio-Temporal Structure-from-Motion for Initialising 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32231)
*Harshit,Sami Brandt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出ST-SfM，一种面向同步标定多相机视频的稀疏时空SfM方法，可生成静态3D点和动态4D点，并用于初始化4D高斯泼溅。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态高斯泼溅通常用随机点或首帧SfM点云初始化，二者都不包含关于什么在运动、何时何地运动的信息。

Method: ST-SfM将场景分为静态和动态两个分支：静态结构通过每相机时间中值图像检测、时间稳定性门控并沿极线匹配；动态结构用视频体中的时空兴趣点（STIPs）和HOG3D描述，仅在满足极线与时间一致性的候选间匹配；再用拒绝不一致合并的并查集跟踪，并对所有视图对进行RANSAC三角化，得到静态3D点和带亚帧时间的动态4D点。最后用该稀疏4D点云初始化4D高斯泼溅。

Result: 在N3DV场景上，与随机初始化相比，ST-SfM初始化在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上均有提升。

Conclusion: 利用运动感知的稀疏时空SfM点云初始化4D高斯泼溅，可改善动态场景重建质量。

Abstract: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is usually initialised either with random points or with a structure-from-motion (SfM) cloud of the first frame. Neither says anything about what moves, where and when. We introduce ST-SfM, a sparse spatio-temporal SfM for synchronised, calibrated multi-camera video that splits the scene into two branches. Static structure is detected once per camera on a temporal-median image, gated for temporal stability and matched along epi-polar lines. Motion is detected as space-time interest points (STIPs) in the video volume, described with HOG3D and matched only between candidates that agree both epipolarly and in time. Union-find tracks that refuse inconsistent merges are triangulated with RANSAC over all view pairs, giving static 3D points and dynamic 4D points (x, y, z, t) with sub-frame times. We use ST-SfM derived sparse 4D cloud to initialise 4D Gaussian splatting. In comparison with random initialisation on N3DV scenes we get improvements in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS.

</details>


### [251] [Can You Find the Edit When Nothing Looks Wrong? A Paired Benchmark for Text-Driven Image Manipulation Localization Beyond Semantic Abnormality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32242)
*Peiyu Zhuang,Jianquan Yang,Zhuoying Cai,Yi Jiang,Yingquan Chen,Xinle Wang,Zeqin Yu,Dongdong Lin,Ruitao Xie,Kaige Li,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个配对图像编辑基准，用同一目标的可信替换与异常替换来比较图像篡改定位性能，发现定位器在语义可信编辑上往往表现更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺少针对同一目标的匹配可信编辑与异常编辑，难以衡量定位性能如何随语义可信度变化。

Method: 为每张源图像生成同一目标的语义可信和异常替换，且使用相同编辑器、语言和生成设置；为每个输出估计掩码并保留掩码重叠足够的配对，以直接比较两种语义条件下的定位性能。数据集包含来自6500张照片的47747个双语三元组，覆盖4种编辑器、3个源域和6种预期违规类型，并在9个公开定位器上评估。

Result: 在27个模型-数据集比较中，有26个显示可信编辑上的编辑器平均IoU更低；该差距在像素变化控制和区域大小分析下仍然存在。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了“语义可信度捷径”：当编辑结果看起来普通时，定位性能常会减弱。该基准为测量这一差距和开发在可信编辑上仍有效的定位器提供了受控实验环境。

Abstract: Instruction-driven image editing can alter a photograph while keeping the result coherent with the scene. Existing benchmarks lack matched plausible and anomalous edits of the same target, making it difficult to measure how localization performance changes with semantic plausibility. We construct a paired benchmark by generating semantically plausible and anomalous replacements of the same target in each source photograph. Both edits use the same editor, language, and generation settings. We estimate a separate mask for each output and retain pairs with sufficient mask overlap, enabling direct comparison of localization performance under the two semantic conditions. The release contains 47,747 bilingual triplets from 6,500 photographs, spanning four editors, three source domains, and six intended violation types. Across nine public localizers, editor-averaged IoU is lower on plausible edits in 26 of 27 model-dataset comparisons. This gap persists under pixel-change controls and region-size analyses. These findings reveal a semantic-plausibility shortcut: localization often weakens when an edited result looks ordinary. The benchmark provides a controlled setting for measuring this gap and developing localizers that remain effective on plausible edits.

</details>


### [252] [Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32964)
*Nhat Ha Nguyen,Sudipta Chowdhury,Lokesh Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DriveAnswer 基准，用强证据/弱证据配对问题联合评估驾驶视觉语言模型的答案正确性、证据充分性判断与视觉定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估将视觉定位与可回答性分开衡量，难以区分“有充分证据支持的预测”和“虽定位到相关但证据不足的预测”。可靠驾驶模型需要在证据不足时选择弃答。

Method: 构建包含 20,151 个问题、覆盖七类推理家族的基准，通过匹配的强证据与弱证据配置保持场景事实和语义答案不变，仅改变观察是否足以支持回答；弱证据下弃答为正确行为，并联合评估答案-弃答行为与完整定位。

Result: 六类家族评估中，最强零样本基线强证据准确率达 67.31%，但仅 21.55% 的匹配问题同时满足答案-弃答行为和完整定位。受控适配后，Gemma-4-12B 在该联合能力上达 63.29%，约为零样本近三倍；Qwen3-VL-8B 也表现出类似的证据敏感回答与定位提升。

Conclusion: 语义正确性、证据充分性和视觉定位是不同能力，应进行联合评估；DriveAnswer 揭示了现有模型在证据不足时可靠弃答与定位方面的显著不足。

Abstract: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

</details>


### [253] [Reliable and grounded reporting of any computed tomography scan with FORA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32823)
*Sezgin Er,Utku Turkbey,Alperen Gur,Omer Faruk Durugol,Suprosanna Shit,Murong Xu,Julia Wolleb,Jiayi Wang,Xiaoliang Wang,Hadrien Reynaud,Teodora Spasojevic,Dong Yang,Andriy Myronenko,Pengfei Guo,Yufan He,Can Zhao,Marc Edgar,Andreas Maier,Michael Moor,Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir,Daguang Xu,Bernhard Kainz,Bjoern Menze,Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORA 是一个通用 CT 模型，可识别并空间定位 1,028 个层级化放射学概念，并覆盖 28 种 CT 协议生成报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CT 人工智能系统多局限于特定解剖区域、检查类型或预设异常，难以提供全面且具有空间定位依据的影像解读。

Method: 基于 304,962 例常规 CT 检查及其报告进行训练，无需病灶级人工标注；架构结合多实例学习与可解释概念瓶颈，连接空间证据、放射学发现和报告生成；先在胸片验证架构，再训练三维 CT 模型。

Result: 在 36,619 例留出 CT 检查上，放射学概念识别宏观 AUROC 达 0.918，比 18 个现有 CT 模型中最强者高 0.21；在三个公开基准排名第一，并在 Merlin 自身测试集上以 0.907 对 0.826 胜出；肺栓塞、肾肿块和肋骨骨折定位中，最强空间证据落入标注病灶内的概率最高达随机水平的 348 倍；报告生成宏观发现召回率超过最强现有生成器 3 倍以上。

Conclusion: 单一模型可在 12 种 CT 检查类型中结合广泛异常识别、空间定位和报告生成，并可仅利用常规报告而无需病灶级监督。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.

</details>


### [254] [MYSTIQUE: Few-Shot Facial Identity Transfer with Performance Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32232)
*Shihan Cheng,David Hyde,Junting Deng,Michael Bao,Paul Debevec,Roshni Cooper,Soshi Shimada*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究视觉特效中的身份迁移任务，提出基于扩散模型的 MYSTIQUE，用目标人物多张照片提供身份，并通过分离的输入流读取表情、光照和场景，以缓解自重建训练导致的身份泄漏问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身份迁移需要把驱动图像中的人物身份替换为目标人物，同时保留表情、光照、姿态和场景。由于缺少成对真实数据，现有方法多用自重建训练，模型容易走捷径，从驱动图像复制身份线索，导致推理时身份泄漏。作者观察到，只要某个输入读取了驱动图像，泄漏就可能发生。

Method: 提出 MYSTIQUE：身份来自目标人物的一组照片，表情、光照和场景通过独立流输入；采用多阶段训练学习身份与其他因素解耦，并在输入端使用随机块掩码（边界不沿脸部轮廓）、自增强（随机改变表情输入中的脸型但保留表情）和人脸随机化（替换表情与光照输入中的人物，而真值仍为驱动图像）。推理时还将光照输入 warp 到第一遍结果的脸型上，以减少经光照流产生的脸型泄漏。评估结合人脸识别分数、人类判断和已知脸型渲染结果上的脸型指标。

Result: 用户研究中，评审者认为 MYSTIQUE 的结果比各对比方法更接近目标人物；在对比方法中，MYSTIQUE 最能准确恢复目标脸型，并且当提供更多目标照片时，其识别分数提升最大。

Conclusion: 通过从所有读取驱动图像的输入路径上抑制身份泄漏，并将身份、表情、光照和场景分离建模，MYSTIQUE 能在无成对真值条件下实现更接近目标身份和脸型的身份迁移。

Abstract: In visual effects, identity transfer replaces the identity in a driving image with that of a target person, while preserving the expression, lighting, pose and scene of that image. Paired ground truth is rarely available, so many methods are trained by self-reconstruction, where the model can learn a shortcut by copying identity cues from the driving image. This shortcut causes identity leakage at inference, where the driving image shows a different person. Our key observation is that leakage can enter through any input that reads the driving image. We therefore present MYSTIQUE, a diffusion-based identity transfer method that takes identity from a set of the target's photos and reads expression, lighting and scene through separate streams. It learns to disentangle identity from the other streams through multi-stage training, with disentanglement strategies at their inputs: a random block mask whose boundaries do not follow the face outline, self-augmentation, which randomly changes the face shape in the expression input and keeps its expression, and face randomization, which replaces the person in the expression and lighting inputs while the ground truth stays the driving image. At inference, we also warp the lighting input onto the face shape of a first pass, which reduces face-shape leakage through the lighting stream. Since face-recognition scores and human judgments each have limits, we evaluate identity with both, together with face-shape metrics on rendered faces of known shape. In a user study, raters judge MYSTIQUE's results more like the target than those of each compared method. Among these methods, MYSTIQUE also recovers the target's face shape most accurately, and its recognition score gains the most as more photos of the target are given.

</details>


### [255] [CaveBench: Benchmarking Abductive Physical Reasoning from Internal Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32251)
*Guanxin Lin,Chen Yang,Shenxiang Zeng,Honghui Zhu,Xin Li,Wenbo Deng,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CaveBench 基准，用于评估视觉语言模型能否仅凭装置描述和内部观测图像，推断隐藏的外部控制操作，即进行溯因物理推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准未专门测试 VLM 是否能从内部观测理解外部物理驱动因素，而这是物理推理能力的重要开放问题。

Method: 构建 CaveBench，覆盖 5 个物理域、20 个装置场景、10,200 个模拟 episode（9,000 训练、1,000 验证、200 测试）；问题涉及 1 至 6 个事件，并要求给出每个事件的完整控制集；评估 27 种 VLM 配置及 7 种适配基线，并进行错误分析。

Result: 六事件精确匹配准确率最强闭源模型为 68.0%，最强开放权重模型为 12.5%；适配基线显示单事件性能提升不一定带来完整序列提升；错误集中在视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合和动作组合。

Conclusion: 当前 VLM 在从内部现象推断外部原因方面仍存在明显不足，CaveBench 揭示了模型在完整过程解释和多事件控制组合上的关键短板。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are advancing in physical reasoning, but whether they can understand external physical drivers from internal observations remains an open question. Existing benchmarks have not specifically targeted this setting. To this end, we introduce CaveBench, a benchmark for abductive physical reasoning from internal observations. Models receive apparatus descriptions and internal images while the external controls remain hidden, and must infer the operations responsible for the observed responses. CaveBench spans 20 apparatus scenes in five physical domains and contains 10,200 simulated episodes, split into 9,000 training, 1,000 validation, and 200 test episodes. Questions span one to six events and require the complete control set at every event, testing whether an explanation accounts for the entire process. Synchronized observations and control records provide the inputs and reference answers. Evaluating 27 VLM configurations yields six-event exact-match accuracies of 68.0% for the strongest closed-source model and 12.5% for the strongest open-weight model. Seven adaptation baselines show that single-event gains need not improve complete sequences. Error analysis identifies failures in visual identification, physical inference, evidence integration, and action composition, specifying where current models struggle to connect internal phenomena with their external causes.

</details>


### [256] [Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32940)
*Dohoon Kim,Taesup Moon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究视觉语言模型（VLMs）是否能在事先知道自己在一系列视觉任务和图像条件下的弱点，并区分所有模型共同面对的困难与模型自身特有的困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元认知不仅是判断单个答案是否正确，也包括了解自己在不同任务类型和图像条件下的强项与弱项；作者希望检验VLMs是否具备这种关于自身视觉弱点的前瞻性知识。

Method: 作者在多种开源和闭源VLMs上测试其对视觉任务类型和图像条件难度的预判，并将所有模型共同困难与模型自身特有困难分离；随后训练VLMs预测自身准确率，并分析其在解题过程中对自身答案赋予的概率。

Result: VLMs事先几乎不了解自己的视觉弱点：会误判整体准确率，甚至不知道哪些任务对所有模型都困难，多数模型也误判退化图像对自身的影响。训练模型预测准确率可让其学会在未见任务类型上的自身准确率水平，但不能教会其哪些任务类型困难；然而一旦开始解题，模型对自身答案的概率会反映其特有弱点。

Conclusion: VLMs内部持有关于自身弱点的信息，但尚未反映在其明确预测中；该评估为教学VLMs认识自身弱点的方法提供了测试，而答案概率可作为起点信号。

Abstract: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.

</details>


### [257] [StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32281)
*Xiaoye Liang,Yiming Huang,Jialu Wu,Yushe Cao,Ruxiang Duan,Yi Sun,Tie Liu,Lai Jiang,Mai Xu,Shikun Feng,Yiheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 StreamCoach 流式动作质量评估框架，在 OnCueCoaching 范式下结合连续思维链推理与主动、证据门控的教练反馈，并构建 EE4D-Stream 数据集进行训练与评测，在干预时机、动作评估和教练质量上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作质量评估多针对已完成动作，难以实时反馈；流式方法虽降低延迟，但推理能力有限，难以利用细微动作线索和运动专项知识，且反馈碎片化，只关注单个身体部位，忽略其他部位细节与动作阶段转换。

Method: 提出 StreamCoach 框架，包括 Technique-Aware Reasoning 和 Holistic Coaching：前者依据运动专项标准跟踪身体部位动作与动作阶段转换，后者整合累积证据给出及时、全面的优势与技术错误反馈。基于 Ego-Exo4D 的 1213 条体育视频序列，通过 LLM 辅助重标注和人工审核构建 EE4D-Stream，提供密集思维链标注与证据门控语音内容；采用 Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning 联合优化反馈时机与内容。

Result: 在 EE4D-Stream 上与 11 个离线及流式基线（含三个专有模型）对比，StreamCoach 在干预时机、动作评估和教练质量上均达到最优，超过 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5。

Conclusion: StreamCoach 通过连续思维链推理与证据门控的主动教练反馈，有效提升流式动作质量评估的及时性、综合性与专项推理能力，为实时体育训练反馈提供了新框架与基准数据集。

Abstract: In fitness and sports training, timely action quality assessment (AQA) is essential for learners to identify and correct technical errors during movement execution. However, most AQA methods assess completed performances, limiting their ability to provide timely feedback. Streaming methods alleviate this latency, but limited reasoning hinders their use of subtle movement cues and sport-specific knowledge. Moreover, their fragmented feedback focuses on one body part at a time, overlooking movement details of other body parts and transitions between action phases. To address these limitations, we propose StreamCoach, a streaming AQA framework under the OnCueCoaching paradigm that couples continuous chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with proactive, evidence-gated coaching. Technique-Aware Reasoning tracks body-part movements and action-phase transitions against sport-specific criteria, while Holistic Coaching integrates accumulated evidence to deliver timely, comprehensive feedback on strengths and technical errors. To support training and benchmarking, we construct EE4D-Stream from 1,213 sports video sequences in Ego-Exo4D through LLM-assisted reannotation and manual review of selected claims, pairing dense CoT annotations with evidence-gated speech content. Building on this dataset, we train StreamCoach using Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning to jointly optimize feedback timing and content. We benchmark 11 offline and streaming baselines on EE4D-Stream, including three proprietary models. StreamCoach achieves state-of-the-art results across intervention timing, action assessment, and coaching quality, surpassing both GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

</details>


### [258] [One, No One and One Hundred Thousand CTs: Testing Anatomical Control in Text-to-CT Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33003)
*Francesca Pia Panaccione,Eugenio Lomurno,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出CtrlCT工具包，用于统一评估文本到CT生成器的可信度与控制能力，并对五个公开生成器进行基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到CT生成器评估中预处理和指标不一致，难以比较；且很少测试编辑报告是否会按预期改变CT，报告对解剖结构的控制程度缺乏证据。

Method: 提出CtrlCT工具包，测试生成器的Credibility和Control两个属性。Credibility将生成CT群体与真实CT及报告比较；Control采用变形测试，无需参考CT，在固定种子下编辑一个发现，检查目标发现是否按请求改变、否定发现是否保持缺失、远处解剖变化是否不超过新种子，并验证跨种子一致性。用Report Card汇总指标和洞察。

Result: 在940个胸部CT和687个胸膜积液与心脏增大编辑上基准测试五个公开生成器，并留出第六个测试工具包。发现最可信的生成器对新增积液几乎无响应，而最响应的生成器生成的CT更不真实且多样性更低；文献中已有分析未能揭示这一现象。

Conclusion: CtrlCT揭示了文本到CT生成中可信度与控制能力之间的权衡，强调需要标准化、可复现的评估协议；作者将在接收后发布CtrlCT、编辑、种子和30,525个合成CT。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning and the public availability of computed tomography (CT) datasets with paired reports have enabled many Text-to-CT generators. However, their evaluations almost always differ in preprocessing and metrics, which hinders comparison. Moreover, their protocols almost never test how editing the report changes the CT, not even at the same seed, so the report is often assumed to control the anatomy without evidence of how much and how consistently it does. We therefore propose CtrlCT, a toolkit that tests two properties of a generator, Credibility and Control. Credibility tests compare generated CTs, as a population, with real CTs and reports; Control tests are metamorphic and need no reference CT: at a fixed seed, editing one finding should change it as requested, keep negated findings absent and shift distant anatomy no more than a new seed, and the change should hold across seeds. A Report Card summarises all measures and insights for each generator. We benchmark five public generators on 940 chest CTs and 687 edits of pleural effusion and cardiomegaly, holding out a sixth to test the toolkit. Among them, the most credible generators barely respond to an added effusion, while the most responsive produce less realistic and less diverse CTs. The analyses proposed in the literature do not reveal this. We release CtrlCT, its edits, seeds and 30,525 synthetic CTs after acceptance.

</details>


### [259] [EventDiffusion: Learning Native Event Stream Distribution from Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33096)
*Karthik Sundar Senthilkumar,Christopher Thirgood,Simon Hadfield*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EventDiffusion，一种分层生成框架，直接从真实记录中学习原生异步事件流条件分布，并引入 CEFS 事件流真实性指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有高时间分辨率，但真实录制稀缺；稀疏 RGB 观测无法唯一确定中间事件流，现有模拟器依赖预设传感器动态和估计亮度轨迹，限制了生成事件流的多样性与保真度。

Method: EventDiffusion 将生成分解为三个概率过程：事件活动扩散（EAD）学习随机离散事件计数；事件空间分配（ESA）在保持基数不变的情况下将计数分配到像素；事件时间扩散（ETD）学习连续异步时间戳分布。同时提出结合事件活动、极性、多尺度时空结构和时间保真度的 CEFS 真实性指标。

Result: 在所有数据集上，EventDiffusion 的准确率达到 SOTA 方法的两倍，并在不同相机和任意分辨率下表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: EventDiffusion 能更真实、多样地生成异步事件流，CEFS 可有效评估事件流真实性，方法具有跨相机和跨分辨率泛化能力。

Abstract: Event cameras capture asynchronous brightness changes at high temporal resolution, but scarce recordings constrain data-driven research. Sparse RGB observations cannot uniquely determine intervening events since identical frames may correspond to streams with different activity, polarities, and timing. Existing simulators largely rely on prescribed sensor dynamics and estimated brightness trajectories, whose assumptions limit the diversity and fidelity of plausible event streams. We introduce EventDiffusion, a hierarchical generative framework that directly learns the conditional distribution of native asynchronous event streams from real recordings. EventDiffusion decomposes generation into three probabilistic processes: Event Activity Diffusion (EAD) learns stochastic discrete event counts; Event Spatial Allocation (ESA) distributes these counts to individual pixels while preserving cardinality; and Event Timing Diffusion (ETD) learns continuous asynchronous timestamp distributions. We also introduce CEFS, an event-stream realism metric combining event activity and polarity with multiscale space-time structure and temporal fidelity. Across all datasets, EventDiffusion achieves double the accuracy of SOTA methods and demonstrates robustness across different cameras at any resolution.

</details>


### [260] [Towards a Multimodal Aesthetic Agent for Photographic Reference Grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32299)
*Kunjie Lin,Haitao Zhang,Bosheng Chen,Lanhui Xu,Gaofeng Pan,Yuxin Lin,Tianjiao Liu,Yi Yang,Yue Huang,Xinghao Ding,Zixu Lin,Yunlong Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 JarvisAura，一个面向参考图引导摄影调色的多模态美学智能体，将调色建模为可编辑参数空间中的结构化决策，兼顾审美理解、参考选择与可控渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仅图像参考方法只能对齐整体外观，缺乏基于指令的选择性迁移；像素空间生成编辑器常输出扁平化图像，缺少可编辑参数，难以继续精修。因此需要既能理解用户意图又能输出可控调色参数的方案。

Method: JarvisAura 集成视觉属性感知、策略级推理和参数化执行，构建从审美规划到后端渲染及参数细化的统一推理—执行流程；采用三阶段训练：参数—外观关联的持续预训练、参考图引导的监督微调，以及基于多维奖励和动态数据生成的参考对齐组相对策略优化。

Result: 在 Ref-Bench 上，JarvisAura 在报告的各自动指标中取得同类方法最佳表现，并获得 74% 的人工评定任务成功率，比 GPT-Image-2.5 高 9 个百分点。

Conclusion: 将摄影调色表述为可编辑参数空间中的结构化决策，并结合多模态美学智能体与分阶段训练，可在参考图引导下实现更可解释、可控且更符合用户意图的调色效果。

Abstract: Reference-guided photographic color grading helps users realize their aesthetic intent by selectively drawing on the color and tonal characteristics of a reference photograph. Doing so requires understanding which characteristics users wish to adopt and translating these preferences into controllable edits. However, image-only reference methods align overall appearance without instruction-grounded selection, while pixel-space generative editors typically produce flattened images without editable parameters, limiting subsequent refinement. To address these challenges, we introduce JarvisAura, a multimodal aesthetic agent that formulates photographic color grading as structured decision-making in an editable parameter space. JarvisAura offers three key advantages: (1) an aesthetic agent paradigm that integrates visual attribute perception, strategy-level reasoning, and parameterized execution for interpretable and controllable photographic color grading; (2) a unified reasoning-to-execution pipeline that connects aesthetic planning with backend rendering and editable parameter refinement; and (3) a three-stage training strategy comprising Parameter-Grounded Continual Pre-Training for parameter-appearance grounding, Reference-Grounded Supervised Fine-Tuning for reference-guided reasoning and parameter decisions, and Reference-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for rendered-outcome refinement with multidimensional rewards and dynamic data derivation. On Ref-Bench, JarvisAura achieves the best scores among methods with results across reported automatic metrics and a 74% human-rated task-success rate, exceeding GPT-Image-2.5 by 9 percentage points.

</details>


### [261] [CREDIT: Compositional Reliability Learning for Noisy Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32310)
*Tiancai Zhou,Yongxiang Li,Suimei Liu,Zhong Yuan,Dezhong Peng,Xi Peng,Xu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究组合图像检索（CIR）中噪声三元组对应（NTC）问题，提出CREDIT框架，通过证据不确定性学习和扩散引导细化来估计三元组可靠性并抑制噪声监督传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实训练数据常存在参考图像、修改文本和目标图像之间语义对应不可靠的NTC问题。现有方法通常用固定规则判断三元组是否正确，但NTC下语义可靠性并非二值，而是存在不同程度的不确定性，导致对不可靠三元组过度自信并逐步强化噪声语义。

Method: 提出CREDIT框架，包含两个互补模块：ECUL通过证据学习显式建模三元组对应不确定性，实现不确定性感知的可靠性估计以抑制噪声监督；DRR在ECUL提供的可靠监督基础上，利用文本条件扩散进一步细化参考表示，生成更鲁棒的组合查询特征。

Result: 大量实验表明，CREDIT在不同设置下均持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 显式量化三元组对应不确定性并抑制噪声监督传播，有助于提升组合图像检索在噪声数据下的鲁棒性和性能。

Abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that satisfies user intent based on a multimodal query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. However, real-world training data are often corrupted by Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC), where the semantic correspondence among the reference image, modification text, and target image becomes unreliable. Existing methods implicitly assume that the correctness of triplet correspondence can be determined by fixed decision rules. However, under NTC, the authenticity of semantic correspondence is difficult to determine accurately, and different triplets exhibit varying degrees of semantic reliability rather than binary correctness. Consequently, deterministic confidence is insufficient to faithfully characterize correspondence reliability, often leading to overconfident supervision for unreliable triplets and progressively reinforcing noisy semantics during compositional representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose a Compositional Reliability learning framework with Evidential uncertainty and DiffusIon-guided refinemenT (CREDIT), which explicitly quantifies the uncertainty of triplet correspondence to estimate its reliability and suppress the propagation of noisy supervision. CREDIT consists of two complementary components: The Evidential Compositional Uncertainty Learning (ECUL) module explicitly models correspondence uncertainty via evidential learning, enabling uncertaintyaware reliability estimation to suppress noisy supervision. Building upon the reliable supervision provided by ECUL, the Diffusion-enhanced Reference Refinement (DRR) module further refines reference representations through textconditioned diffusion, producing more robust compositional query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CREDIT consistently outperforms existing methods under various settings.

</details>


### [262] [$ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32290)
*Edoardo Giacomello,Sheida Rahnamai Kordasiabi,Mehdi Seifi,Florian Jug*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ε-Seg++，用于稀疏标注电子显微镜体积的语义分割：在层级VAE每一层加入语义专家并用专家乘积融合，支持无泄漏3D子体积输入，并将检查点选择与平均集成作为方法一部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EM体积的逐体素密集标注成本过高；原ε-Seg仅从最高潜层分类且只处理2D patch，同时验证标签稀缺导致检查点选择困难。

Method: 在层级每一层放置语义专家，通过无参数product of experts整合预测；采用无泄漏子体积切分协议支持3D输入并在相同稀疏监督下比较2D/3D；将检查点选择视为方法的一部分，对排名靠前的检查点进行跨训练时间集成。

Result: 在BetaSeg FIB-SEM上，2,500个训练标签时多层专家使2D平均Dice提升约0.1；不超过600标签时2D模型匹配或超过3D ε-Seg且预测成本约为其1/11；超过约1,000标签后3D占优；匹配标注成本下3D ε-Seg++平均Dice为0.905，高于D3PM的0.880，并快5.4至27倍；检查点集成平均表现匹配单最佳选择，并在小验证集时显著改善最差情况。

Conclusion: ε-Seg++通过多层语义专家、3D稀疏监督协议和检查点集成，在稀疏标注EM分割中提升了精度、效率与验证集稀缺下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $ε$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $ε$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, the multi-level experts improve 2D mean Dice by about 0.1 at 2,500 training labels. With up to 600 training labels, the 2D model matches or exceeds 3D $ε$-Seg at about one eleventh of its prediction cost. Above roughly a thousand labels, 3D inputs dominate, and at matched annotation cost 3D $ε$-Seg++ reaches a mean Dice of 0.905 versus 0.880 for D3PM, while predicting between 5.4 and 27 times faster (with our checkpoint ensemble or a single model, respectively). Checkpoint ensembling matches single-best selection on average and markedly improves the worst case when the validation set is small.

</details>


### [263] [MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32297)
*Zichen Zou,Xiaosong Jia,Wen-Ming Chen,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MaskedVGGT：冻结强预训练 2D 编码器，仅预训练随机初始化的多视图 Transformer，通过掩码自蒸馏学习跨视图交互，无需几何标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图自监督方法通常从零联合学习图像表示和跨视图交互，无法利用 DINO、CLIP、前沿 VLM 等 2D 基础模型的持续进步；同时几何标注昂贵，限制数据扩展。

Method: 冻结预训练 2D 编码器，训练新增多视图 Transformer；采用无标注掩码自蒸馏：学生模型基于完整锚视图和高度掩码的其余视图预测被掩码位置目标，EMA 教师基于未掩码输入提供目标；随后微调并扩展到 10 亿参数规模。

Result: 在相同数据、架构和优化更新次数下，MaskedVGGT 预训练后微调优于单阶段监督 VGGT-Ω；也优于 E-RayZer、CroCo、MuM 和 Muskie；加入额外无标注视频可进一步提升泛化，学习到的表示可迁移到多种下游任务。

Conclusion: 有效分工是复用 2D 预训练的强图像表示，并从无标注多视图数据中学习跨视图交互，从而避免依赖几何标注。

Abstract: Multi-view feed-forward models show strong scalability, but their reliance on costly geometric annotations limits data scaling. Existing 3D self-supervised approaches reduce this reliance through cross-view completion (e.g., CroCo, MuM, Muskie) or novel-view synthesis (e.g., RayZer, E-RayZer), typically learning image representations and cross-view interactions jointly. We argue that learning single image representations from scratch is unnecessary for 3D pretraining methods, as doing so fails to benefit from the continuing advances in 2D foundation models (e.g., DINO, CLIP, frontier VLMs). We introduce MaskedVGGT, which freezes a strong pretrained 2D encoder and pretrains only an added, randomly initialized multi-view transformer, focusing on learning interactions across views. MaskedVGGT pretrains the multi-view transformer through masked self-distillation without annotations: a student predicts targets at masked locations based on complete anchor views and heavily masked remaining views, while an exponential-moving-average teacher provides prediction targets based on unmasked inputs. In experiments across model sizes up to 1B parameters, MaskedVGGT pretraining followed by fine-tuning outperforms single-stage supervised VGGT-$Ω$ training with the same training data, model architecture, and total number of optimization updates. MaskedVGGT also outperforms E-RayZer, CroCo, MuM, and Muskie, providing evidence for the effectiveness of building multi-view pretraining on strong 2D representations. Finally, extending pretraining with additional unlabeled videos further improves generalization, and the learned representations transfer to diverse downstream tasks. These results demonstrate an effective division of learning: reuse strong image representations from 2D pretraining and learn cross-view interactions from unlabeled multi-view data without relying on geometric annotations.

</details>


### [264] [Longitudinal Characterization of Personalized Hydration Dynamics Using a Facial-Video Digital Hydration Biomarker](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32326)
*Janindu Athukorala,D. M. J. Prathapa,Thanveer Ahamed,Yudara Kularathne*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该探索性研究通过面部视频生物标志物连续追踪成人水合状态，分析个体内变化、饮水后反应及个体差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水合状态会持续变化，但通常只在单一时间点评估；面部视频水合评分虽能追踪状态转变，其纵向行为和个人校准意义尚不明确。

Method: 5名成人分别完成补水和电解质日，按相同2.0 L饮水计划，在12小时内每30分钟采集面部视频（250段）；另在单独早晨进行500 mL电解质挑战，2小时内采集基线和4次随访视频（25段）。分析轨迹、饮后变化、变异性、评分≥50时间占比，并探索起始评分和饮料日影响。

Result: 10天中7天首次扫描为当日最低。50次饮水后平均升高4.0分，优于打乱时间对照（p<0.001）。21次起始评分<50的饮水后无后续评分下降，平均升高11.3分，高于置换期望5.7分（p<0.001）；起始≥50者无超出偶然的升高。500 mL电解质后5人2小时内平均变化均为正，峰值升高7.2–22.6分，出现在30–90分钟。相同饮水计划下，评分≥50时间占比个体间为16%–100%。电解质日较水日晨基线平均增幅高7.7分，但日顺序固定。

Conclusion: 面部视频水合评分显示与饮水相关的纵向变化及显著个体差异。这些探索性结果支持在更大规模对照研究中进一步验证个人校准和水合方案。

Abstract: Background. Hydration is often assessed at a single time point despite continuous changes in body water. A facial-video biomarker has tracked hydration-state transitions, but its longitudinal behavior is unclear.
  Objective. To assess within-person hydration score changes, individual differences in fluid response, and implications for personal calibration.
  Methods. Five adults completed water and electrolyte days with an identical 2.0 L fluid schedule, using facial videos every 30 minutes over 12 hours (250 videos). On a separate morning, each completed a 500 mL electrolyte challenge with baseline and four follow-up videos over 2 hours (25 videos). Analyses assessed trajectories, post-drink changes, variability, time at or above score 50, and exploratory effects of starting score and beverage day.
  Results. The first scan was the day's lowest on 7 of 10 days. Across 50 intakes, the mean post-drink change was +4.0 points, exceeding a shuffled-time comparison (p less than 0.001). For 21 intakes starting below 50, no subsequent score fell; the mean rise was +11.3 points versus +5.7 expected under permutation (p less than 0.001). Intakes starting at 50 or above showed no rise beyond chance. After 500 mL electrolytes, mean change over 2 hours was positive for all five participants, with peak increases of 7.2 to 22.6 points at 30 to 90 minutes. Despite identical fluid schedules, time at or above 50 ranged from 16% to 100%. The electrolyte day showed a greater mean increase from morning baseline than the water day (+7.7 points), although day order was fixed.
  Conclusion. Facial-video hydration scores showed longitudinal changes associated with drinking and marked individual differences. These exploratory findings support further research on personal calibration and hydration protocols in larger controlled studies.

</details>


### [265] [SofaSpace: A Benchmark for Executable Visual Spatial Reasoning in Continuous Motion and Environment Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32285)
*Ze Rong,Kun Shi,Zhedong Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 受移动沙发问题启发，论文提出SofaSpace基准，用于评估连续平面刚体运输与环境构建中的视觉空间推理，包含3000个场景、四类任务视图和534个SofaSpace-Hard任务，并用几何验证器检查完整运动过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刚体可能在起点和终点都可行，但在移动途中撞墙；现有评估容易关注端点一致性而忽略连续有效性，因此需要区分端点一致与有效运动、几何可行与功能合规。

Method: 构建SofaSpace基准，围绕几何兼容性、非局部机动规划、交互与时间协调三类挑战组织3000个场景；设置四类任务：规划运动、重建布局、设计满足运输需求的环境、联合生成布局与运动；另设534个SofaSpace-Hard任务测试规划与判断；使用几何验证器对提交运动的整个刚体过程进行检查。

Result: 静态规划任务中，端点一致率与连续有效率差异显著：Claude从97.2%降至52.8%，DeepSeek从100.0%降至30.6%，Kimi从97.2%降至29.4%，最强配置仍保持98.3%的完全有效率。环境构建中，最强配置生成的295个可行布局有181个满足全部功能要求，而Kimi为172个中仅1个。

Conclusion: 可执行检查能够区分端点一致与有效运动、几何可行与功能合规；SofaSpace揭示了连续空间推理和功能合规评估的重要性。

Abstract: A rigid body can fit at its start and goal yet collide with a wall as it moves between them. Inspired by the moving sofa problem, we introduce SofaSpace, a benchmark for visual spatial reasoning through continuous planar rigid-body transport and environment construction. SofaSpace contains 3,000 scenes organized around three challenges: geometric compatibility, nonlocal maneuver planning, and interactive and temporal coordination. Four task views ask models to plan a motion, reconstruct a layout, design an environment that meets transport requirements, or jointly generate a layout and a motion. A separate set of 534 SofaSpace-Hard tasks tests planning and judgment. A geometric verifier checks the entire body throughout each submitted motion. On static planning tasks, endpoint agreement and continuous validity differ substantially within the same submitted plans: Claude drops from 97.2% to 52.8%, DeepSeek from 100.0% to 30.6%, and Kimi from 97.2% to 29.4%, while the strongest configuration retains 98.3% full validity. Environment construction reveals a further gap. Of 295 feasible layouts generated by the strongest configuration, 181 satisfy all evaluated functional requirements; for Kimi, one of 172 does. These results show how executable checks distinguish endpoint agreement from valid motion and geometric feasibility from functional compliance.

</details>


### [266] [Improving Character Identity Consistency in Diffusion-Based Visual Story Generation through Identity Memory and Automatic Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32383)
*Maria-Emilia Grigore,Stelian Spînu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Stable Diffusion XL的模块化多帧视觉故事生成流程，通过LoRA、ControlNet、IP-Adapter、Best-of-K重排序和身份记忆机制提升角色身份一致性，并在自定义分级基准上验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在自动视觉故事生成中日益重要，但连续帧间角色身份一致性仍具挑战，现有模型常出现面部特征、服装、视觉风格或人体比例显著变化。

Method: 构建模块化流程：使用Stable Diffusion XL，结合LoRA角色个性化、ControlNet姿态结构控制、IP-Adapter视觉身份迁移，并引入Best-of-K候选选择与持久身份记忆的重排序机制。同时集成并扩展StoryDiffusion为可复现本地工作流，采用CLIP图像相似度、DINO相似度和CLIP文本-图像对齐等自动指标，在包含多角色和多故事且按易、中、难分级的自定义基准上评估SDXL基线、Best-of-K、身份记忆和完整流程等变体。

Result: 实验表明，重排序、身份记忆和视觉条件控制能够减少跨帧身份漂移，并提升生成视觉故事的整体连贯性和稳定性。

Conclusion: 所提模块化流程可有效改善多帧视觉故事生成中的角色身份一致性，并提供可复现的本地工作流及帧选择改进。

Abstract: Automatic visual story generation using diffusion-based models has become an increasingly important research direction in generative artificial intelligence. However, maintaining character identity consistency across consecutive frames remains an open challenge, as existing models often produce significant variations in facial traits, clothing, visual style, or anatomical proportions. This paper proposes a modular pipeline to improve character identity consistency in multi-frame visual story generation using Stable Diffusion XL alongside additional conditioning and automatic selection mechanisms. The proposed system integrates LoRA fine-tuning for character personalization, ControlNet for pose-based structural control, and IP-Adapter for visual identity transfer. Furthermore, a reranking mechanism based on Best-of-K candidate selection and persistent identity memory is introduced to automatically select the most visually consistent generated images. The work also includes integrating and extending the StoryDiffusion framework into a reproducible local workflow, along with improvements for generated frame selection. Performance evaluation uses automatic metrics such as CLIP image similarity, DINO similarity, and CLIP text-image alignment. Experimental evaluation was conducted on a custom benchmark of multiple characters and visual stories organized into difficulty levels (easy, medium, and difficult). Both progressive variants of the proposed pipeline and extended versions of StoryDiffusion were evaluated, including SDXL baseline, Best-of-K, Identity Memory, and the Full Pipeline. Results show that reranking, identity memory, and visual conditioning reduce identity drift across frames and improve the overall coherence and stability of generated visual stories.

</details>


### [267] [GUI-WEdit and GUI-SkillEvo: Gradient-Free Adaptation of Small GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32332)
*Haixia Bi,Yingtian Chen,Sihan Yang,Zuzheng Kuang,Yuzhen Tong,Kai Fu,Zhengyong Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出两种无梯度适配的小型GUI智能体GUI-WEdit-4B与GUI-SkillEvo-2B，分别通过受约束的后期MLP权重更新和迭代式程序性技能演化来提升桌面工作流执行可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型GUI智能体虽能执行桌面工作流，但重复的局部错误和脆弱的程序性决策限制了其可靠性，因此需要更稳健的适配方法。

Method: 基于GUI-Owl-1.5骨干进行无梯度适配：4B模型利用轨迹反馈对后期多层感知机（MLP）构造受保护的闭式更新，并将成功状态作为保护约束；最终仅改变一个权重张量中的23,739,095个参数，占44.378亿参数骨干的0.535%。2B模型保持权重固定，由助手迭代提出并优化程序性技能。

Result: 在排除Google Drive任务的361项OSWorld子集上，两个冻结系统分别取得48.02%和45.47%的最终聚合得分。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过受约束的局部权重编辑或固定的程序性技能演化，可以在有限参数改动或权重冻结条件下适配小型GUI智能体，并获得所报告的OSWorld聚合性能。

Abstract: Small graphical user interface (GUI) agents can execute desktop workflows, but repeated local errors and fragile procedural decisions limit their reliability. We present GUI-WEdit-4B and GUI-SkillEvo-2B, two gradient-free adaptations of GUI-Owl-1.5 backbones. For the 4B model, we use trajectory feedback to construct guarded, closed-form updates to a late multilayer perceptron (MLP), retaining successful states as protection constraints. The final checkpoint changes 23,739,095 parameter values, or 0.535\% of the 4,437,815,808-parameter backbone, within one weight tensor. For the 2B model, an assistant iteratively proposes and refines procedural skills while the model weights remain fixed. On the 361-task OSWorld subset excluding Google Drive tasks, the frozen systems obtain final aggregate scores of 48.02\% and 45.47\%, respectively.

</details>


### [268] [Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32337)
*Hao Liu,Xiang Tang,Ruotong Li,Xiaopeng Fan,Yujiu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的闭环视频生成框架STEP，通过短片段逐步规划物理事件，提升生成视频的物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常预先生成整段视频的运动轨迹，预测误差会累积并降低后续帧质量。

Method: STEP采用短时事件规划，每轮包括四步：从最新帧测量场景状态；预测下一物理事件并渲染为控制片段；在控制下生成下一短片段；验证事件是否发生，若未发生则重采样。每轮基于实际生成帧，形成闭环。

Result: 在Physics-IQ Verified和PhyGenBench上，STEP提升了三种冻结生成器的物理合理性，且无需训练即可应用于新生成器。

Conclusion: 短程闭环控制可减少长程预测误差累积，提高视频生成的物理可信度，并具有良好的通用性。

Abstract: Video generation models synthesize realistic imagery yet still struggle to produce physically plausible evolution. Existing methods guide generation with a motion trajectory predicted for the entire clip in advance, so prediction errors accumulate and degrade later frames. We propose STEP(Short-Term Event Planning), a training-free closed-loop framework that guides generation one short clip at a time. Each round consists of four steps: grounding measures the scene state from the latest frames, event planning predicts the next physical event and renders it into a control clip, latent-guided generation produces the next short clip under this control, and verification checks whether the event occurs and resamples the clip if it does not. Because each round is grounded in the frames actually generated, control relies only on reliable short-range predictions. STEP improves the physical plausibility of three frozen generators on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, and can be applied to new generators without training.

</details>


### [269] [SynAVID: A Synthetic Audio-Visual Immersive Dataset of Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32311)
*Jun Xu,Sujing Li,Chunhao Bi,Zhengxue Cheng,Ronghua Wu,Qunshan Gu,Li Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SynAVID，一个包含八个室内外场景的合成音视频沉浸式数据集，用于在变化视点和场景条件下同步建模视觉与双耳听觉，并评测现有视觉重建、双耳音频重建和音视频编辑方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沉浸式场景建模需要视点与场景条件变化下同步的视觉和听觉观测，但获取可控场景变化所需的同步观测与参考数据仍然困难。

Method: 构建包含八个室内外场景、分钟级片段的合成音视频数据集；每个片段结合固定相机阵列与移动轨迹，并提供同步、视点相关的双耳音频；通过共享场景动态、声源事件和观察者位姿驱动视觉渲染与几何感知声学合成；评测现有视觉重建、双耳音频重建和音视频编辑方法。

Result: 混合观测配置通常能提升固定与移动测试视图上的视觉重建，但短暂占据和稀疏观测区域仍具挑战；不同方法在频谱、双耳和感知音频指标上的排名不一致；几何与实例标注揭示观测支持不均衡及局部高斯表示问题；配对参考可评估目标编辑与周围内容，受控几何变化会产生依赖听者的声学响应。

Conclusion: SynAVID为受控场景变化下的同步音视频沉浸式建模提供了合成数据与评测基准，表明现有方法在视觉重建、双耳音频重建和音视频编辑方面仍有改进空间，尤其需要关注稀疏观测区域和听者相关声学响应。

Abstract: Immersive scene modeling requires synchronized visual and auditory observations under changing viewpoints and scene conditions. Obtaining such observations and references for controlled scene changes remains challenging. We introduce SynAVID, a synthetic audio-visual immersive dataset comprising eight indoor and outdoor scenes. Each minute-scale episode combines fixed camera arrays and moving trajectories with synchronized, viewpoint-dependent binaural audio. Shared scene dynamics, sound-source events, and observer poses drive visual rendering and geometry-aware acoustic synthesis. We evaluate existing methods for visual reconstruction, binaural audio reconstruction, and audiovisual editing. Mixed-observation configurations generally improve visual reconstruction on fixed and moving test views, while transiently occupied and sparsely observed regions remain challenging. Methods rank differently on spectral, interaural, and perceptual audio metrics. Geometric and instance annotations expose uneven observation support and local Gaussian representations beyond aggregate scores. Paired references assess target edits and surrounding content, while controlled geometry changes produce listener-dependent acoustic responses. The project page is available at https://avery-xu.github.io/synavid-project/.

</details>


### [270] [FlowVecFont: Scalable Vector Font Generation via Latent Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32327)
*Takumu Fujioka,Gouhei Tanaka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 FlowVecFont，一种仅基于矢量轮廓训练、可扩展的纯矢量字体生成模型。它用 Transformer 变分自编码器将字形序列编码为定长连续潜变量 token，再通过条件流匹配生成矢量字形；在 500 万字形数据上验证了模型规模扩展带来的质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有矢量字体生成方法常依赖专门生成/细化机制、位图表示或外部预训练模型，导致系统复杂、计算与实现成本增加，并引入对外部资源的依赖。作者希望用简单模型的规模化实现高质量纯矢量字体生成，且无需外部预训练。

Method: 提出 FlowVecFont：基于潜空间流匹配的矢量字体生成模型，仅用矢量轮廓训练。采用 Transformer 变分自编码器将字形序列映射为固定长度连续潜变量 token，从而支持标准条件流匹配进行矢量字形生成。模型可基于类别标签或参考字形条件生成，后者可泛化到未见字符和字体。实验使用 Google Fonts 中约 500 万字形，包含非拉丁字符。

Result: 实验表明，在不同条件策略下，生成质量随模型规模增大而提升。在拉丁字形对比中，800M 参数的 FlowVecFont 优于 DeepVecFont-v2 和 DesigNet，并与预训练的 27B 参数 VecGlypher 质量相当。作者还发布了矢量字体机器学习库 TorchFont。

Conclusion: 仅靠扩大简单纯矢量模型的规模，即可实现高质量矢量字体生成，无需外部预训练或复杂专用机制；FlowVecFont 展示了可扩展性与竞争力，并提供了配套工具库 TorchFont。

Abstract: Fonts are natively represented as vector outlines. Many existing studies on vector font generation have relied on specialized generation or refinement mechanisms, bitmap representations, or externally pretrained models to address the challenges of learning vector representations. These approaches often increase system complexity, incur additional computational and implementation costs, and introduce dependencies on external resources. We show that scaling a simple model enables high-quality pure vector font generation without external pretraining. We propose FlowVecFont, a scalable model for vector font generation based on latent flow matching and trained solely on vector outlines. A Transformer-based variational autoencoder maps glyph sequences into fixed-length continuous latent tokens, enabling standard conditional flow matching for vector glyph generation. The model supports conditioning on class labels or reference glyphs, with the latter enabling generalization to unseen characters and fonts. Experiments on 5M glyphs collected across Google Fonts, including non-Latin characters, show that generation quality improves with model scale across conditioning strategies. In a comparison on Latin glyphs, the 800M-parameter FlowVecFont outperforms DeepVecFont-v2 and DesigNet and achieves quality competitive with the pretrained 27B-parameter VecGlypher. We also provide TorchFont, a machine learning library for vector fonts.

</details>


### [271] [Visual-State Graph Memory for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32369)
*Ailar Mahdizadeh,Pritam Sarkar,Xiangteng He,Leonid Sigal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的流式视频记忆机制 Visual-State Graph（VSG），用对象关系图和事件日志替代原始帧序列，在固定输入预算下提升对过去内容的推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解中，回答当前问题所需的证据可能已离开近期帧窗口；保留全部帧难以扩展，丢弃旧帧又削弱对过去的推理能力。

Method: VSG 将视频流表示为动态演化的对象关系图及事件日志：重复出现的对象用持久节点表示并记录带时间戳的状态变化；通过比较新对象参与的关系与已有对象关系判断是否为同一对象；在视频到达时构建记忆，提问时在固定输入预算下检索相关对象、事件和近期帧。

Result: 在四个流式视频基准和七个 7B 至 32B 参数的开源视觉语言模型上评估，匹配输入预算时，VSG 提升了对过去内容的推理，同时保持实时理解能力。

Conclusion: VSG 表明，以流的状态而非原始帧序列构建免训练记忆，可在不增加输入预算的情况下兼顾流式视频的实时理解与长时程推理。

Abstract: In streaming video understanding, the evidence needed to answer a question may have already left the recent-frame window. Keeping all frames does not scale with video length, while dropping older frames limits the model's ability to reason about the past. We propose Visual-State Graph (VSG), a training-free memory that stores the state of a stream rather than the raw sequence of frames. VSG represents the stream as a graph of objects and their relations, together with a log of events; similar to a dynamically evolving scene graph. An object observed repeatedly is represented by one persistent node, with a timestamped history of how its state changes. To determine whether a newly mentioned object already exists in the graph, we compare the relations it takes part in with those of stored objects. We build this memory as the video arrives, before the questions are known. When a question arrives, we retrieve relevant objects and events alongside recent frames under a fixed input budget. Our evaluation spans four streaming-video benchmarks and seven open-source vision-language models ranging from 7B to 32B parameters. Under matched input budgets, VSG improves reasoning about the past while preserving real-time understanding.

</details>


### [272] [Cross-Version Compatibility of TESSERA Embeddings Through Lightweight Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32329)
*Yutong Yang,Zhengpeng Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究评估轻量转换器能否让在一个 Tessera 嵌入版本上训练的冻结分类器，继续使用另一个版本的嵌入，从而延长下游模型寿命。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下游模型往往比其训练所依赖的嵌入版本存续更久，因此需要判断跨嵌入版本的兼容转换是否可行。

Method: 在2024年25个站点的6,280个共址三元组上拟合 v1、v1.1、v2 之间的转换器，并采用训练、验证、测试站点不重叠的设计；用四类土地覆盖任务测试，辅以2021 WorldCover 标签和24个无有效原生 v2 值的采样站点评估。

Result: 在真实 v2 上训练的分类器达到0.937准确率和0.844 macro-F1；在原始 v1.1 上仅0.061和0.050，但转换后的 v1.1 达到0.917和0.795。v1 到 v2 的直接转换误差低于经 v1.1 的组合转换。地理迁移较差：在20个新站点上，原站点训练的转换器仅0.597准确率，尽管与 v2 余弦相似度为0.902；新队列内训练的转换器达到0.784。

Conclusion: 转换可在测试站点上恢复冻结分类器的大部分性能，但新站点结果表明嵌入相似度不能替代下游任务评估。

Abstract: Downstream models often outlive the embedding release on which they were trained. We test whether lightweight converters let a classifier trained on one Tessera release use embeddings from another. We fit converters between v1, v1.1, and v2 on 6,280 co-located triplets from 25 sites in 2024, with disjoint training, validation, and test sites. On a four-class land-cover test, a classifier trained on true v2 reaches 0.937 accuracy and 0.844 macro-F1. The same classifier scores 0.061 and 0.050 on raw v1.1, but 0.917 and 0.795 on converted v1.1. Direct v1-to-v2 translation has lower error than composition through v1.1. Geographic transfer is less reliable. On a separate cohort of 20 sites, a converter trained on the original sites reaches 0.597 accuracy despite 0.902 cosine similarity to v2, whereas a converter trained within the new cohort reaches 0.784. Tests with 2021 WorldCover labels and at 24 sampled sites without valid native v2 values extend the evaluation. Conversion recovers much of the frozen classifier's performance on the tested sites, but the new-site result shows that embedding similarity cannot stand in for downstream evaluation.

</details>


### [273] [LRQ-Cache: Compressing Feature Caches in Video Diffusion via Low-Rank Approximation and Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32345)
*Ruizhe Yao,Zhen Huang,Songpan Gao,Danyi Liu,Zijian Cao,Weijie Zheng,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LRQ-Cache 是一种无需训练的视频扩散 Transformer 特征缓存压缩方法，结合低秩近似与量化，大幅降低时间缓存占用，使原本超出单卡显存的预测缓存可在单张 80GB H100 上运行并显著加速生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频 DiT 推理昂贵，时间缓存虽可复用去噪步骤间的中间特征，但密集特征缓存随视频长度、分辨率和缓存覆盖范围增长，达到每视频 109-346 GiB，超过单 GPU 显存，只能 CPU 卸载或跨 GPU 分片，导致生成变慢或缓存而非计算决定 GPU 数量。

Method: 观察到缓存特征存在冗余：少量跨 token 共享的通道模式可捕获大部分能量。提出 LRQ-Cache，将低秩近似与量化结合，用少量因子表示每个缓存特征，存储前量化，复用时重建，且不改变原有缓存机制。

Result: 在 HunyuanVideo 和 Wan2.1 的三种缓存机制上，LRQ-Cache 将预测缓存的持久状态减少 42-71 倍，降至每视频 2.3-4.9 GiB。TeaCache 的 VBench 指标与原生缓存相差 0.25 个百分点以内；Wan2.1 预测缓存较大下降至多 3.5 个百分点，且更高秩可缩小差距。超过单张 80GB H100 显存的预测缓存可放入单卡，生成比 CPU 卸载原生缓存快 2.7-5.9 倍。

Conclusion: 直接压缩缓存状态本身可有效解决视频 DiT 时间缓存的内存瓶颈；LRQ-Cache 无需训练、基本保持生成质量，并使大缓存可在单 GPU 上高效运行。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity generation, but inference is expensive because every denoising step evaluates a large transformer over all spatiotemporal tokens of the video. Temporal caching accelerates them by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps. However, retaining dense feature tensors introduces a persistent storage cost that grows with video length, resolution, and cache coverage, reaching 109-346 GiB per video for the predictive caches we evaluate. Such states exceed the memory of a single GPU, so native caches must either be offloaded to the CPU, which slows generation, or be sharded across several GPUs, e.g., with sequence parallelism, so that the cache rather than the compute sets the number of GPUs. We instead shrink the cached state itself, exploiting its redundancy: a few channel patterns shared across tokens capture much of the energy of each cached feature. Based on this observation, we propose LRQ-Cache, a training-free method that combines low-rank approximation and quantization for feature-cache compression. LRQ-Cache represents each cached feature with a small set of factors, quantizes them before storage, and reconstructs the feature at reuse time, leaving cache mechanisms unchanged. Across three caching mechanisms on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1, LRQ-Cache reduces the persistent state of predictive caches by 42-71x, to 2.3-4.9 GiB per video. VBench stays within 0.25 pp of the native cache for TeaCache, and the larger drops of the Wan2.1 predictive caches, up to 3.5 pp, shrink at higher ranks. As a result, predictive caches that exceed the memory of a single 80 GB H100 GPU fit on it with LRQ-Cache, making generation 2.7-5.9x faster than with CPU-offloaded native caches.

</details>


### [274] [PRC4D: Physical Relation-Constrained Persistent 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32396)
*Junho Kim,Hyunyoung Choi,Jiseok Kim,Seongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PRC4D框架，通过识别可靠的刚性物理关系，在遮挡期间保持多物体4D重建的空间一致性与运动传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将短期接触或共享运动误判为持续刚性关系，可能引入错误运动约束并扭曲整体重建，因此需要区分持久耦合与瞬态交互。

Method: PRC4D结合3D接触、相对运动一致性与序列级验证，构建可靠刚性关系图，并用该图指导观测姿态优化及从可见部件到遮挡部件的运动传播，同时不改变已重建几何。

Result: 在真实多物体序列和受控遮挡仿真中，方法提升了重建精度，降低了相对姿态误差，并在可见性变化下获得更一致的物体配置。

Conclusion: 可靠的物理关系约束有助于提升遮挡下的4D重建一致性与准确性，避免由瞬态交互导致的错误运动约束。

Abstract: A faithful 4D reconstruction should capture both the shape and motion of objects, even when they disappear from view. Existing methods preserve previously observed geometry and extend motion through occlusion using local spatial and motion associations. However, treating short-term contact or shared motion as sufficient evidence of persistent rigidity can introduce incorrect motion constraints and distort overall reconstruction. To address this limitation, we present PRC4D, a physical relation-constrained framework that identifies reliable rigid relations and uses them to maintain spatial consistency through occlusion. PRC4D combines 3D contact and relative motion consistency with sequence-level verification to distinguish persistent couplings from transient interactions. The resulting graph guides observed-pose refinement and motion propagation from visible to occluded components without altering reconstructed geometry. Experiments on diverse real-world multi-object sequences and controlled occlusion simulations demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy, reduced relative pose errors, and more consistent object configurations under changing visibility.

</details>


### [275] [Adaptive and Detection-Aware Super-Resolution for Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32394)
*Cezica-Elena Luncanu,Stelian Spînu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于SRCNN的单图像超分辨率（x4），从经典基线逐步引入残差学习、Charbonnier损失和自适应损失，并评估超分辨率对YOLOv8目标检测的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超分辨率在监控、卫星、医学成像和目标检测等场景中很重要，但重建质量提升是否一定带来下游检测性能提升仍不明确，因此需要任务感知的评估。

Method: 采用SRCNN-based单图像超分辨率方法，逐步加入残差学习、Charbonnier损失和基于梯度划分平滑、纹理、边缘区域的三区域自适应损失；使用PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS和EdgeMAE评估重建与结构细节，并在COCO验证集上用YOLOv8比较双三次插值和SRCNN变体对检测的影响。

Result: 实验表明，更好的重建质量并不总是带来更好的检测性能；但对于小目标，检测感知变体结合残差缩放相比双三次基线提升了F1分数。

Conclusion: 当超分辨率用于计算机视觉流水线时，应重视任务感知评估，而不能仅依赖重建指标。

Abstract: Image super-resolution aims to reconstruct a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input and is relevant for surveillance, satellite imagery, medical imaging, and object detection. This paper investigates SRCNN-based single-image super-resolution for a scale factor of x4, starting from a classical baseline and progressively introducing residual learning, Charbonnier loss, and adaptive loss functions. The proposed approach includes a three-region adaptive loss, where image areas are divided into smooth, texture, and edge regions using gradient information. The models are evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and EdgeMAE in order to measure both reconstruction quality and structural detail preservation. In addition to reconstruction evaluation, the paper analyzes the impact of super-resolution on object detection. A YOLOv8 detector is applied to images processed through bicubic interpolation and SRCNN-based variants, using images from the COCO validation dataset. The results show that improved reconstruction quality does not always lead to better detection performance. However, for small objects, a detection-aware variant combined with residual scaling improves the F1 score compared to the bicubic baseline. These results highlight the importance of task-aware evaluation when super-resolution is used in computer vision pipelines.

</details>


### [276] [LookAnything: A Foundation Model for Holistic Gaze Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32351)
*Jiayu Tang,Yuchen Zhou,Hongsheng Wu,Hanjing Ye,Ke Huang,Cheng Wang,Yuqin Dai,Yufei Huang,Yonggen Ling,Chao Gou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LookAnything，一个统一的注视基础模型，通过大规模多任务跨域训练支持注视定位、描述与推理，并构建HoliGaze基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注视理解方法依赖头部裁剪、深度图等辅助输入和定制架构，易产生级联误差与推理开销；且多在单一领域训练，仅支持热图式注视跟随，缺乏灵活性和泛化能力。

Method: 提出LookAnything基础模型，统一多种注视中心任务；引入可学习注视先验查询以增强注视感知表征，无需外部辅助输入；支持点、框、热图、语言等多类输出；构建HoliGaze语料与基准，含31.1万问答对、5个能力维度和9项任务。

Result: LookAnything在整体注视跟随任务上持续优于33个领先视觉语言模型，并在5个传统目标检测基准上与专用专家模型保持高度竞争力；在未见数据集和真实机器人部署中验证了域外泛化与灵活适应能力。

Conclusion: LookAnything弥合了现有注视理解方法在灵活性、泛化性和多任务统一性上的不足，为多样交互场景提供了可泛化的注视中心基础模型。

Abstract: Human gaze provides a rich window into attention and intent, making its understanding essential for applications ranging from social signal analysis to human-robot interaction. Existing methods typically employ highly customized architectures relying on auxiliary inputs like head crops or depth maps, causing cascading errors and inference overhead. Trained on single domains and confined to isolated gaze following with heatmap outputs, they lack flexibility and generalization for diverse interactive scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present LookAnything, a foundation model that unifies diverse gaze-centric tasks for holistic gaze following. Benefiting from large-scale multi-task and cross-domain training, LookAnything flexibly adapts to various settings, generating diverse outputs (points, boxes, heatmaps, and language) and supporting broad gaze-centric localization, description, and reasoning. At its core, we introduce learnable gaze-prior queries to promote gaze-aware representation learning, eliminating the need for auxiliary external inputs. To facilitate this paradigm, we construct HoliGaze, a comprehensive corpus and benchmark comprising 311K question-answer pairs across 5 capability dimensions and 9 distinct tasks. Experiments demonstrate that LookAnything consistently outperforms 33 leading vision-language models on holistic gaze following, while remaining highly competitive with dedicated specialists across 5 conventional target detection benchmarks. Evaluation on unseen datasets and deployment on a real robot further validate its strong out-of-domain generalization and flexible adaptation in real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [277] [Every Edit Its Own Budget: Per-Instruction Token Freezing for Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-Edit Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32407)
*Jyotirmoy Nath,Neeraj Kumar,Brejesh Lall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 TIDE，一种免训练、指令感知的基于漂移的图像编辑加速方法，为每条指令部分分配独立的计算预算，通过不平衡最优传输定位各部分区域，并按相对漂移冻结 token、只计算剩余 token，从而在多指令编辑场景下加速且不丢失编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于指令的图像编辑中，当一条指令包含多个编辑时，加速极具挑战。现有免训练加速器对整幅图使用单一阈值跳过预测已停止变化的 token，但该阈值一旦为速度而调高，会优先冻结小而收敛慢的编辑，导致用户请求的编辑消失。

Method: 1) 通过不平衡最优传输在编辑器自身的注意力中定位每条指令部分对应的区域，无需掩码或外部模型；2) 当某 token 的漂移相对其所属部分足够小时将其冻结，并沿直线路径移动到其终点估计；3) 稀疏引擎仅计算剩余 token。论文还证明部分无关规则无法保证逐部分误差预算，刻画了每个部分的最优阈值策略（除一个平局类外），并推导出该规则达到最优的条件。

Result: 在 FLUX.2 Klein 上，单一全局阈值在 89% 的 MICE-Bench 图像中至少破坏一个编辑的预算，而 TIDE 在相同或更高速度下最多少丢弃 77% 的编辑（MICE-Bench 上为 48%），人类评分者确认了这一差距。在多步的 Klein Base 上，TIDE 在六个基准上均为最快（4.81–4.89x），所需 TFLOPs 比原始方法少 5.3x，为实测最大节省。相同设置下在 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511（第二个模型家族）上也是最快（3.46–3.52x），并在全部六个基准上丢弃编辑最少。

Conclusion: TIDE 通过为每条指令部分分配独立计算预算并按相对漂移冻结 token，实现了免训练的多指令编辑加速，在多个模型家族和基准上兼顾速度与编辑完整性，显著优于全局阈值方案，代码将公开。

Abstract: Accelerating instruction-based image editing when one instruction requests several edits is challenging. Many training-free accelerators for flow-matching image editors skip tokens whose prediction has stopped changing, but decide this with a single threshold for the whole image. With several edits, such a threshold, tuned for speed, freezes small and slowly settling edits first, and requested edits disappear. We propose TIDE (Training-free Instruction-aware Drift-based Editing), which gives every instruction part its own compute budget. First, TIDE finds the region of each part in the editor's own attention by unbalanced optimal transport, without masks or external models. Second, it freezes a token once its drift is small relative to its own part and moves it along the straight path to its endpoint estimate. Third, a sparse engine computes only the remaining tokens. We prove that part-agnostic rules cannot guarantee per-part error budgets, characterize the optimal per-part threshold policy up to one tie class per part, and derive when our rule attains it. On FLUX.2 Klein, one global threshold breaks at least one edit's budget in 89% of MICE-Bench images, and TIDE drops up to 77% fewer edits at matched or higher speed (48% on MICE-Bench), a gap human raters confirm. On the many-step Klein Base, TIDE is the fastest compared method on six benchmarks (4.81-4.89x) and needs 5.3x fewer TFLOPs than vanilla, the largest saving we measure. With the same settings, it is also the fastest compared method on Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, a second model family (3.46-3.52x), and drops the fewest edits on all six benchmarks. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [278] [Sub-Riemannian structure for Oriented Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32361)
*Thomas Besnier,Stefan Sommer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文针对3D有向点云中基于欧氏空间局部性的信息聚合易跨越几何上不同但空间接近的表面问题，提出在位置-方向空间上定义亚黎曼接触度量，并导出可近似局部距离的显式评分用于下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法用R^3中的k近邻和半径球定义局部性，可能把空间接近但几何上分离的表面（如薄叶两面的点）错误合并，导致特征跨边界泄漏并影响性能。

Method: 将点提升为位置-法向对(x,n)，在M=R^3×S^2上引入非完整水平分布：空间速度须位于法向正交平面内，法向可重新定向但有代价，从而定义亚黎曼接触度量，并导出显式评分以比较有向点。

Result: 将该评分作为PointNet++聚合机制中的直接替换后，在接触附近的分割和对应精度提升；用于模拟有向点上的热扩散时，跨边界泄漏减少。

Conclusion: 基于位置-方向空间的亚黎曼接触度量能更几何一致地定义有向点云局部性，减少薄结构或接触面间的特征泄漏，并改善分割、对应和扩散等下游任务。

Abstract: Many frameworks dealing with 3D (oriented) point clouds define locality in the ambient Euclidean space: $k$-nearest-neighbor graphs and radius balls in $\mathbb{R}^3$ are critical to define which points are "close to one another" and should exchange information. This can unintentionally merge sampled surfaces that are close in space but geometrically distinct such as the two faces of a thin leaf. Then, features are more prone to leak across boundaries which hinder performance. To address this, we propose to define a sub-Riemannian contact metric on position-orientation space $\mathbb{M}=\mathbb{R}^3\times \mathbb{S}^2$: points are lifted to $(x,n)$ with $n$ a surface normal, and "motion" is constrained to a non-holonomic horizontal distribution in which spatial velocity must stay in the plane orthogonal to the normal which can reorient at a cost. From this, we derive an explicit score, which locally approximate the distance, to compare oriented points for downstream tasks. We report improved segmentation and correspondence accuracy near contact when using the score as a drop-in change inside PointNet++ aggregation mechanism as well as reduced leakage when using it to simulate heat diffusion on oriented points.

</details>


### [279] [TESS: Query-Guided Temporal Event-Structured Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32410)
*Qi Lu,Shiyan Tong,Shujie Li,Sen Li,Likun shi,Maofei Que,Xiaolong Jiang,Yao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出无需训练的 TESS 框架，用于长视频中基于查询的时间事件结构化帧选择，通过保留参考事件与目标事件的互补证据及其时间顺序，提升长视频时间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频中与问题相关的关键事件稀疏且分散，视觉预算有限时容易遗漏事件或其时间上下文；现有帧选择方法多关注语义相关性或时间覆盖，忽视定位相关事件并建立时间关系所需的互补证据。

Method: TESS 是无需训练的查询引导时间事件结构化帧选择框架，联合选择展示参考事件和目标事件且符合所需时间顺序的帧；基于冻结的视觉-语言表示，结合软时间门控、角色感知预算分配和角色内冗余抑制来保留互补事件证据。

Result: 在四个长视频理解基准和三个多模态骨干网络上，TESS 在固定帧预算下比最强基线稳定提升 4.0 至 5.5 个百分点；在更长视频和更紧视觉预算下表现更优，独立证据标注也证实其提升了事件与时间关系覆盖。

Conclusion: 显式组织时间证据是一种有效的免训练策略，可保留事件关系并支持长视频中的高效时间推理。

Abstract: Temporal localization in long videos is challenging because brief, question-relevant events are dispersed among extensive redundant content. Limited visual budgets increase the risk of omitting these events or their temporal context, undermining reliable reasoning. Existing frame selection methods emphasize semantic relevance or temporal coverage, often overlooking the complementary evidence needed to locate related events and establish their temporal relationships. To address this limitation, we propose TESS, a training-free framework for query-guided temporal event-structured frame selection. TESS selects frames that jointly show the reference event and the event asked about, in the required temporal order. Leveraging frozen vision-language representations, TESS integrates soft temporal gating, role-aware budget allocation, and within-role redundancy suppression to preserve complementary event evidence. Extensive experiments across four long-video understanding benchmarks and three multimodal backbones demonstrate that TESS consistently outperforms the strongest compared baseline by 4.0-5.5 percentage points under a fixed frame budget. Further analyses reveal greater improvements on longer videos and robust performance under tighter visual budgets, while independent evidence annotations confirm enhanced event and temporal-relation coverage. These findings establish explicit temporal evidence organization as an effective training-free strategy for preserving event relationships and supporting efficient temporal reasoning over long videos. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TESS_code.

</details>


### [280] [Video Models are Excellent Motion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32432)
*Kian Izadpanah,Ali Mahdavi Amiri,Daniel Cohen-Or,Yiorgos Chrysanthou,Andreas Aristidou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文主张视频基础模型已成为强大的运动生成器，其运动先验比专用运动模型更丰富、更通用，并通过统一评估框架验证这一观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
