Motivation: 作者认为视频基础模型不仅能生成动态视觉内容，还蕴含更自然、范围更广的运动先验；需要系统比较其与专用运动模型在运动生成与运动控制上的能力差异。

Method: 提出统一评估框架，在三种设置下比较视频基础模型与专用运动模型：纯文本运动生成、从稀疏关键帧重建视频生成运动、基于视频增强运动模型输出；将所有输出转换为共享3D骨骼表示，评估运动自然性、语义对齐、动作覆盖、物理运动特征及对运动约束的保真度，并研究宽松骨骼控制下的运动条件生成。

Result: 视频基础模型能生成更自然、语义更有意义的运动，尤其在复杂和复合动作上表现更好；专用运动模型并不总能稳定改进视频生成运动，而视频模型可利用稀疏运动引导增强骨骼动画。

Conclusion: 专用运动模型的角色可能发生转变：从生成完整动画转向引导和控制视频基础模型中已嵌入的更丰富运动能力。

Abstract: Video foundation models have emerged as powerful generators of dynamic visual content, exhibiting remarkable capabilities in synthesizing complex actions and interactions. We argue that these models have also become excellent motion generators, with motion priors that are richer and more general than those learned by dedicated motion models. Their advantage extends beyond visual realism and is manifested in two important aspects: motion naturalness, including coherent body coordination, physical plausibility, and realistic interactions with objects and the environment; and motion scope, encompassing a much broader range of activities and semantic coherence, particularly uncommon, complex, and compound actions. To investigate this position, we introduce a common evaluation framework that compares video and dedicated motion models through three complementary settings: text-only motion generation, reconstruction of video-generated motion from sparse keyframes, and video-based enrichment of motion-model outputs. By converting all outputs into a shared 3D skeletal representation, we evaluate motion naturalness, semantic alignment, action coverage, physical motion characteristics, and fidelity to motion constraints. Our results suggest that video foundation models can generate more natural and semantically meaningful movements, particularly for complex and compound actions. Moreover, we investigate motion-conditioned generation through loose skeletal control, finding that dedicated motion models do not consistently improve video-generated motion, while video models can enrich skeletal animations using sparse motion guidance. Our findings suggest a shift in the role of specialized motion models, from generating complete animations to guiding and controlling the richer motion capabilities already embedded in video foundation models.

</details>


### [281] [PVWander: 3D Memory-guided Panoramic Video Wandering with Path-Facing Canonicalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32443)
*Chuanxin Song,Xiaodong Wang,Shijie Chen,Junliang Xie,Zhanmi Zhong,Suiying Wu,Peixi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PVWander，一种基于 3D 记忆引导的全景视频生成框架，用于从初始 ERP 全景沿指定轨迹持续合成场景一致的 360° 长时观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全景视频模型在相机控制生成上已有进展，3D 引导方法也能提升场景一致性，但长时稳定漫游仍受运动与朝向关系多样、生成伪影和深度误差导致记忆引导不完美等问题困扰。

Method: PVWander 将已生成观测累积到在线点云记忆并重投影以引导后续生成，并设计 Path-Facing canonicalization 对齐运动与朝向，以及 Timestep-aware gating modulation 根据扩散去噪的时间步自适应调节重投影记忆引导。

Result: 实验表明 PVWander 提升了长时全景视频生成质量，消融实验验证了 Path-Facing canonicalization 和 Timestep-aware gating modulation 两个设计的有效性。

Conclusion: PVWander 通过 3D 记忆引导和两种互补设计，有效缓解长时全景视频漫游中的一致性与记忆引导问题，实现更稳定的长时生成。

Abstract: Long-horizon panoramic video wandering aims to continuously synthesize scene-consistent $360^\circ$ observations along user-specified camera trajectories from an initial equirectangular projection (ERP) panorama. Existing panoramic video models have achieved promising results in camera-controlled generation, while recent 3D-guided approaches further provide geometric guidance for improving scene consistency. However, stable long-horizon wandering remains challenging due to diverse motion--orientation relationships and imperfect memory guidance induced by accumulated generation artifacts and depth inaccuracies. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PVWander}, a 3D-memory-guided framework that accumulates generated observations into an online point-cloud memory and reprojects it to guide subsequent generation, with two complementary designs: \textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} for motion--orientation alignment and \textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} for adaptive memory guidance. \textit{Path-Facing canonicalization} exploits the horizontal cyclic symmetry of ERP panoramas to uniformly align each clip's ERP orientation with its principal translation direction, yielding more consistent, forward-like relative motions while preserving the prescribed camera path. \textit{Timestep-aware gating modulation} exploits the coarse-to-fine nature of diffusion denoising to adaptively regulate reprojected memory guidance through timestep-dependent channel-wise gates, preserving its structural benefits while mitigating visual artifacts from imperfect projections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVWander achieves improved long-horizon generation quality, while ablations validate the effectiveness of both designs.

</details>


### [282] [ObsBridge: Observation-Grounded Conditioning for Ego Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32447)
*Zhenhao Wang,Shaofeng Liang,Jiemin Wu,Sijia Chen,Keni Shi,Nan Li,Wenshuo Chen,Bowen Tian,Runwei Guan,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ObsBridge，一种基于观测桥接的历史状态恢复与流式轨迹预测框架，用于提升自我视角下行人轨迹预测在遮挡、可见性受限和跟踪误差下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我视角行人预测中，遮挡、有限视野和跟踪误差会污染观测到的运动历史；现有方法要么先补全噪声历史再预测，要么联合训练辅助历史重建分支，但预测器仍可能对恢复历史中的残余误差敏感，且辅助重建仍在原始损坏坐标上计算交互。

Method: ObsBridge 首先使用冻结估计器，从智能体相对位置、自我相对位置、图像平面位置和可见性状态中恢复历史运动；训练时采用智能体级课程学习，逐步用完整估计历史替换干净教师历史，使预测器适应不完美恢复；设计残差几何适配器融合编码运动与原始观测证据，并通过社会注意力聚合表示，条件化流式轨迹生成器。

Result: 在多个基准上实验表明 ObsBridge 优于现有最先进方法；在 EgoTraj-TBD 上，minADE@20 降低 6.5%，minFDE@20 降低 8.7%。

Conclusion: 将未来预测同时条件化于恢复的历史状态和原始观测证据，并通过渐进训练适应不完美恢复，可有效提升自我视角行人轨迹预测的鲁棒性和准确性。

Abstract: Pedestrian forecasting from ego-view observations is challenging because occlusion, limited visibility, and tracking errors corrupt observed motion histories. Such errors are particularly consequential for autonomous robot navigation. Existing paradigms typically either impute noisy history positions before forecasting or jointly train an auxiliary history reconstruction branch. However, predictors trained on clean histories may be sensitive to residual errors in recovered histories at deployment. Meanwhile, auxiliary reconstruction still computes inter-agent interactions over raw, corrupted coordinates. We investigate conditioning future prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, with progressive training to accommodate imperfect recovery. Building on this insight, we propose ObsBridge, a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework with observation-grounded historical bridging. Specifically, ObsBridge first employs a frozen estimator to recover historical motion from agent-relative and ego-relative positions, image-plane locations, and visibility states. During training, we introduce an agent-wise curriculum that gradually replaces clean teacher histories with complete estimated histories before context encoding. This progressively exposes the predictor to estimated histories during training. Furthermore, we design a residual geometry adapter to fuse the encoded motion with original observation evidence. We aggregate the resulting representations through social attention to condition the flow-based trajectory generator. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ObsBridge outperforms state-of-the-art methods. On EgoTraj-TBD, it reduces minADE@20 by 6.5\% and minFDE@20 by 8.7\%. The code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge.

</details>


### [283] [One Subspace Is Not Enough: LocalSubspaceAD for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32424)
*Daniel Pröll,Sebastian Hegenbart*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 LocalSubspaceAD，将 SubspaceAD 的单一主成分子空间扩展为多个局部子空间，用于少样本工业异常检测；方法无需训练，通过 k-means 对基础模型 patch 特征聚类并为每个簇拟合子空间，以所有子空间重投影残差的最小值作为异常分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业正常样本在外观、纹理和几何上差异很大，而少样本场景只能从少量图像建模这种变化。单一子空间必须覆盖全部正常变化，导致某个语义区域中异常偏差可能落入另一区域的正常变化范围内。

Method: 使用基础模型的 patch 特征，先用 k-means 将相似 patch 特征分组，并为每个簇拟合一个主成分子空间；每个 patch 的异常分数取其在所有子空间中重投影残差的最小值。该方法不需要训练，也不需要 EM 迭代优化。

Result: 在 MVTec AD、VisA 和 Real-IAD 上，使用 1、2、4 shots 时均优于 SubspaceAD：DINOv2 上图像 AUROC 提升 1.2 至 1.8 个点；DINOv3 上图像 AUROC、像素 AUPR 和 AUPRO 提升 1.4 至 4.4 个点。多实例类别和 PCB 等正常外观异质性较强的对象上增益最明显。消融表明增益来自局部子空间对变化更细粒度的建模，而非子空间偏移或单纯增加容量；局部子空间捕捉了特征空间中的连贯簇结构，模型并非压缩记忆库。

Conclusion: LocalSubspaceAD 通过局部化子空间更精细地建模正常外观变化，在少样本异常检测中取得稳定提升，并说明性能收益来自对特征空间簇结构的有效利用。

Abstract: Defect-free industrial samples can vary considerably in appearance, texture, and geometry. In few-shot anomaly detection, this variability has to be modeled from only a handful of images. SubspaceAD showed that a single principal subspace of foundation-model patch features is a strong training-free model of nominal appearance. However, a single subspace has to cover all of the nominal data's variability, so a deviation that is anomalous for one semantic region can be within the nominal variability of another. We propose LocalSubspaceAD, which extends SubspaceAD from a single subspace to a mixture of subspaces, assigning each group of patches with similar features its own subspace. The set of patch-features is partitioned using k-means, one subspace is fit per cluster, and each patch is scored by the minimum of re-projection residuals over all subspaces. The proposed method requires no training and no EM refinement. On MVTec AD, VisA and Real-IAD with 1, 2 and 4 shots, it improves over a single subspace (SubspaceAD) on both evaluated backbones: by 1.2 to 1.8 points image AUROC on DINOv2, and by 1.4 to 4.4 points in image AUROC, pixel AUPR and AUPRO on DINOv3. The gains are most pronounced on objects with heterogeneous nominal appearance, such as multi-instance categories and PCBs. Ablations show that the gains stem from a finer-grained model of variability through locally oriented subspaces, rather than from the subspace offsets (cluster means). We further show that the gains do not stem from added capacity alone: the local subspaces appear to capture the structure of coherent clusters in feature space, and the model does not merely act as a compressed memory bank.

</details>


### [284] [A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32445)
*Joonghyuk Shin,Alex Trevithick,Katarína Tóthová,Liyuan Zhu,Shengyu Huang,Jaesik Park,Shalini De Mello,Laura Leal-Taixé,Riccardo de Lutio,Haithem Turki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 M2R（Mesh to Remember），一种少步因果视频渲染器，将自身特征存储到网格表面对应位置，并通过栅格化网格在表面重新出现时检索特征，从而在长时交互中保持视频世界模型的视觉一致性和物体持久性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型能生成逼真画面，但长期交互中一致性差；显式 3D 世界模型几何与状态持久，但外观不够真实。已有方法用粗网格代理引导视频模型，但代理只指定位置，不指定外观，导致渲染器需反复“发明”外观，表面重现时容易遗忘并重新生成。

Method: 利用网格在不同帧和视角下标识每个像素对应的表面，即使物体移动也可作为渲染内容的“地址”。M2R 将渲染器特征存储在所描绘表面的物体坐标系中，并在表面重新进入视野时通过栅格化网格检索这些特征。外观因此随物体移动、跨重访持久，并可在多个观察代理间共享；内存随可见表面增长，而非随帧数增长。

Result: 仅用合成数据训练的 M2R 可零样本迁移到真实室内扫描和编码代理生成的世界。在静态、动态和多代理基准上，其一致性优于现有方法：物体持久性提升一倍以上，跨代理一致性接近翻倍，同时以 40 FPS 实时渲染 720p 视频。

Conclusion: 将网格作为像素对应表面的持久地址，并在表面上存储和检索渲染特征，可有效解决视频世界模型长期一致性、物体持久性和多代理共享外观的问题，同时保持实时高分辨率渲染能力。

Abstract: Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates. We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).

</details>


### [285] [TDD: Target-Discrepancy Distillation for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32467)
*Zefan Feng,Zhaocheng Yu,Laibin Chang,Kui Jiang,Junjun Jiang,Xiaopeng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向水下图像增强的目标差异知识蒸馏（TDD）方法，通过对参考目标外观与退化图像相对该目标的差异进行联合蒸馏，并在推理时仅依赖退化图像完成增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下退化会改变图像外观并削弱增强所需的语义线索；仅识别场景内容不能明确应恢复的目标外观，也不能刻画输入相对该目标的变化。

Method: 对每个退化图像—参考图像训练对，从水下视觉语言教师提取参考特征作为目标外观监督，并用成对特征残差表示观测相对同一目标的差异；将二者联合蒸馏到轻量引导网络，使其仅从退化图像预测这两类表示。在多尺度增强网络中引入渐进知识融合：先由估计差异调制空间特征更新，再用目标外观引导细化更新后的特征，并通过通道交互整合响应。

Result: 在六个水下基准上，全参考与无参考指标均取得有竞争力的性能；消融实验和特征可视化分析了知识来源、联合蒸馏与渐进融合的贡献。

Conclusion: 以“先校正差异、后目标细化”的组织方式，可在推理阶段无需教师和参考图像的情况下有效利用目标外观与差异知识，提升水下图像增强效果。

Abstract: Underwater degradation changes image appearance and can compromise the semantic cues used to guide enhancement. Identifying scene content alone does not explicitly specify the appearance to recover or the input-dependent changes associated with that target. We propose target-discrepancy knowledge distillation (TDD) for underwater image enhancement, which organizes guidance around these two aspects of the same restoration problem. For each degraded-reference training pair, reference features from an underwater vision-language teacher provide target-appearance supervision, while paired feature residuals describe the observation's discrepancy relative to the same target. Both representations are jointly distilled into a lightweight guidance network that predicts them from the degraded image alone; neither the teacher nor reference images are required at inference. To align their use with their supervisory roles, we introduce progressive knowledge fusion within a multi-scale enhancement network. The estimated discrepancy first conditions spatial feature updates, after which target-appearance guidance refines the updated features and channel interactions consolidate their responses. This correction-before-refinement design lets target-guided refinement build on discrepancy-conditioned features. Experiments on six underwater benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance across full-reference and no-reference metrics. Ablations and feature visualizations analyze the contributions of the knowledge source, joint distillation, and progressive fusion.

</details>


### [286] [Which Parameters to Update? An Instance-Specific Adaptation Framework for Real-World Pansharpening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32450)
*Jin-Liang Xiao,Liang-Jian Deng,Yu-Xuan Zhang,Hua Meng,Zhengchun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向全色锐化的实例级测试时自适应框架，利用观测到的PAN-LRMS图像对选择并更新预训练网络的部分参数，从而提升模型在真实场景中的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全色锐化旨在融合低分辨率多光谱图像与全色图像以获得高分辨率多光谱图像。深度学习方法性能显著，但训练数据与测试图像之间的分布偏移会降低预训练网络性能，限制其实际泛化能力。

Method: 提出实例特定测试时自适应框架：使用交叉评分识别哪些参数组的更新能够改善图像块重建；仅更新被选中的参数组，并通过结合光谱一致性项与新设计空间一致性项的损失函数进行优化。

Result: 实验表明，自适应后的网络优于其预训练版本，并在GaoFen-2、QuickBird和WorldView系列数据集上优于代表性先进全色锐化方法。

Conclusion: 利用测试时观测图像对进行参数子集选择与更新，可有效缓解分布偏移问题，提高预训练全色锐化网络的泛化能力和实际应用表现。

Abstract: Pansharpening aims to fuse a single observed image pair, comprising a low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) image and a panchromatic (PAN) image, to obtain a high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) image. Recently, deep learning-based methods have achieved significant performance due to their strong capability of extracting nonlinear features. However, distribution shifts between training data and test images can degrade the performance of pretrained pansharpening networks, limiting their generalization in real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose an instance-specific test-time adaptation framework that uses the observed PAN-LRMS pair to select and update only a subset of the pretrained network's parameters. Specifically, the framework uses cross-scoring to identify parameter groups whose updates improve reconstruction across image patches. It then updates the selected groups by minimizing a loss that combines a spectral consistency term with a newly designed spatial consistency term. Experiments show that the adapted networks perform better than their pretrained counterparts and outperform representative state-of-the-art pansharpening methods on GaoFen-2, QuickBird, and WorldView series datasets.

</details>


### [287] [OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32473)
*Zhilu Zhang,Xiaoyu Liu,Wenxi Liu,Shengfeng He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 OmniPersist，将透视视频生成与全景演化统一到单阶段扩散模型中，以解决相机转向后离开视野的动态物体在潜空间中无法合理演化、易突变或消失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型在有限透视视角下难以保持动态物体的持续性：相机转开再转回时，离开视野的运动实体往往不能合理演化。

Method: 提出单阶段统一扩散框架，联合透视视频生成与全景演化，无需辅助模型或初始全景输入；全景流采用较低帧率以保持效率；通过几何锚定 GeoAnch 建立空间对应，通过时间补偿 TemComp 进行时间聚合；框架兼容潜空间级和注意力级相机控制架构。

Result: 在新构建的动态基准上，针对图像到视频和视频续写任务，实验显示在视觉质量、相机可控性、重访一致性和动态持续性方面均有稳定提升。

Conclusion: OmniPersist 能在单一扩散框架中耦合透视与全景信息，有效增强动作条件世界模型对出视野动态物体的持续建模能力，并具备较好的架构兼容性。

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.

</details>


### [288] [ViDM: Efficient and Order-Robust Parallel Visual Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32461)
*Xudong Tan,Peng Ye,Chenyu Huang,Yaoxin Yang,Huafeng Qin,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ViDM，将多问题视觉推理转化为单次前向传播中的并行决策，在共享视觉输入下同时生成多个问题的答案分布，从而提升准确率与推理效率，并增强对问题顺序的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归多模态大语言模型面对共享同一视觉输入的多个问题时，需要逐 token 顺序生成答案，问题数量增加会累积解码成本并延迟整个决策集完成；同时，答案预测可能随问题顺序变化而不稳定。

Method: ViDM 将共享视觉上下文、多个问题及问题专属决策槽组织为一个序列，复用原生语言模型头一次性产生所有答案分布；引入 Decision-Query Mask，使每个决策查询直接关注共享上下文及对应问题；采用 case-balanced multi-order training 增强对问题重排序的鲁棒性。

Result: 在覆盖图像、多图像和视频任务的九个基准上，ViDM 将 Qwen3.5-4B 的平均准确率从 73.49% 提升到 77.55%，平均端到端吞吐量达到基线的 8.4 倍；在平均每图 11.4 个问题的 GQA 上端到端加速达 20.3 倍。ViDM 还提升了平均准确率和最差顺序准确率，并降低顺序引起的波动，并在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 和 InternVL3.5-4B 上得到进一步验证。

Conclusion: ViDM 通过单次前向传播实现多问题并行视觉决策，在多个模型和任务上同时改善准确率、推理吞吐与问题顺序鲁棒性，说明并行决策范式可有效替代多问题场景下的顺序自回归解码。

Abstract: Visual decision-making demands accurate judgments and timely responses. Yet for multiple questions sharing the same visual input, autoregressive multimodal large language models generate answers token by token, accumulating sequential decoding costs as question count grows and delaying completion of the decision set. Their predictions can also vary with question order. We introduce ViDM, which transforms multi-question visual inference into parallel decisions in a single forward pass, improving both accuracy and inference efficiency. ViDM organizes shared visual context, multiple questions, and question-specific decision slots into one sequence, reusing the native language-model head to produce all answer distributions simultaneously. A Decision-Query Mask aligns each decision query's direct attention with shared context and its corresponding question, while case-balanced multi-order training strengthens robustness to question reordering. Across nine benchmarks spanning image, multi-image, and video tasks, ViDM improves Qwen3.5-4B's average accuracy from 73.49% to 77.55% while achieving 8.4x the baseline's average end-to-end throughput. On GQA, where each evaluated image has 11.4 questions on average, the end-to-end speedup reaches 20.3x. ViDM also improves mean and worst-order accuracy while reducing order-induced variation across multiple benchmarks, with further validation on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and InternVL3.5-4B.

</details>


### [289] [COHERE4D: Training-Free Dense Surface Alignment for Coherent Metric 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32482)
*Zhumei Wang,Shaofei Wang,Xiang An,Mingtao Pei,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 COHERE4D，一种无需训练的单目 4D 重建框架，通过配准独立预训练的人体和场景基础模型所预测的人体表面，实现具有公制尺度的连贯人体—场景 4D 重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体基础模型可恢复公制尺度人体网格但缺乏场景定位，场景基础模型可估计全局一致的 3D 几何与相机运动但缺乏可靠公制尺度；二者重建同一前景人体表面，但现有方法未直接利用这一共享表面，常依赖稀疏接触约束或泛化较差的数据驱动对齐模块。

Method: COHERE4D 无需训练，直接在可见人体表面上建立稠密、像素对齐的 3D 对应关系，并用 RANSAC 与跨帧一致性抑制遮挡、背景污染和深度噪声导致的离群点；同时求解序列级共享尺度以将场景几何和相机运动校准到人体公制尺度，以及逐帧人体平移以对齐相机空间人体网格与缩放后的场景几何。

Result: 在多种骨干网络和基准上，COHERE4D 在人体—场景对齐、公制场景与相机位姿重建、全局人体运动估计方面显著优于先前方法；仅增加约 4 ms/帧，整体推理最高可达 14 FPS。

Conclusion: 直接配准人体与场景基础模型共享的人体表面，可在无需额外训练的情况下获得连贯、公制尺度的 4D 人体—场景重建，并兼顾精度与效率。

Abstract: Human and scene foundation models offer complementary strengths for monocular 4D reconstruction: human models recover metric-scale body meshes but lack scene grounding, whereas scene models estimate globally consistent 3D geometry and camera motion without reliable metric scale. Crucially, both models reconstruct the same foreground human surface. Yet existing methods do not directly exploit this shared surface: lacking reliable foreground human geometry in scene reconstructions, earlier approaches either resort to sparse contact constraints or learn data-driven alignment modules that generalize poorly to out-of-distribution scenes. We present COHERE4D, a training-free framework that directly registers the human surfaces predicted by independently pretrained human and scene foundation models to reconstruct a coherent, metric 4D world. COHERE4D establishes dense, pixel-aligned 3D correspondences over the visible human surface and employs RANSAC with cross-frame consensus to suppress outliers from occlusion, background contamination, and depth noise. This formulation solves for two complementary geometric quantities: a sequence-level shared scale that calibrates scene geometry and camera motion to metric human size, and per-frame human translations that align camera-space human meshes with the scaled scene geometry to enforce spatial and temporal consistency. Across diverse backbones and benchmarks, COHERE4D substantially outperforms prior methods in human--scene alignment, metric scene and camera pose reconstruction, and global human motion estimation, adding only 4,ms/frame, enabling overall inference at up to 14 FPS.

</details>


### [290] [Déjà-VAE: Training-Free Consistent Editing with Pseudo-Invertible Encoders and Latent Back-Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32501)
*Ron Libman,Yamit Ehrlich,Ohad Fried,Assaf Shocher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Déjà-VAE 是一个无需训练或微调、同时提升自编码一致性与编辑稳定性的框架，可减少潜扩散模型工作流中跨潜空间/像素空间的累积漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型在潜空间与像素空间往返以及连续编辑时，自编码误差和编辑模型引入的意外修改会逐步累积，导致图像结构、纹理和颜色漂移；现有流程缺乏对显式修改之外信息保持的一致性保障。

Method: 方法包含两部分：1）将预训练 VAE 改造成满射伪可逆神经网络，使用固定增益平衡相对原始编码器/解码器的偏差，使新解码器 D' 成为编码器 E' 的显式非线性右逆，满足 E'(D'(z))=z，从而实现潜空间往返与重复重建的幂等性；2）采用自适应小波反投影，在 ℓ2 意义下寻找最接近编辑器输出的潜变量，同时约束小波系数变化低于校准阈值的分量与上一潜变量匹配，每轮仅校正一次且校准后无需额外网络评估。

Result: 在多种模型和编辑基准上的测试表明，该方法相较原始流程及专门的一致性方法具有更小的漂移。

Conclusion: Déjà-VAE 通过精确自编码一致性和校准式编辑稳定化，无需训练即可支持纯潜空间工作流以及生成与像素空间操作/约束交替的工作流，有效抑制误差累积。

Abstract: Consistency is essential to generative workflows: repeated processing should preserve information beyond the changes explicitly requested. In latent diffusion models, this requires stability both when moving between latent and pixel spaces and when applying successive edits. Autoencoding errors and unintended changes from the editing model can accumulate across these operations, progressively altering image structure, texture, and color. We introduce Déjà-VAE, a framework that combines exact autoencoding consistency with calibrated editing stabilization, without training or fine-tuning. Its autoencoding component converts a pretrained variational autoencoder into a surjective pseudo-invertible neural network, with a fixed gain balancing deviations from the pretrained encoder and decoder. The modified decoder $D'$ is an explicit nonlinear right inverse of the encoder $E'$, satisfying $E'(D'(z))=z$ by construction. Consequently, $D'$ is a reflexive generalized inverse: latent round trips preserve their input, up to numerical precision, and repeated image reconstruction is idempotent. To suppress editing drift, adaptive wavelet back-projection finds the closest latent to the editor's output in $\ell_2$, subject to matching the previous latent on wavelet coefficients whose changes fall below calibrated thresholds. This correction is applied once per turn, with no additional network evaluations after calibration. Together, these components support workflows that remain in latent space or interleave generation with pixel-space operations and constraints. Tests across models and editing benchmarks show less drift than stock pipelines and dedicated consistency methods.

</details>


### [291] [DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32513)
*Changlong Jiang,Youci Tang,Haohong Kuang,Hang Xu,Jinghong Zheng,Ran Wang,Zhenghong Yu,Chen Feng,Xiaofeng Yue,Yang Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DiffAnchor，一种少步数、在锚点空间进行扩散的单目3D手部姿态估计框架；它不直接扩散关节坐标，而是扩散中间锚点，再由锚点到关节的偏移预测和加权聚合完成精确关节定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的方法直接对最终3D关节坐标去噪，需要同时探索合理姿态并恢复精确坐标，往往依赖更多去噪步数或多假设，导致推理成本增加。

Method: DiffAnchor 在锚点空间进行少步扩散：固定上下文锚点提供稳定全局参考，噪声动态锚点迭代细化到有信息的关节区域；采用重要性引导的锚点选择与补充机制保留有效锚点、移除无效锚点并探索覆盖不足区域；最后通过锚点到关节偏移预测和加权聚合得到精确关节位置。

Result: 在 HO-3D V2、NYU、ICVL 和 InterHand2.6M 上的实验表明，该方法在前三个基准上达到最先进性能，在具有挑战性的交互手估计上具有竞争力，同时推理效率与确定性回归基线相当。

Conclusion: 将随机探索放在中间锚点空间而非最终关节输出上，可降低扩散过程的精度负担，从而仅用少量去噪步数和单一假设实现准确且高效的3D手部姿态估计。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.

</details>


### [292] [CalibTrack: Exploring Learned Heteroscedastic Covariance for Robust Multi-Camera Pedestrian Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32500)
*Jack Roberts,Aditya Iyer,Nora Ayanian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究学习式异方差测量协方差对多视角多目标跟踪校准与鲁棒性的影响，并提出检测端预测器 CalibTrack，用逐检测协方差替代统一协方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析式多视角多目标跟踪依赖测量协方差进行关联、融合和状态估计，但现有协方差多为启发式设定，需要针对部署场景手工调参。

Method: 提出 CalibTrack 检测端预测器，为每个检测输出协方差；在 WildTrack 和 MultiviewX 数据集上结合 GM-PHD、JIPDA、剪枝 delta-GLMB 等跟踪核心评估，并通过稳定扩散模拟恶劣天气、高斯噪声、相机偏色和相机丢失测试鲁棒性。

Result: CalibTrack 在恶劣条件下平均跟踪性能优于置信度缩放协方差，并产生更校准的预测；但与更强启发式协方差相比，学习协方差的收益受观测质量和下游跟踪器选择限制。

Conclusion: 研究表明学习式异方差协方差在分析式跟踪中具有价值，为不确定性感知的分析式多相机跟踪提供了原则性探索，但其效果并非无条件优于强启发式方法。

Abstract: Analytical multi-view multi-object tracking (MV-MOT) systems rely on measurement covariance estimates to guide association, fusion, and state estimation. These covariance estimates are typically heuristic, requiring hand-tuning to the specific deployment scenario. We investigate how learned heteroscedastic measurement covariance affects calibration and robustness in analytical multi-camera tracking. To support this analysis, we introduce CalibTrack, a detector-side predictor that replaces uniform measurement covariance with per-detection covariance. We evaluate CalibTrack on the WildTrack and MultiviewX pedestrian tracking datasets with multiple analytical tracker cores, including an identity-informed GM-PHD, JIPDA, and pruned delta-GLMB filter. We additionally evaluate robustness by simulating adverse weather conditions with stable diffusion, Gaussian noise, camera browning, and camera dropout. CalibTrack improves average adverse tracking performance over confidence-scaled covariance, while producing better calibrated predictions, indicating the value of heteroscedastic covariance within analytical tracking. Comparisons with stronger heuristic covariance methods show that the benefits of learned covariance remain bounded by the quality of available observations and the downstream tracker choice. Together, these findings provide a principled exploration of learned covariance estimation and its potential for uncertainty-aware analytical tracking.

</details>


### [293] [HS-OVSeg: Multi-Granularity Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing via Heterogeneous Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32518)
*Wei Huang,Chenying Liu,Xudong Kang,Xiao Xiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出HS-OVSeg统一训练框架，利用场景级、对象级和像素级异构监督解决遥感开放词汇语义分割中像素级标注稀缺问题，并在多数据集上取得优于现有模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感开放词汇语义分割需要灵活文本驱动分割，但缺乏大规模、语义多样且具有精确像素级标注的数据集；现有遥感数据虽包含丰富的场景级和对象级标注，却缺少像素级监督。

Method: 提出HS-OVSeg框架：以场景级类别名和带边界框的对象级类别名为条件，利用SAM3生成像素级伪标签；结合真实语义掩码，通过LoRA微调SAM3，实现场景级、对象级和像素级三类标注的联合训练。

Result: 统一训练覆盖20个遥感数据集，包括3个场景分类、4个对象检测和13个语义分割数据集，并人工标注7个分类/检测数据集的1000张图像用于像素级评估；HS-OVSeg在20个训练来源数据集和5个留出数据集上均显著优于现有遥感开放词汇语义分割模型。

Conclusion: HS-OVSeg能够有效利用异构多粒度监督，展现出强多粒度分割能力，并为遥感开放词汇语义分割提供可扩展的统一训练方案。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables flexible, text-driven mapping of remote sensing (RS) imagery beyond predefined categories. Despite advances in segmentation foundation models, RS-OVSS remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale, semantically diverse datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations. Meanwhile, existing RS datasets contain abundant scene- and object-level annotations that offer valuable semantic information but lack precise pixel-wise supervision. To exploit these complementary sources, we propose HS-OVSeg, a unified training framework that integrates heterogeneous scene-, object-, and pixel-level supervision for RS-OVSS. Specifically, we generate pixel-wise pseudo-labels using SAM3, conditioned on scene-level class names and object-level class names with bounding boxes. Combined with ground-truth semantic masks, these pseudo-labels enable joint training across all three annotation granularities through LoRA-based fine-tuning of SAM3. Our unified training spans 20 RS datasets, including 3 scene classification, 4 object detection, and 13 semantic segmentation datasets, with 1,000 images from the 7 classification and detection datasets manually annotated for pixel-level evaluation. HS-OVSeg substantially outperforms existing RS-OVSS models across both the 20 training-source and 5 held-out datasets, demonstrating strong multi-granularity segmentation capabilities under heterogeneous supervision. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [294] [X-3DComposer: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Composition with Any Assets from Any Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32491)
*Zidian Qiu,Ancong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: X-3DComposer 是一个前馈式 3D 场景布局预测模型：给定场景图像、物体掩码和任意来源的物体资产，它能在约 1 秒内联合预测所有物体的旋转、平移和逐轴尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从图像构建可编辑 3D 场景需要物体资产和布局，但现有方法中场景生成将布局与生成耦合，姿态估计器通常一次只处理一个物体，且依赖真实尺寸 CAD、深度或迭代优化，因此缺少通用的布局解决方案。

Method: 该方法将物体视为视图：先把每个物体资产渲染出来，与场景图像一起输入一个由 VGGT-$\Omega$ 改造的多视角几何模型，再由每个物体渲染视图预测出的相机，以闭式解得到物体位姿。相机内参、相机位姿和深度为可选输入，整个布局预测可在一次前馈中完成。

Result: 在固定五种场景生成方法生成的网格、仅替换布局时，X-3DComposer 的布局比这些方法的原生布局更准确；相比独立布局模型 SceneMaker，在 IndoorMix 测试集上将场景级 Chamfer 距离降低 52%，在 3D-FUTURE 上降低 28%。

Conclusion: 将物体资产渲染视为多视角观测，并借助多视角几何模型预测相机，可以高效、通用地实现场景级物体布局预测，且布局精度优于现有场景生成方法和独立布局模型。

Abstract: Composing an editable 3D scene from images requires an asset for each object and a layout that places the assets. 3D generation and CAD retrieval now supply the assets, but layout still lacks a general solution: scene generation methods couple it with generation, and pose estimators handle one object at a time and need true-size CAD models, depth, or iterative refinement. We present X-3DComposer, a feed-forward model that predicts the layout separately from asset generation. Given one or more images of a scene, the object masks, and an asset for each object from any source, it jointly predicts the rotation, translation, and per-axis scale of all objects in a single forward pass of about one second. The key idea is to treat objects as views: renders of the assets are processed together with the scene images by a multi-view geometry model adapted from VGGT-$Ω$, and each object pose follows in closed form from the cameras predicted for its renders. Camera intrinsics, camera poses, and depth are optional inputs. When the meshes produced by five scene generation methods are kept fixed and only their layout is replaced, the layouts of X-3DComposer are more accurate than the native layouts of these methods. Compared with the stand-alone layout model SceneMaker, it reduces the scene-level Chamfer distance by 52% on IndoorMix, our test set from six indoor datasets, and by 28% on 3D-FUTURE.

</details>


### [295] [GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32510)
*JiaHui Huang,Songyan Zhang,Hanbing Li,Hanchao Leng,Kuiyuan Yang,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeoVLDrive，一个基于几何接地的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，用于 3D 时空推理与规划，并在 NAVSIM 等基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 规划器虽继承预训练视觉-语言模型的语义知识，但其推理很少真正基于 3D 场景结构及其随时间的变化。

Method: 通过门控交叉注意力将 3D 基础模型的多层特征注入视觉-语言主干；设计结构化潜在思维链（CoT），将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动和元动作组织为有序且分别监督的潜在状态；动作专家基于这些状态和多层场景特征生成轨迹候选，并用场景接地的交互评分 token 进行排序；同时提出 NAVSIM 3DQA 用于训练和评估度量级 3D 空间与运动理解。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 91.8 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 90.9 EPDMS；在 NAVSIM 3DQA 上几何接地主干总体得分 89.2%，比微调后的 Qwen3-VL-2B 基线高 4.6 个百分点；在 LingoQA 上主干达到 68.6% Lingo-Judge 准确率。

Conclusion: 几何接地与结构化潜在 CoT 能有效提升 VLA 模型的 3D 时空理解与规划性能，并在多个基准上验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

</details>


### [296] [An Integrated Remote Sensing and Machine Learning Framework for Mapping Hazard Associated with Leached Metals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32505)
*Salman Karim,Bahareh Nojabaei,Hosein Foroutan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究整合卫星遥感、地下水监测和机器学习，在美国弗吉尼亚州4个燃煤残渣（CCR）场地开展浸出金属相关风险的空间制图与筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在利用遥感植被与环境协变量辅助识别CCR场地地下水金属污染相关风险的空间格局，弥补传统地下水监测点位稀疏、成本高和空间覆盖有限的问题。

Method: 将地下水组分浓度转换为危害商（HQ）并构建复合危害指数（HI）；使用Sentinel-2植被指数、生物物理参数、时空指标及土壤、气候、水文、地形和土地覆盖等预测变量；评估6种监督分类器，并采用空间分离测试块、特征集消融和留一场地测试。

Result: 33个金属-场地组合中24个显示较高HQ与较低植被指数共现（符号检验p=0.007）；3个场地井点HI与CIRE和冠层叶绿素含量负相关（Spearman rho最低-0.71）。随机森林场地内HI分类精度为0.768-0.924，较高HI类召回率为0.965-0.999；34个组分-场地组合HQ分类精度为0.775-0.989。环境协变量通常比植被特征贡献更多预测信息，移除植被预测因子未降低性能，单一场地中仅CCR单元距离表现最佳。零样本跨场地精度降至0.734-0.749，不优于多数类基线。

Conclusion: 该框架展示了卫星观测与环境数据结合地下水测量用于场地校准空间风险筛查的潜力，但识别的是间接环境关联而非直接检测溶解态金属，强调本地校准和独立验证的重要性。

Abstract: This study integrates satellite remote sensing, groundwater monitoring, and machine learning to map leached-metal-associated hazards at four coal combustion residual (CCR) sites in Virginia, USA. Constituent-specific groundwater concentrations were expressed as Hazard Quotients (HQ) and combined into a composite Hazard Index (HI). Predictors included Sentinel-2 vegetation indices, biophysical parameters, and spatiotemporal metrics (2019-2025), alongside soil, climate, hydrology, topography, and land cover. Six supervised classifiers were evaluated using spatially separated test blocks, feature-set ablation, and leave-one-site-out testing. Higher HQ coincided with lower vegetation indices in 24 of 33 metal-site combinations near monitoring wells (sign test p = 0.007). Well HI was negatively correlated with CIRE and canopy chlorophyll content at three sites (Spearman rho as low as -0.71). Random Forest achieved within-site HI classification accuracies of 0.768-0.924 and higher-HI-class recall of 0.965-0.999. For 34 constituent-site combinations, HQ classification accuracies ranged from 0.775 to 0.989. Environmental covariates generally contributed more predictive information than vegetation features. Removing vegetation predictors did not reduce performance, and distance to the CCR unit alone performed best at one site. Zero-shot cross-site accuracy declined to 0.734-0.749, no better than the majority-class baseline. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating satellite observations and environmental data with groundwater measurements for site-calibrated spatial hazard screening. The framework identifies indirect environmental associations rather than directly detecting dissolved metals, highlighting the importance of local calibration and independent validation.

</details>


### [297] [Advanced Synthetic Image Detection Using Hybrid Feature Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32538)
*Ameya Uppina,S Navaneetha Krishnan,Nikhil N Iyer,Joe Dhanith P R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于深度学习特征分析的合成图像检测方法，通过CBAM、ResNet50、DCT分块筛选和SRM模块识别真假图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI模型不断生成更逼真的图像，亟需鲁棒方法区分真实图像与AI生成图像。

Method: 利用CBAM与ResNet50分析复杂对象特征和形变；采用离散余弦变换（DCT）评分进行选择性图像块分析，提取复杂度最高和最低区域，并分别用SRM模块与ResNet50模块处理。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在真实图像与合成图像分类中取得较高准确率。

Conclusion: 该研究有助于构建更可靠的合成图像检测框架。

Abstract: In the realm of generative AI, models such as GANs, MidJourney, DALL-E, and others have been continuously evolving to generate increasingly lifelike images. This rapid advancement has created an urgent need for robust methods to distinguish between real and AI-generated images. This paper proposes a novel approach for the detection of synthetic images by employing deep learning techniques for feature analysis. The proposed architecture classifies images by identifying variations that generative models struggle to replicate, particularly fine-grained textures and complex object features. Deformations in complexes are examined with the help of the CBAM architecture along with ResNet50. We have performed a selective patch-based analysis using Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) scoring, extracting the regions with the most and least complexity for further processing with an SRM Module and ResNet50 module. Experimental results show that our approach achieves high accuracy in classifying real-world images from synthetic ones, contributing to the development of more reliable detection frameworks.

</details>


### [298] [Rescuing Discarded Boundary Samples in Semi-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32532)
*Yuzhao Jiang,Meng Zhang,Jie Ma,Xiaohong Guan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种用于置信度阈值半监督学习的附加模块BRC，通过修正被丢弃样本的伪标签来缓解确认偏差并保留边界信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪标签半监督学习常通过置信度阈值丢弃低置信度样本以缓解确认偏差，但这些样本多位于类别边界附近，直接丢弃会损失有价值的边界信息。

Method: 提出Boundary Refinement and Correction（BRC），不改变基础SSL方法的伪标签选择规则，仅处理被拒绝样本：识别其中仍可能有用的样本，用修正后的软伪标签替换原伪标签，并重新加入无监督损失。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、STL-10和TissueMNIST上，BRC可适配多种基础SSL方法，错误率最多降低4.97个百分点；在边界附近样本上Top-1准确率提升12.80个百分点；扩展到语义分割也获得1.03-2.39 mIoU的稳定提升。

Conclusion: BRC能有效利用被阈值丢弃的边界样本，细化模型决策边界，并具有跨数据集、跨基础方法和跨任务的通用性。

Abstract: The field of semi-supervised learning (SSL) has seen substantial progress, driven by ongoing refinements within the pseudo-label SSL paradigm. The main difficulty lies in reducing the adverse impact of confirmation bias. The predominant approach is to apply a confidence threshold during training to discard low-confidence samples. Nevertheless, while this mitigates the bias, the discarded samples are mostly situated near class boundaries, and consequently, this strategy also loses valuable boundary information. To address this problem, we propose Boundary Refinement and Correction (BRC), an add-on for confidence-thresholded SSL that rescues useful discarded samples without changing how the base SSL method selects pseudo-labels. BRC keeps the original confidence-based selection rule and operates only on the rejected set. It first identifies discarded samples that may still be useful for training, then replaces their original pseudo-labels with corrected soft pseudo-labels and returns them to the unsupervised loss. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, STL-10, and TissueMNIST demonstrate the flexibility and broad applicability of BRC across diverse datasets and base SSL methods, reducing error rates by up to 4.97 percentage points. On boundary-near samples, BRC further improves Top-1 accuracy by 12.80 percentage points, directly supporting its ability to refine the model's decision boundary. An exploratory extension to semantic segmentation also yields consistent gains of 1.03-2.39 mIoU, indicating that BRC generalizes beyond image classification.

</details>


### [299] [Smooth Essential-Manifold Residuals for View-Graph Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32540)
*Viktor Larsson,Johannes Schönberger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究多视图图校准中基于成对基础矩阵估计相机内参的问题，提出一种等距降维到2x2矩阵的非线性最小二乘残差表示，使本质矩阵约束更利于高斯-牛顿优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统奇异值形式将两个独立的本质矩阵约束压缩为一个标量残差，导致每条边的Gauss-Newton模型秩亏，收敛性能差。

Method: 将校准目标视为最小化到本质流形的距离，推导等距降维到2x2矩阵，使非线性本质矩阵约束的每个分支变为线性子空间，从而得到光滑二维残差，其平方范数等于原始流形距离，且Gauss-Newton近似通常满秩，无需逐边SVD。

Result: 实验表明新残差保持几何目标的估计精度，同时以更少且计算更便宜的迭代收敛；结合鲁棒初始化和优化后，在与低成本代数目标相当的运行时间下达到最先进的视图图校准精度。

Conclusion: 所提出的2x2等距残差表示改善了视图图校准的优化条件，在精度和效率之间取得良好平衡，并可实现高精度、低运行成本的相机内参校准。

Abstract: View-graph calibration jointly estimates camera intrinsics from multiple pairwise fundamental matrices. The correct intrinsics transform each fundamental matrix into an essential matrix, casting the calibration problem as minimizing the distance to the essential manifold. We study how to represent this objective for nonlinear least squares. The conventional singular-value formulation collapses two independent essential-matrix constraints into one scalar residual. Its per-edge Gauss-Newton model is therefore rank deficient, which leads to poor convergence. We instead derive an isometric reduction to 2x2 matrices, where each branch of the nonlinear essential-matrix constraint becomes a linear subspace. This reduction yields a smooth two-dimensional residual whose squared norm is exactly the original manifold distance, whose Gauss-Newton approximation is generically full rank, and whose evaluation requires no per-edge singular value decomposition. Experiments show that the new residual retains the estimation accuracy of the geometric objective while converging in fewer, computationally cheaper iterations. Combined with robust initialization and optimization, it achieves state-of-the-art view-graph calibration accuracy at a runtime comparable to inexpensive algebraic objectives.

</details>


### [300] [RSReasoner: Reformulating and Auditing Geospatial Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32536)
*Xu Zhang,Xinpeng Zhang,Yunrui Zou,Hongliang Chen,Xiaotian Jiang,Yang Zheng,Kaitai Guo,Jimin Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对地理空间推理分割基准中“推理”定义不清、存在感知捷径的问题，提出新的分类框架并构建大规模数据集与诊断基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准常把推理简化为类别省略，忽视属性混合，导致显式类别推理被忽略、模型可利用感知捷径，难以精确评估真实推理能力。

Method: 作者按类别表达（显式/隐式）和属性性质（感知/推理）重新形式化任务，审计90,708条查询；并设计三阶段流程利用OpenStreetMap属性并抑制几何与语义噪声，构建RSReasoner数据集（106,610图像、213,220查询）和RSReasoner-Bench诊断基准（75,400查询，含四类规范类型及受控变体）。

Result: 实验表明RSReasoner-Bench能从多维度精确评估模型能力并暴露捷径行为；在RSReasoner上微调可同时提升推理能力和跨类型泛化。

Conclusion: 研究为未来地理空间推理研究与基准设计提供关键启示，并强调需区分显式/隐式类别表达和感知/推理属性，以避免感知捷径、更准确评估推理能力。

Abstract: Geospatial reasoning segmentation aims to localize geographic targets from language requiring semantic inference beyond direct visual perception. However, existing benchmarks often operationalize reasoning as category omission while overlooking attribute mixing, which neglects explicit-category reasoning, introduces perceptual shortcuts, and fails to precisely evaluate reasoning capability. To diagnose and address these limitations, we first reformulate geospatial reasoning segmentation along category expression (explicit vs. implicit) and attribute nature (perceptual vs. inferential), and audit 90,708 queries across existing benchmarks to reveal that pure explicit-inferential queries account for only 0.61% whereas 31.98% mix both attribute types. We then develop a three-stage pipeline that harnesses OpenStreetMap attributes while mitigating geometric and semantic noise to construct RSReasoner, a large-scale dataset of 106,610 images with 213,220 reasoning queries, and RSReasoner-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 75,400 queries across four canonical types and controlled variants. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSReasoner-Bench precisely evaluates model capability across multiple dimensions while exposing shortcut behaviors, and fine-tuning on RSReasoner boosts both reasoning and cross-type generalization. Our findings offer key insights for future geospatial reasoning research and benchmark design. Datasets and code will be released at https://github.com/Ricardo-XZ/RSReasoner.

</details>


### [301] [Align or Fail: The Hidden Gap in Cross-Domain Panoptic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32542)
*Huy Hoang Nguyen,Oliver Zendel,Tobias Glueck,Minh Nhat Vu,Andreas Kugi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究开放词汇全景分割中视觉骨干升级为何难以转化为跨域性能提升，发现核心问题是密集区域特征与CLIP文本嵌入之间存在“分组-识别失配”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础骨干常被视为OVPS区域提议的即插即用升级，但骨干提升往往不能带来良好的跨域下游性能，因此需要厘清其失败机制。

Method: 以基于扩散的OVPS模型ODISE为测试平台，将其视觉提取器替换为DINOv2、ConvNeXt或DINOv3；通过阶段诊断、线性探针和区域-文本对齐分析定位问题；并测试文本侧适配器、保形掩码保留CMR和2.7M参数视觉侧LoRA等适配方法，同时比较OVSeg、CAT-Seg和MaskCLIP。

Result: DINOv3在源域和近域提升源域性能，但在多个跨域目标上崩溃，而其他基线表现相反；分析表明DINOv3嵌入保留语义信息但与CLIP几何不兼容。文本侧适配对词汇重叠更敏感，CMR收益有限且依赖目标域，视觉侧LoRA可较大程度修复视觉到CLIP的接口差距。

Conclusion: 跨域失败可分离为两个轴：可恢复的视觉到CLIP接口差距，以及CLIP类识别系统共享的词汇边界限制；前者可由视觉侧LoRA largely修复，后者需要不同补救措施。

Abstract: Vision foundation backbones are often treated as drop-in upgrades for improving region proposals in open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation (OVPS). Yet, improvements in backbones often fail to translate well into downstream cross-domain performance. Using ODISE, a diffusion-based OVPS model with a CLIP-based recognition branch, as a testbed, we replace its diffusion visual extractor with DINOv2, ConvNeXt, or DINOv3, and find that backbone upgrades can introduce a grouping-recognition mismatch: an alignment gap between dense-region features and CLIP text embeddings. Across source and near-domain, the newer DINOv3 variant improves source-domain performance but collapses on several cross-domain targets, whereas other baselines, interestingly, show the opposite. Stage-wise diagnostics, linear probes, and region-text alignment analyses indicate that DINOv3 embeddings retain semantic information but are geometrically incompatible with CLIP. We test adaptations, including text-side adapters, conformal mask retention (CMR), and a lean 2.7M-parameter visual-side LoRA, and find that text-side adaptation is more sensitive to vocabulary overlap. CMR provides only limited and target-specific gains, indicating that retention alone cannot resolve the full cross-domain failure. To understand why ADE20K resists improvement across all interventions, we evaluate OVSeg, CAT-Seg, and MaskCLIP. This separates two failure axes: a recoverable visual-to-CLIP interface gap that visual-side LoRA largely repairs, and a vocabulary-boundary limitation shared by the evaluated CLIP-based recognition systems that requires different remedies.

</details>


### [302] [UnifiedAD: One-Shot Anomaly Detection across Modalities via Evidence Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32551)
*Shangze Li,Chuancheng Shi,Simiao Xie,Wenhua Wu,Xingyu Zhu,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UnifiedAD，通过异常证据校准统一单模态与多模态异常检测，仅需每个目标类别一个正常参考且无需梯度更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单模态和多模态异常检测依赖模态特定建模与打分，在正常参考有限时难以获得可比较的异常证据，因此需要统一检测框架。

Method: 从独立辅助数据集的正常与异常样本中提取神经元级判别先验，结合目标参考在保常态变换下的神经元响应一致性选择可靠异常神经元并确定异常方向；为每层和每模态构建低秩正常子空间，用投影残差量化查询特征偏离；再利用正常参考及其变换的响应分布分别校准投影残差和异常方向响应，转化为可跨层、跨模态聚合的可比较异常证据。

Result: 在多个异常检测基准上，UnifiedAD 在图像级异常检测和像素级异常定位方面均表现良好。

Conclusion: UnifiedAD 能以极少正常参考和无训练更新的方式有效统一单模态与多模态异常检测，并获得较强检测与定位性能。

Abstract: Both single-modal and multi-modal anomaly detection aim to identify deviations from normal patterns, providing a common foundation for unified detection. However, existing methods rely on modality-specific modeling and scoring, making it difficult to obtain comparable anomaly evidence with limited normal references. To that end, we propose UnifiedAD, which unifies single-modal and multi-modal anomaly detection through anomaly evidence calibration, requiring only one normal reference per target category and no gradient updates. Specifically, we first derive neuron-level discriminative priors from normal and anomalous samples in an independent auxiliary dataset and combine them with neuron response consistency under normality-preserving transformations of the target reference to select reliable neurons, termed anomaly neurons, and identify anomaly directions. Next, we construct a low-rank normal subspace for each layer and modality from the selected neurons' spatial responses to the reference and quantify query feature deviations from normal structure using projection residuals. Finally, we separately calibrate projection residuals and anomaly-direction responses using the response distributions obtained from the normal reference and its transformations, converting them into comparable anomaly evidence for aggregation across layers and modalities. Experiments on multiple anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that UnifiedAD achieves strong performance in both image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level anomaly localization.

</details>


### [303] [PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32554)
*Yang Cao,Zhe Zhu,Yiheng Zhang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Haoyuan Li,Le Wan,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PartAgent，一种无需训练的智能体式 3D 部件分割框架，通过整合 3D 结构提议与 2D 语义线索，并闭环迭代优化部件划分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 部件分割需要同时理解几何结构与语义上下文；预训练 3D 专家能提供空间区域提议，2D 专家能提供部件语义线索，难点在于如何将二者互补能力整合并逐步优化分割结果。

Method: 提出训练无关的 PartAgent 框架，包含两个模块：一是结构-语义专家集成，通过图像到表面映射融合 3D 专家区域与多视角 2D 语义证据，构建多粒度部件划分；二是观测驱动的闭环划分优化，根据当前划分及证据选择检查、证据修复、组合或重选动作，并验证变更、利用更新状态指导后续决策。

Result: 在 PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT 上取得 68.41 mIoU，比最强竞争方法高 8.53 分；在 3DCoMPaT200、PartNeXt、PartNetE 和 PartObjaverse-Tiny 上均取得最高 mIoU，四数据集平均 69.36，比竞争方法最高均值高 7.28 分。

Conclusion: PartAgent 能有效融合 3D 几何结构与 2D 语义信息，并通过闭环优化提升 3D 部件分割性能，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。

Abstract: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.

</details>


### [304] [SetCon: Setup-Conditioned IMU-Language Learning from 3D Human Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32548)
*Lennart Schiweck,Alaa Saleh,Cristóbal Curio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出SetCon，用选择性不变性替代IMU-语言模型中对安装方式的完全不变性，从而提升跨设备零样本活动识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IMU-语言模型为使编码器对佩戴方式不变，丢弃了设备相对身体的方向信息，如重力方向，而这对于区分坐、站、躺等活动很重要。

Method: SetCon从少量无标签窗口估计设备在已知身体部位上的安装方式，并以此条件化编码器；利用3D人体运动生成多种已知传感器设置下的仿真IMU信号，监督校准和表征学习；测试时用类名或由类名与活动描述文本嵌入平均得到的anchor表示类别。

Result: 仅在基于Nymeria动作捕捉模拟的IMU上训练，SetCon在13个真实数据集上取得56.6%平均零样本准确率（类名）和65.3%（anchor），优于AnyMo的41.8%和46.7%。

Conclusion: 选择性保留安装相关信息比完全不变性更有效，可在无需目标设备标注窗口的情况下实现更好的零样本活动识别，并能支持语言模型回答动作如何及按何顺序执行。

Abstract: Aligning inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals with text enables zero-shot activity recognition across wearable devices. A worn device's signal depends on its setup, the combination of body site and mounting. Leading IMU-language models make their encoders invariant to the mounting, which also discards the device's orientation relative to the body, such as the direction of gravity that separates sitting, standing and lying. We introduce SetCon, which replaces full invariance with selective invariance. It estimates each device's mounting on its known body site from a few unlabeled windows and conditions its encoder on this estimate. Because the mounting stays nearly fixed while the device is worn, the moving body serves as a calibration target. Both calibration and representation learning are supervised by 3D human motion, since one movement can be simulated under many known sensor setups. At test time, a class is represented by its name or by an anchor, which averages the text embeddings of the name and of activity descriptions and needs no labeled window. A language model built on the frozen encoder also answers how and in what order a movement is performed. Trained only on IMU simulated from the same Nymeria motion capture as AnyMo, SetCon reaches 56.6% mean zero-shot accuracy on 13 real datasets with class names and 65.3% with anchors, against 41.8% and 46.7% for AnyMo.

</details>


### [305] [MinPair: Measured Minimal Pairs for Fine-Grained Control in Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32549)
*Lennart Schiweck,Cristóbal Curio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MinPair，通过从真实动作片段构造最小对比字幕对，并引入对比成对损失，提升文本到动作生成中对动作执行方式（如高度等细粒度属性）的控制能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法多能捕捉“做什么动作”，但难以控制“如何执行动作”。当字幕中仅高度等属性词变化时，模型往往忽略该词，因为训练损失和标准指标不要求其利用唯一区分两个近似字幕的关键词。

Method: MinPair 从真实动作片段出发，用基于规则的动作描述子测量三维身体运动，再由语言模型生成带时间信息的身体部位字幕。利用描述子找出同一动作下属性不同的片段，构造最小对比字幕对：真实字幕与仅改变一个属性值的改写字幕。随后用对比成对损失训练扩散去噪器，使其从真实字幕比从改写字幕更准确地重建动作；训练无需合成动作，推理流程不变。

Result: 在22个目标任务和每次只改一个属性的字幕编辑上测试。仅使用 MinPair 字幕即可帮助动作达到目标，并改善 M2M、R@3 和 FID，但模型仍忽略大多数单词编辑。加入成对损失后，遵循模板编辑的比例从11%提升到60%，标准指标未进一步提升。使用身体部位字幕时，MinPair 达到的目标数超过使用多达99倍动作数据训练的最先进方法。

Conclusion: 显式构造最小对比字幕对并结合对比成对损失，可显著增强文本到动作生成的细粒度属性控制；身体部位字幕和最小对比监督能在不增加推理成本的情况下取得较强控制效果。

Abstract: Text-to-motion generation has made great progress in capturing what action to perform, yet it remains limited in controlling how that action is executed. For example, when only the height word of a kick request changes, none of the tested state-of-the-art methods reaches all three of knee, waist and head height. The other words of a caption usually imply an attribute such as height, so neither the training loss nor the standard metrics require a model to use the word that states it. A model has to use this word only when it alone separates two otherwise identical captions. We introduce MinPair, which creates such caption pairs from real motion clips. It starts from rule-based motion descriptors that measure the 3D body motion of each clip. From these descriptors a language model writes MinPair captions, timed body-part captions that say how each body part moves. The same descriptors show in which attributes two clips of the same action differ. A measured minimal pair joins the true caption of one clip with an altered copy in which only one attribute takes the value measured in the other clip. A contrastive pair loss then requires a diffusion denoiser to reconstruct the clip more accurately from its true caption than from the altered copy. Training needs no synthetic motion and inference stays unchanged. Control is tested on 22 target tasks and on caption edits that each change one attribute. MinPair captions alone help motions reach their targets and improve the standard metrics M2M, R@3 and FID, yet a model trained on them still ignores most single-word edits. The pair loss raises the share of followed template edits from 11% to 60%, while the standard metrics do not improve further. With body-part captions, MinPair reaches more targets than state-of-the-art methods that were trained on up to 99 times more motion data.

</details>


### [306] [Sol$^{3}$: Accelerating Video Diffusion for Free via Hierarchical Sparse Attention Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32562)
*Guoxin Fan,Weilun Feng,Chuanguang Yang,Mingqiang Wu,Xiaokun Liu,Jitao Lu,Zhulin An,Libo Huang,Boyu Diao,Di Gao,Yongjun Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Sol3 是一种无需训练的分层稀疏注意力方法，通过从块到 token 的逐步路由来细化精确计算分配，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升扩散视频模型推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Sol-Attn 虽结合稀疏精确计算与低成本代表性近似，但块内注意力可能只关注少数 token，而块级决策仍需评估许多低响应成员，造成额外开销。

Method: 提出 Gaussian-guided 分层路由，利用各级统计阈值从块到 token 确定精确计算范围；设计异构路由统计，结合块中心相关性与块内 Key/Value 变化识别难以近似的 Mixed blocks；在 Mixed blocks 中均匀比较原始 token 相关性以选择需精确计算的成员。

Result: 在视频生成、音视频联合生成和世界模拟任务上，Sol3 实现 86% 注意力稀疏度和 3.07 倍注意力加速，同时保持质量。

Conclusion: Sol3 通过更细粒度地分配精确计算，仅对关键交互进行精确计算并用代表性项近似其余成员，有效提升了无需训练扩散视频模型的注意力效率。

Abstract: Sol-Attn (Sparsifying online attention) combines sparse exact computation with low-cost representative approximation to accelerate training-free inference in diffusion video models. However, intra-block attention can focus on only a few tokens. While preserving these key interactions exactly, the block-level decision incurs the cost of evaluating many low-response members. We propose Sol$^{3}$, a training-free hierarchical sparse attention method that further refines how exact computations are allocated. First, we introduce Gaussian-guided hierarchical routing, which determines the scope of exact computation step by step, from blocks to tokens, using statistical thresholds at each level. Only a subset of members within Mixed blocks that require refinement is selected for exact computation, while representative terms approximate the remaining members. We further design heterogeneous routing statistics that combine block-center correlations with variations in Key and Value within blocks to identify blocks that are difficult to approximate. Among these Mixed blocks, we uniformly compare raw token relevance to select members requiring exact computation. Experiments on video generation, audio-video co-generation, and world simulation tasks demonstrate that Sol$^{3}$ achieves 86% attention sparsity and delivers a $3.07\times$ attention speedup while preserving quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/FofGofx/sol3.

</details>


### [307] [CoReQ: Condition-Aware Cross-Modal Repair and Quality-Guided Robust Collaborative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32588)
*Ziwei Guo,Lingzhi Li,Jin Wang,Yunjiang Xu,Yupeng Ouyang,Benyuan Yang,Yujun Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出CoReQ框架，用于多车协同感知中的跨模态修复与质量引导融合，通过LiDAR与4D Radar互补提升恶劣天气和退化观测下的协同检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多车协同感知可缓解遮挡和感知范围受限问题，但恶劣天气导致的缺失回波和虚假回波会降低单车特征质量并影响协同检测；LiDAR几何信息丰富、4D Radar天气适应性强，二者互补有望改善退化观测下的感知，但如何根据观测条件进行跨模态修复以及如何融合修复后可靠性仍不同的多车特征仍需解决。

Method: 提出CoReQ条件感知修复与质量引导协同感知框架。其CBCR模块从点云占用、密度和特征统计中提取车辆级观测条件，并据此调整LiDAR与Radar特征的双向校正；TaQE模块利用EMA教师的分类和定位信息构建监督目标，预测修复后特征的空间质量；CoQF模块将质量信息与内容匹配，并结合双方观测条件进行多车特征加权融合。

Result: 在V2X-R和V2X-Radar-C数据集上的实验表明，该框架在多种观测条件下具有竞争力，在V2X-R雪天条件下AP@0.7取得显著提升，并在所比较的V2X-Radar-C方法中取得最高AP。

Conclusion: CoReQ通过条件引导的跨模态修复和质量引导的多车融合，有效利用LiDAR与4D Radar互补性，提升了退化观测条件下的协同感知检测性能。

Abstract: Multi-vehicle collaborative perception can use observations from different perspectives to alleviate the problems of occlusion and limited sensing range. However, missing echoes and false echoes caused by bad weather will reduce the quality of single-vehicle features and affect collaborative detection. LiDAR provides richer geometric information, and 4D Radar has strong weather adaptability. The complementarity of the two provides the possibility to improve perception under degraded observations. However, how to adjust cross-modal repair according to the current observation conditions and how to reasonably integrate multi-vehicle features whose reliability still differs after repair are still problems that need to be solved. To this end, we propose CoReQ, a condition-aware repair and quality-guided collaborative perception framework. For the former, the condition-guided bidirectional cross-modal repair module (CBCR) extracts vehicle-level observation conditions from point cloud occupancy, density and feature statistics, and adjusts the bidirectional correction of LiDAR and Radar features accordingly. For the latter, we combine local reliability assessment with collaborative weighting: first, the task-aware quality estimation module (TaQE) uses the classification and positioning information of the EMA teacher to construct a supervision target and predict the spatial quality of the repaired features; then, the condition and quality guided fusion module (CoQF) matches the quality information with the content, and the observation conditions of both parties are jointly used for multi-vehicle feature weighted fusion. Experiments on V2X-R and V2X-Radar-C show that the framework is competitive under a variety of observation conditions, achieving significant gains in AP@0.7 on V2X-R under snowy conditions, and achieving the highest AP among the compared V2X-Radar-C methods.

</details>


### [308] [FewRef-5: Fixed-Reference Test-Time Adaptation for Virtual Staining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32591)
*Wenxuan Wang,Liwen Wang,Mingmin Wu,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 FewRef-5，一种基于 StainPromptInversion 的参考辅助测试时适应方法，用少量真实 MAS 参考图构建固定染色目标，在部署时对 H&E 到 MAS 的虚拟染色结果进行逐查询优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定推理规则无法利用部署时可获得的真实目标染色参考，限制了对染色外观的查询特异性校正；测试时适应可在不重新训练生成器的前提下实现参考引导的逐查询细化。

Method: 从 5 个真实 Masson 三色（MAS）训练 patch 中提取组织掩膜内的光密度均值和标准差并平均为固定染色目标；在逐查询视觉提示优化中，将计划式统计匹配损失与该目标结合，并加入边缘/Gram 一致性惩罚及继承的重建目标；目标在查询间保持不变，预训练生成器保持固定。

Result: 在 1,989 个 H&E 到 MAS 输出上，FewRef-5 相比 Edge+Gram 变体将目标集 FID 从 183.201 降至 166.904，并将源参考 SSIM 从 0.92787 提升至 0.94996；但源 PSNR 和 MS-SSIM 下降，表明存在端点权衡而非一致更优的重建。

Conclusion: 参考辅助的测试时适应可改善目标域真实感和源参考结构相似度，但不能全面提升所有重建指标，需权衡目标染色外观与源图像保真度。

Abstract: Virtual staining synthesizes special-stain images from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), extending the information available from an existing digital slide. However, a fixed inference rule can leave available real target-stain references unused, limiting query-specific correction of stain appearance at deployment. Test-time adaptation (TTA) provides a mechanism for this reference-guided, query-specific refinement without retraining the generator. We therefore propose FewRef-5, a reference-assisted TTA method for virtual staining built on StainPromptInversion. We extract tissue-masked optical-density means and standard deviations from five real Masson's trichrome (MAS) training patches and average them into a fixed stain target. A scheduled statistic-matching loss introduces this target into per-query visual-prompt optimization alongside our edge/Gram consistency penalties and the inherited reconstruction objectives. The target remains unchanged across queries, avoiding recursive dependence on earlier generated outputs while the pretrained generator stays fixed. On recorded H&E-to-MAS outputs for 1,989 queries, FewRef-5 reduces target-set FID from 183.201 to 166.904 and increases source-referenced SSIM from 0.92787 to 0.94996 relative to our Edge+Gram variant. Source PSNR and MS-SSIM decrease, showing an endpoint trade-off rather than uniformly better reconstruction.

</details>


### [309] [Completion-Aware Compression for Progressive 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32628)
*Reagan Koo,Yeong-Gyu Kim,Eun-Seok Ryu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种渐进式3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）编解码方案，用单一紧凑码流支持按任意已接收字节预算进行部分重建，并逐步补充高斯点，从而在传输过程中尽早获得可用重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽能高质量新视角渲染，但场景表示体积大、传输成本高；剪枝和压缩虽能减小文件，但渐进传输还要求在完整场景到达前即可使用；现有渐进表示依赖预定义编码层级，更新粒度受限。

Method: 设计渐进式3DGS码流，将属性保真度与高斯点提前可用带来的图像收益进行权衡；采用完成感知的比特分配，并支持在任意接收字节预算下细粒度增量解码，无需单独编码或后续属性细化。

Result: 在完整文件大小和接收字节匹配时，完成感知分配相较仅属性分配将1/8 PSNR提高0.48–1.43 dB；所提编解码将原始3DGS表示压缩62–88倍，同时保持接近参考的Full PSNR；在50 Mbps传输模型下，约0.2秒即可获得部分重建。

Conclusion: 该渐进式3DGS编解码能够在高压缩率下支持早期可用和细粒度渐进重建，在传输效率与重建质量之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view rendering, but its large scene representations are costly to transmit. Pruning and compression reduce file sizes, yet progressive delivery also requires usable reconstructions before the full scene arrives. Existing progressive representations provide partial scenes, but level-based updates are limited by predefined coding boundaries. This paper presents a progressive 3DGS codec that balances attribute fidelity with the image benefit of making Gaussians available earlier. Its single compact stream supports partial 3D reconstruction and adds newly decoded Gaussians as more bytes arrive. The stream supports fine-grained updates at arbitrary received-byte budgets, without separate encodings or later attribute refinement. At matched complete-file sizes and received bytes, completion-aware allocation improves 1/8 PSNR over attribute-only allocation by 0.48-1.43 dB. The proposed codec compresses original 3DGS representations by 62-88 times while retaining near-reference Full PSNR. Under the evaluated 50-Mbps delivery model, partial reconstruction becomes available in approximately 0.2 s.

</details>


### [310] [VenusOCR2.0: Towards Efficient and Effective Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32617)
*Lei Li,Zheng Wei,Yi Yuan,Qingbin Liu,Jiang Bian,Zang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出紧凑型10亿参数视觉语言识别器VenusOCR2.0，面向文本、表格和公式的高精度、高吞吐文档解析，并结合有界递归自我改进数据引擎与并行草稿模块PTPv2提升性能与推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档解析需要在识别质量与吞吐之间平衡，同时递归自我训练容易导致模型崩溃；自回归解码也成为高吞吐部署的瓶颈。

Method: 构建有界递归自我改进数据引擎，让模型仅作为弱点探测器，并用多专家medoid共识、VLM视觉验证和因子化合成提供监督；采用动态分辨率SigLIP2编码器、2x2空间token合并、Qwen3-0.6B解码器和紧凑OTSL表格token；提出约67M参数的PTPv2解耦并行草稿模块，结合冻结多层验证器条件、独立学习掩码和块因果全位置下一token预测。

Result: 在OmniDocBenchv1.6上总体得分96.45，公式CDM达98.57，超过Gemini-3-Pro的92.91和Qwen3-VL-235B的89.78；在单张H20 GPU的vLLM部署中，PTPv2实现2.96倍单请求加速和最高2.36倍批处理吞吐提升，并保持与标准自回归解码逐token无损等价。

Conclusion: VenusOCR2.0在小参数规模下实现了领先的文档解析精度，并通过PTPv2在保证无损输出的同时显著提升推理效率，适合高精度与高吞吐部署场景。

Abstract: We present VenusOCR2.0, a compact 1B-parameter vision-language recognizer designed for both high-accuracy and high-throughput document parsing across text, tables, and formulas. To continuously improve recognition quality without self-training collapse, we build a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) data engine where the model acts strictly as a weakness probe, while external multi-expert medoid consensus, VLM visual verification, and factorized synthesis supply reliable supervision across pretraining, curated SFT, and RLVR. VenusOCR2.0 couples a dynamic-resolution SigLIP2 encoder and 2x2 spatial token merging with a Qwen3-0.6B decoder, adopting compact atomic OTSL tokens to shorten table sequences and reduce structural errors. To further eliminate the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, we introduce PTPv2, a lightweight ($\sim$67M) decoupled parallel draft module that combines frozen multi-layer verifier conditioning, a standalone learned mask, and block-causal all-position next-token prediction. On OmniDocBenchv1.6, VenusOCR2.0 achieves an overall score of 96.45 and a state-of-the-art 98.57 formula CDM, substantially outperforming massive general-purpose VLMs such as Gemini-3-Pro (92.91) and Qwen3-VL-235B (89.78). Deployed in vLLM on a single H20 GPU, PTPv2 delivers a 2.96x single-request speedup and up to 2.36x higher batched throughput while guaranteeing lossless, token-for-token equivalence with standard autoregressive decoding.

</details>


### [311] [ShapeQuest: Towards Granularity-Controlled Edit-Conditioned 3D Asset Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32621)
*Faris Abu-Ali,Sankalp Sinha,Didier Stricker,Muhammad Zeshan Afzal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出面向编辑条件三维资产检索的新基准 ShapeQuest 和新模型 ShapeQuester，用于根据“移除一个扶手”等指令检索完成指定编辑并保留其他部分的三维资产变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像领域的编辑条件检索研究较成熟，但针对单个三维资产的同类问题仍缺乏系统研究和基准。现有方法难以区分竞争性编辑变体，因此需要构建数据基准并设计能感知编辑区域与保留区域的模型。

Method: 构建 ShapeQuest 开源流水线，对带纹理网格进行部件增删、材质和颜色修改，并按编辑影响表面积比例控制五级粒度；在指令未指定部件时构造多个有效目标，并用视觉语言模型从可暴露编辑部件的视角评判，再由人工审核。提出 ShapeQuester，将检索与编辑后点云重建联合学习，用部件掩码监督变化区域和保留区域，并采用冻结预训练点编码器。

Result: ShapeQuest 包含 50 个类别的 87,824 条查询和 50,919 个形状的图库，图库中含竞争性编辑变体。ShapeQuester 在测试集达到 50.4 operation-macro mAP@10，高于相同输入融合基线的 47.2 和最强基线的 48.6；当点编码器从头训练时，重建任务在验证集带来 6.5 点提升，其中 3.3 点来自部件掩码。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了编辑条件三维资产检索的基准与评测流程，并表明联合重建和部件掩码监督能有效提升对编辑变体的区分能力，为后续三维资产检索研究提供了数据和模型基础。

Abstract: Given a reference asset and an instruction such as "remove one armrest," a retriever must find variants that make the edit and preserve the other parts. This search is well established for images but remains underexplored for individual 3D assets. To study this problem, we introduce ShapeQuest and ShapeQuester, a new benchmark and model for edit-conditioned 3D asset retrieval. ShapeQuest's open-source pipeline edits textured meshes through part additions, removals, and material and colour changes. It controls edit granularity across five levels, defined by the fraction of the object's surface area each edit affects. It constructs multiple valid targets when an instruction leaves the choice of part open. A vision-language model judges each edit from views chosen to expose the edited parts, and human raters audit its judgments. ShapeQuest has 87,824 queries in 50 categories and a 50,919-shape gallery with competing edits. To distinguish these variants, ShapeQuester learns retrieval alongside reconstruction of the edited point cloud, with part masks supervising changed and preserved regions. With a frozen pretrained point encoder, ShapeQuester reaches 50.4 operation-macro mAP@10 on the test split, against 47.2 for the fusion baseline with the same inputs and 48.6 for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction adds 6.5 points on the validation split when the point encoder is trained from scratch, including 3.3 from part masks.

</details>


### [312] [On the Capabilities and Limitations of Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32625)
*Jose Sosa,Thomas Gillet,Rim Sleimi,Albert Abello*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在零样本设置下系统评估了12种开放词汇语义分割方法在6个地球观测数据集上的云检测性能，涵盖二分类云检测和多类云分割，并分析了提示词敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言基础模型推动了无需任务特定训练的开放词汇语义分割发展，但其在地球观测云检测中的能力仍缺乏充分探索，尤其是厚云、薄云、云影和背景的细粒度区分。

Method: 在6个公开地球观测数据集上，以零样本方式评估12种OVSS方法，不进行微调或目标数据适配；任务包括二分类云检测和多类分割（厚云、薄云、云影、背景）；并进行受控的文本提示敏感性分析。

Result: 不同模型和数据集间性能差异明显；SegEarth-OV3在6个数据集中的4个上取得最佳二分类云检测性能；多种方法在二分类云检测上表现有潜力，但多类分割仍较困难，尤其是细粒度云类别区分；提示词分析显示模型对替代文本描述响应不一，外观导向提示对部分方法有益、对另一些方法有害。

Conclusion: 研究展示了零样本OVSS用于云检测的潜力和当前局限，并为未来可泛化云分割研究建立了比较基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language foundation models have enabled open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) without task-specific training, offering new opportunities for Earth Observation (EO) applications. However, their capabilities for cloud detection remain insufficiently explored. In this work, we evaluate twelve OVSS approaches across six publicly available EO datasets in a zero-shot setting, i.e., without fine-tuning or adaptation to the target data. We investigate both binary cloud detection and multiclass segmentation, distinguishing between thick clouds, thin clouds, cloud shadows, and background. Our results show differences in performance across models and datasets, with SegEarth-OV3 achieving the highest binary cloud detection performance on four of the six datasets. While several approaches demonstrate promising performance in binary cloud detection, multiclass segmentation remains more challenging, particularly when distinguishing between fine-grained cloud categories. Furthermore, our controlled prompt sensitivity analysis reveals model-dependent responses to alternative textual descriptions, with appearance-oriented prompts benefiting certain approaches while degrading the performance of others. Overall, our findings demonstrate both the potential and current limitations of zero-shot OVSS for cloud detection, establishing a comparative benchmark for future research on generalisable cloud segmentation. Code will be available at: https://github.com/josesosajs/zero-shot-cloudovss.

</details>


### [313] [Attack-Inference Aligned Universal Adversarial Attacks on Video Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32658)
*Ruiqi Shen,Chang Liu,Henghui Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出面向视频目标分割（VOS）两阶段推理范式的通用对抗攻击框架 AUV，通过优化通用对抗扰动破坏共享记忆空间，实现对多种提示模态的强攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VOS 对抗攻击往往忽视 VOS 的“目标初始化 + 基于记忆的传播”两阶段结构，难以充分利用其共享记忆机制和实际流式推理中的脆弱性。

Method: AUV 与 VOS 通用两阶段范式对齐，针对初始化阶段和传播阶段设计解耦训练策略来优化通用对抗扰动（UAP），并通过扰乱共享记忆空间实现跨掩码、点、框和语言提示的 prompt-agnostic 攻击。

Result: AUV 在 VOS 攻击上达到 SOTA：在 DAVIS17-val 上将基于掩码的 SAM3 降至仅 8.4 J&F，而此前 SOTA 在相同训练设置下为 55.4；同时具有最快起效、最持久和视频中途任意时刻攻击等更优时间动态表现，并可适用于不同 VOS 模型。

Conclusion: AUV 框架能够有效揭示真实流式 VOS 的脆弱性，说明结合两阶段推理结构和共享记忆空间的攻击设计对 VOS 安全评估具有重要意义。

Abstract: Modern video object segmentation (VOS) relies on a two-stage inference paradigm: target initialization and memory-based propagation. However, existing adversarial attacks on VOS often overlook this structure. To bridge this gap, we propose AUV, an adversarial framework that Aligns with the Universal two-stage paradigm of VOS models. Specifically, AUV optimizes a universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) through decoupled training strategies tailored for both initialization and propagation stages. By disrupting the shared memory space, it achieves prompt-agnostic attacks across different modalities, including masks, points, boxes, and language. Extensive experiments show that AUV establishes state-of-the-art VOS attack performance, such as degrading mask-based SAM3 to only 8.4 J&F on DAVIS17-val (compared to 55.4 for the previous SOTA under the same training setup). It also exhibits superior temporal dynamics with the fastest onset, the most enduring persistence, and the support of any-time mid-video attacks. The AUV optimization framework is applicable to different VOS models, revealing vulnerabilities in real-world streaming VOS. Code is available at https://github.com/FudanCVL/AUV.

</details>


### [314] [HazeFlux: Few-Step Generative Priors for Real-World Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32632)
*Yunong Liu,Danna Xue,Javier Vazquez-Corral*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种两阶段真实单图去雾框架，利用少步流匹配生成先验，通过LoRA微调与像素级监督实现雾到清晰转换，并用VAE解码器跳连保持结构细节，在四个真实基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实配对去雾数据稀缺且合成雾训练模型存在严重域偏移、泛化到真实雾效果差；预训练生成编辑模型可提供强先验，但标准生成模型偏重分布对齐而非像素保真，且潜空间压缩会丢失细粒度结构细节。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用LoRA微调潜空间生成骨干，在流匹配目标之外加入像素级监督，实现直接的雾图到清晰图转换；第二阶段在VAE解码器中引入结构保持跳连，绕过潜压缩伪影以恢复精确空间边缘。

Result: 在四个真实世界去雾基准上，该方法显著优于现有去雾方法。

Conclusion: 将少步流匹配生成先验适配到真实去雾任务的两阶段设计，可有效缓解域偏移并保持结构细节，提升真实场景去雾性能。

Abstract: Real-world single-image dehazing suffers from severe domain shifts, as paired real data is scarce and models trained on synthetic haze generalize poorly to real-world haze. While pre-trained generative editing models offer powerful image priors to bridge this generalization gap, applying them to image dehazing poses two major challenges: standard generative models prioritize distribution alignment over strict pixel-level fidelity, and operating in compressed latent spaces inherently discards fine-grained structural details. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage framework that adapts the generative prior of a few-step flow-matching backbone to real-world dehazing. In the first stage, we fine-tune the latent backbone using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), supervised not only on a flow-matching objective, but also on pixel-level supervision, thus enabling direct hazy-to-clear translation.
