We therefore evaluate latent knowledge stability across visual and linguistic elicitation conditions from two complementary perspectives: answer preference and internal support. Specifically, we devise the margin retention score (MRS), which measures the first-order projected degradation of the initial answer's logit margin over competing options across conditions and assesses how changes in latent knowledge representations affect this margin. We also present latent knowledge support-structure stability (KSS), which evaluates reference-correct items by comparing internal support profiles constructed using the margin gradient under the reference condition, which jointly reflects changes in how internal support is distributed and changes in total support magnitude. We further construct MMStableBench, comprising 19,452 knowledge items (facts), each probing the same latent knowledge across varied image viewpoints, semantically equivalent question formulations, and answer-option permutations. Experiments across 15 MLLMs show that MRS and KSS reveal latent knowledge instability not captured by accuracy, while an MRS-inspired regularizer further improves the generalization of edited latent knowledge.

</details>


### [423] [MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32630)
*Prince N. Y. Annan,Ali A. A. Aziz,Stephen E. Moore*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文评估多种检索模型在Twi（Akan）语—英语跨语言检索任务上的表现，并提出MargEmbed-Akan查询编码器，以跨语言分数蒸馏提升Twi查询检索英文段落的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Twi使用者在线检索的信息多为英文，因此跨语言检索至关重要；现有嵌入模型在低资源语言Twi上的效果仍需评估和改进。

Method: 在AfriQA和圣经翻译检索两个Twi-English任务上评估BM25、五个开放嵌入模型和两个专有模型。提出MargEmbed-Akan：以AfriE5-Large-instruct为基础，用冻结基模型对英文问题及硬负例打分，并通过NLLB-200的Twi回译文本和原始英文问题训练学生模型复现分数；训练时段落由冻结基模型编码，评估时由MargEmbed-Akan编码问题和段落。

Result: AfriQA上，AfriE5和gemini-embedding-001均为66.6 nDCG@10，EmbeddingGemma 2、Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B、OpenAI text-embedding-3-large分别为56.6、51.3、53.4；MargEmbed-Akan达71.5，比gemini-embedding-001高4.9、比基模型高5.0、比OpenAI高18.1，在无E/O的Twi上增益最大（+7.5）。英语检索与基模型无显著差异，但两个专有模型高1.5–2.2分。圣经翻译检索中，标准Twi上MargEmbed-Akan与gemini-embedding-001统计持平（97.2 vs. 96.5），无变音符号Twi上更优（92.7 vs. 84.9）。

Conclusion: MargEmbed-Akan能显著提升Twi-English跨语言检索，尤其对非标准拼写Twi更有效，同时基本保持英语检索性能；研究未使用AfriQA数据进行训练或模型选择。

Abstract: Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates.
  We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving English behaviour. During training, passages are encoded by the frozen base model; at evaluation, MargEmbed-Akan encodes questions and passages.
  On AfriQA, base AfriE5 and gemini-embedding-001 both achieve 66.6 nDCG@10; EmbeddingGemma 2, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large achieve 56.6, 51.3, and 53.4, respectively. MargEmbed-Akan achieves 71.5, outperforming gemini-embedding-001 by 4.9 points, its base model by 5.0, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 18.1. Its largest gain is on Twi typed without E and O (+7.5 over gemini-embedding-001). English retrieval does not differ significantly from the base model, although both proprietary models score 1.5-2.2 points higher. On Bible translation retrieval, MargEmbed-Akan and gemini-embedding-001 are statistically tied on standard Twi (97.2 vs. 96.5 nDCG@10); MargEmbed-Akan performs better on diacritic-free Twi (92.7 vs. 84.9). No AfriQA data was used for training or model selection.

</details>


### [424] [Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32631)
*Konrad Stolte,Toni Fetzer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种逆向生成对话结构化记录配对数据的方法：先采样符合模式的有效记录，再据此生成对话，并可选合成语音，从而无需人工标注；同时引入变异配置、人物设定和主题计划提升对话多样性，并验证其在下游抽取任务中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练或评估将对话转换为结构化记录的模型需要成对的转录文本与精确记录，但这类数据标注成本高，在敏感领域尤其难以获取。

Method: 先采样符合模式的有效记录，再生成对应对话，并可选合成语音；为避免朴素提示语言模型只产生单一对话的小变体，加入采样的变异配置、人物设定和按记录字段排序的主题计划作为显式变异机制；通过嵌入空间测量输出多样性，并在下游抽取任务中评估。

Result: 完整配置下嵌入方差分布在约2.5倍多的独立方向上，参与率为23.3对9.2；两个医学对话语料得到同数量级结果，样本量、文本长度和语言是额外因素；8B抽取模型在本文方法生成的对话上微调达到64.8%字段准确率，高于朴素生成的57.5%。

Conclusion: 逆向生成方法可在无需标注的情况下构建高质量配对数据，并显著提升对话多样性及下游结构化抽取性能；作者发布了生成库和带对齐记录的德语临床对话语料。

Abstract: Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation. We measure the variation that reaches the output through embedding space, where the embedding variance spreads over about two and a half times as many independent directions with our full configuration compared to without (participation ratio 23.3 against 9.2). Two corpora of medical dialogue give values of the same order, with sample size, text length and language being additional factors there. We also show the positive effect of our method in a downstream test, where an 8B extraction model reaches 64.8% field accuracy when fine-tuned on dialogues from our method, against 57.5% from naive generation. We release the generation library and the generated corpus of German clinical dialogues with aligned records.

</details>


### [425] [Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32660)
*Zixuan Chen,Shengyou Yuan,Nang Yuan,Ming Ma,Zelin Xiao,Lin Zhou,Siyuan Luo,Jiaqi Su,Chengrui Wu,Tiankuo Yao,Nairong Zheng,Cong Pang,Jiapeng Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Bathys 9B 和 27B 深度搜索智能体，围绕可验证问题合成、后训练与上下文压缩下的在线强化学习构建训练框架，并在 BrowseComp 上取得 66.51% 和 80.49% 的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂开放任务需要智能体迭代收集信息、重构查询并基于证据验证，而非单次检索；因此需要同时保证搜索深度、可靠性和长程工具使用能力。

Method: 构建高质量可验证数据：将线索改写为需独立检索的间接引用，并保留证据链以验证唯一答案；采用 SFT、KTO 和 CM-GSPO 的后训练与在线强化学习流程，其中 SFT 稳定长程工具使用与查询重构，KTO 利用二元反馈提升证据 grounded 答案选择，CM-GSPO 在压缩上下文下优化子轨迹并校正子轨迹优势加权。

Result: 在带轨迹自验证和条件重试的评估协议下，Bathys 9B 和 27B 在 BrowseComp 上分别达到 66.51% 和 80.49%。

Conclusion: 结合可验证数据构造、分阶段后训练和上下文压缩下的在线强化学习，可有效提升深度搜索智能体的搜索深度、证据可靠性和复杂任务表现。

Abstract: Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.

</details>


### [426] [Social Bias Neurons in Multilingual Language Models: A Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32685)
*Lance Calvin Lim Gamboa,Yue Feng,Mark Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文利用机制可解释性方法定位多语言指令微调模型中编码社会偏见的神经元，并比较不同方法、语言和偏见维度下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言模型在处理社会刻板印象相关输入时会表现出社会偏见，作者希望从模型内部机制层面识别并刻画编码这些偏见的组件。

Method: 在三种指令微调模型、四种语言和七个偏见维度上开展分析，使用多语言偏见基准，采用激活概率熵和积分间隙梯度两种方法识别社会偏见神经元。

Result: 积分间隙梯度方法更有效，其识别出的神经元主要集中在模型最深层层级，抑制这些神经元能更明显降低模型偏见；高资源语言和低资源语言的神经元分布模式不同；性别、国籍和社会阶层偏见相关神经元与其他偏见维度重叠最多。

Conclusion: 语言在预训练数据中的表示会影响偏见在模型内部的表示方式；性别、国籍和社会阶层在模型学习与处理偏见中具有关键作用。

Abstract: Multilingual models exhibit social bias when processing inputs pertaining to societal stereotypes. We adapt emerging mechanistic interpretability methods to pinpoint and characterize model components that encode this bias. We conduct our analysis across three instruction-tuned models, four languages, and seven bias dimensions. Specifically, we leverage multilingual bias benchmarks in implementing two methods for identifying social bias neurons: activation probability entropy and integrated gap gradients. We find the latter method to be more effective, as the neurons it isolates (which are largely concentrated at the model's deepest layers) lead to sharper decreases in model bias when suppressed. Further analysis reveals neuron distribution patterns differ between high- and low-resourced languages, suggesting that a language's representation in pretraining data influences how its biases are represented within model internals. Our results also indicate that neurons linked to gender, nationality, and social class biases overlap the most with neurons related to other bias dimensions, pointing to the pivotal role these three dimensions play in how models learn and handle bias.

</details>


### [427] [Red-Teaming a Sovereign LLM, Its Reasoning and Its Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32710)
*Hatef Otroshi Shahreza*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究系统提示中的保密指令能否保护开放权重大语言模型中的敏感信息，并通过多模型、多语言、多推理模式的红队测试发现其防护效果有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重LLM越来越多用于处理敏感信息，因此需要验证仅靠系统提示中的保密指令是否足以防止信息泄露。

Method: 对Apertus v1.5及其他五个模型家族进行红队测试，覆盖六种语言和推理模式；使用合成个人记录评估直接披露、纠正诱饵、是/否验证、派生值查询、推理泄露和授权检查，并考察版权归属、历史误述和刻板印象等问题。

Result: 尽管有保密指令，Apertus 8B和70B在纠正诱饵攻击中分别有96%和95%的请求泄露信息；验证查询和派生值查询也会暴露受保护信息，推理轨迹可能在最终答案未披露时泄露机密记录；后训练并未持续提升安全性。

Conclusion: 仅靠系统提示无法确保保密性，需要面向多语言和推理过程的安全评估与更强保护机制。

Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for applications with sensitive information. We investigate whether confidentiality instructions in system prompt can protect such information. We red-team Apertus v1.5, an open sovereign LLM, and five other model families across six languages and reasoning modes. We use synthetic personal records to evaluate direct disclosure, correction baits, yes/no verification, derived-value queries, reasoning leakage and authorisation checks. We also explore copyright attribution, historical misrepresentation and stereotyping. Despite confidentiality instructions, Apertus 8B and 70B leak information in 96% and 95% of requests, respectively, in correction-bait attacks. Verification and derived-value queries also expose protected information without necessarily revealing identifiers. Moreover, reasoning traces can leak confidential records even when final answers withhold them. Our experiments also show that post-training does not consistently improve safety. Our findings demonstrate that system prompts alone cannot ensure confidentiality and highlight the need for multilingual reasoning-aware safety evaluations.

</details>


### [428] [ASCENT: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Advancing Stepwise Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models on Common Clinical Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32734)
*Yera Choi,Yeong Hwa Kim,Jaedeok Lee,Taekang Kim,Sangdoo Yun,Seong-Eun Moon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建了ASCENT——一个由临床医生标注的逐步诊断推理基准与训练资源，包含3,078个来自MedQA-USMLE的逐步问题，用于评估大语言模型在信息不完整条件下逐步形成和修正诊断印象的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在医学问答上表现优异，但真实临床工作流强调逐步诊断推理：随着信息累积，诊断印象会被不断修正。现有评估很少考察这种逐步推理能力，因此需要更贴近临床流程的基准。

Method: 作者构建ASCENT基准，将每个病例拆解为与电子病历对齐的步骤（Findings、Impression、Rationale），并开展实验与训练；在ASCENT上微调Qwen2.5-7B和32B，并进行反事实扰动、格式与内容控制、评审一致性及 rollout 等稳健性分析。

Result: 实验显示，即使在MedQA-USMLE上表现很强的推理模型，在ASCENT上仍有较大提升空间；通用前沿模型差距更大，暴露出“信息完整诊断”与“逐步诊断”之间的持续鸿沟。微调Qwen2.5-7B和32B后，F1较预训练和HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT基线均有可测提升，提升主要来自精确率。稳健性分析表明，微调模型依赖先前诊断印象的诊断内容而非模仿其输出格式；但rollout中的误差传播仍是临床部署的关键挑战。

Conclusion: ASCENT揭示了当前大语言模型在逐步临床诊断推理上的不足，并证明基于该资源微调可带来性能提升；同时，误差传播问题表明此类模型距离可靠临床部署仍有差距。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at medical question answering yet are rarely evaluated on the stepwise diagnostic reasoning that defines real clinical workflows, where impressions are revised as information accumulates. We build Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for NaturalisTic Diagnosis (ASCENT), a clinician-annotated benchmark and training resource of 3,078 stepwise problems derived from MedQA-USMLE that decomposes each vignette into EMR-aligned steps (Findings, Impression, supporting Rationale), enabling evaluation of intermediate reasoning under incomplete information.
  Experiments and training with ASCENT revealed insights into how current LLMs handle stepwise diagnostic reasoning. Even strong reasoning models that perform well on MedQA-USMLE leave substantial headroom on ASCENT, and general-purpose frontier models trail further, exposing a persistent gap between fully informed and stepwise diagnosis. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B and 32B on ASCENT yields measurable F1 gains over both pre-trained and HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT-trained baselines, with gains driven primarily by precision. Complementary robustness analyses (counterfactual perturbation, format-vs-content control, judge agreement, and rollout) further show that ASCENT-fine-tuned models rely on the diagnostic content of prior impressions rather than imitating their output format, while error propagation under rollout remains a key challenge for clinical deployment.

</details>


### [429] [Beyond Fixed-Context Likelihood: Zero-Shot AI-Generated Text Detection via Context Perturbation Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32778)
*Yifan Tang,Jingran Li,Yihao Wang,Zhen Yang,Jianyi Liu,Gongshen Liu,Ru Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出零样本检测器CPD，通过比较完整前缀与短窗口下token对数概率增益，并减去期望增益来检测AI生成文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同样的token对数概率提升在不同位置可能正常也可能异常，因此需要一种相对于单预训练语言模型预期增益的零样本检测方法。

Method: CPD保持文本不变，分别在完整前缀和近期短窗口下评分每个token；用完整前缀分布下的期望增益（等于到受限前缀分布的KL散度）校正观测增益，再将带符号偏差之和按其解析参考标准差缩放。

Result: 在GEN、DetectRL-X和HART上，减去期望增益使AUROC提升32.78至35.81个百分点；CPD优于7个零样本基线，平均AUROC达94.80%，5%假阳性率下召回率为79.60%；在HART上按草稿来源区分文本的AUROC为89.15%，高于按最终表达标签的65.50%。

Conclusion: CPD是一种有效的零样本AI文本检测方法，并能更清晰地反映文本的草稿来源差异。

Abstract: The same increase in token log probability from earlier context can be typical at one position and unusually large at another. We introduce Context Perturbation Discrepancy (CPD), a zero-shot detector that measures this gain relative to what a single pretrained language model expects. Keeping the passage fixed, CPD scores each observed token under its full prefix and under a short window of recent tokens. Under the full-prefix distribution, the expected gain equals the KL divergence from that distribution to the restricted-prefix distribution. CPD subtracts this expectation from each observed gain and scales the sum of the signed deviations by its analytical reference standard deviation. On unedited human and AI texts from GEN, DetectRL-X, and HART, subtracting the expected gain raises AUROC by 32.78-35.81 percentage points at the same variance scale. CPD outperforms seven zero-shot baselines, averaging 94.80% AUROC and 79.60% recall at a 5% false-positive rate. On original and edited HART passages, the same scores separate texts more clearly by draft origin than by the benchmark's final-expression labels (89.15% versus 65.50% AUROC). Code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-tyf/CPD.

</details>


### [430] [Is Prosody Encoded in the Neural Audio Codec Mimi?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32795)
*Nicolas Ballier,Artem Saloev,Erin Pacquetet,Taylor Arnold*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文关注神经音频编解码器在编码阶段捕获了哪些语音信息，并以对话语音代理和语音到语音翻译中使用的 Mimi 编解码器为对象，考察其与韵律相关的潜在特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多在解码阶段评估神经音频编解码器重建语音的自然度，较少研究编码阶段捕获了哪些语音/音系信息，尤其是韵律信息。

Method: 对 Mimi 编解码器的编码表示进行分析，考察其中与韵律相关的潜在对应特征；Mimi 被 Moshi、Sesame 等对话语音代理以及 Hibiki 等语音到语音翻译下游任务使用。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或定量发现，仅说明研究方向和对象。

Conclusion: 摘要强调应关注神经音频编解码器编码阶段的韵律信息，但未明确给出最终结论。

Abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).

</details>


### [431] [Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32889)
*Ida Dencker,Simon Karg,Kenneth Enevoldsen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文构建并标注了英语和丹麦语社交媒体评论数据集，用于检测仇恨语气、建设性语气及对父评论的赞同，并微调多语言大模型进行分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络仇恨言论持续增长且平台减少审核，建设性言论成为对抗仇恨的替代策略；需要自动化检测仇恨与建设性言论，以监测其流行度和在线动态。

Method: 收集并标注大规模英语和丹麦语社交媒体评论，标注仇恨语气、建设性语气和对父评论的赞同；微调多个多语言LLM，并比较上下文增强与非上下文增强架构。

Result: E5-large在上下文增强任务上平均F1为82%，在非上下文增强任务上平均F1为81.6%，均为最佳。

Conclusion: 多语言LLM在跨语言可扩展检测仇恨和建设性言论方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.

</details>


### [432] [From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32807)
*Hantao Hua,Jiming Su,Yonggang Che,Feng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 GramDelta，一个面向运行时语法增量更新的约束解码框架，用于在约束随生成过程逐步出现和演化时高效生成符合形式约束的输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语法约束解码中的相关约束并不总能在解码前完全获得，而可能随着新声明、推断类型信息或运行时分析反馈逐步出现。现有结构化解码引擎擅长处理固定或预声明约束，但当首次出现的语法更新改变已提交前缀的解析状态时，直接重建约束状态会重复解析前缀，开销较大。

Method: GramDelta 维护已提交前缀上的解析状态，仅将新增语法规则引发的变更沿历史依赖传播，避免前缀重放；随后通过基于共享历史图表的无编译因子化投影，将更新后的解析状态映射为精确的下一 token 掩码，避免每次更新都重新编译掩码缓存。

Result: 在四种模型配置上的实验表明，无更新时 GramDelta 带来的额外开销可忽略；在持续运行时语法演化下，相对于最强的重建基线，它将首次语法更新的中位延迟降低 10.7–11.5 倍，并将相对于无约束解码的额外 TPOT 开销降低 53.1–81.9%。

Conclusion: GramDelta 在保持与完全重建相同结果的同时，使更新成本与实际语法变更影响相关，从而支持约束随生成前缀逐步出现和演化时的高效约束解码。

Abstract: Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback. Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies, avoiding prefix replay. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts, avoiding per-update mask-cache recompilation. GramDelta therefore preserves the result of full reconstruction while making update cost sensitive to the actual impact of a grammar change. Experiments across four model configurations show that GramDelta adds negligible overhead without updates; under sustained runtime grammar evolution, it reduces median first-seen grammar-update latency by 10.7--11.5x and reduces the additional TPOT overhead over unconstrained decoding by 53.1--81.9% relative to the strongest reconstruction baseline. These results enable efficient constrained decoding when constraints progressively emerge and evolve with the generated prefix.

</details>


### [433] [Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32997)
*Uriel Benymon,Tristan Whipps,Armita Ghobadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该探索性计算研究用小型GPT-2模型考察二语关键期效应，比较先学英语后再学德语或芬兰语时，以及顺序训练与EWC约束下的内部表征变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二语关键期可能取决于已有母语知识被修改的难易程度；以往研究多关注行为表现，较少直接考察内部表征。

Method: 训练一个小型两层GPT-2模型：先学英语，再通过顺序训练或弹性权重巩固（EWC）学习德语（较近）或芬兰语（较远）。对每种语言20个保留探针句的mean-pooled隐藏状态，在嵌入层和两个Transformer层计算与纯英语模型的余弦相似度，并比较1个和2个二语epoch后的变化。

Result: Transformer层中英语相似度保持较高，但嵌入层变为负值；二语相似度在Transformer层上升；德语和芬兰语在第二Transformer层的差异大于第一层。EWC使Fisher加权参数漂移降低约6%，但Transformer层相似度变化小于0.001。每种条件仅一次训练，结果属初步。

Conclusion: 研究表明可从内部表征而非仅行为角度探讨二语关键期；EWC虽减少重要参数漂移，但对Transformer层表征相似度影响很小。由于每种条件仅一次训练，结论需重复验证。

Abstract: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.

</details>


### [434] [Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33005)
*Shuguang Chen,Salman Paracha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向LLM智能体的记忆系统Leto，将记忆视为对未来响应的预测问题，而非对过去对话的忠实记录，通过索引、记忆回放和效用循环提升记忆对后续任务的实际帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统把记忆当作过去的记录，并以对对话的保真度来评估；但记忆的价值在于能否改善智能体响应。由于记忆系统在响应生成前就决定记忆什么和提供什么，保真度无法判断这些决策是否真正有用，因此忠实记忆也可能无法提升响应质量。

Method: 作者将记忆建模为预测问题，提出Leto记忆系统。Leto通过记忆索引保留对对话细节的访问，使信息可通过来源保持可用；当请求到来时，记忆回放利用索引预测并补充请求未显式说明但智能体所需的上下文；由于所提供上下文的效用直到响应生成后才确定，系统引入效用循环，用响应结果改进未来记忆选择。

Result: 在三种场景、五个基准上与六个记忆系统比较：个性化场景中，PrefEval准确率比最强对比系统高16.3个百分点，PERMA任务完成率高3.1个百分点；长程任务中，在MemoryArena五个环境平均取得最佳总体表现，且收益随链深度增加；长上下文理解中，与直接检索原始历史表现相当，但提供更少上下文token。

Conclusion: 记忆系统应以其对未来响应的效用而非对过去的保真度来评估。Leto通过索引、回放和效用循环，在个性化、长程任务和长上下文理解中均表现出优势，说明面向未来效用的记忆设计更有效。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

</details>


### [435] [FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33078)
*Yisrael Clark,Guy Katz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 FOL-Proof，一种用于验证大语言模型生成的一阶逻辑翻译是否语义忠实的语义防火墙流程，并在多个基准和新增对抗基准上取得接近完美的选择性准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常被用于将自然语言语句翻译成一阶逻辑以增强推理，但模型容易产生错误；若生成的 FOL 公式语义不忠实，会污染下游推理。因此需要一种可靠机制来验证 LLM 生成的 FOL 翻译。

Method: FOL-Proof 通过英语资源语法和最小递归语义等语义分析工具确定性地获得候选翻译池，再用 SMT 求解器检查每个语言解读是否与 LLM 生成的公式逻辑等价；忠实则接受，不忠实则拒绝，或可选地通过反复调用 LLM 修复。该方法采用保守策略：搜索不完整、结构不支持或检查不确定时选择弃权而非错误拒绝。

Result: 在 ProofWriter、RuleTaker、PrOntoQA 以及新的对抗基准 LongFaithCheck 上评估，FOL-Proof 达到接近完美的选择性准确率；直接 LLM 评判和往返翻译基线表现明显更差。

Conclusion: FOL-Proof 能有效充当 LLM 生成一阶逻辑翻译的语义防火墙，在保证保守性和避免误拒的同时，显著优于现有验证基线。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

</details>


### [436] [SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33030)
*Shivank Rajput,Himanshu Singh,A. V. Subramanyam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SALSA，一种从优化攻击语料中学习越狱后缀分布的生成式框架，训练后可高效采样越狱后缀，在开源和黑盒专有模型上取得有竞争力的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化的 GCG 类越狱攻击虽有效，但推理成本高且迁移性差，因此需要更高效、可扩展的越狱后缀生成方法。

Method: SALSA 从优化得到的攻击语料中学习越狱后缀的概率分布，训练生成模型；训练完成后通过采样生成攻击后缀，并给出当学习到的后缀分布接近优化输出分布时可保持高攻击成功率的直觉解释。

Result: 在开源目标上，攻击成功率与先进优化基线相当，单提示生成时间从 3.46 秒降至 0.04 秒；黑盒迁移中，对 GPT-3.5-Turbo 达到 99% ASR，对更难的 GPT-4o 达到 45% ASR，在相同采样预算下超过最强基线两倍以上。

Conclusion: 学习对抗后缀分布可为持续发现 LLM 漏洞提供可扩展且实际高效的基础，说明生成式采样在保持高攻击成功率方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.

</details>


### [437] [Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33050)
*Zihan Chen,Di Zhu,Lei Nico Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文研究AI聊天机器人回答的“交付方式”（流式逐字显示 vs 一次性回放缓存答案）如何影响盲选偏好与后续使用行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI回答速度差异很大：推理模型会先思考再回答，缓存可立即返回旧答案。通常认为更快回答会因交付速度获得偏好，但“劳动幻觉”和屏幕文本呈现研究提示，逐字展开的答案可能比同样内容一次性显示更受青睐。

Method: 利用三类自然使用中的变异：1）法国政府聊天机器人竞技场compar:IA中，同一提示随机获得流式新答案或同一模型的一次性缓存回放；2）提供方拥塞导致流式回答变慢，分析324,029段对话；3）WildChat中4,378,514条日常ChatGPT回复，分析拥塞变慢对用户继续使用的影响。

Result: 同一提示下，缓存回放使答案在决定性盲选中获胜概率降低25.8个百分点；同一存储文本流式显示时获57%决定性票，回放时仅29%，且回放被评为更不完整、更肤浅、更常出错。拥塞变慢的流式回答在投票中未获可检测净收益，但较慢的首轮交流降低用户追问概率；WildChat中因拥塞变慢的回复也降低用户继续对话概率。

Conclusion: 交付方式会显著影响盲选偏好，且方向与竞技场设计者预期相反；等待会损害追问和持续使用，而两两比较在双方都慢时无法捕捉这一成本。结果对AI服务如何缓存与流式输出、如何分配延迟预算以及偏好排行榜如何评估模型均有启示。

Abstract: Answers from generative AI chatbots built on large language models (LLMs) now arrive at very different speeds: reasoning models deliberate before replying, while response caches can return a stored answer at once. Blind preference votes, which rank these models, are read as judgments of their text, and if delivery matters, faster answers are expected to gain. Research on the labor illusion and on how text appears on screen suggests instead that an answer which unfolds as it is written is credited over the same answer shown at once. We test these accounts with three sources of variation in natural use. First, compar:IA, a French government chatbot arena, answered repeated prompts, by a random draw, either with a fresh answer streamed as it was written or with a stored earlier answer from the same model, shown at once. Within the same prompt, a replay lowered an answer's chance of winning a decisive blind vote by 25.8 percentage points. The same stored text won 57% of its decisive votes when streamed and 29% when replayed, and voters called it less complete, more superficial and more often incorrect when replayed. Second, provider congestion slowed streamed answers. In 324,029 conversations, slower answers earned no detectable net credit in the vote, but a slower first exchange made visitors less likely to ask a follow-up question. Third, in 4,378,514 WildChat replies from everyday ChatGPT use, replies slowed by congestion made users less likely to continue. Delivery moved blind votes, in the direction opposite to the one the arena's designers expected, while waiting cost follow-up questions that a comparison between two answers cannot register when both are slow. The results bear on how AI services cache and stream answers, how they budget latency, and how preference leaderboards evaluate models.

</details>


### [438] [AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33093)
*Guangyuan Wang,Chengran Li,Minchen Luo,Jichen Feng,Mengdi Wang,Yifan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 AIChipBench，评估 LLM 编码智能体为量化 Qwen3.5、Gemma 3/4、Llama 3.2 解码器编写可综合 RTL 的能力，重点揭示状态更新错误难以通过输出测试发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型解码器在硬件中跨解码步保存状态，错误的状态更新可能当时输出正确却在若干 token 后出错，因此仅靠输出测试会漏掉错误；需要明确编码智能体构建此类硬件真正需要什么。

Method: 构建 AIChipBench：智能体依据可执行整数参考模型实现量化解码器 RTL，在固定预算下用公开测试调试；冻结设计在留出 token 序列、复位、内存停顿和综合上评分，另设接近固定面积的加速赛道；分析 4 个编码智能体共 9,136 次尝试，并进行反馈类型匹配研究。

Result: 指出首个状态不匹配的反馈在全部 12 个智能体-任务单元中都将接受率比仅输出反馈提高 25.0 至 46.9 个百分点，并使每个被接受设计所需的智能体小时数减半；69 个被接受设计中有 45 个在新序列和条件下、于测试要求的 32 步内失败；超过三分之一的正确设计加速尝试未得到正确加速设计；总分排名 Sol 5.6、Fable 5.1 高于 Astra 6 和 Opus 5.5，且 200 次随机划分中顺序稳定。

Conclusion: 硬件智能体需要能暴露存储状态的调试反馈，其基准测试也需要远超出开发用例的最终测试，否则设计可能通过输出测试但仍然错误。

Abstract: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

</details>


### [439] [SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33124)
*Yuchao Wu,XingCheng Liang,Xuanze Wang,Yini Huang,Yue Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SAG-Mem 对话记忆框架，通过保留完整对话消息、分块索引和查询时词法扩展来检索分散的互补证据，并在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上取得领先成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期对话记忆需要跨会话检索互补事实，包括与原问题相似度较低的中间证据；现有方法依赖派生记忆表示或持久关系结构，构建成本高且可能丢失原始细节。

Method: SAG-Mem 将完整对话消息保存在不重叠块中，构建时不需模型推理，仅用词法索引，不做 LLM 抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。查询时先用 BM25 召回候选，由证据评估器识别有用块，再用所选证据中的词法线索进行第二轮检索；同时对相对时间表达添加日历解释并保留原始措辞。SAG-Mem-Lite 用基于嵌入的候选评分替代证据评分以降低成本。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上，SAG-Mem 总体得分分别为 83.08 和 80.20，均为所评估方法中最高；在 LongMemEval 上比最强基线高 7.20 分。SAG-Mem-Lite 得分分别为 77.09 和 77.20，运营成本低于 Full Context 和所有基于记忆的基线，查询延迟较低。

Conclusion: 保留原始对话并结合证据引导的检索扩展，是长期对话记忆的有效设计。

Abstract: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.

</details>


### [440] [CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33148)
*Dawid J. Kopiczko,Tijmen Blankevoort,Yuki M. Asano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出仅从教师模型的行动轨迹中蒸馏长程智能体策略，无需教师的隐藏思维链；学生模型在空推理块下训练，仍可在推理时开启思考并保持类似教师的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过强化学习训练长程智能体成本高；常见做法是模仿强教师的思维链和行动，但最强教师多为闭源模型，其思维链隐藏在 API 后不可获得。

Method: 将学生模型在教师行动轨迹上微调，训练时推理块留空，并用自身生成回放缓冲区的 KL 损失限制漂移；引入 CoT-proxies，即在空推理块后放置教师推理的简短摘要；方法也适用于仅用闭源教师可见输出和 API 返回推理摘要的场景。

Result: 蒸馏 Qwen3.6-27B 行动使 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 成功率从 7% 升至 18%，Qwen3-32B 从 12% 升至 25%；加入 CoT-proxies 后 Qwen3-4B 升至 35%；蒸馏 GPT-5.6 Luna 使 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 从 7% 升至 48%，在 SWE-bench Verified 从 3% 升至 28%。

Conclusion: 教师的隐藏思维链并非必需；仅行动蒸馏和 CoT-proxies 即可训练长程策略，并可原样应用于闭源教师，且空推理块训练可迁移到开启思考的推理模式。

Abstract: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [441] [EvoMisty: Building, Optimizing, and Evolving Capabilities on a Social Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31341)
*Xiao Wang,Lu Dong,Ifeoma Nwogu,Srirangaraj Setlur,Venu Govindaraju*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 EvoMisty，一个基于插件的框架，让编码智能体从官方文档构建机器人控制程序，在真实机器人上验证原子能力，并通过用户指定指标迭代优化任务程序，最终蒸馏可复用技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交机器人面临多样且变化的任务，现有基于 LLM 的方法依赖手工控制接口和预定义能力，缺乏按用户指标优化已完成任务并跨任务复用性能改进的通用机制。

Method: EvoMisty 从官方文档生成控制程序，在物理机器人上验证候选能力，将验证后的能力存入原子能力库并与已有技能组合完成任务；任务完成后收集执行数据、测量用户指定指标、迭代优化任务程序，并将最终方案蒸馏为可复用技能库。

Result: 在 Misty II 机器人上使用 Claude Code 和 Codex 评估，两者分别构建 109 和 107 个已验证原子能力，均完成 28 个 AutoMisty 基准任务及 7 个额外任务；优化在 5 个任务上提升全部 7 项指标，例如对话响应延迟分别降低 52% 和 71%；复用优化后的对话技能可使另外 3 个对话任务延迟降低 33% 至 72%。

Conclusion: EvoMisty 能支持编码智能体构建并持续改进机器人能力，实现基于用户指标的迭代优化和跨任务技能复用，并在真实机器人上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Social robots face diverse and changing tasks in companionship and education. LLM-based methods can generate task programs, but they still rely on manually developed control interfaces and predefined capabilities. They also lack a general mechanism to optimize completed tasks based on user-specified metrics and reuse performance improvements across tasks.We present EvoMisty, a plugin-based framework that enables coding agents to build and continually improve robot capabilities. EvoMisty builds a control program from official documentation and verifies candidate capabilities on a physical robot. Verified capabilities are stored in an atomic capability library and combined with existing skills to solve tasks. After task completion, EvoMisty can collect execution data, measure user-specified metrics, and iteratively improve task programs. It then distills reusable skills from final solutions into a skill library for future tasks.We evaluate EvoMisty on a physical Misty II robot using Claude Code and Codex. The two agents construct 109 and 107 verified atomic capabilities, respectively. Both complete all 28 AutoMisty benchmark tasks and seven additional tasks beyond AutoMisty's capabilities. Optimization improves all seven evaluated metrics across five tasks. For example, dialogue response latency decreases by 52% and 71%, respectively. Reusing skills from one optimized dialogue task reduces latency by 33% to 72% in three other dialogue tasks without further optimization. All code and experimental videos will be publicly released through the webpage: https://wangxiaoshawn.github.io/projects/evomisty/index.html

</details>


### [442] [Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31446)
*Anjiabei Wang,Tesca Fitzgerald*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何利用人类纠正机器人行为时的“何时干预”和“如何干预”信息来学习价值表征，并验证其在目标推断和纠正预测任务中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于纠正的学习方法主要比较纠正后的新轨迹与机器人原计划行为，忽视了干预前机器人行为所提供的上下文信息。

Method: 作者将干预前和干预后的行为转化为偏好对，用于学习近似人类潜在奖励的价值函数：干预后偏好通过比较纠正行为与被替换行为构建，干预前偏好通过干预前状态之间的时间关系构建；并在目标推断和纠正预测两个下游任务上评估学习到的价值表征。

Result: 干预后偏好对目标推断尤其有效，干预前偏好则对纠正预测表现更强；结合两类信息在两个任务上均表现良好，并能泛化到训练中未见的参与者。

Conclusion: 人类“何时”纠正与“如何”纠正提供了互补信息，可用于从纠正交互中学习价值表征。

Abstract: When people intervene to correct a robot, they provide information not only through how they correct its behavior, but also through when they choose to intervene. Existing approaches to Learning from Corrections focus on comparing the new trajectory to the robot's originally intended behavior, thus underutilizing the context of the robot's behavior before the intervention. In this work, we investigate how both pre- and post-intervention behavior can be translated into preference pairs for learning value functions that approximate a human's latent reward. We construct post-intervention preferences by comparing corrected behavior with the behavior it replaces, and pre-intervention preferences from temporal relationships among states leading up to an intervention. We evaluate the learned value representations through two downstream tasks: goal inference and correction forecasting. Our results show that post-intervention preferences are particularly effective for goal inference, while pre-intervention preferences provide strong correction-forecasting performance. Combining both sources of information performs strongly across both tasks, even when generalizing to participants unseen during training. These findings demonstrate that both when and how humans correct provide complementary information for learning value representations from corrective interactions.

</details>


### [443] [Geometric Control Analysis of an Internally Actuated Flying Wing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31463)
*Jonathan Becker,Ella M. Atkins*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究仅由内部移动质量、动量轮和外部推力驱动的固定翼无人机，进行几何可达性与可控性分析，并设计非线性MPC进行轨迹跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统固定翼无人机依赖控制舵面，会增加CFD建模与流场分析复杂度；本文旨在验证无传统控制面配置的可行性与可控性。

Method: 采用李括号计算与强李代数秩条件分析非线性动力学可达性；用Sussmann条件分析姿态子系统的小时间局部可控性；通过Huygens-Steiner定理显式处理时变惯性张量；并设计考虑飞行包线约束的非线性模型预测控制器。

Result: 表明系统一般具有小时间局部可达性，奇异构型可被质量驱动立即逃离；姿态子系统在平衡点满足小时间局部可控性；动量轮偏航控制与移动质量导致的惯性变化共同形成满秩可达李代数；MPC可在无扰动和扰动流场下跟踪不同轨迹。

Conclusion: 该无传统控制面固定翼UAS配置在几何上具备可达性与姿态可控性，结合非线性MPC可实现轨迹跟踪，为简化高保真建模与流场分析提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This paper presents a rigorous geometric accessibility and controllability analysis for a fixed-wing Uncrewed Aircraft System (UAS) actuated solely by an internal moving mass, a momentum wheel, and external thrust. This configuration eliminates traditional control surfaces, which in turn reduces the combinatorial set of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) studies necessary for high-fidelity modeling of flight through unsteady flow fields. Using Lie bracket computations and the strong Lie Algebra Rank Condition, it is shown that the full nonlinear dynamics are generically small-time locally accessible, with singular configurations explicitly characterized and shown to be immediately escapable by direct mass actuation. The stronger property of small-time local controllability is shown to hold for the attitude subsystem at equilibrium points, using Sussmann's condition. A key contribution is the explicit treatment of the time-varying inertia tensor via the Huygens-Steiner Theorem, which introduces nontrivial coupling between the control vector fields. The momentum wheel provides direct yaw authority that, combined with inertia variation from the moving mass, generates a full-rank accessibility Lie algebra. A nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (MPC) is derived with consideration of flight envelope constraints and is applied to track different trajectories under unperturbed and perturbed flow field conditions.

</details>


### [444] [CRAB-H: Task-Centric Certification for Healthcare Autonomous Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31470)
*Tord Johan Eide,Einar Holt*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出CRAB H，一种面向医疗自主系统的任务中心认证方法，将具体医疗任务作为一级治理对象，通过任务需求档案TRP H比较系统已展示能力与任务所需能力来完成认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统认证常以基准分数判断机器人是否足够好，难以反映特定医疗任务对认知能力、治理约束、证据和运行假设的实际要求；同时不可重复评估的认知维度不应被丢弃。

Method: CRAB H扩展ARC治理架构，引入任务需求档案TRP H定义任务所需认知能力、治理约束、证据要求和运行假设；采用可靠性门控的保证分配机制，将无法可重复评估的维度转入LEA运行要求；并以逐维度合规判定的阈值合取定义Capability Margin。

Result: 提出任务中心认证框架、TRP H档案、可靠性门控保证分配机制和Capability Margin定义；认证由基准分数比较转为已展示能力与所需能力的比较，不可靠维度被治理而非忽略。

Conclusion: CRAB H将认证与具体医疗任务需求对齐，保留非补偿性治理逻辑，适合安全关键医疗部署，避免用可相互补偿的标量分数替代逐维度合规判断。

Abstract: This paper introduces CRAB H as a task-centric certification methodology for healthcare autonomous systems. CRAB H extends the ARC governance architecture by introducing the task as a first-class governance object, represented through Task Requirement Profiles TRP H. Each profile defines the cognitive capabilities, governance constraints, evidentiary requirements, and operational assumptions necessary for the safe execution of a specific healthcare activity. Rather than asking whether a robot achieves a sufficiently high benchmark score, CRAB H asks whether demonstrated capabilities satisfy the requirements of the task. Certification becomes a comparison between demonstrated capability and required capability. A reliability-gated assurance allocation mechanism routes cognitive dimensions that cannot be reproducibly evaluated to LEA operational requirements rather than discarding them. Governance integrity is preserved: unreliable dimensions are governed, not ignored. The Capability Margin is defined as the threshold-based conjunction of per-dimension compliance determinations, not as a subtracted scalar preserving non compensatory governance logic appropriate for safety-critical healthcare deployment

</details>


### [445] [Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31488)
*Ruwan Wickramarachchi,Jonathan Francis,Alessandro Oltramari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出“具身神经符号AI”部署导向范式，将学习型感知、规划与控制同显式机器可读背景知识和形式化约束结合，以提升机器人部署的泛化性、可审计性和安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLA端到端系统在真实部署中仍存在分布偏移下泛化脆弱、物理与因果推理有限、细粒度运动控制不稳定，以及难以表达和审计“机器人不得做什么”等安全保证不足的问题。

Method: 提出Embodied NeSy AI范式，融合知识引导感知、约束感知符号规划和混合学习，将学习型感知、规划与控制与显式、机器可读的背景知识及形式化约束集成。

Result: 摘要主要给出概念性框架，未报告具体实验数据；其预期能力包括环境推理、新任务适应，以及对安全和运行要求提供可审计、机器可检查的合规性支持。

Conclusion: 具身神经符号AI有望支持可扩展、可信赖的机器人部署，但其实际效果仍需进一步实验验证。

Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects, layouts, lighting, or contact conditions), limited physical and causal reasoning, and inconsistent fine-grained motor control. Critically, many VLA pipelines offer limited ways to express and audit what a robot must not do, making it difficult to provide assurance in safety-critical settings. These limitations constrain scalability, maintainability, and trust when robots move beyond controlled demonstrations. We propose Embodied Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI: a deployment-oriented paradigm that integrates learned perception, planning and control with explicit, machine-readable background knowledge and formal constraints. By combining knowledge-guided perception, constraint-aware symbolic planning, and hybrid learning, Embodied NeSy AI enables robots to reason about their environment, adapt to new tasks, and provide auditable, machine-checkable compliance with safety and operational requirements, thus supporting scalable, trustworthy robot deployment.

</details>


### [446] [Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31535)
*Shizhe Chen,Paul Pacaud,Cordelia Schmid*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Hi3R-VLA，一种将视觉、语言和动作统一锚定在显式 3D 几何中的机器人操作策略，通过点云表示和 3D-RoPE 动作到点注意力实现精确且可泛化的动作预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型虽 increasingly 引入 3D 几何，但如何有效利用 3D 几何进行精确且可泛化的动作预测仍是核心挑战。

Method: 将空间对齐的视觉特征与语言条件融合进点云表示，以增强任务相关语义；将低层控制命令锚定在同一 3D 坐标系中，并使用 3D-RoPE 增强的动作到点注意力在由粗到细的点特征上建模动作目标与观测点之间的几何关系。

Result: 分析表明 3D 内语义融合及观测-动作空间对齐的重要性；在少于 250M 可训练参数下，Hi3R-VLA 在 RoboCasa、RLBench、RoboTwin2、DexJoCo 和 DexSuite 上跨单臂、双臂夹爪及灵巧手等多种操作任务和 embodiment 达到 SOTA，真实机器人评估也验证其有效性。

Conclusion: Hi3R-VLA 证明了以显式 3D 几何统一视觉、语言和动作能有效提升机器人操作的精确性与泛化能力，并具备跨任务、跨 embodiment 和真实世界部署潜力。

Abstract: While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate 3D geometry, how to effectively exploit it for precise and generalizable action prediction remains a central challenge. We introduce Hi3R-VLA, a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities - vision, language, and action - in explicit 3D geometry for robotic manipulation. Our model integrates spatially-aligned visual features and language conditioning into point cloud representations, enriching scene geometry with fine-grained, task-relevant semantics. It then anchors low-level control commands in the same 3D coordinate frame and uses 3D-RoPE enhanced action-to-point attention over coarse-to-fine point features to model geometric relationships between action targets and observed points. Our analysis demonstrates the importance of semantic fusion within 3D and spatial alignment between observations and actions. With fewer than 250M trainable parameters, Hi3R-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa, RLBench, RoboTwin2, DexJoCo and DexSuite across diverse manipulation tasks and embodiments, from single-arm and dual-arm grippers to dexterous hands. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate its effectiveness in the physical world. The model, code and dataset are publicly released at https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/hi3r_vla.html.

</details>


### [447] [Sampling at Scale: Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31561)
*Minchan Jung,Dimitrios S. Georgiou,Augustinos D. Saravanos,Evangelos A. Theodorou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向多智能体轨迹优化的分布式采样架构 DS-TO，通过定制分裂机制让每个智能体仅在自己的控制空间采样，从而兼顾非凸探索与大规模扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体轨迹优化同时面临非凸景观探索和大量智能体扩展两大难题；采样方法利于探索但随维度扩展差，直接嵌入分布式优化又会在处理约束非凸性与搜索空间随邻域规模增长之间产生权衡。

Method: 提出基于 splitting 机制的分布式采样轨迹优化 DS-TO：每个智能体只在自己的控制空间采样，采样维度不随邻域规模增长，同时仍暴露于约束诱导的非凸性和其他智能体决策；算法完全去中心化，仅需邻域通信，并支持并行局部更新、子问题内并行 Jacobi 更新和单步约束线性化等高效变体。

Result: 在二维和三维任务中，最多 1024 个智能体的实验表明，DS-TO 相比最先进的基于导数的分布式优化具有更好的探索和约束满足效果，并相较现有分布式采样方法具有更优的扩展性。

Conclusion: DS-TO 通过为采样量身定制的分裂机制，有效缓解了分布式采样在多智能体轨迹优化中的扩展性与非凸探索矛盾，实现了可扩展、完全去中心化且约束满足更好的轨迹优化。

Abstract: Multi-agent trajectory optimization poses two coupled challenges: effectively exploring non-convex landscapes and scaling favorably to large teams of agents. Sampling-based methods are natural candidates for the exploration challenge but scale poorly with problem dimension. Moreover, their off-the-shelf integration into distributed optimization introduces a fundamental trade-off: sampling either fails to address the constraint-induced non-convexity or its search space grows with neighborhood size. We address this gap by introducing a $\underline{D}\text{istributed}$ $\underline{S}\text{ampling-based}$ $\underline{T}\text{rajectory}$ $\underline{O}\text{ptimization} \ \text{(DS-TO)}$ architecture built on a splitting mechanism tailored to sampling. Under this splitting, each agent samples only in its own control space, independent of neighborhood size, while still remaining exposed to both the constraint-induced non-convexity and the decisions of other agents. The resulting algorithm is fully decentralized, requiring only neighborhood communication, with all local updates executed in parallel across agents. Efficient variations, including parallel Jacobi updates within each agent's subproblem and single-step constraint linearization, further reduce computation. Experiments on 2D and 3D tasks with up to 1024 agents demonstrate improved exploration and constraint satisfaction over state-of-the-art derivative-based distributed optimization, and superior scalability to existing distributed sampling methods.

</details>


### [448] [FabricBench: A Standardized Policy Benchmark for Bimanual Fabric Manipulation with a Contact-Driven Deformable Simulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31577)
*Wenkang Hu,Haoran Wang,Liu Liu,Wenchao Huang,Yiji Chen,Mengao Zhao,Xincheng Tang,Zhengjie Shu,Lai Jiang,Wei Li,Zhendong Wang,Zhizhong Su,Huamin Wang,Ruigang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 FabricBench，一个用于双臂织物操作的标准基准，包含六类任务、10,000 个仿真就绪资产，并支持构型与外观泛化测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 织物操作面临几何变化、自遮挡和接触复杂等挑战，但现有机器人评测主要集中于刚性物体，缺乏标准化、可复现的织物操作基准。

Method: 基于 Newton 开源求解器构建仿真环境，通过接触力实现稳定的双臂抓取、保持和释放，无需人工附着；重新设计布料-刚性体接触与双向力耦合，支持机械臂、织物和自由刚性物体交互；设置六类任务并评估六种代表性策略。

Result: 抓取-保持-释放测试中 45/45 成功，基线配置均失败；最佳策略平均成功率 77%，但长时程 T 恤折叠均未超过 36%；在最变形初始 T 恤构型下成功率降至 6-14%；π0.5 零样本真机部署基本保持任务难度排序（Spearman ρ=0.94）。

Conclusion: FabricBench 可作为可复现的织物操作测试平台，用于衡量能力并暴露策略在构型泛化方面的局限。

Abstract: Fabric manipulation challenges robot policies with changing geometry, self-occlusion, and contact, yet standardized evaluation remains focused on rigid objects. We introduce FabricBench, a benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with six tasks spanning garments, silk, and bags, 10,000 simulation-ready assets, and controlled tests of configuration and appearance generalization. Built on an open-source solver in Newton, our simulator enables stable bimanual grasping, holding, and release through contact forces, without artificial attachment. Redesigned cloth-rigid contact and bidirectional force coupling support interactions among robot arms, fabric, and free rigid objects, allowing a bag to support its contents and transmit their weight to the grippers. In a controlled grasp-hold-release evaluation, our solver succeeds in all 45 trials, compared with none for the tested baseline configurations. Evaluating six representative policies, including vision-language-action models and world action models, reveals substantial remaining challenges: the best policy achieves 77% average success, while no policy exceeds 36% on long-horizon T-shirt folding. Under the most deformed initial T-shirt configurations, success falls to 6-14% across policies, with larger drops than under the evaluated appearance shifts. Zero-shot deployment of $π_{0.5}$ on a real robot largely preserves task difficulty ordering across six tasks (Spearman $ρ=0.94$). These results establish FabricBench as a reproducible testbed for measuring fabric-manipulation capabilities and exposing limitations in configuration generalization. The project website is available at https://fabricbench.github.io/.

</details>


### [449] [A Self-Organizing Swarm Control Model for Underwater Robots Based on Turing-Type Reaction-Diffusion Principles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31637)
*Takeshi Ishida*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需领导者、绝对坐标和相对位置/速度信息的去中心化群体控制模型，仅利用两个不同通信距离信道接收到的信号数量来驱动水下机器人群体形成与调控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下环境中GPS和高速无线电通信不可用，通信带宽与可见度严重受限，传统Boids等群体编队方法依赖邻居相对位置和速度向量，难以应用。

Method: 将基于图灵斑图形成的元胞自动机模型扩展到连续空间；根据内、外邻域两个通信信道接收信号数之差计算势场，使机器人向高势区域运动；采用势值时间平均、基于滞回的状态评估、基于时间差的逐步转向以及与外部方向指令的向量合成来实现稳定行为。

Result: 二维仿真表明可实现自主群体形成，并可通过形态学参数控制群体空间分散度；在通信成功率降至约0.7的丢包条件下，仍能保持群体维持和高极化度，表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提去中心化群体控制模型可在无领导者、无绝对坐标且通信受限的水下场景中实现群体编队与空间调控，并对通信丢包具有较强鲁棒性。

Abstract: In underwater environments, Global Positioning System (GPS) signals and high-speed radio communication are unavailable, and severe constraints exist on communication bandwidth and visibility; consequently, applying conventional swarm formation methods, such as the Boids model, which require the relative positions and velocity vectors of neighboring vehicles, is difficult. This study proposes a decentralized swarm control model that operates without a leader or absolute coordinates, relying solely on the number of received signals from two communication channels with different transmission ranges (inner and outer neighborhoods). The proposed model extends a cellular automaton model based on Turing pattern formation principles to continuous space and is grounded in the fundamental concept that swarms form as robots move toward regions of higher potential calculated from the difference in received signal counts. Specifically, stable behavior is determined through temporal averaging of potential values, hysteresis-based state evaluation, stepwise turning based on temporal differences, and vector composition with an external directional command. Two-dimensional simulation results demonstrated that autonomous swarm formation and control of swarm spatial dispersion via a morphological parameter are achievable, confirming robustness in maintaining swarms and high polarization even under communication dropouts where the communication success rate decreases to approximately 0.7.

</details>


### [450] [Collision Rendering: GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Planning on Sparse Voxel Radiance Fields with Risk-Bounded Collision Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31658)
*Byoungkwon Yoon,Han Gyeom Lee,Hojun Lee,Yuseop Sim,Daniel Sungwoo Bae,Martin Byung-Guk Jun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Collision Rendering，这是首个基于稀疏体素辐射场（SVR）的轨迹规划框架，可实现 GPU 加速、风险有界的碰撞检测与可微碰撞代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辐射场能为机器人提供详细场景表示，但如何将学习到的空间基元可靠地转化为碰撞判据仍缺乏共识，导致其在轨迹规划中应用不足。

Method: 利用 SVR 的结构化体积密度，将其渲染管线作为碰撞概率的快速数值近似器；用碰撞球近似机器人，并在每个球处放置重合的球形相机；在概率碰撞模型下，从渲染管线推导每个球最大方向碰撞概率的上界；在 GPU 上评估该上界，形成可集成到采样规划器的模块化碰撞检测器；并通过渲染不透明度计算碰撞代价及其梯度，扩展到轨迹优化。

Result: 在消费级 GPU 上实现毫秒级碰撞检测；所有查询均得到无碰撞轨迹，优于其他基于辐射场的规划器。

Conclusion: Collision Rendering 无需辅助几何地图或修改学习表示，即可将 SVR 渲染用于风险有界碰撞检测和轨迹优化，展示了辐射场在机器人轨迹规划中的潜力。

Abstract: Although radiance fields provide detailed scene representations for robotics, they remain underexplored for trajectory planning, without a widely agreed-upon way to translate learned spatial primitives into reliable collision criteria. To bridge this gap, we introduce Collision Rendering, the first trajectory planning framework on sparse voxel radiance fields (SVR), which supports GPU-accelerated, risk-bounded collision checking and a differentiable collision cost. Our key insight is that the structured volumetric density of SVR allows its rendering pipeline to serve as a fast numerical approximator of collision probability. We approximate the robot with collision spheres and place a coinciding spherical camera at each sphere. Under a probabilistic collision model, we derive an upper bound on each sphere's maximum directional collision probability from the camera's rendering pipeline. Evaluating this bound on the GPU yields a modular collision checker that integrates with established sampling-based planners without an auxiliary geometric map or changes to the learned representation. We further compute a collision cost and its gradients from rendered opacities through the same pipeline, extending the framework to trajectory optimization. Experiments demonstrate millisecond collision checking time on a consumer-grade GPU and collision-free trajectories in all queries, outperforming other radiance field-based planners.

</details>


### [451] [Exteroceptive Sensor Faults in Autonomous Vehicles: A Cross-Modal Taxonomy and Fault Injection Toolkit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31667)
*Davide Possenti,Daniele Cianca,Stefano Arrigoni,Francesco Braghini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文综述自动驾驶外感知传感器故障，提出跨模态、按故障来源划分的分类体系，并发布开源故障注入工具包，用于感知系统可靠性研究与安全验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机、LiDAR和雷达会因硬件老化、环境干扰、标定错误、嵌入式软件错误及其组合而性能退化，直接影响感知质量与安全；现有综述和基准多针对单一传感器、孤立条件或整车级后果，缺乏统一术语来关联三种模态的故障来源。

Method: 综述外感知传感器故障文献，提出跨模态、来源驱动的五类分类法：硬件、环境、标定、软件和协同故障；将每类映射到物理或逻辑机制、可观测表现和受影响子系统，并关联ISO 26262与ISO 21448安全分析；发布开源故障注入工具包，包含94个症状级例程（41相机、27 LiDAR、26雷达）、四级严重程度、可复现突发调度和逐帧标签。

Result: 形成了统一的跨模态故障分类与映射框架；工具包提供可操作的故障注入和标注能力；在Boreas数据集上的示例展示了各类故障如何改变相机图像、LiDAR点云和雷达扫描。

Conclusion: 该分类体系和工具包为研究传感器可靠性、开发与基准测试故障检测和诊断方法、构建带故障标注的数据集以及感知系统安全验证提供了共享参考和受控测试平台。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles rely on cameras, LiDAR, and radar to perceive their surroundings, yet these exteroceptive sensors can be degraded by hardware aging, environmental interference, miscalibration, embedded software errors, and combinations of these causes, with direct consequences for perception quality and safety. Existing surveys and benchmarks mostly address individual sensors, isolated conditions, or vehicle-level consequences, and no common vocabulary relates fault origins across the three modalities. This paper reviews the literature on exteroceptive sensor faults and proposes a cross-modal, origin-driven taxonomy that organizes them into five categories, namely hardware, environmental, calibration, software, and synergistic faults, mapping each entry to its physical or logical mechanism, observable manifestation, and affected subsystem, and relating the categories to the safety analyses of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448. To make the taxonomy operational, we release an open-source fault injection toolkit with 94 symptom-level routines (41 camera, 27 LiDAR, and 26 radar), four graded severity levels, reproducible burst scheduling, and per-frame labels recording the fault category, affected subsystem, and severity. Examples on the Boreas dataset illustrate how each category alters camera images, LiDAR point clouds, and radar scans. Together, the taxonomy and the toolkit provide a shared reference and a controlled testbed for studying sensor reliability, developing and benchmarking fault detection and diagnosis methods, and building fault-annotated datasets for the safety validation of perception systems. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/davidepossenti/AV-SensorFault-Toolkit.

</details>


### [452] [Exact Collision Gradients for Ellipsoids in Differentiable Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31676)
*Shamak Dutta,Biswadip Dey*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究椭球碰撞的可微仿真梯度问题，指出现有线性估计碰撞时间的方法在斜碰撞、接触曲率和较大时间步下梯度误差显著，并提出基于Perram-Wertheim接触函数的连续碰撞检测与对接触条件求导的方法，从而在任意步长下获得精确梯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微仿真中的梯度在碰撞瞬间最不可靠；固定步长仿真只在物体重叠后检测碰撞，现有方法用碰撞时间的线性估计进行修正，但该估计会引入梯度误差，尤其对椭球斜碰撞和考虑自旋的情形。

Method: 分析椭球碰撞中线性碰撞时间估计的梯度误差来源；采用基于Perram-Wertheim接触函数的连续碰撞检测求碰撞时间，并对接触条件而非搜索过程进行微分，以获得精确梯度。

Result: 理论表明线性估计的梯度误差随碰撞倾斜度、接触曲率和时间步增大而增大，忽略自旋还会增加误差；在最优控制和系统辨识问题中，精确梯度能恢复最优控制和真实参数，而线性估计即使考虑自旋也无法做到。

Conclusion: 通过连续碰撞检测和对接触条件求导，可在任意步长下获得椭球碰撞的精确梯度，显著提升可微仿真在含碰撞学习与控制问题中的可靠性。

Abstract: Differentiable simulation enables gradient-based optimization in learning and control problems involving collisions, but its gradients are least reliable at the moment of impact, when the velocities jump. A fixed-step simulator detects a collision only after the bodies overlap, and some differentiable simulators correct for this with a linear estimate of the time of impact. In this paper, we study impacts between ellipsoids. We show that the gradient error of this estimate grows with the obliqueness of the collision, the curvature at contact, and the time step, and that ignoring spin adds a further error. Subsequently, we find the time of impact with continuous collision detection on the Perram Wertheim contact function and differentiate through the touching condition rather than the search. This gives exact gradients at any step size. We demonstrate our method on an optimal control problem and a system identification problem. In both, exact gradients recover the optimal control and the true parameters, while the linear estimate does not, even when it accounts for spin.

</details>


### [453] [CATWAY: Cost-sensitive agentic three-way robot decisions with calibrated language-model confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31694)
*Erik Derner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 CATWAY，一种成本敏感的三路决策门控，用于机器人语言模型智能体在执行、询问和拒绝指令之间做选择；它由错误成本确定阈值，并用校准概率融合投票与多维度评分，在家庭、新机器人域和 TRUST-NAV 上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人智能体必须判断指令应执行、询问还是拒绝，且不安全执行的成本远高于不必要询问。已有机器人门控没有同时做到由错误成本推导全部阈值、基于校准概率行动、以及在一个域拟合后在另一个域不改动评估。

Method: CATWAY 使用四类指令条件（清晰、模糊、不可行、不安全）上的损失矩阵，在概率单纯形上划定执行、询问、拒绝区域，其中询问是信息收集步骤。其概率通过逻辑回归融合十次采样投票与模糊性、不可行性、风险性的分级评分。模型在家庭指令上拟合后冻结，并在三个小模型的文本级决策、两个新机器人域和外部 TRUST-NAV 基准上测试，与直接提示、成本感知提示和无门控智能体比较。

Result: 在每次决策 11 次生成对 1 次生成下，CATWAY 在全部 18 个家庭比较中显著更便宜（每项平均损失 0.28 对 0.57-0.83），在新域 18 个中 9 个显著更便宜，在 TRUST-NAV 18 个中 10 个显著更便宜（Holm 校正），且从未显著更贵。它没有执行 142 条不安全测试指令中的任何一条。一致投票时，最小期望损失规则将校准简化为一个损失推导阈值，导致六种模型配置中有两种仅靠投票的门控从不执行清晰指令，在 TRUST-NAV 上每项成本 0.49，而 CATWAY 为 0.13 和 0.09；融合估计在所有集合上避免了该问题。

Conclusion: CATWAY 表明，成本敏感且校准融合的三路决策门控能有效降低决策损失、避免不安全执行，并具有跨域迁移能力；仅依赖投票的门控可能因阈值退化而拒绝清晰指令，融合概率估计更稳健。

Abstract: A language-model robot agent must decide whether to execute, question or refuse an instruction, and an unsafe execution costs far more than an unneeded question. No prior robot gate derives all its thresholds from error costs or acts on calibrated probabilities, and none was fitted in one domain and evaluated unchanged in another. We propose CATWAY, a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate: a loss matrix over four instruction conditions (clear, ambiguous, infeasible, unsafe) fixes execute, ask and refuse regions on the probability simplex, the question being the information-gathering step. Its probabilities fuse a ten-sample vote with graded scores of ambiguity, infeasibility and risk by logistic regression. Fitted on household instructions and frozen, CATWAY was tested on text-level decisions of three small models in-domain, in two new robot domains and on the external TRUST-NAV benchmark. At eleven generations per decision against one, it was significantly cheaper than a direct prompt, a cost-aware prompt and an unguarded agent in all 18 household comparisons (mean loss per item 0.28 against 0.57-0.83), in 9 of 18 in the new domains and in 10 of 18 on TRUST-NAV (Holm per set), and never significantly costlier. It executed none of the 142 unsafe test instructions. On a unanimous vote, the minimum-expected-loss rule reduces calibration to one loss-derived threshold, so for two of six model configurations a gate on the vote alone never executed a clear instruction, costing 0.49 per item on TRUST-NAV against CATWAY's 0.13 and 0.09; the fused estimate avoided this on every set.

</details>


### [454] [FoveaWAM: Role-Aware 4D World-Action Modeling for Dynamic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31705)
*Jiaqi Yin,Baoyue Zhang,Jiyuan Zhang,Wenxuan Liu,Zhaofei Yu,Yue Deng,Tiejun Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出FoveaWAM，一种按角色分配预测精度的原生4D世界-动作模型，用于低延迟动态物体操作，并引入OnTimeBench评估策略在自身延迟下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作运动物体时，策略必须预测动作执行时刻的场景，但预测耗时会让目标时刻不断后移；场景级预测计算昂贵，目标中心预测又会遗漏影响接触的周围物体。

Method: 核心思想是按角色解耦预测需求：目标位姿需毫米级精度，周围环境主要关注间隙与运动影响。FoveaWAM将目标过去和未来运动建模为度量SE(3)轨迹，将周围环境建模为稀疏3D流，静态部分依赖当前帧；同时提出OnTimeBench，让场景在策略计算期间持续运动以按各自延迟评估策略。

Result: FoveaWAM在单张RTX 5090上动作耗时15.1 ms，比视频世界-动作基线快约10倍；在OnTimeBench达到82.1%成功率，比最强基线高20.8个百分点，并在DOMINO和真实机器人任务上领先。

Conclusion: 按角色分配预测精度可在保持动态操作性能的同时显著降低推理延迟，FoveaWAM为低延迟动态操作提供了有效方案，OnTimeBench也提供了考虑策略延迟的评估方式。

Abstract: To manipulate a moving object, a policy must predict the scene at the moment its action executes, yet every millisecond spent predicting pushes that moment further away. Scene-level forecasts are computationally expensive, whereas target-centric forecasts can omit nearby objects that affect contact. Our key insight is that what a policy must predict decouples by role: only the target's pose, which determines contact, requires millimeter precision, while the surroundings matter primarily through the clearance they leave and the motion they impart. We present FoveaWAM, a native 4D world-action model that allocates precision according to these roles. Specifically, it models the target's past and future motion as a metric SE(3) trajectory, the surroundings as sparse 3D flow, and relies on the current frame for everything static. This compact representation lets FoveaWAM act in 15.1 ms on one RTX 5090, about 10 times faster than video world-action baselines, leaving substantially less time for the scene to evolve before action execution. To evaluate each policy under its own latency, we introduce OnTimeBench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark in which the scene keeps moving while the policy computes. FoveaWAM reaches 82.1% success on OnTimeBench, 20.8 points above the strongest baseline, and also leads on DOMINO and real-robot tasks. Project page: https://foveawam.github.io/

</details>


### [455] [DAA for an Autonomous Delivery Drone: Maneuver Selection Policies for Near-Collision Risk Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31729)
*Franco Callari,Ishay Kamon,Anthony Narkawitz,Pradeep Yarlagadda,Amir Navot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文面向自主无人机在共享空域中的探测与避让（DAA）问题，比较两种避让机动选择策略：纯几何策略与考虑入侵者位置不确定性的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型无人机DAA条件与有人机传统DAA假设差异显著：机载感知有限导致碰撞风险只能在近距（亚公里级）发现，决策时间短，最近点（CPA）及其到达时间预测不确定性大，且低空小型无人机机动包线受限。

Method: 提出并比较两种策略：一是纯几何方法，在CPA处朝远离入侵者方向转向；二是不确定性感知方法，考虑入侵者位置已知不确定性来源，朝远离包含CPA处入侵者位置分布的平面方向转向。使用风险比指标，在大量模拟的与有人机近碰撞遭遇数据集上评估性能。

Result: 两种策略均可行，可由机载航迹估计以闭式形式计算；第二种考虑不确定性的策略性能显著优于纯几何策略。

Conclusion: 在小型无人机受限感知、短决策时间和强机动约束下，考虑不确定性信息的避让机动选择能显著提升DAA性能。

Abstract: Detect-and-avoid (DAA) systems for autonomous drones operating in shared airspace must select avoidance maneuvers under conditions that differ markedly from those assumed by conventional DAA architectures designed for crewed aircraft. Limited on-board sensing capabilities restrict detection of collision risk to near distances (sub-km), the time available for decision-making is severely limited, uncertainty in the predicted closest point of approach (CPA) and the time to reach it is substantial, and the maneuver envelope of a small uncrewed aircraft at low altitude is tightly constrained.
  This paper presents and compares two maneuver-selection strategies that address these challenges: (1) a purely geometric approach, steering in the direction away from the intruder at CPA, and (2) a method that also takes into account the known sources of uncertainty in the intruder's location, and steers away from a plane expected to contain the intruder's location distribution at CPA.
  Performance is evaluated using the risk ratio metric on a large dataset of simulated near-collision encounters with crewed intruders. Results indicate that both strategies are feasible (i.e., computable in closed form from an onboard track estimate), and that the second strategy substantially outperforms the first.

</details>


### [456] [Sparks of Weight-Space Programming for Robot Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31715)
*Kyle Coelho,Eugen Solowjow*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需额外数据、示范或训练即可修正机器人基础模型失败的方法：通过权重空间编程，让语言模型智能体直接读写预训练视觉-语言-动作策略的参数，在动作专家中改写少量近静默神经元以触发纠正动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略的失败往往不是随机的，而是反复进入相同的可识别卡住状态；若该状态体现在模型内部激活中，则小范围参数编辑可能触发纠正行为，从而避免数据采集、示范和再训练。

Method: 将权重空间编程（WSP）应用于大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作策略；由语言模型智能体直接读取和写入网络参数；选择在动作专家中重新利用少量近静默神经元，使编辑在失败相关情境下开启，并产生直接指定的纠正动作（如降低夹爪朝向目标）。在仿真中对pi0.5策略进行实验，并用反向编辑和随机编辑作为对照。

Result: 在pi0.5仿真策略上，编辑约0.0002%的参数即可提升对反复出现失败的修复效果，包括对已针对任务微调过的策略；反向和随机编辑表明性能提升来自预期行为。

Conclusion: 该方法在失败情境可识别且简单纠正即可解决时效果最好；表明通过极小规模、定向的参数编辑可修正机器人基础模型的重复性失败，而无需额外数据或训练。

Abstract: This paper demonstrates an approach for correcting failures of robot foundation models (RFMs) without additional data collection, demonstrations, or training. We apply weight-space programming (WSP), in which a language-model agent directly reads and writes a neural network's parameters, to a large, pre-trained vision-language-action policy. The idea is simple: many policy failures are not random but repeatedly land in the same recognizable stuck state, so if that state is visible in the model's internal activations, a small edit could trigger a corrective movement while leaving the rest of the model's parameters unchanged. A core design choice is where to write the edit: repurposing a few near-silent neurons in the action expert lets the edit switch on in situations associated with the failure and produce a corrective movement, such as lowering the gripper toward the target, that is specified directly rather than learned through training. Empirically, when applied to the pi0.5 policy in simulation, we find that edits to roughly 0.0002% of the parameters can improve success on recurring failures, including for a policy that was already fine-tuned on its task. Reversed and random edits indicate that the gains come from the intended behavior, and the approach works best when the failure situation is recognizable and a simple correction can address it.

</details>


### [457] [Many Senses, One World: Learning Hierarchical Multimodal World Representations for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31782)
*Jin Yang,Youlin Wang,Ping Wei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 HiMoDex，一个基于分层多模态世界状态表示的两阶段框架，用于双臂灵巧操作策略学习，并在五项真实任务上取得 78.7% 的平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂灵巧操作需要同时利用视觉上下文以及触觉、力扭矩、音频等非视觉物理交互线索，如何有效融合这些多模态信息以学习控制策略是核心挑战。

Method: HiMoDex 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段在 119 万同步多模态时间步数据上预训练分层表示网络，将视觉、触觉、力扭矩和音频线索整合为统一世界状态嵌入；第二阶段冻结该网络，用其嵌入条件化共享世界-动作 Transformer，联合学习动作生成和动作条件未来状态预测。

Result: 在五项真实世界任务中，HiMoDex 平均成功率达到 78.7%，相比最强基线绝对提升 32.0%；消融实验验证了分层表示学习和两阶段训练的有效性，失败分析解释了不同变体的性能差异。

Conclusion: HiMoDex 表明分层多模态世界状态表示与两阶段训练能够有效整合多模态交互线索，提升双臂灵巧操作策略的成功率和协调控制能力。

Abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on multimodal inputs that capture visual context and non-visual physical interaction cues for precise and coordinated control. To address the challenge of effectively integrating these modalities for policy learning, we propose HiMoDex, a two-stage framework centered on hierarchical multimodal world-state representations. In Stage 1, we pretrain a hierarchical representation network on the collected dataset of 1.19 million synchronized multimodal time steps. The network integrates visual context with tactile, force-torque, and audio cues into unified world-state embeddings. In Stage 2, we freeze the pretrained network and use its embeddings to condition a shared world-action transformer. The transformer jointly learns action generation and action-conditioned future-state prediction. Experiments across five real-world tasks show that HiMoDex achieves an average success rate of 78.7\%, representing an absolute improvement of 32.0\% over the strongest evaluated baseline. Extensive ablations validate the benefits of hierarchical representation learning and two-stage training. Failure analysis helps explain performance differences across variants. Code, data, and demos will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/.

</details>


### [458] [Beyond the Benchmark: Localizing Released Autonomous Driving Models to Real Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31814)
*Morui Zhu,Deyuan Qu,Qi Chen,Qing Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究已发布自动驾驶模型在新实车部署时的性能落差，提出 R2R 部署本地化方法，在保留原模型的前提下定位并修正其与源系统耦合的组件，从而提升闭环规划与真实传感器适配效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已发布自动驾驶模型虽在基准测试上表现优异，但部署到新实车仍很困难；即使经过常规适配，模型仍可能耦合于源感知、数据和执行过程中的假设。

Method: 提出 Released-to-Real（R2R）部署本地化方法，识别源系统耦合并仅修正受影响组件；针对数据与行为适配，发现轨迹级优化与滚动时域执行的不匹配通过 ego state 进入，提出 Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning（HA-RL），利用目标驾驶记录校正而无需生成式闭环 RL 的高成本 rollout；针对物理传感器适配，在冻结感知权重下定位并修正源相关的空间与时间表示，无需目标标注或重训练。

Result: HA-RL 将已发布扩散规划器的闭环成功率从 82.2% 提升到 95.2%；跨多个已发布检测器和三种真实传感器配置的传感器适配，使多相机检测器在五相机目标配置上的车辆 mAP 从 0.041 提升到 0.420。

Conclusion: 结果表明，R2R 为新实车部署前准备和适配已发布模型提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Released autonomous-driving models achieve strong benchmark performance, yet deploying them on a new real vehicle remains challenging.
