We study this deployment gap and find that released models can remain coupled to assumptions from their source sensing, data, and execution processes even after conventional adaptation. We introduce Released-to-Real (R2R), a deployment-localization methodology that identifies such source-system coupling and corrects only the affected components while preserving the released model. For data and behavior adaptation, we find that the mismatch between trajectory-level optimization and receding-horizon execution enters through the ego state rather than the observation, and introduce Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning (HA-RL), which corrects it on recorded target driving without the costly rollouts of generative closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). For physical sensor adaptation, R2R localizes and corrects source-dependent spatial and temporal representations with frozen perception weights, requiring neither target annotations nor retraining. HA-RL improves the closed-loop success rate of a released diffusion-based planner from 82.2% to 95.2%, while sensor adaptation across multiple released detectors and three real sensor rigs improves the vehicle mean average precision (mAP) of a released multi-camera detector from 0.041 to 0.420 on a five-camera target rig. These results provide a practical path for preparing released models before deployment on new real vehicles. Our project page is publicly available at https://released-to-real.github.io.

</details>


### [459] [VG-GP: Uncertainty-Gated Visuo-Geometric Memory for Negative-Transfer-Resistant Grasp Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31826)
*Yonglong Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 VG-GP，一种即插即用的视触几何高斯过程记忆框架，用于闭环 SE(2) 残差抓取迁移，提升预训练对映抓取网络在未见不规则物体上的零样本抓取成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练对映抓取网络对规则形状泛化较好，但在质量分布不规则、薄边或陌生手柄等新物体上零样本失败率高；现有经验记忆方法存在视觉外观偏置、覆盖有效基础抓取导致负迁移，以及闭环采集退化等问题。

Method: VG-GP 融合颜色不变的表面法线 DINOv2 特征、规范 SE(2) 夹爪对齐 3D 局部高度图和接触几何描述子，并使用在源物体上学习的 ARD 长度尺度乘积核；对基础抓取与候选 SE(2) 替代方案建立联合后验，仅当联合协方差 LCB 超过风险敏感阈值时覆盖基础策略；引入基于单记录必要性与充分性干预的在线反事实筛选门，隔离导致负迁移的源经验；通过等预算 SE(2) 探针上的贝叶斯期望改进实现闭环采集。

Result: 在 ManiSkill3 的 42 个互不重叠 YCB 物体上，VG-GP 包装预训练 GR-ConvNet 基础策略，将 22 个未见物体的物理抬升率从 38.6%（34/88）提升到 53.4%（47/88），零回退（+13 次挽救，0 次损失；物体聚类 95% CI [+6.8%, +22.7%]，精确 McNemar p=0.00024）。在 10 个留出物体上，EI 主动采集达到 45.0%（18/40，基础为 32.5%，达到 oracle 余量的 5/7），相对被动回退实现 55.0% 探针分歧，并单调降低认知不确定性。

Conclusion: VG-GP 能作为即插即用模块有效增强预训练抓取策略对未见不规则物体的零样本迁移能力，同时通过风险敏感覆盖、反事实筛选和主动采集避免负迁移并提升闭环抓取效率。

Abstract: Pretrained antipodal grasping networks generalize well to canonical shapes but frequently fail zero-shot on novel objects with irregular mass distributions, thin rims, or unfamiliar handles. While episodic experience memory adapts a frozen base policy without retraining, naive retrieval suffers from visual appearance bias, negative transfer from overriding working base grasps, and degenerate closed-loop acquisition. We present VG-GP, a plug-and-play Visuo-Geometric Gaussian Process memory framework for closed-loop $SE(2)$ residual grasp transfer. First, we fuse color-invariant surface-normal DINOv2 features, canonical $SE(2)$ gripper-aligned 3D local heightmaps, and contact-geometry descriptors under a product kernel with Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) lengthscales learned strictly on source objects. Second, we model the joint posterior over the base grasp and candidate $SE(2)$ alternatives, overriding the base policy only when the joint-covariance Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) clears a risk-sensitive threshold. Third, an online counterfactual curation gate using single-record necessity and sufficiency interventions quarantines source experiences causing negative transfer. Fourth, we close the acquisition loop via Bayesian Expected Improvement (EI) over equal-budget $SE(2)$ probes. Across 42 disjoint YCB objects in ManiSkill3 (20 source, 12 development, 10 held-out test), VG-GP wraps a pretrained GR-ConvNet base policy and raises physical lift rate across all 22 unseen objects from 38.6% (34/88) to 53.4% (47/88) with zero regressions (+13 rescues, 0 losses; object-clustered 95% CI [+6.8%, +22.7%], exact McNemar $p = 0.00024$). On the 10 held-out objects, EI active acquisition reaches 45.0% (18/40 vs. 32.5% base, 5/7 of oracle headroom), achieves 55.0% probe divergence over passive fallback, and monotonically reduces epistemic uncertainty.

</details>


### [460] [POISE: Curvature-Aware Critic Regularization for Smooth Actor-Critic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31835)
*Jeong Woon Lee,Namho Kim,Hyoseok Hwang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文针对actor-critic在机器人控制中动作高频振荡的问题，提出仅正则化critic的POISE方法，通过曲率加权能量惩罚减少动作抖动。在TD3的六个连续控制任务上，POISE显著提升平滑度，多数任务回报无显著变化，但Ant上升、Hopper下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练后的actor常出现高频动作振荡。现有平滑方法多约束actor，PAVE虽正则化critic但分别惩罚动作梯度变化和曲率，未衡量相同梯度变化在不同平坦程度下导致的贪婪动作位移，也未反映该位移对应的价值损失。

Method: 作者用greedy shift刻画状态转移下贪婪动作的一阶位移，并证明该位移的曲率加权能量可二阶近似保留上一贪婪动作所损失的价值。基于此提出POISE：沿时间与空间状态位移正则化曲率加权能量，采用saddle-free曲率度量和与奖励尺度一致的缩放，同时不改变actor。

Result: 在TD3的六个连续控制任务上，POISE使所有任务平滑度分数平均降低5.9倍（几何平均4.5倍），最强基线为2.2倍（1.9倍），并在五个任务上取得最低分数。配对回报区间在四个任务上包含零，Ant提升14%，Hopper下降11%。

Conclusion: POISE通过仅正则化critic的曲率加权能量，能有效减少actor动作振荡，并在多数任务上基本保持回报；但不同任务存在回报权衡，如Ant改善而Hopper退化。

Abstract: Actor-critic methods achieve high returns in robotic control, yet trained actors exhibit high-frequency action oscillations. Most smoothness methods constrain the actor, whereas PAVE regularizes the critic by separately penalizing action-gradient variation and encouraging negative action curvature. The same gradient change, however, moves the critic's preferred action farther where the critic is flat, and separate penalties do not measure this motion. We characterize this motion through the greedy shift, which approximates greedy-action displacement across state transitions to first order under local concavity. Since displacement alone does not reflect its critic-value consequences, the analysis further shows that the shift's curvature-weighted energy approximates the value lost by retaining the previous greedy action to second order. Based on this relationship, POISE regularizes the curvature-weighted energy along temporal and spatial state displacements. It employs a saddle-free curvature metric and reward-scale-consistent scaling while leaving the actor unchanged. On six continuous control tasks with TD3, POISE reduces the smoothness score on every task by $5.9\times$ on average ($4.5\times$ geometric mean), compared with $2.2\times$ ($1.9\times$) for the strongest baseline, and achieves the lowest score on five tasks. Paired return intervals include zero on four tasks, with a 14% increase on Ant and an 11% decrease on Hopper.

</details>


### [461] [Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31843)
*Yonglong Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Co-DRIS + SuperMimic 感知-动作协同设计框架，用于提升机器人在感知噪声、观测丢失、关节执行误差和接触参数变化同时发生时的反应式操作鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单帧框架如 DRIS 在单一不确定性下表现较好，但在感知与执行不确定性耦合时性能严重下降，原因包括无记忆编码和固定高刚度 PD 控制。

Method: 方法包括：惯性世界坐标系下物理信息世界模型，结合精确弹道运动学与零初始化接触残差，并通过零成本反事实 dropout 一致性加速训练；动作条件双流因果 GRU 信念编码器，缓解去噪与滞后矛盾；相位感知变阻抗软接控制，在力矩层将 7-DoF Franka Research 3 机械臂切换至过阻尼状态。

Result: 在 3 种子尾部评估和未见投掷测试中，标准基准达到 89.6±0.4%，4σ 噪声下为 70.5%；10 类耦合/丢失压力场景平均 66.6±0.5%，较 DRIS 提升 39.0%，50% 丢失下提升 30.4%。还验证了阻抗解耦、+0.65 s 飞行时间偏移下的因果接触触发，以及跨任务迁移：钢盘乒乓反弹 87.5% 至 100.0%，FR3+Hand 抓取在 4 倍噪声下提升 8.4%，峰值冲击力降低 6% 至 13%。

Conclusion: 感知-动作协同设计能显著提升机器人在耦合不确定性和观测丢失下的鲁棒性，并具备跨任务迁移能力；变阻抗与因果信念编码是应对感知-执行耦合退化的关键。

Abstract: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).

</details>


### [462] [Ada-BFM: Adapting Behavior Foundation Models for Humanoid Scene Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31863)
*Furui Xu,Weishuai Zeng,Zirui Wang,Kangning Yin,Jiacheng Bao,Huayi Wang,Yingying Qin,Yufei Xue,Yang Tang,Zenghao Tang,Kailin Li,Jingbo Wang,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Ada-BFM 是一个面向人形机器人场景交互的后训练框架，通过在预训练行为基础模型上加入轻量适配器，使模型适应地形和物体交互等任务，并在每个交互域内共享一个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为基础模型（BFMs）通过大规模行为数据预训练，在全身协调控制上表现良好，但难以直接扩展到场景交互，因为场景交互需要根据几何约束和接触动力学调整运动。

Method: 提出 Ada-BFM 后训练框架，在原始 BFM 架构中加入轻量适配器，实现交互相关调整，同时保留预训练控制能力；不针对每个任务单独训练控制器，而是为每个交互域产出一个共享模型，支持多样化的地形或物体交互任务。

Result: 仿真和真实世界实验表明，Ada-BFM 能实现多样化的场景交互行为，相比从零训练加速学习，并在很大程度上保留预训练行为能力和通用全身控制优势。

Conclusion: Ada-BFM 是一种有效且高效的方法，可将 BFM 的能力扩展到预训练设置之外的场景交互，同时保留其在通用全身控制方面的优势。

Abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose humanoid control through pretraining on large-scale behavioral data. However, their proficiency in whole-body coordination does not readily extend to scene interaction, which requires adapting motion to scene-dependent geometric constraints and contact dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ada-BFM, a post-training framework that adapts pretrained BFMs for humanoid scene interaction. Ada-BFM augments the original architecture with a lightweight adapter, enabling interaction-specific adjustments while leveraging pretrained control capabilities. Rather than producing a separate controller for each task, the framework yields a shared model for each interaction domain, supporting diverse tasks involving terrain or object interaction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that Ada-BFM enables diverse scene interaction behaviors, accelerates learning compared with training from scratch, and largely preserves pretrained behavioral competence. These findings establish Ada-BFM as an effective and efficient approach to extending the capabilities of BFMs beyond their pretraining settings while retaining their strengths in general whole-body control.

</details>


### [463] [BendGS: Observation-Conditioned Gaussian Self-Modeling for Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31844)
*Jeong Woon Lee,Doungjun Kim,Namho Kim,Seungheon Chae,Jongwoo Kim,Hyoseok Hwang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BendGS 利用从观测中估计的虚拟骨干驱动由电机指令条件化的 3D 高斯变形，从而在无需测量关节角的情况下预测连续体机器人的下一状态 3D 形状、外观和末端位姿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体机器人连续弯曲且缺少关节角和固定连杆几何，现有自模型难以同时预测下一 3D 形状、外观和末端位姿；而铰接高斯自模型通常依赖关节角驱动变形。

Method: 用前馈网络从多视图图像重建机器人 3D 高斯；将坐标帧链拟合到反投影深度点得到虚拟骨干以估计弯曲状态；在状态转移中，用网络根据相对电机指令预测骨干变化并变形绑定高斯；变形后的高斯渲染下一图像和 3D 形状，远端坐标帧给出末端位姿；训练仅用 RGB-D 图像和掩码，无需弯曲或末端标签。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人上，BendGS 相比对比方法取得最低 Chamfer 距离、最佳图像质量和最低末端位姿误差。

Conclusion: BendGS 为连续体机器人提供了一种无需测量关节角、可统一预测下一 3D 形状、外观和末端位姿的可渲染高斯自模型，并在仿真与真实场景中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Visual self-models learn from images how a robot moves under motor commands. Continuum robots need them even more, as they bend continuously without measured joint angles or fixed link geometry. Existing continuum self-models predict point clouds, image-space curves, or future images, but not the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose together from an observed body. 3D Gaussians offer a renderable representation of shape and appearance, yet articulated Gaussian self-models rely on joint angles to drive deformation. In this work, we propose BendGS, which uses a virtual backbone estimated from observation to drive command-conditioned Gaussian deformation, enabling next-state prediction for continuum robots without measured joint angles. In Gaussian modeling, a feed-forward network reconstructs the robot as 3D Gaussians from multi-view images, and the backbone, a chain of coordinate frames, is fitted to back-projected depth points to estimate the bending state. In transition, a network predicts its change under a relative motor command to deform the bound Gaussians. The deformed Gaussians render the next images and the 3D shape, and the distal frame gives the tip pose. Training losses use RGB-D images and masks, without bending or tip labels. On simulated and real robots, BendGS achieves the lowest Chamfer distance, best image quality, and lowest tip errors among the compared methods.

</details>


### [464] [CALVIN-MAX: When Does a Mid-Execution Change Hurt a Robot Policy?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31868)
*Sajjad Pakdamansavoji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 CALVIN-MAX 基准，用 7,828 个案例系统衡量机器人任务执行过程中环境变化带来的代价，并区分变化发生时机的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人常在环境变化后仍需继续工作，但已有研究未区分变化发生时机与变化世界本身造成的代价，也未衡量变化对后续任务的持续影响。

Method: 构建基于 CALVIN 五指令链的 CALVIN-MAX 基准，每个案例比较三次运行：无变化、从受影响指令开始即有变化、机器人在运动中遇到变化；并在每策略 1,526 个留出案例上评估十种已发布策略。

Result: 十种策略在八类核心变化下于受影响指令上损失 4.4 至 9.9 个百分点。视觉相关变化在运动中发生比从一开始发生少损失 5.4 个百分点，而场景或机器人变化未检测到显著时机效应。回退机器人到指令开始会消除该收益；预先设定的更严格测试仅三种策略通过。变化还影响后续指令：仍完成当前指令的策略完成下一指令的概率低 5.0 至 16.8 个百分点。

Conclusion: 环境变化对机器人策略的代价不仅取决于变化本身，也取决于发生时机和后续持续性；CALVIN-MAX 为分离这些效应提供了标准化评估。

Abstract: Robots must often keep working after the world changes, as when a block moves or the camera shifts while the robot still acts on what it saw before. Recent work showed that one change during a task lowers success for every policy tested, but did not separate the effect of its timing from the cost of the changed world, or measure what it costs afterwards. We introduce CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases on CALVIN's five-instruction chains, each with one change to the objects, the camera, the robot, or the instruction. Each case compares three runs that are identical until the affected instruction begins: one without the change, one with it in place from that moment, and one in which it arrives while the robot is moving. The second run against the first gives the cost of the changed world, and the third against the second the effect of meeting it mid-motion. On 1,526 held-out cases per policy, with hypotheses fixed in advance, each of ten released policies loses 4.4 to 9.9 percentage points on the affected instruction over the eight core changes. Whether timing matters depends on the change: one that alters what the robot sees costs 5.4 points less mid-motion than from the start, whereas a change to the scene itself or to the robot shows no detectable effect. Rewinding the robot to the start of the instruction removes the benefit for every policy; the stricter test we fixed in advance, that the rewound run then matches the second run, passes for three. The cost also outlasts the affected instruction: the change stays in place, and a policy that still completes that instruction is 5.0 to 16.8 points less likely to complete the next one.

</details>


### [465] [PreWAM: Exploring the Design of Latent Future Prediction for World-Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31901)
*Wan Chi,Sen Li,Zihang Cui,Chuqin Huang,Yunlong Wang,Nanshan Deng,Yanjun Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 PreWAM 世界-动作模型，基于预训练 DINO 特征构建结构化语义预测空间，通过残差世界预测和时间尺度预测组织未来监督，并在多个机器人操作基准和真实实验中验证了性能与泛化鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型利用未来视觉变化作为策略学习的监督信号，但预测空间的选择会显著影响泛化能力和运动信息可恢复性；已有方法需要更合适的结构化语义预测空间来提升视觉扰动下的鲁棒性和分布偏移下的泛化。

Method: 先对预测空间进行受控研究，发现空间结构化的语义特征更有利于泛化和运动信息恢复；据此提出 PreWAM，在预训练 DINO 特征定义的预测空间中围绕状态变化组织未来监督。具体包括残差世界预测，联合学习源相对变化及未来状态以强调动态信息并保留语义；时间尺度预测，根据时间距离条件化世界查询以捕捉短期局部运动和长期状态演化；这些预测目标与动作监督共同训练共享视觉-语言骨干，并用于预训练和下游策略学习。

Result: 在 LIBERO 系列、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin 2.0 以及真实机器人操作实验中，PreWAM 展现出较强的操作性能，并在多种分布偏移下提升了泛化性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 采用结构化语义预测空间并结合状态变化监督与多时间尺度预测，可有效增强世界-动作模型的学习效果、泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Abstract: World-action models combine action generation with future prediction, allowing visual transitions to serve as supervision for policy learning. Our controlled study of prediction spaces shows that spatially structured semantic features support better overall generalization under visual perturbations and make motion information more readily recoverable from learned predictive representations. Building on these observations, we introduce PreWAM, a world-action model that organizes future supervision around state changes in a prediction space defined by pretrained DINO features. Specifically, Residual World Prediction jointly learns source-relative changes and their resulting future states to emphasize dynamic information while preserving future-state semantics. Temporal-Scale Prediction conditions world queries on temporal distance to capture both short-term local motion and longer-horizon state evolution. These predictive objectives jointly shape a shared vision-language backbone with action supervision during pretraining and downstream policy learning. Experiments across the LIBERO benchmark family, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic manipulation demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved generalization and robustness under diverse distribution shifts.

</details>


### [466] [RESET: One Demonstration, One Verified World, Self-Improved Skills Across Embodiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31894)
*Zheng Sun,Zhuo Li,Zhihao Li,Hengyi Sim,Ge Wang,Ziyue Zhu,Mingkai Jia,Fei Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RESET框架：从单次真实演示重建接触丰富世界并生成冻结只读成功判据，经检验、白盒任务图自改进、冻结代码部署和跨机器人迁移，使LLM编码智能体无需真实成功评分器或可重置环境即可学习机器人操作技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人任务缺少ground-truth成功评分器和可重置练习环境，而仿真中LLM编码智能体可迭代自改进。作者观察到单次真实演示可同时提供场景几何、终态成功标准和物理参考轨迹，且与源机器人运动学解耦。

Method: RESET包含五步：Rebuild从一次演示重建接触丰富世界并派生冻结只读判据；Examine用开环回放和轮廓一致性检验世界；Self-improve依据逐节点失败证据演化模块化白盒任务图和技能代码；Execute将冻结代码部署到真实机器人且运行时零LLM调用；Transfer将验证过的世界与判据共享给未见机器人而无需新演示。还通过注入重建缺陷分析容错性。

Result: 在8个由单次真实演示重建的操作任务上，RESET在仿真未见布局中平均成功率97%，零样本代码27%，逐任务微调pi0.5策略31%，Diffusion Policy 50%。无目标演示时，3种异构机器人获得相同任务技能：相似臂机器人95%技能函数原样复用，不同臂和手机器人自行编写。真实机器人4台共280次试验成功率80%。缺陷注入表明练习容忍许多重建错误，几何错误仍可能造成停滞或误导，检查能标记多数错误，物理随机化覆盖其余。

Conclusion: 单次真实演示足以构建可验证、可共享且可冻结部署的机器人操作技能学习闭环。RESET在仿真和真实异构机器人上有效，降低了对成功评分器、可重置环境和运行时LLM调用的依赖。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents can iteratively self-improve robot manipulation skills in simulation benchmarks, yet real-world tasks provide neither ground-truth success scorers nor resettable practice environments. Our key observation is that a single real demonstration simultaneously specifies scene geometry, defines the terminal success criterion, and serves as a physical reference trajectory for verifying world fidelity---all decoupled from the source robot's kinematics. We present {RESET}: we reconstruct a contact-rich world and derive a frozen read-only criterion from one demonstration ({R}ebuild); check that world against the demonstration by open-loop replay and silhouette consistency ({E}xamine); evolve modular white-box task graphs and skill code from per-node failure evidence ({S}elf-improve); deploy frozen code on real robots with zero runtime LLM calls ({E}xecute); and share the verified world and criterion with unseen robots without new demonstrations ({T}ransfer). On 8 manipulation tasks, each rebuilt from one real demonstration, RESET achieves 97% average success on unseen layouts in simulation, whereas zero-shot code reaches 27%, per-task fine-tuned pi0.5 policies 31%, and Diffusion Policy 50%; injecting reconstruction defects shows that practice tolerates many reconstruction errors, that geometric errors can still stall or mislead it, and that the check flags most of them while physical randomization covers the rest. Without any target demonstrations, 3 heterogeneous robots acquire the same task skills in the shared world: a robot with similar arms copies 95% of its skill functions unchanged from the source robot, while robots with different arms and hands write their own. In real-robot experiments, the resulting programs run on 4 robots and succeed in 80% of 280 trials.

</details>


### [467] [RoboHarness-RL: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for VLM-Based Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32016)
*Liyang Li,Mingyu Liu,Xiaoman Li,Zhiyue Zhao,Jin-Chuan Shi,Canyu Zhao,Haokai Zhang,Jinyuan Tian,Linhao Zhong,Hao Chen,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Agentic harnesses enable frontier vision-language models (VLMs) to manipulate robots through perception, planning, and control tools, yet achieving comparable performance with compact open-weight VLMs remains challenging. We present RoboHarness-RL, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for improving VLM-based robot manipulation through tool calls. Starting from supervised fine-tuning on successful teacher demonstrations, the VLM further improves through multi-turn reinforcement learning with task-outcome rewards, without relying on vision-language-action models or world action models. To support efficient multi-turn training, we develop LiteHarness, which uses hierarchical memory to keep interaction contexts compact while preserving task performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, RL raises success from 31.2% to 44.0% on RoboTwin 2.0 and from 57.8% to 73.3% on LIBERO-Pro; these gains extend to randomized RoboTwin scenes unseen during training (26.4% to 38.0%). Behavioral analysis further shows that RL reduces repetitive-call rates by up to $4\times$, shortens successful executions, and improves recovery from negative feedback. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/RoboHarness-RL/

</details>


### [468] [Learning When a Robot Should Ask For Help: Adaptive Intervention Requests in Human-Robot Teaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31925)
*Yanran Jiang,Cécile Paris,Dana Kulić,Leimin Tian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Robots operating in complex environments occasionally encounter situations where autonomous navigation fails. Requesting and receiving a timely intervention from their human supervisor can be critical for failure prevention or recovery. However, requesting help too frequently or at inappropriate times can increase operator workload and reduce team efficiency, while delayed requests may lead to prolonged downtime or unrecoverable failures. In addition to alert timing, the human, robot and task context also influences the intervention outcomes. This paper proposes an algorithm for learning to generate adaptive human intervention requests during human-robot teaming. A help-seeking policy is trained via offline reinforcement learning based on past intervention helpfulness and autonomous progress. This learned alert policy enables a robot to selectively request human help when the intervention outcome is likely to be beneficial. We evaluate the proposed policy in different task environments and user expertise levels in simulation, followed by evaluation in a physical user study. Our findings demonstrate that the learned policy improves exploration efficiency, reduces unnecessary alerts, and enhances novice user support without compromising expert performance in real-time human-robot teaming missions.

</details>


### [469] [MARGIN: A Risk-Aware Agent for Robot Program Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32093)
*Hongbo Duan,Fan Du,Haipeng Luo,Bin Qian,Zichao Nie,Yilin Mi,Yaopeng Tian,Jiake Tian,Siyuan Liu,Yan Gao,Fangming Liu,Xueqian Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出风险感知机器人编程代理MARGIN，将成功机器人rollout转化为程序改进证据，以near-miss margin衡量最慢成功开发rollout的剩余执行预算比例，并用于优先脆弱程序、指导修复和选择更稳健修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人编程代理通过反复测试与修复提升控制策略，但二元成功率会饱和，且程序在未见场景中仍存在执行风险，因此需要风险感知且预算高效的程序细化方法。

Method: MARGIN使用near-miss margin信号优先处理脆弱程序、指导定向修复，并选择既保持开发成功率又增加执行余量的修订；采用精确safe-racing规则加速基于成功的候选评估，并使用配对执行探针识别隐藏回归。

Result: 在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-90和Robosuite上评估。80任务LIBERO-Pro复现中78个程序开发成功率完美但仍存在未见种子失败；margin预测held-out失败的AUC为0.774，低margin程序失败风险高2.97倍；两轮37个LIBERO-Pro任务中执行控制步数分别减少10.7%和15.0%，LIBERO-90和Robosuite减少18.0-20.0%；safe racing在保持相同选择下减少53.5%固定序列候选评估episode；配对执行探针通过识别隐藏回归改善接受决策。

Conclusion: near-miss证据可作为风险感知、预算高效的机器人程序细化基础，在保持开发成功的同时提升未见场景执行安全性与效率。

Abstract: Robot-programming agents improve executable control policies through repeated testing and repair, yet binary success saturates while execution risk persists across unseen scenes. We introduce MARGIN, a risk-aware agent that converts successful robot rollouts into actionable evidence for program refinement. Its near-miss margin measures the fraction of the execution budget remaining in the slowest successful development rollout. The agent uses this signal to prioritize fragile programs, guide targeted repairs, and select revisions that preserve development success while increasing execution headroom. An exact safe-racing rule accelerates success-based candidate evaluation. We evaluate MARGIN across LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-90, and Robosuite. In our 80-task LIBERO-Pro reproduction, 78 programs attain perfect development success while accounting for substantial failures on unseen seeds. The near-miss margin predicts held-out failures with an AUC of 0.774, and low-margin programs exhibit 2.97 times higher failure risk. Across two independent evaluation rounds spanning 37 unique LIBERO-Pro tasks, MARGIN reduces executed control steps by 10.7% and 15.0%, with reductions of 18.0-20.0% on LIBERO-90 and Robosuite. Safe racing reduces fixed-sequence candidate-evaluation episodes by 53.5% while retaining identical selections, and paired execution probes improve acceptance decisions by identifying hidden regressions. Together, these results establish near-miss evidence as an effective basis for risk-aware, budget-efficient robot program refinement.

</details>


### [470] [KeyMemVLA: Subtask-Guided Key Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32081)
*Yongwei Zhang,Tao Chen,Sicheng Ma,Yuanzhe Xing,Pengwei Zhang,Yongen Zhao,Yaoqing Hu,Zhikun She,Ce Hao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 KeyMemVLA，一种由子任务引导的关键记忆框架，用于在有限记忆预算下解决长时程、依赖记忆的机器人操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作策略难以在长时程任务中推断任务进度，并回忆当前观测中缺失的历史证据；因此需要在有限记忆预算下保留对阶段消歧和后续决策最关键的历史信息。

Method: 该方法采用两级标注选择满足“进度指示”或“决策证据保留”标准的子任务，并将其末帧标为关键帧以监督在线记忆写入；共享视觉-语言主干联合学习子任务、动作和关键帧预测。推理时先根据指令、视觉上下文和记忆预测当前子任务，再以该语义条件预测动作和未来记忆写入位置，并在执行中于选定时刻保留真实观测。作者还提出 KMBench 评估跨子任务的主动记忆保留。

Result: 在 RMBench-$M(n)$、RoboTwin-MeM、KMBench 和真实世界操作任务上的评估显示，该方法平均成功率高于对比基线；消融实验和表征分析支持关键记忆与显式任务进度语义的作用。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将稀疏关键记忆与在线进度推断相结合，对依赖历史信息的控制具有重要价值。

Abstract: Memory-dependent long-horizon manipulation requires vision-language-action (VLA) policies to infer task progress and recall evidence absent from current observations. Under a limited memory budget, the challenge is to retain history that resolves stage ambiguity and supports subsequent decisions. We present KeyMemVLA, a subtask-guided key memory framework based on progress indication and decision-evidence retention. A two-level annotation process selects subtasks satisfying either criterion and labels their final frames as keyframes to supervise online memory writes. A shared vision-language backbone jointly learns subtask, action, and keyframe prediction. At inference, the policy first predicts the current subtask from the instruction, visual context, and memory, then uses this semantic condition to predict actions and future memory-write positions. Actual observations are retained at the selected times during execution. We introduce KMBench to evaluate active memory retention for decisions across subtasks. Evaluations on RMBench-$M(n)$, RoboTwin-MeM, KMBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show higher average success rates than the compared baselines. Ablation studies and representation analysis support the roles of key memory and explicit task-progress semantics. These results highlight the value of coupling sparse key memory with online progress inference for history-dependent control.

</details>


### [471] [ActiveBridge: Scaling Active Prior for Robots through Egocentric Perception-Interaction Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32098)
*Zixiao Gu,Qiren Qin,Yu He,Zhengyang Liu,Da Huang,Hongquan Zhang,Simo Wu,Peng Zhou,Guangnan Ye,Yunbo Wang,Yanwei Fu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ActiveBridge 训练框架，从人类第一视角视频中学习主动感知先验，并通过世界-动作建模迁移到机器人，使机器人用单个头部相机主动调整视角完成操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基础模型在非结构化场景中性能受限，因为它们只基于给定观测行动，忽略了人类第一视角视频中“主动寻找信息”的先验。

Method: 设计可通过头部动作主动控制视角的机器人，仅用单个头部相机、不使用腕部相机；在人类训练阶段，使用指令条件模型联合预测未来第一视角视频和同步的头-腕动作轨迹，以头部动作作为主动感知的显式监督。

Result: 在主动操作任务上，ActiveBridge 优于基线方法；消融实验表明联合头-腕动作监督带来收益。

Conclusion: 从第一视角视频中学习并迁移人类主动感知先验，可提升机器人在非结构化场景中的主动操作性能，联合头-腕动作监督是关键。

Abstract: Robotics foundation models are now widely used for manipulation, and egocentric videos offer rich data for scaling. However, existing methods overlook the human active priors captured in egocentric videos, which limits performance in unstructured scenes. They act on given observations instead of actively seeking information as humans do. We propose ActiveBridge, a training framework that learns these human active priors and transfers them to robots through world-action modeling. We design a robot that actively controls its viewpoint through head actions to acquire the visual information needed for manipulation using a single head camera, without wrist cameras. During human training, an instruction-conditioned model jointly predicts future egocentric videos and synchronized head-wrist action trajectories, with head actions providing explicit supervision for active perception. Experiments show that ActiveBridge outperforms baselines on active manipulation tasks, while ablations demonstrate the benefit of joint head-wrist action supervision.

</details>


### [472] [Ego2Real: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Visuo-Tactile Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32101)
*Ange Bao,Haishan Zhang,Lingzi Xie,Shuang Li,Pei Zhao,Ling Shi,Bidan Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Ego2Real框架，利用第一人称人类演示和触觉手套，将双手灵巧操作技能迁移到拟人机器人手。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅依赖视觉难以获取物理接触和施力意图信息，导致手-物交互解释存在歧义，因此需要触觉传感来实现可靠的人类到机器人灵巧技能迁移。

Method: Ego2Real在两个阶段引入触觉监督：一是触觉引导的手-物交互重建，用触觉信号优化手部姿态和接触几何；二是接触信息驱动的强化学习，将人类接触模式转化为机器人接触奖励，并结合细化运动参考训练机器人手。

Result: 实验表明，在重建和策略学习中同时加入触觉监督可提高操作成功率，说明触觉观测能提升第一人称演示的质量与可迁移性。

Conclusion: 丰富第一人称演示中的触觉信息，并对重建与策略学习进行触觉监督，有助于机器人学习并复现人类灵巧接触行为，同时适应自身形态与驱动特性。

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation from egocentric human demonstrations offers a scalable path toward robot skill acquisition. Vision alone, however, provides limited information about physical contacts and the demonstrator's force intent, leading to ambiguities in interpreting hand-object interactions. Capturing human touch via tactile sensing is therefore crucial for reliable human-to-robot dexterous skill transfer. We present Ego2Real, a framework that leverages egocentric demonstrations and tactile gloves to transfer bimanual dexterous manipulation skills to robotic hands. Ego2Real incorporates tactile supervision at two complementary stages: (1) tactile-guided hand-object interaction reconstruction, which uses measured tactile signals to refine hand poses and contact geometry; and (2) contact-informed reinforcement learning, which translates human contact patterns into robotic contact rewards. By combining refined motion references with physical contact rewards during training, Ego2Real guides anthropomorphic robotic hands to emulate demonstrated contact behaviors while adapting to their own morphology and actuation. Experiments show that incorporating tactile supervision into both reconstruction and policy learning yields higher manipulation success rates, underscoring the importance of enriching egocentric demonstrations with tactile observations to improve their quality and transferability.

</details>


### [473] [Wind-Aware Trajectory Planning for Deformable Aerial Formations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32184)
*Haozhe Wang,Xun Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Family-Air，一种风感知的轨迹族规划器，用于密集城市环境中无人机编队的协同空中运输，通过虚拟管与联合优化实现编队中心运动、形变和时序规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集城市环境中的协同空中运输要求无人机编队穿越受限空间，并适应建筑周围空间变化的风场；编队形变虽能通过狭窄区域，但会改变单机速度和所遇局部风，从而产生编队运动与气动效应的耦合。

Method: 构建虚拟管作为共享无碰撞飞行空间；用共享仿射变换表示连续轨迹族，将空间变化风和形变诱导速度纳入统一的空速相对运动目标；联合优化编队中心运动、形变和时序，并施加虚拟管约束、机间分离约束和运动学可行性约束。

Result: 在四种城市风场场景的仿真中验证了局部风与形变耦合的重要性；飞行仿真进一步显示轨迹跟踪精度有所提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，风感知的轨迹族规划在复杂城市环境中的协同空中运输具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Coordinated aerial transport in dense urban environments requires drone formations to navigate confined spaces and adapt to spatially varying winds around buildings. Formation deformation enables passage through narrow spaces but changes individual drone velocities and the local winds they encounter, coupling formation motion with aerodynamic effects. We propose Family-Air, a wind-aware trajectory-family planner that constructs a virtual tube as shared collision-free flight space and jointly optimizes formation-center motion, deformation, and timing. A shared affine transformation represents a continuous trajectory family, incorporating spatially varying wind and deformation-induced velocities into a unified air-relative motion objective. The optimization enforces virtual-tube containment, inter-drone separation, and kinematic feasibility. Simulations across four urban wind-field scenarios demonstrate the importance of local wind-deformation coupling. Flight simulations further show improvements in trajectory tracking accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of wind-aware trajectory-family planning for coordinated aerial transport in complex urban environments.

</details>


### [474] [Duo: Towards Spatiotemporal Action Coordination in Bimanual Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32108)
*Zhimu Zhou,Yuqi Yang,Yixin Lin,Junsen Zhang,Jian Zhao,Jiayu Zhong,Jiaxun Sun,Bingxin Wang,Binhua Zuo,Bo Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Duo，一种用于双臂操作策略的简单有效设计：在每个时间步为两只手臂分别生成动作 token，并在流匹配过程中通过跨臂注意力建模双臂协作，从而同时捕捉空间与时间依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂操作要求两只手臂执行不同动作并相互协调，但常见基于流的机器人策略将双臂动作合并为每个未来时间步的一个 token，使注意力只能在时间维度区分位置，难以在手臂维度建模交互。

Method: Duo 在共享动作头内将两只手臂拆分为每个时间步两个动作 token，并在流匹配期间使用跨臂注意力让两臂运动交互；在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboDojo 和真实任务上评估，并对臂间协调、动作分组和 token 粒度进行系统性消融。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，Duo 提升四个基础策略的整体成功率，参数规模覆盖 0.45B 到 3.62B；FLOWER（0.89B）提升 12.55 个百分点，π0.5（3.62B）提升 9.02 个百分点。FLOWER-Duo 在 RoboDojo 上取得最佳随机泛化、精度和内存分数；真实任务中成功率和执行速度均优于 π0.5，并能随训练数据增加有效扩展。

Conclusion: 消融表明跨臂注意力是性能提升的主要驱动因素，而按手臂分组交互在精度与计算量之间提供最佳权衡；Duo 通过显式建模双臂空间交互有效增强双臂操作策略。

Abstract: Bimanual manipulation requires each arm to perform distinct motions while coordinating with the other. Common flow-based robotic policies combine both arms' actions into one token per future timestep, giving attention distinct positions across time but not across arms. We introduce Duo, a simple but effective design that models spatial and temporal dependencies within one shared action head. Specifically, Duo separates both arms into two action tokens per timestep, allowing each arm's motion to interact via cross-arm attention during flow matching. On RoboTwin 2.0, Duo improves the overall success of all four base policies, from 0.45B to 3.62B parameters, with gains of 12.55 and 9.02 percentage points for FLOWER (0.89B) and $π_{0.5}$ (3.62B), respectively. Despite its compact size, FLOWER-Duo achieves the best randomized-generalization, precision, and memory scores on RoboDojo. In real-world tasks, it outperforms $π_{0.5}$ in both success rate and execution speed, while scaling effectively with increasing training data. To provide deeper insight into the design of Duo, we conduct systematic ablations on inter-arm coordination, action grouping, and token granularity, confirming that cross-arm attention drives the improvement while arm-wise interaction offers the best accuracy-compute trade-off.

</details>


### [475] [Reading Geometric Anchors: Viewpoint Generalization in Imitation Learning for Robotic Manipulation with RGB-Only Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32162)
*Chengyu Tao,Chunxi Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出ReGeoAnch，一种面向视角泛化的几何锚定模仿学习框架，通过在机器人基座和夹爪坐标系中建立锚点，并结合解耦外观引导的几何读出与跨视角读出一致性，提升操作策略在新视角下的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于RGB的模仿学习对相机位置变化敏感，现有通过合成视角配对相同动作的方法忽略了跨视角的物理对应关系；基于深度和相机标定的3D策略又面临观测点集变化的问题。

Method: 提出ReGeoAnch：在机器人基座坐标系建立全局锚点、在夹爪坐标系建立局部锚点，提供跨视角共享物理参考；采用Point-to-Anchor Aggregation进行解耦外观引导的几何读出，获得锚点周围可比且稳定的几何；通过Anchor-to-Policy Readout实现可控解耦信息流，用视角不变的机器人状态查询视角相关外观以选择任务相关锚点，并仅用几何值形成最终读出；引入Cross-View Readout Consistency对齐源视角与合成目标视角的策略读出方向。

Result: 在MetaWorld和ManiSkill3的12个操作任务上实验表明，ReGeoAnch相比基线策略具有更好的视角泛化性能。

Conclusion: 通过跨视角共享的几何锚点、解耦的外观与几何信息读出以及跨视角一致性约束，可有效缓解RGB模仿学习中的视角变化问题并提升策略的视角泛化能力。

Abstract: Moving the camera changes where objects appear in an image, challenging RGB-based imitation learning. A common strategy pairs synthesized views with the same demonstrated action, but ignores supporting physical correspondence across views. By predicting depth with camera calibrations, 3D policies may handle it yet suffer the issue of varied observed point sets. To address these limitations, we propose ReGeoAnch, a geometry-anchored imitation learning framework for viewpoint generalization. Specifically, we build global anchors in the robot base frame and local anchors in the gripper frame, providing shared physical references across viewpoints. Furthermore, Decoupled Appearance-Guided Geometric Readout uses Point-to-Anchor Aggregation (PAA) to obtain comparable and stable geometry around anchors beyond pointwise correspondence. A controllable and decoupled information flow, Anchor-to-Policy Readout (APR), leverages complementary visual and geometric information and supports viewpoint generalization: view-dependent appearances are queried by view-invariant robot state to select task-relevant anchors, with geometric values alone to form the final readout. We further introduce Cross-View Readout Consistency to align the directions of policy readouts from paired source and synthesized target views. Experiments on 12 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld and ManiSkill3 demonstrate improved viewpoint generalization over baseline policies.

</details>


### [476] [OVOK: A Recursive Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Video-Based Articulated Robot State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32185)
*Cheng Dai,Renkai Luo,Guanfeng Tang,Siming Li,Hao Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出OVOK（One Video to Kinetics），一种递归自我改进的智能体框架，用于从视频中恢复带关节机器人的状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该问题本身病态：不同相机内参、相机到机器人的位姿和关节角可能产生相似观测。现有任务特定回归器通常假设内参已知，需大量数据采集和机器人特定训练，跨场景迁移差；基础模型虽可零样本用于任意机器人，但估计误差较大。

Method: 在人工编写协议下，智能体初始化器构建机器人特定的OVOK-4k；随后通过proposer–executor–verifier循环，根据反馈联合演化工具和可执行工作流，仅当验证器判断有正向改进时才接受更新；最终冻结保留的工作流用于准确推理。

Result: 实验表明，演化后的工作流在DREAM-V和RoboKeyGen-V上取得最先进结果，能够提供稳健且准确的估计。

Conclusion: OVOK通过智能体式递归自我改进和验证机制，有效演化工具与工作流，从而提升从视频恢复机器人关节状态的准确性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Recovering articulated robot state from video supports metric spatial sensing for manipulation, scene reconstruction, and action planning. Yet the problem is ill-posed: different intrinsics, camera-to-robot poses, and joint angles can explain similar observations. Prior task-specific regressors typically assume known intrinsics, fit one robot through laborious data collection and robot-specific training, and still transfer poorly across scenes. Foundation models apply to any robot zero-shot, but their estimates have large errors. We present OVOK (One Video to Kinetics), a recursive self-improving agentic framework for this task. Under a human-authored protocol, an agentic initializer constructs robot-specific OVOK-4k; a proposer--executor--verifier loop then jointly evolves tools and executable workflows from feedback. Updated tools and workflows are accepted only when the verifier judges a positive improvement. The retained workflow is frozen for accurate inference. Experiments demonstrate that the evolved workflow achieves state-of-the-art results on DREAM-V and RoboKeyGen-V, delivering robust and accurate estimates.

</details>


### [477] [SkillHarness: Execution-Aware Coordination with Plug-and-Play Skills for Long-Horizon Traversal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32186)
*Bailin He,Xiting Zhao,Kang Wang,Xinyu Zhou,Yongxing Cui,Haojie Liu,Qiao Sun,Hongyan Zhang,Wenqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 SkillHarness，一个具备执行感知能力的协调框架，通过可插拔的运动技能库、感知强化学习和视觉语言引导的技能调度，实现复杂地形下的自适应长程穿越。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多地形运动策略通常固定且依赖重新训练，难以适应未知障碍和环境变化；同时感知扰动与不可靠的技能切换会影响鲁棒执行，因此需要提升技能可扩展性、执行协调性和长时程适应性。

Method: 提出 SkillHarness 执行感知协调框架：集成灵活、即插即用的运动技能库；采用感知强化学习，在保留任务相关环境参考的同时持续更新本体感觉反馈，以降低感知波动敏感性；利用视觉语言引导的 Harness 通过事件触发推理、几何可行性验证和执行阶段约束协调导航与技能执行；并引入执行反馈与回顾式决策修正来改进技能选择、避免不当切换。

Result: 在多种地形配置、感知扰动和多障碍穿越任务上评估了 SkillHarness，重点考察其在长时程穿越中的适应性与可靠性；框架可在不重新训练运动策略的情况下组合和扩展已有技能，以适应未见地形和任务组合。

Conclusion: SkillHarness 通过可插拔技能库与执行感知协调机制，提高了复杂地形下技能组合、切换和长程穿越的鲁棒性，为无需重训策略的自适应多技能运动提供了一种可行方案。

Abstract: Traversing complex terrain requires robots to coordinate diverse locomotion skills while adapting to unseen obstacles and changing environments. Although perceptive reinforcement learning enables agile locomotion, conventional multi-terrain locomotion rely on fixed policy, limiting adaptability and skill extensibility. Perceptual disturbances and unreliable skill transitions further challenge robust execution. To address these challenges, we propose SkillHarness, an execution-aware coordination framework that integrates a flexible, plug-and-play locomotion skill library. To enhance traversal robustness, we introduce a perceptive reinforcement learning approach that preserves task-relevant environmental references while continuously updating proprioceptive feedback, reducing sensitivity to perceptual fluctuations. A vision-language-guided Harness coordinates navigation and skill execution through event-triggered reasoning, geometric feasibility verification, and execution-phase constraints. By flexibly composing and extending available skills, SkillHarness adapts to unseen terrain and task combinations without retraining the locomotion policies. The framework further incorporates execution feedback and retrospective decision revision to improve skill selection and avoid inappropriate skill switching. We evaluate SkillHarness across diverse terrain configurations, perceptual disturbances, and multi-obstacle traversal tasks to assess its adaptability and reliability in long-horizon traversal.

</details>


### [478] [Disentangling Visual Dynamics for World Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32228)
*Yuhong Shi,Yihan Guo,Jie Wei,Jianyi Liu,Jingwen Fu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 FactorWorld，一种用于世界模型规划的 disentangled 视觉动力学框架，通过分离智能体与外部动力学，并将因子与任务信号关联，提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉世界模型可通过预测潜在状态进行规划，但智能体动力学与外部动力学纠缠会掩盖任务进展。现有方法面临两个挑战：抑制跨因子干扰并保留有用信息；以及将因子与任务相关信号关联，因为仅靠稳定性不足以保证有意义的规划距离。

Method: 提出 FactorWorld 框架。为分离智能体与外部动力学，设计由双向反事实对引导的 Counterfactual Consensus Residual Factorizer（CCRF），将共享上下文与动态残差分离，并结合平均/最差伙伴约束抑制干扰，以状态和运动监督保留信息。为将因子转化为规划决策，引入 semantic routing，对完整表示的任务预测进行细化，用于状态估计、轨迹评分和任务自适应规划。

Result: 在 MiniGrid、MetaDrive 和 CARLA 上，因子稳定性在两个骨干网络上均有提升。MiniGrid 上因子路由将平均成功率从 78.80% 提升至 82.40%。在包括 Push-T 在内的四个连续控制任务中，FactorWorld 的平均成功率为 91.67% 至 100%。

Conclusion: 将解耦视觉动力学与显式任务相结合，可显著提升世界模型的规划能力。

Abstract: Visual world models enable planning through predictive latent states. However, entangled agent and exogenous dynamics can obscure task progress. Disentangling visual dynamics for planning requires addressing two challenges: 1) suppressing cross-factor interference while retaining useful information; and 2) linking factors to task-relevant signals, since stability alone does not ensure meaningful planning distances. Therefore, we introduce FactorWorld, a disentangled visual dynamics framework for world model planning. To separate agent and exogenous dynamics, we propose a Counterfactual Consensus Residual Factorizer (CCRF) guided by bidirectional counterfactual pairs. CCRF separates shared context from dynamic residuals, combining average and worst-partner constraints to suppress interference with state and motion supervision to retain useful information. To translate these factors into planning decisions, we introduce semantic routing to refine full-representation task predictions for state estimation, trajectory scoring, and task-adapted planning. Experiments on MiniGrid, MetaDrive, and CARLA show improved bidirectional factor stability across two backbones. On MiniGrid, factor routing raises mean SR from 78.80% to 82.40%. Across four continuous control tasks, including Push-T, FactorWorld achieves mean success rates ranging from 91.67% to 100% across tasks. These results demonstrate that combining decoupled visual dynamics with explicit tasks can significantly improve the planning capabilities of world models.

</details>


### [479] [Roboclock: A Unified Benchmark for Time-Aware Robotic Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32233)
*Yujie Zhao,Anthony L. Hu,Zimeng Huang,Zhijing Wu,Luobin Wang,Richard Li,Shrivas Sudharsan,Henrik I. Christensen,Jishen Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboClock，一个面向时间感知机器人操作的统一基准，覆盖 60 个任务和三类时间约束，并采用延迟对齐评估协议与时间敏感指标，系统评估现有机器人方法在时间维度上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基准主要关注空间正确性和逻辑任务完成，忽视了真实应用中时间窗口、事件响应速度和吞吐量等关键时间约束，导致机器人可能因时间问题而失败。

Method: 构建 RoboClock 基准，包含 5 个应用领域、60 个任务，围绕 Temporal Window、Event-Reactive 和 Throughput 三类时间约束设计任务；引入 Latency-Aligned 评估协议，在模型推理和控制接口延迟期间持续推进环境时间，并结合时间敏感指标评估超过 30 种方法。

Result: 表现最好的训练型 VLA 方法在 Easy 级任务上时间成功率也仅为 8.3%，且在泛化和迁移方面仍存在持续挑战。

Conclusion: 当前机器人系统在时间推理与执行延迟方面存在根本性局限，需要联合优化物理能力、时间推理和执行延迟。

Abstract: Time is a fundamental dimension of robotic intelligence: a robot may fail despite physically correct actions if it acts outside a valid time window, responds too slowly to an event, or fails to meet required throughput. Yet existing robotic benchmarks primarily emphasize spatial correctness and logical task completion, largely overlooking the temporal constraints of real-world applications. We present RoboClock, a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation featuring 60 tasks across five application domains. Mirroring these failure modes, RoboClock structures tasks around three types of temporal constraints: Temporal Window, Event-Reactive, and Throughput. Furthermore, RoboClock incorporates a Latency-Aligned evaluation protocol that continuously advances environment time during model inference and control-interface delays, paired with time-sensitive metrics. Evaluating over 30 methods, we find that the best-performing approach is the trained VLA, yet it achieves only 8.3% temporal success even on Easy-level tasks, with persistent challenges in generalization and transfer. These findings reveal fundamental limitations in current robotic systems and highlight the need to jointly optimize physical competence, temporal reasoning, and execution latency.

</details>


### [480] [Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32238)
*Kaipeng Fang,Yuhao Wang,Ji Zhang,Yunsong Zhou,Jingkuan Song,Lianli Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究多模态智能体与视运动策略协作时的交接失败问题，提出边界感知策略学习，显式塑造并扩展策略的交接边界，从而提升机器人系统可靠性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体负责通用推理，策略负责精确物理控制，但策略仅在有限起始状态内可靠；智能体可能在交接边界外调用策略，导致系统失败。现有整体任务策略的交接边界狭窄且难以被智能体刻画，协调困难。

Method: 提出Boundary-Aware Policy Learning：先用Boundary-Explicit Training在多样起始姿态的接触片段上微调策略，形成宽且明确的边界，并通过简单交接协议告知智能体；再用Boundary-Expanding Self-Improvement在筛选出的成功系统轨迹上重训策略，将边界扩展到任务更早阶段，使智能体更早交接并减少语言模型调用。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0和RoboDojo上，系统比最强基线高超过26个百分点，在随机化RoboTwin 2.0场景达到98.4%成功率，同时API成本和执行时间分别降低41.3%和37.5%。

Conclusion: 稳健的智能体-策略编排不仅依赖提升单个组件，还需要显式塑造二者之间的交接边界。

Abstract: Agent-orchestrated robot systems combine the general reasoning capability of multimodal agents with the precise physical control of learned visuomotor policies. Yet such systems often fail at the moment of handoff: a policy is reliable only from a limited set of start states, while the agent may invoke it outside this region. We call this region the policy's handoff boundary. Existing whole-task policies typically have handoff boundaries that are narrow and difficult for an agent to characterize, making reliable coordination challenging. We propose Boundary-Aware Policy Learning, which explicitly shapes and then expands the handoff boundary of a visuomotor policy. First, Boundary-Explicit Training fine-tunes the policy on contact segments with diverse start poses, yielding a wide and well-defined boundary that can be communicated to the agent through a simple handoff protocol. Second, Boundary-Expanding Self-Improvement retrains the policy on curated successful system rollouts, extending the boundary toward earlier stages of each task and allowing the agent to hand over sooner with fewer language-model calls. Across RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboDojo, our system outperforms the strongest baseline by over 26 percentage points, reaching 98.4% success in randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes, while further reducing its API cost and execution time by 41.3% and 37.5%, respectively. These results suggest that the key to robust agent-policy orchestration lies not only in improving either component individually, but also in explicitly shaping the boundary between them.

</details>


### [481] [VLAs Execute, Code Recovers: 3D Skill Envelopes Bridge the Compositional Gap in Agentic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32245)
*Jiajie Zhang,Yankai Xiang,Changhao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Composing frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) skills under an agentic planner promises scalable long-horizon manipulation without long-horizon demonstrations, yet strong atomic skills routinely fail at seams even under a correct plan. Standard remedies reset the robot's pose or draft entry conditions in language, missing the physical cause we uncover via causal interventions: even after re-homing, a frozen VLA rigidly retraces its habitual trajectory and collides with displaced scene residue, whether or not it can see it. We propose the Skill Envelope, a policy-measured 3D geometric precondition capturing the volume a frozen skill sweeps during successful executions. Exploiting the insight that the rigidity making a frozen skill fragile at seams also makes its trajectory predictable in advance, we expose each envelope as two classical 3D tools (CHECK to detect blocking residue and FREE to locate safe placement regions), establishing a division of labor where VLAs execute in-distribution manipulation and code repairs out-of-distribution states. On LIBERO-Goal with frozen $π_{0.5}$, our zero-failure envelope predicts collisions at 0.946 AUROC (0.944 from one RGB-D view) and beats frontier VLMs on seam readiness (0.902 vs. 0.793); using it for skill ordering and code repair lifts success from 82.8% to 92.3% on two-step seams and from 29.7% to 93.8% on drawer-bearing 3-4 step chains, matching privileged world reset. Together, these results show that reliable VLA composition hinges on measuring a policy's physical workspace rather than guessing preconditions in language. Ongoing work closes the loop with autonomous LLM orchestration, synthesized free-object recovery, and cross-policy evaluation on cluttered benchmarks and real hardware.

</details>


### [482] [Motion Chain of Thought: Disentangling Motion Semantics from Visual Appearance for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32241)
*Xiangkai Ma,Xinyi Wang,Junjie Wang,Sheng Xu,Mingyang Li,Yue Ma,Han Zhang,Yuzheng Zhuang,Wenzhong Li,Zhihao Yuan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出PILOT框架，通过表征推演（RD）将运动思维链作为模型原生能力，显式建模潜在状态转移令牌以指导精细动作轨迹生成，从而改进世界动作模型在机器人操作中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）的视觉分支主要预测静态视觉观测，未充分反映运动交互下世界状态演化；高层物理条件演化与低层动作轨迹生成在动作模型中存在表征纠缠，形成结构瓶颈，并削弱世界演化建模对动作生成的预测能力。

Method: 提出PILOT（Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories），其核心为表征推演（RD）。RD将运动思维链（CoT）引导集成为模型原生能力，促使动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移令牌，并将其作为推理空间中的CoT保留，以指导细粒度运动轨迹生成。

Result: 实验表明，RD提升了WAMs在复杂机器人操作任务中的成功率和泛化能力；通过解耦高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节增强了模型的物理可解释性；RD引入的丰富状态转移监督信号缓解了动作生成中的稀疏监督问题，并支持减少演示数据下的数据高效真实机器人适配。

Conclusion: RD能够弥合静态视觉预测与状态转移动态建模之间的差距，使WAMs更好地统一世界状态演化理解与动作生成，并在性能、泛化、可解释性和数据效率方面带来收益。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding action generation. However, existing visual branches focus on predicting static visual observation, rather than reflecting potential transition information that captures the evolution of world states under motion interactions. This leads to representational entanglement between high-level physical condition evolution and low-level action trajectory generation within the Action Model, creating a structural bottleneck while weakening the predictive capability of world evolution modeling for action generation. We propose PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories), whose core Representational Deduction (RD) bridges this gap by integrating motion chain-of-thought (CoT) guidance as a native model capability. Specifically, RD aims to encourage the action branch to explicitly model potential state transition tokens, which are retained as CoT in the reasoning space to guide fine-grained motion trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that RD not only improves the success rate and generalization ability of WAMs in complex robotic manipulation tasks but also enhances the model's physical interpretability by decoupling high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details. Furthermore, the abundant state transition supervision signals introduced by RD effectively alleviate the sparse supervision in action generation, supporting data-efficient real-robot adaptation with reduced demonstration sets.

</details>


### [483] [RoboDemo: Reconciling Demonstration Intent and Execution Progress for Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32256)
*Xiangkai Ma,Zhihao Yuan,Linbo Zhai,Xinyi Wang,Junjie Wang,Sheng Xu,Guiliang Liu,Han Zhang,Chuyi Chen,Jifeng Gao,Wenzhong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboDemo 是一个基于双级联测试时训练的演示增强机器人操作框架，旨在同时维护全局任务先验和跟踪实际交互进度，从而提升长时序操作表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时序机器人操作不能只依赖当前观测预测下一步动作，还需要保持对子任务阶段预期进度的全局程序性先验，并跟踪交互产生的实际进度。

Method: 提出 RoboDemo，使用双级联 Test-Time-Training；参考视频可为任务相关人类演示或仿真语料中语义兼容的机器人视频。将参考视频中的任务语义与物理运动信息转入持久演示意图记忆，并将在线观测、机器人状态和执行动作压缩为交互进度记忆。参考与执行视频 token 通过独立 fast-weight 状态更新，动作专家级联读取记忆：先获取参考引导，再用实际进度细化。

Result: 在 Imitator Game 上达到 90.7% 成功率，在三个真实家庭任务上平均达到 73.3% 成功率。

Conclusion: RoboDemo 能在保持参考意图稳定的同时适应执行偏差，且不覆盖已存储意图；在有/无配对人类演示情况下均具适用性，并公开真实视频、代码与权重。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires more than predicting the next action from the current observation. The policy must maintain a global procedural prior that specifies the expected progress of each subtask stage, while also tracking the realized progress produced by its interactions. To this end, we propose RoboDemo, a demonstration-augmented manipulation framework built on Dual-Cascaded Test-Time-Training. RoboDemo accepts either a task-relevant human demonstration video or a semantically compatible robot video retrieved from simulation corpus as reference, allowing us to evaluate its applicability with and without paired human demonstrations. Task semantics and physical motion information from the reference video are then transferred into persistent demonstration-intent memory. During deployment, we causally compress online observations, robot states, and executed actions into interaction-progress memory. To keep reference intent stable while interaction progress continually evolves, reference and execution video tokens independently update their respective fast-weight states. The action expert performs cascaded memory reads, first obtaining reference guidance and then refining it using realized progress, allowing the policy to adapt to execution deviations without overwriting the stored intent. RoboDemo achieves 90.7% success on Imitator Game and 73.3% success across three real-world household tasks. Real-world videos, code and hf-weights are available in our project website.

</details>


### [484] [EgoLoAF: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations with Hand-Object Affordances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32260)
*Yiming Zeng,Jiangyuxuan Dai,Yuheng Na,Tan Zhu Xuan,Zihan Lin,Xinfang Qi,Shijian Zhang,Chengqi Shi,Yihan Kuang,Zhide Zhong,Junjie He,Junfeng Li,Zimu Han,Naipeng Li,Haoang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EgoLoAF 提出一种仅利用第一视角人类演示、无需可穿戴动捕和真实机器人遥操作数据的人形 VLA 训练范式，并通过显式手-物交互线索提升动作生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形视觉-语言-动作模型训练依赖昂贵的真实机器人遥操作；现有将人类演示转为人形数据的方法多需可穿戴追踪器，且手-物交互线索隐式，部分还混入遥操作数据，限制可扩展性和精确接触学习。

Method: 从录制相机位姿估计躯干运动、从视频重建双手轨迹以生成人形动作目标；用每只手相对物体的当前位姿表示手-物可供性，并在后训练中通过交叉注意力注入动作专家，同时冻结视觉-语言主干；仅用转换后的第一视角数据后训练 VLA。

Result: 发布 128,400 个第一视角演示回合，覆盖 1,000 小时和 1,284 个任务，并提供转换后的人形动作轨迹与机器人视角观测。四项真实任务中，EgoLoAF 平均任务进度分数为 73.1，接近遥操作的 74.4，数据采集效率平均提升 4.03 倍。

Conclusion: EgoLoAF 表明无需可穿戴动捕和真实机器人遥操作数据，也能从第一视角人类演示构建可扩展的人形 loco-manipulation 训练数据，并在真实任务中接近遥操作性能。

Abstract: Training humanoid vision-language-action (VLA) models relies heavily on costly real-robot teleoperation. Recent efforts convert egocentric human demonstrations into humanoid training data. However, most methods still require wearable motion trackers and leave important hand-object interaction cues implicit. Many also mix in real-robot teleoperation data for VLA post-training. These dependencies limit scalable data collection, while implicit interaction cues make precise contact harder to learn. To overcome these limitations, we propose EgoLoAF, the first paradigm to derive all training data for humanoid loco-manipulation directly from egocentric demonstrations without wearable motion trackers. We post-train the VLA on the converted data alone, without real-robot teleoperation demonstrations, and use explicit hand-object interaction cues to guide action generation. Specifically, to obtain humanoid action targets, we estimate torso motion from recorded camera poses and reconstruct both hand trajectories from video. From the same recording, we use each hand's current pose relative to the object to represent hand-object affordances. During post-training, we inject these affordances into the action expert through cross-attention while keeping the vision-language backbone frozen. Additionally, we release 128,400 egocentric demonstration episodes spanning 1,000 hours and 1,284 tasks, together with converted humanoid action trajectories and rendered robot-view observations. Across four real-world tasks, EgoLoAF nearly achieves teleoperation performance (73.1 vs. 74.4 in mean Task Progress Score), while achieving a mean 4.03 times improvement in data-collection efficiency.

</details>


### [485] [Putting a Robot on a Phone Call: Layered Signaling, Bounded Occupancy and Turn Arbitration over WebRTC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32308)
*Zheyuan Zhang,Zaide Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文将 Thor 机器人接入浏览器语音通话，并测量信令、WebRTC 媒体中继、语音生成、会话协调与异常恢复的时序表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是让浏览器语音通话可靠驱动机器人扬声器，同时与本地语音访问协调，降低首拨延迟并处理并发占用、断线和边界异常。

Method: 将 HTTPS 信令、经中继的 WebRTC 媒体和语音生成分离为可观测路径；浏览器预取中继凭证并预留 500 ms 窗口；后端在 55 s 截止期内并行准备语音与 WebRTC answer；用会话槽和非阻塞扬声器锁协调本地语音访问；设置 2 s gate 允许控制端在播放前抑制聊天；开展首拨、占用与恢复、60 s 断线、40 次受控回放及边界轨迹测量。

Result: 16 次首拨中 15 次达到可说话；Wi-Fi 为 7/8，中位 5.57 s；蜂窝为 8/8，中位 6.76 s；20 个占用与恢复场景均允许后续呼叫；5 次 60 s 断线中后端释放线路而手机仍离线；40 次回放中，1 s 决策时 gate 可抑制聊天，3 s 时聊天与控制反馈顺序播放且无重叠；边界轨迹暴露了反馈项命名错误及新呼叫查询返回前任反馈的问题。

Conclusion: 该架构在单平台上展示了可观测、可协调的浏览器语音通话集成能力，但测量范围限于应用事件和模拟控制决策，未评估声学输出与任务正确性。

Abstract: We put a Thor robot on a browser voice call, with speech sent from Safari, answers played through the robot's loudspeaker and transcripts returned to the phone. We separate HTTPS signaling, relayed WebRTC media and speech generation into independently observable routes. The browser prefetches relay credentials and allows a 500 ms window after its first relay candidate. The backend starts speech and WebRTC-answer preparation concurrently within a 55 s deadline. A session slot and a non-blocking speaker lock coordinate calls with local voice access. A 2 s gate gives the controller an opportunity to suppress chat before playback. Fifteen of sixteen first dials reached ready-to-speak, comprising seven of eight Wi-Fi calls with a median of 5.57 s and eight of eight cellular calls with a median of 6.76 s. All twenty scored occupancy and recovery scenarios admitted a later call. During five 60 s outages, the backend released the line while the phone remained offline. Across 40 controlled replays, enabling the gate suppressed chat when the controller decided at 1 s. At 3 s, chat and controller feedback both played in sequence, with no overlapping output in any trace. Two additional boundary traces exposed a receipt naming a later feedback item and a new call's query returning its predecessor's feedback. These measurements cover application events on one platform and simulated controller decisions, with acoustic output and task correctness outside their scope.

</details>


### [486] [Any2Act: Scaling In-Context Robot Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32353)
*Ziang Ren,Zifan Wang,Zhuoyang Li,Benhao Qin,Haoyang Li,Qingtao Liu,Xuchuan Chen,Zekun Qi,He Wang,Yanchao Yang,Li Yi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出机器人上下文学习基础模型Any2Act，通过统一到执行机器人的相机布局与动作空间表示，实现从单次演示完成未见任务，无需微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人上下文学习方法受限于人-机器人配对数据稀缺，或仅支持少量来源类型且规模有限，难以利用多种演示来源。

Method: 将演示统一表示为执行机器人的相机布局和动作空间；基于120万条真实轨迹、1万任务的机器人-机器人配对学习跟随；将人类视频、仿真、UMI和其他机器人数据转换到该表示，并用少量配对训练源路由适配器，预训练模型保持冻结；长时任务使用免训练跟踪器仅输入执行进度附近的演示窗口，并支持回滚重试失败步骤。

Result: 单次演示下，Any2Act在未见任务上无需微调达到57.5%成功率，超过每任务用50次演示微调的VLA；使用其他演示来源时仍保留执行机器人自身演示成功率的74%-91%。

Conclusion: 统一 embodiment-grounded 演示表示可解耦“学习跟随”与“接纳新来源”，使机器人ICL高效利用多源演示并泛化到未见任务。

Abstract: Robot in-context learning (ICL) enables a policy to perform unseen tasks by following contextual demonstrations, without task-specific fine-tuning. This is increasingly valuable as large language models reasoning at low frequency can specify tasks through demonstrations and delegate high-frequency execution to such a policy. However, methods conditioned on human videos are bounded by scarce human-robot pairs, while those conditioned on robot demonstrations accept only one or two source types at limited scale. We present Any2Act, a foundation model for robot ICL. Our key insight is that a demonstration should be expressed in the camera layout and action space of the robot that performs it (the executor), not of whoever provided it (the demonstrator). This unified embodiment-grounded representation decouples learning to follow from admitting a new source. Any2Act learns to follow once, from robot-to-robot pairs that already take this form in 1.2M real trajectories spanning 10K tasks. Human videos, simulation, UMI, and other robots are then translated into this representation, and source-routed adapters trained on only a few hundred pairs each absorb the residual gap while the pretrained model stays frozen. For long horizons, a training-free tracker feeds only the demonstration window around the executor's progress, bounding the context and rolling back to redo failed steps. From a single demonstration, Any2Act achieves 57.5% success on unseen tasks without fine-tuning, exceeding VLAs fine-tuned on 50 demonstrations per task; other demonstrators retain 74-91% of the success achieved with the executor's own demonstrations.

</details>


### [487] [Does Research-Paper Context Improve LLM-Generated Quadruped Navigation? An Exploratory Simulation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32381)
*Barnabas Juhasz,Rolf Pfister*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文测试将特定研究论文作为上下文是否能改善大语言模型为Go2四足机器人编写的导航代码，发现提供增量重规划论文反而降低了物理仿真中的任务完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能编写机器人导航代码，但随着研究进展和发现数量增加，模型可能无法回忆并应用相关发现。作者希望验证：向模型提供特定论文作为上下文，是否会提升其编写的导航代码质量。

Method: 在冻结大语言模型（Claude Opus 5）和运动策略的条件下，比较模型在有/无特定论文上下文时编写的导航控制器，涵盖三种设置：行为树、基于共享基座编辑的导航器、从零编写的控制器；并在Isaac Sim物理仿真与理想运动学仿真中测试，使用双侧Fisher精确检验分析结果。

Result: 当迷宫最短路径在回合中被阻塞时，提供增量重规划论文上下文编写的8个控制器中仅2个完成全部四次行程，而无该上下文时为7/8（双侧Fisher精确检验，p=0.041）。该差异仅在物理仿真中出现；在理想运动学仿真中，有/无论文上下文的控制器无法区分。

Conclusion: 大语言模型在获得研究论文作为上下文时，可能过度重视论文内容及其目标（如增量重规划的效率），从而负面影响主任务完成并导致代码鲁棒性下降。

Abstract: Large language models can write competent robot navigation code, but not only does the research on the topic advance, a model may also, due to the volume of findings, fail to recall relevant findings and apply them to the task at hand. In this work, we test whether providing particular research papers as context improves the LLM-written navigation code for the Go2 quadruped, with the LLM (Claude Opus 5) and locomotion policy frozen. Specifically, we compare the navigation controllers the LLM writes when provided with and without particular papers across three settings: behavior trees, navigators edited from a shared base, and controllers written from scratch. When a maze's shortest route is blocked mid-episode, 2 of 8 controllers written with the context of an incremental-replanning paper complete all four trips under Isaac Sim physics, against 7 of 8 without it (two-sided Fisher's exact test, p = 0.041). This difference appears only under physics: in an idealized kinematic simulator, the controllers written with and without the paper are indistinguishable. We hypothesize that an LLM provided research papers as context tends to overweight both their content and their goals -- in this case, the efficiency of incremental replanning -- negatively affecting the fulfillment of the main task and leading to less robust code.

</details>


### [488] [A Face Robot which Imitates Human Musculoskeletal Skin System and Its Evaluation on Basic Movement of Facial Expression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32413)
*Shun Kaneko,Shunnosuke Yoshimura,Akihiro Miki,Kento Kawaharazuka,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受解剖学启发的面部机器人平台，模拟人类面部肌肉骨骼系统的分层结构，并评估其复现FACS面部动作单元（AU）的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面部机器人需要大量协调的小幅运动，但在紧凑面部结构中实现这些运动仍然困难，因此希望借鉴人类面部肌肉骨骼的分层组织方式。

Method: 平台由骨骼、肌肉和皮肤组成，其几何、形状和附着位置来自三维解剖数据；采用线驱动柔性肌肉组件并通过PTFE管布线，使执行器远离面部。作者选择并制造了65块肌肉（34种肌肉类型），用于复现FACS中47个目标AU，并分两阶段评估：无皮肤时肌肉驱动，以及附着硅胶皮肤后驱动。

Result: 在肌肉组件阶段复现了47个目标AU中的40个，在附着皮肤后复现了30个。

Conclusion: 结果表明，使用受解剖学启发的肌肉骨骼结构复现广泛的FACS面部表情是可行的，该平台为未来受解剖学启发面部机器人的系统化开发与评估提供了基础。

Abstract: Facial robots require many coordinated, smallamplitude motions, but accommodating these motions in a compact face remains difficult. This paper presents an anatomically inspired facial-robot platform that reproduces the layered organization of the human facial musculoskeletal system. The platform comprises bone, muscle, and skin components whose geometry, shape, and attachment locations are derived from three-dimensional anatomical data. Wire-driven, compliant muscle components are routed through PTFE tubes, allowing actuation to be placed away from the face. We describe the selection and fabrication of 65 muscles (34 muscle types) required to reproduce the 47 target action units (AUs) in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS). We then evaluate the reproducibility of individual AUs in two stages: muscle actuation without skin and actuation after the silicone skin is attached. Forty of the 47 target AUs were reproduced with the muscle components, and 30 were reproduced after skin attachment. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reproducing a broad range of FACS facial expressions using an anatomically inspired musculoskeletal structure. The proposed platform provides a foundation for the systematic development and evaluation of future anatomically inspired facial robots

</details>


### [489] [Delay-Tolerant Formation Tracking for Multi-AGV Systems via Reference-Shift Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32409)
*Yunfei Bi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种用于差分驱动AGV编队运输的级联控制方案，将有延迟的邻居数据仅用于参考轨迹滤波，从而把跟踪环与无线网络解耦，并在理论证明与大规模高保真仿真中验证其对任意有界延迟、丢包和切换拓扑的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多AGV共同运输负载时需保持编队，同时各自跟踪参考轨迹；无线链路存在依赖链路、时变且跳变的延迟，直接延迟耦合可能导致驱动饱和甚至失稳，因此需要一种对网络延迟和拓扑变化鲁棒的编队控制方法。

Method: 将差分驱动AGV建模为运动学独轮车，采用级联设计：邻居的延迟数据只驱动二阶滤波器以平移本车参考，饱和限制保证平移参考可行，未修改的增益调度跟踪律跟踪平移参考，前馈精确使跟踪环不受网络影响。作者证明任意延迟下跟踪与编队误差有界，并在每一下界延迟及有向、可能切换图中收敛；构造显式常数的严格Lyapunov函数，证明指数收敛和延迟无关增益的局部输入-状态估计；无向图下耦合以至少 lambda/(lambda+Lambda*lambda_2(L)) 的因子衰减持续局部误差造成的编队误差。还使用事件驱动、误差可控仿真验证不等式，并在高保真AGV模型上进行4,894次运行，包含驱动动力学、打滑、定位误差、时钟偏移和丢包Wi-Fi及配对基线比较。

Result: 级联方案在高达4 s延迟、90%丢包和最多12辆车时从未失败；直接延迟耦合在其增益使驱动饱和时失败。耦合使牵引力损失后的编队误差降低21-32%，安全停车后降低至多47%，但牺牲跟踪精度。定位偏差和时钟偏移无法被任何耦合律观测，限制了可达精度。

Conclusion: 该级联设计能在任意有界延迟和切换有向图下保持跟踪与编队误差有界并收敛，且对持续局部误差具有可量化的衰减作用；高保真仿真显示其比直接延迟耦合更鲁棒，但不可观测的定位偏差和时钟偏移仍是精度限制因素。

Abstract: Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) that transport a load together must keep a formation while each vehicle tracks its own reference, and they coordinate over wireless links with link-dependent, time-varying and jumping delays. We propose a cascade design for differential-drive AGVs modelled as kinematic unicycles: delayed data from the neighbours drive only a second-order filter that shifts each vehicle's own reference, and an unmodified gain-scheduled tracking law follows the shifted reference. A saturation keeps the shifted reference feasible, and the feed-forward is exact, so the tracking loop never sees the network. We prove that tracking and formation errors remain bounded for arbitrary delays and converge for every bounded delay and every directed, possibly switching, graph. We also construct a strict Lyapunov function with explicit constants and prove exponential convergence and a local input-to-state estimate with delay-independent gains. On undirected graphs, the coupling attenuates the formation error caused by persistent local errors by at least the factor lambda/(lambda+Lambda*lambda_2(L)) (leak lambda, coupling gain Lambda, algebraic connectivity lambda_2(L)), for any delay. Every inequality is verified with an event-driven, error-controlled simulation. A robustness study on a high-fidelity AGV model (drive dynamics, slip, localisation errors, clock offsets, lossy Wi-Fi) comprises 4,894 runs, including paired comparisons against tuned baselines. The cascade never failed, with latencies up to 4 s, 90% packet loss and up to 12 vehicles, whereas a direct delayed coupling failed when its gain saturated the drives. Coupling reduced the formation error after traction losses by 21-32% and after safety stops by up to 47%, at the price of tracking accuracy. Localisation bias and clock offsets, which no coupling law can observe, limit the achievable accuracy.

</details>


### [490] [ROVO: Robust Rotation-Only Visual Odometry for UAVs at Low and Moderate Altitudes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32475)
*Xiaokai Song,Li Zhang,Xichao Teng,Erting Pan,Yibin Ye,Kun Wang,Leqi Liu,Guangcheng Dai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出面向单目无人机航拍图像的纯旋转视觉里程计ROVO，通过估计并鲁棒融合图像间旋转来提升轨迹姿态估计鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低中等高度下，图像噪声会严重干扰单目视觉导航中的旋转和平移估计，微小扰动可能导致平移方向出现较大误差；长距离视觉感知中的角度线索启发了仅利用旋转信息的思路。

Method: ROVO从匹配图像中估计成对旋转，在重叠窗口内进行鲁棒平均，并通过共享帧对齐相邻窗口；轨迹状态仅保留方向信息，从而避免不确定的地标深度传播到后续估计。

Result: 轨迹仿真中，滑动窗口ROVO的平均方向误差仅为传统SLAM基线的10.7%；真实飞行数据在原始Bell412设置下达到与ORB-SLAM3和DPVO相当的旋转精度；在更窄视场或更高飞行高度下，相对旋转RMSE较各对比中次优方法降低19.7%至69.4%。

Conclusion: ROVO能够为单目航拍图像提供鲁棒且准确的旋转估计，尤其在窄视场和高空等挑战性场景中优于对比方法。

Abstract: Image noise can confound rotation and translation estimates in monocular visual navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) at low and moderate altitudes, where even small perturbations may cause large errors in translation direction. Inspired by angular cues in long-range visual perception, we propose rotation-only visual odometry (ROVO) for monocular aerial imagery. ROVO estimates pairwise rotations from matched images, robustly averages them over overlapping windows, and aligns consecutive windows through shared frames. By retaining only orientation in the trajectory state, it prevents uncertain landmark depth from propagating to later estimates. In trajectory simulation, sliding-window ROVO achieved a mean orientation error just 10.7% as large as that of the conventional SLAM baseline. On real flight data, ROVO achieved rotation accuracy comparable to ORB-SLAM3 and DPVO under the original Bell412 settings. With a narrower FoV or at higher flight altitude, ROVO reduced relative rotation RMSE by 19.7--69.4% compared with the next-best method in each comparison. Code and simulation tools are available at https://github.com/sssxxxkkkk/ROVO.

</details>


### [491] [ViTacLab: Physically Consistent Visuo-Tactile Simulation, Benchmarking, and Representation Learning for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32476)
*Linjing You,Zeming Yang,Zhenhao Shen,Shengqiang Xu,Guanda Li,Wenxuan Li,Jiyu Guo,Jasper Lu,Kyle Xu,Shawn Xie,Junjie Zhu,Siyu Wu,Jian Liu,Changhao Zhang,Rongchong Li,Zeyi Li,Hengshuang Zhao,Ruihai Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ViTacLab 统一框架，包含 ViTacSim 仿真器、ViTacBench 基准和 ViTacPolicy 策略，用于接触丰富的机器人操作与视触觉学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视触觉仿真器难以兼顾物理保真度与可扩展性，且基准多局限于两指夹爪，缺少对灵巧手、双臂和触觉主导任务的系统评测。

Method: ViTacSim 采用稀疏接触力晶格、稠密力阵列和触觉图像三模态触觉表示，基于 PhysX 接触求解结果进行局部刚度对齐、滑移-粘滞解耦下的切向力重建及摩擦锥投影；ViTacBench 覆盖平行夹爪、灵巧手和双臂系统；ViTacPolicy 用空间位姿嵌入和 Transformer 聚合异构触觉输入，并用共享码本的双流 VQ-VAE 对齐力阵列与触觉图像。

Result: Hertzian 压痕和真实传感器滑动测试将法向与切向力 RMSE 从 2.31/1.85 N 降至 0.42/0.53 N；256 个并行环境下触觉管线吞吐达 2482.9 FPS。仿真和真实实验在多个接触丰富任务上取得提升，但触觉主导任务的绝对成功率仍较低。

Conclusion: ViTacLab 提供了可扩展、较高保真度的触觉仿真、基准与策略学习框架，但纯触觉控制仍是尚未解决的难点。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but existing visuo-tactile simulators trade physical fidelity for scalability, and benchmarks largely focus on two-finger grippers. We present ViTacLab, a framework comprising ViTacSim, ViTacBench, and ViTacPolicy. ViTacSim uses a tri-modal tactile primitive: a global sparse contact-force lattice, a local dense force array, and tactile images. Anchored to PhysX contact-solver outputs, it corrects normal inconsistency through local stiffness alignment and reconstructs tangential forces under decoupled slip-stick regimes while preserving GPU parallelism. A joint projection preserves the sparse wrench and enforces local friction cones. ViTacBench spans parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and bimanual systems, with tasks ranging from vision-dominant to tactile-dominant regimes. ViTacPolicy aggregates variable numbers of heterogeneous tactile inputs using spatial-pose embeddings and a Transformer, and aligns force-array and tactile-image modalities through a two-stream VQ-VAE with a shared codebook. Controlled Hertzian-reference indentation and real-sensor sliding tests reduce normal and tangential force RMSE from 2.31 and 1.85 N to 0.42 and 0.53 N, respectively. Throughput reaches 2,482.9 tactile-pipeline FPS at 256 parallel environments. Simulation and real-world experiments show gains on several contact-rich tasks, while low absolute success on tactile-dominant tasks highlights the remaining difficulty of purely tactile control.

</details>


### [492] [CodeWAM: A Code World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32483)
*Zhisheng Chen,Jinpeng Wang,Beicheng Lou,Zhengwei Xie,Hao Wu,Rui Qian,Kun Wang,Vivian W. H. Wong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 CodeWAM，一种将可执行代码纳入世界表示的自驾世界模型，用代码刻画自车在候选规划下的状态演化，并用学习到的视觉模型建模场景相关后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶世界模型需要同时表达周围场景以及候选规划下自车的运动后果，仅依赖学习式表示难以清晰刻画规划执行带来的自车状态转移。

Method: CodeWAM 将可执行代码作为世界表示的一部分：代码根据规划执行描述车辆状态演化，视觉模型捕捉场景相关结果；执行代码生成候选条件运动序列，并与先前规划及运动历史比较，联合执行后果与场景预测表示候选未来；被选规划进入下一决策的执行上下文以连接连续选择。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 达到 93.6 PDMS，在 v2 navtest 达到 92.1 EPDMS，在 NAVHARD 达到 50.6 EPDMS；进一步实验显示成对执行一致性提升，并在无需额外训练下于 Hydra-MDP 和 DrivoR 上获得增益。

Conclusion: 可执行代码可作为驾驶世界模型的有效补充表示，有助于更完整地评估候选规划的未来后果与执行一致性。

Abstract: Driving world models anticipate action consequences through representations of how the world evolves. For autonomous driving, these representations must capture both the surrounding scene and the ego vehicle's motion under a candidate plan. We propose CodeWAM, a driving world model that incorporates executable code as part of its world representation. Code represents ego dynamics by expressing how the vehicle state evolves under plan execution, while a learned visual model captures scene-dependent consequences. Executing the code produces a candidate-conditioned motion sequence, which is evaluated relative to the prior plan and recorded motion history. The resulting execution consequences and learned scene outcomes jointly represent the candidate's future, enabling the planner to assess both what a plan may lead to and how the vehicle transitions into that future. The selected plan becomes part of the next decision's execution context, linking successive choices within the model. CodeWAM achieves 93.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, 92.1 EPDMS on v2 navtest, and 50.6 EPDMS on NAVHARD. Further experiments demonstrate improved pairwise execution consistency and gains on Hydra-MDP and DrivoR without additional training, supporting executable code as a complementary representation for driving world models.

</details>


### [493] [CoFiNav: VLM-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Semantic Navigation for Open-Ended Last-Mile UAV Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32493)
*Xuanpu Wang,Shun Hu,Bing Li,Rongqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出CoFiNav，一种由视觉语言模型引导的粗到细无人机语义导航框架，用于根据开放式语义描述而非精确坐标完成末端配送导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机配送依赖精确终端坐标、预定义终端规格或任务专用定位流程，限制了配送范围和灵活性；开放式语义描述虽提供新范式，但传统空中导航方法难以泛化到开放词汇终端导航场景。

Method: CoFiNav利用任务描述、OpenStreetMap粗先验地图和累积观测，通过视觉语言模型决定下一步应验证的未解析实体或空间关系；几何感知模块将语义观测请求转换为基于RGB图像和LiDAR的可行视点，再由传统运动规划安全执行，实现分层语义搜索和主动三维观测的粗到细定位。

Result: 在多个城市环境中的实验表明，CoFiNav在成功率上优于代表性适配基线，同时所需飞行路径更短、观测次数更少。

Conclusion: CoFiNav能够支持基于开放式语义描述的无人机末端配送导航，提升开放词汇终端定位的泛化能力，并在成功率和效率方面表现更优。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) delivery is an important application of the low-altitude economy, enhancing the flexibility and accessibility of last-mile logistics. Existing UAV delivery methods generally rely on precise terminal coordinates, predefined terminal specifications, or task-specific localization procedures, limiting the scope and flexibility of delivery. As UAV logistics becomes more intelligent, open-ended semantic descriptions offer a new paradigm for specifying terminal destinations.
