However, conventional aerial navigation methods have limited ability to generalize to delivery scenarios that require open-vocabulary terminal navigation. To enable this broader delivery paradigm, we propose CoFiNav, a VLM-guided coarse-to-fine UAV semantic navigation framework that progressively grounds relation-defined terminal destinations through hierarchical semantic search and active 3D observation. Given a task description, a coarse prior map from OpenStreetMap (OSM), and accumulated observations, CoFiNav uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine which unresolved entity or spatial relation should be verified next. A geometry-aware module converts the semantic observation request into feasible viewpoints using RGB images and LiDAR, while conventional motion planning handles safe execution. Experiments across multiple urban environments show that CoFiNav outperforms representative adapted baselines in success rate while requiring shorter flight paths and fewer observations.

</details>


### [494] [MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32502)
*Ning Wang,Yoshihiko Nakamura,Tianwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions

</details>


### [495] [AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32523)
*Kuan Xu,Tianxin Hu,Ruofei Bai,Ruimeng Liu,Yuefan Hao,Zeyu Jiang,Zitong Zhan,Shenghai Yuan,Chen Wang,Lihua Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AirLeg 是一个自监督视觉-惯性-腿式 SLAM 系统，通过视觉与腿式本体感知相互促进，实现低成本腿式机器人定位，并在仿真预训练与真实部署中持续自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习式腿式里程计受监督信号限制：仿真训练存在 sim-to-real 差距，真实标签依赖昂贵传感器或继承视觉估计误差。

Method: 提出 AirLeg：在仿真中预训练腿式里程计网络，并用 imperative learning 在无真值下适配机器人；通过多传感器 bundle adjustment，用腿式里程计优化视觉地图，再由视觉地图监督网络；部署时融合估计在线自适应网络。采用双窗口估计器融合视觉、IMU 和腿式里程计，引入形变感知约束关联负载足与视觉重建地形，并用方差分量估计加权约束。

Result: AirLeg 完成全部 17 个 GrandTour 序列，在 19 种方法中平均误差最低（0.19 m）；在低成本四足机器人上仅用 0.5 小时无标签数据达到最低漂移（0.6%），并在嵌入式计算机上实时运行。

Conclusion: AirLeg 证明了自监督视觉-惯性-腿式融合可在无真值标签条件下实现高精度、低漂移、实时的腿式机器人定位，并有效缓解 sim-to-real 与监督信号受限问题。

Abstract: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.

</details>


### [496] [ContinualDrive: A Deployment-Anchored, Multi-Axis Benchmark for Continual Updates of Learned Driving Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32529)
*Zirui Li,Zhiqi Mao,Yangang Ren,Heye Huang,Haohan Yang,Qihang Huang,Zhan Chen,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 ContinualDrive，一个以部署模型为锚点的驾驶规划器部署后持续学习基准，系统研究更新是否真正优于已部署检查点，并揭示评估选择会如何改变结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习评估很少回答“更新后是否优于已部署模型”，且结论依赖未明确说明的评估设置，因此需要部署锚定、可复现的基准与报告规范。

Method: 在 nuPlan 真实日志上按场景类型组依次更新已部署规划器，对同一检查点做开环和闭环评估；显式定义四个测量轴（评估回路、参考检查点、时间聚合、流协议），并将三值发布判定锚定到部署检查点。实验覆盖 PlanTF 与 Diffusion Planner，采用全量微调、adapter 或 LoRA，结合/不结合 replay 或梯度投影，并测试三种任务顺序。

Result: 改变任一评估轴可使结论反转或消失：开环 ADE 在一半核心套件运行中把最终 PlanTF 排在部署模型之上，而所有闭环分数均排在其下；反向迁移未捕捉该损失，且每组刚学完时平均已存在损失；训练种子间排名变化远小于任务顺序间变化。核心套件中无方案在闭环上可测地优于部署规划器；在十倍以上面板中所有最终检查点均落后；全组联合训练可恢复部分损失，但未超过其 nuPlan 闭环分数。

Conclusion: 论文将发现提炼为持续学习报告契约，并承诺发布代码和全部检查点，强调部署后更新评估需明确评估轴并以部署模型为基准。

Abstract: Learned driving planners keep being updated after deployment as new logs arrive, yet continual learning evaluations rarely ask whether an update improves on the deployed model, and their verdicts rest on unstated evaluation choices. We present ContinualDrive, a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners. It updates a deployed planner on real-world nuPlan logs one scenario-type group at a time, evaluates the same checkpoints in open and closed loop, makes four measurement axes explicit (evaluation loop, reference checkpoint, temporal aggregation and stream protocol), and anchors a three-valued release verdict to the deployed checkpoint. We study two planners (PlanTF and Diffusion Planner) under full fine-tuning and adapter or LoRA updates, with and without replay or gradient projection, in three task orders. Verdicts can reverse or vanish when one axis changes: open-loop ADE ranks the final PlanTF model above the deployed one in half of its core-suite runs, whereas every closed-loop score ranks it below; backward transfer misses this loss, which on average is already present when each group has just been learned; and regime rankings vary far less across training seeds than across task orders. In the core suite of full and adapter updates, no regime measurably improved on the deployed planner in closed loop; on a panel more than ten times larger every evaluated final checkpoint trails it, and joint training on all groups recovers much of the loss without exceeding its nuPlan closed-loop score. We distill these findings into a reporting contract and will release the code and all checkpoints.

</details>


### [497] [Next-Manip: On-Demand Agent-Policy Collaboration for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32533)
*Jiayi Liu,Ke Ye,Jiaming Zhou,Yufei Huang,Haotian Liang,Kun-Yu Lin,Junwei Liang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Next-Manip，一种按需协作的智能体—策略框架，通过轻量控制器动态分配多模态智能体与学习策略的执行权，在保持精细控制的同时降低智能体推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人操作需要任务推理、失败恢复和精确控制，但操作数据有限，单一策略难以同时具备这些能力。多模态智能体擅长推理与恢复但缺乏细粒度控制且推理成本高；学习策略执行高效但泛化受限于已学技能。直接结合二者又需频繁判断由哪个执行器行动，若每次都依赖智能体决策则成本过高。

Method: 提出 Next-Manip 按需智能体—策略协作框架，将执行器分配与昂贵的智能体推理解耦。设计 Agent Invocation Controller（AIC），用轻量分类器根据当前执行需求在策略与智能体之间分配控制权；并引入 Task Dynamics Context（TDC），将上下文示例中有信息的操作变化打包为紧凑任务参考，以支持智能体推理和执行器分配。

Result: 在两个仿真基准和真实世界实验中，Next-Manip 达到最先进性能，同时降低了智能体推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过按需调用智能体并将执行器分配从昂贵推理中解耦，Next-Manip 能结合多模态智能体的推理恢复能力与学习策略的高效精细执行能力，实现更高效且性能更强的机器人操作。

Abstract: General-purpose robotic manipulation requires task reasoning, failure recovery, and precise control, yet limited manipulation data make these abilities difficult to obtain from a single policy. Recent multimodal agents show promise in task reasoning and recovery but lack reliable fine-grained control and incur high inference cost, whereas learned policies provide efficient fine-grained execution but struggle beyond their learned skills. Although their complementary strengths suggest combining the two, doing so requires repeatedly deciding which executor should act as task demands change. Instead of relying on the agent for each decision, we present Next-Manip, an on-demand agent--policy collaboration framework that decouples executor allocation from costly agent inference. We propose an Agent Invocation Controller (AIC) that allocates control between the policy and the agent through a lightweight classifier of current execution demands. We further introduce Task Dynamics Context (TDC), which packages informative manipulation changes from in-context examples into compact task references to support both agent reasoning and executor allocation. Across two simulation benchmarks and real-world experiments, Next-Manip achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing agent inference costs.

</details>


### [498] [EmbodiedStudio: A Task-Driven Simulation Generation Platform for Embodied Learning and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32534)
*Yang Zhao,Xubo Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 EmbodiedStudio，一个任务驱动的仿真生成平台，通过闭环仿真反馈与独立审查联合生成场景、任务、机器人行为和评分规则，以提升任务环境可用性与评分可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景与任务生成器虽能扩展仿真环境供给，但生成场景常缺乏任务交互支持或物理稳定性，评分程序也常未忠实实现任务条件，导致可用任务环境仍难获得。

Method: 构建 EmbodiedStudio 平台，联合编写场景、任务、机器人行为和评分规则，并利用编码智能体在仿真中迭代调试场景、行为和带状态评分规则，同时引入闭环仿真反馈与独立审查；过程还产生环境构建经验和物理执行经验，并绑定冻结环境版本以支持可重复评估。

Result: 在场景生成、评分规则评估、消融和学习研究中，EmbodiedStudio 显著提升任务就绪度与评分忠实性，同时改善物理稳定性，并保留用于布局编写与策略适应的可操作监督信号。

Conclusion: EmbodiedStudio 通过闭环、任务驱动的联合仿真生成与审查，有效弥合生成场景可用性和评分程序忠实性之间的实践缺口，并为环境构建与策略学习提供可复用经验。

Abstract: Training and evaluating robots across diverse tasks requires a supply of simulation environments suited to those tasks. While recent scene and task generators offer a promising way to expand this supply, delivering a usable task environment still faces two practical gaps: generated scenes that look plausible in appearance often fail to support the intended task interactions or remain physically stable in simulation, and generated scoring programs frequently attempt task conditions without implementing them faithfully. We present EmbodiedStudio, a task-driven simulation generation platform that bridges these gaps by jointly authoring scene, task, robot-behavior, and rubric programs under closed-loop simulation feedback and independent review. Crucially, as the coding agent iteratively debugs scenes, behaviors, and stateful rubrics in simulation, this closed-loop process natively yields both forward construction experience for learning to build environments and physical execution experience for policy learning, all bound to frozen environment revisions for repeatable evaluation. Across scene generation, rubric evaluation, ablations, and learning studies, EmbodiedStudio substantially improves task readiness and rubric faithfulness while improving physical stability and retaining actionable supervision signals for layout authoring and policy adaptation.

</details>


### [499] [Self-supervised quality evaluation of grid maps without ground truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32550)
*Unal Artan,Manuel Castellano-Quero,Johannes A. Stork,Martin Magnusson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅以2D占据栅格地图为输入的自监督地图质量评估方法，利用自编码器重构地图块，通过重构损失识别需要进一步检查的异常区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地图广泛用于机器人定位与路径规划，识别地图中错误或不准确区域是研究热点；大型环境人工编辑耗时，且现有地图质量评估方法通常依赖真实标签或标注信息，难以获取。

Method: 从地图中提取局部块，使用自编码器学习地图的主导结构；通过计算每个地图块的重构损失判断其是否包含异常结构，从而标记需要进一步调查的区域。方法不依赖底层建图算法，仅使用给定地图作为输入。

Result: 在基准数据集上对先进栅格建图方法的结果以及仓库环境地图进行实验，表明该方法能够识别稀疏数据、杂乱区域和配准错误等问题区域。

Conclusion: 自监督地图质量评估可在无标签条件下辅助机器人地图自省与地图编辑，适用于复杂环境，并能指出需要进一步检查的地图区域。

Abstract: Maps are widely used in the robotics community for localization and path planning and the ability to identify incorrect or inaccurate regions of a map is an area of active research interest. For large environments, manual edits of the map can be very time consuming and a tool which can assist a map editor is needed. With this paper, we contribute to robot introspection through self-assessment of map quality, using only a given map as input to be independent of the underlying mapping algorithm. Current methods for map quality assessment rely on ground-truth or labelled information for training classifiers, both of which can be difficult to obtain. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised learning approach to map quality assessment of 2D occupancy grid maps which identifies regions of a map that require further investigation. We leverage an autoencoder for patches extracted from the map to capture the dominant structure of the map. By evaluating the reconstruction loss of a patch reconstructed with the learned model, we can evaluate whether it contains an unusual structure, which indicates the need of further investigation. We evaluate our method on the outcome of state-of-the-art grid mapping methods using benchmark datasets as well as maps from warehouse environments, highlighting the application to more complex environments. We show that the method identifies regions with sparse data, clutter, and misregistrations.

</details>


### [500] [MXI-MemICL: Towards In-Context Robot Manipulation through Self-Retrieved Interaction Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32564)
*Jialong Peng,Shihao Zhou,Feng Yan,Wen Xiao,Haozheng Wang,Wenqi Ren,Wenyuan Sheng,Jian Qiao,Jiaxu Miao,Lin Ma,Chao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MXI-MemICL，一种面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的记忆引导上下文学习框架，使机器人能从单次演示中获取新技能，无需参数更新、大规模预训练或额外标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人上下文学习方法要么依赖受限于稀缺且昂贵机器人交互数据的大规模预训练，要么需要额外标注且跨任务泛化能力不足，因此需要一种更高效、可泛化的ICL方案。

Method: 将演示视为可检索记忆；用视觉-动作因果编码器把动作及其观察效果编码为可复用记忆；用意图预测器预测下一阶段意图并查询记忆；通过experience-token前缀和带学习门控的交叉注意力将检索经验注入语言主干，引导动作生成。

Result: 在RoboCasa365和RoboTwin 2.0上分别较基线提升+8.2%和+14.4%；真实机器人实验提升+9.0%；加入演示后在已见任务上+5.0%，未见任务上+16.7%。

Conclusion: MXI-MemICL通过记忆引导的上下文学习有效提升机器人操作成功率和跨任务泛化能力，且不依赖大规模预训练或专门标注，代码将公开。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) offers robots a way to acquire new skills from a single demonstration without parameter updates. However, existing robotic ICL methods either rely on large-scale pretraining constrained by scarce, costly robot interaction data or require additional annotations yet struggle to generalize across tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose MXI-MemICL, a framework for memory-guided ICL in vision-language-action (VLA) models. By treating demonstrations as retrievable memory, MXI-MemICL enables in-context manipulation without additional large-scale pretraining or specialized annotations. Specifically, a visual-action causal encoder turns actions and their observed effects in demonstrations and completed interactions into reusable memory to guide execution. To retrieve experience suited to upcoming execution, an intention predictor forecasts the next stage's intent and uses it to query memory. The retrieved experience conditions the language backbone through experience-token prefixes and gated cross-attention, guiding action generation with a learned gate that regulates its influence. MXI-MemICL improves success over the baseline by +8.2% and +14.4% on RoboCasa365 and RoboTwin 2.0. Real-robot experiments show a +9.0% gain, with demonstrations adding +5.0% on seen and +16.7% on unseen tasks. The code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [501] [Follow-Bench 2.0: An End-to-End 3D Benchmark for Socially-Aware Robot Person Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32579)
*Hanjing Ye,Tianle Zeng,Jianwei Peng,Yanci Wen,Yuchen Zhou,Yonggen Ling,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Follow-Bench 2.0，一个端到端3D基准，用于在耦合感知与规划挑战下评估社交感知机器人人物跟随（RPF）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只能部分评估RPF：具身视觉跟踪基准侧重目标可见性且社交交互有限，行人重识别基准缺乏闭环控制，运动规划基准常假设目标与行人状态已知。

Method: 基于Unreal Engine构建难度分级场景，包含多样人流、光照天气、杂乱布局、瓶颈、排队行为、干扰物和临时遮挡；统一闭环协议支持模块化感知-规划流水线、端到端视觉策略和基础模型主动跟踪器；评估后随与侧随配置，并报告任务成功、目标可见性、目标恢复、社交空间侵入、跟随队形和运动平滑性等安全-舒适指标。

Result: 实验表明，面向RPF的模块化流水线在近距离和社交舒适跟随方面显著优于当前端到端视觉策略，但在交互密集环境和侧随场景中社交感知RPF仍远未解决。

Conclusion: Follow-Bench 2.0为研究感知误差、遮挡、人群交互和跟随配置如何共同影响机器人人物跟随提供了诊断平台。

Abstract: Socially-aware robot person following (RPF) requires a mobile robot to follow a designated person in dynamic human environments while maintaining target identity, avoiding obstacles and pedestrians, and preserving socially comfortable formations. Existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this coupled problem: embodied visual tracking benchmarks emphasize target visibility with limited social interaction, person re-identification benchmarks study perception without closed-loop control, and motion-planning benchmarks often assume ground-truth target and pedestrian states. We introduce Follow-Bench 2.0, an end-to-end 3D benchmark for evaluating socially-aware RPF under coupled perception--planning challenges. Built in Unreal Engine, Follow-Bench 2.0 provides difficulty-leveled scenarios with diverse pedestrian flows, lighting and weather conditions, cluttered layouts, bottlenecks, queueing behaviors, distractors, and temporary target occlusions. The benchmark supports modular perception--planning pipelines, end-to-end visual policies, and foundation-model-based active trackers under a unified closed-loop protocol. It further evaluates both back- and side-following configurations and reports safety--comfort metrics covering task success, target visibility, target recovery, social-space intrusion, following formation, and motion smoothness. Experiments show that RPF-oriented modular pipelines substantially outperform current end-to-end visual policies on close and socially comfortable following, but also reveal that socially-aware RPF remains far from solved in interaction-heavy environments and especially in side-following. Follow-Bench 2.0 therefore provides a diagnostic platform for studying how perception errors, occlusions, crowd interactions, and following configurations jointly affect robot person following.

</details>


### [502] [Design, Control, and Teleoperation of a Dexterous Robotic Hand with Soft-Rigid Hybrid Fingers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32582)
*Chao Liu,Wil J. Norton,Brandon Romero,Daniela Rus*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将软硬混合机器人手指扩展为五指腱驱动灵巧手，结合结构柔顺性与刚性骨架，并用线性控制实现通用软抓取，通过遥操作实验验证其在多种抓取和操作任务中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人手增加柔顺性可提升抓取质量和环境接触鲁棒性，但纯软体手通常比刚性手更难控制和建模，因此需要兼顾柔顺性与可控性的设计。

Method: 设计五指软硬混合手，共12个主动自由度，采用腱驱动和刚性骨架结合的结构柔顺性；提出手指与整手的位置/任务空间控制器及遥操作框架，并在多种抓取与操作任务中评估。

Result: 该手可完成人类抓取姿态范围中33种里的28种（84.8%）；伸展速度最高达1432deg/s，高于等效人类关节的700deg/s；在薄变形物体（如纸币、折叠布料）和柔软/精细目标操作中表现优势。

Conclusion: 软硬混合架构结合线性控制策略能有效实现高柔顺、高通用性的五指灵巧抓取与操作，并简化软体手的控制与建模难度。

Abstract: Adding compliance to robot hands results in higher grasp quality and robust contact with the environment. Soft hands are inherently compliant, but are typically more complex to control and model than rigid equivalents.
  We extend prior work on soft-rigid hybrid robot fingers into a five-fingered dexterous gripper --- an integrated tendon-driven hand that is highly compliant and controllable. Structural compliance combined with a rigid skeleton, when realized in a five-fingered hand, allow us to use linear control to achieve soft-grasping generality. We evaluate the use of this hand in a variety of teleoperated manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of the overall mechanical design and control strategy. Our contributions include: (1) Mechanical design of the a five-fingered Soft-Rigid Hybrid Hand, composed of 12 active degrees of freedom, demonstrating a high degree on generalization enabled by the soft-rigid architecture, with our gripper, able to complete 28 of the 33 (84.8\%) grasp postures in the human range. (2) Precise, high bandwidth (up to 1432deg/s extension speed, compared with 700deg/s for the equivalent human joint). (3) Position and task space controllers for the soft-rigid hybrid finger and whole hand. (4) A teleoperation framework for control of this hand, as well as demonstrations of its efficacy in a variety of grasping and manipulation tasks
  Further tests illustrate the hand's advantages in completing non-rigid manipulation tasks, such as picking up thin deformable objects (such as a dollar bill or folding cloth) as well as in interfacing with soft or delicate targets.

</details>


### [503] [An XR-Based System for Enhanced Spatial Awareness in Mobile Robot Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32584)
*Subhransu Sourav Priyadarshan,Valentina Pericu,Federico Rollo,Gianni Viardo Vercelli,Navvab Kashiri*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种集成沉浸式视觉与触觉反馈的多模态扩展现实（XR）机器人遥操作与场景探索系统，用于提升移动机器人在危险环境中的态势感知与操控体验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人遥操作在危险环境中很重要，但缺乏有效可视化与控制界面时态势感知困难；同时，360度摄像头画面在头显中易引发晕动症，低能见度或狭窄环境中的避障也存在挑战。

Method: 系统采用固定双摄像头配置：前向摄像头用于主导航，后向摄像头增强态势感知并减少晕动症；使用16通道Velodyne LiDAR生成实时2D占据栅格地图，并将其转换为手持控制器的振动触觉反馈，以实现直观的非视觉障碍检测。

Result: 20名参与者的人体评估表明，该触觉反馈模态显著降低了遥操作过程中障碍物避让相关的认知负荷。

Conclusion: 多模态XR视觉与触觉反馈相结合的遥操作界面能够改善移动机器人远程操作中的态势感知和避障体验，并减少认知负担。

Abstract: Teleoperation of mobile robots represents a critical capability for operations in hazardous environments, yet maintaining adequate situational awareness remains challenging without effective visualization and control interfaces. This work presents a multi-modal extended reality (XR) system for robot teleoperation and scene exploration that integrates immersive visual and haptic feedback modalities. To address motion sickness commonly induced by 360-degree camera feeds in head-mounted displays (HMDs), the system employs a fixed dual-camera configuration: a forward-facing camera for primary navigation and a rear-facing camera for enhanced situational awareness without operator discomfort. For navigation in confined or low-visibility conditions, a 16-channel Velodyne LiDAR generates real-time 2D occupancy grid maps, which are converted into vibrational haptic feedback on handheld controllers to provide intuitive, non-visual obstacle detection. User evaluation with 20 participants demonstrates that this haptic modality significantly reduces the cognitive load associated with obstacle avoidance during teleoperation.

</details>


### [504] [RoboRecast: Intent-Preserving Demonstration Augmentation via Diagnosis-Driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32622)
*Yushi Long,Juzhan Xu,Haibin Huang,Chi Zhang,Yin Chen,Sida Peng,Ruizhen Hu,Xiaowei Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboRecast 是一个基于智能体优化的框架，用于将源示范中的关键交互迁移到新的仿真场景中，通过联合优化场景与机器人运动生成可用于策略学习的合成数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 收集多样化的真实世界操作示范成本高昂，因此希望利用仿真增强现有示范；但当物体、布局或机器人发生变化时，直接迁移源示范运动可能导致语义不合理或物理不可行。

Method: 提出 RoboRecast，在保留源任务所需交互的前提下，联合优化仿真场景和机器人运动，使这些交互能在目标设置中执行。当交互失败时，智能体利用仿真反馈诊断原因，修改相关场景或运动参数，并测试修改是否解决失败。该方法可从人类和机器人示范生成合成数据，并适应新布局、新物体和新机器人形态。

Result: 在有目标示范时，加入 RoboRecast 数据可提升真实世界单臂任务和仿真双臂任务中的策略成功率；即使没有目标配置下的示范，RoboRecast 也能将源示范适配到新物体或新机器人形态，以支持策略学习。

Conclusion: RoboRecast 能有效利用仿真反馈进行示范适配和数据增强，在物体、布局和机器人形态变化下提升机器人策略学习的可行性与效果。

Abstract: Collecting diverse real-world manipulation demonstrations is costly, motivating the use of simulation to augment existing demonstrations for robot policy learning. When objects, layouts, or robots change, transferring motions from a source demonstration can produce behavior that is semantically implausible or physically infeasible in the new setting. We introduce RoboRecast, an agentic optimization framework that preserves the interactions required by the source task while jointly optimizing the simulated scene and robot motion to make those interactions executable in the target setting. When an interaction fails, the agent uses simulation feedback to diagnose the cause, revise the relevant scene or motion parameters, and test whether the revision resolves the failure. This flexibility allows RoboRecast to generate synthetic data from both human and robot demonstrations and to adapt them to new layouts, objects, and robot embodiments. When target demonstrations are available, adding RoboRecast data improves policy success on both real-world single-arm and simulated bimanual tasks. Even without demonstrations in the target configuration, RoboRecast adapts source demonstrations to support policy learning with new objects or robot embodiments.

</details>


### [505] [BARE: Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32642)
*Zihao Li,Tong Chen,Hua Song,Zitong Ding,Zihao Xu,Ce Hao,Weibang Bai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出BARE框架，利用人体运动先验实现人形机器人快速局部避障，同时保持全身稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在真实环境中需躲避快速接近物体；相比四足机器人全身大动作，人形机器人可通过局部身体调整实现更快速、占空间更小的避障，但局部调整会改变质量分布或支撑条件，难以兼顾快速避障与全身稳定。

Method: 构建由风险引导的运动适配器，根据受威胁身体区域从重定向人体避障动作库中选择参考动作，并依据碰撞紧迫性调整时间相位；以适配参考和连杆级碰撞风险为条件，通过强化学习训练反射式避障策略，协调局部身体调整与全身稳定。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了BARE能够执行有针对性的局部避障，同时保持全身稳定性。

Conclusion: BARE表明结合人体运动先验与强化学习可使人形机器人实现快速局部反射式避障，并维持全身稳定，为人形机器人安全部署提供可行方案。

Abstract: Dynamic obstacle avoidance is essential for safely deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments, where rapidly approaching objects require immediate evasive responses. Recent advances in reflexive evasion have focused primarily on quadrupeds, which typically rely on large-scale whole-body maneuvers. In contrast, humanoids can exploit their rich body articulation to evade through small, localized body adjustments. By moving threatened body regions without repositioning the entire body, these responses may require less execution time and less surrounding free space. However, local adjustments can alter mass distribution or support conditions, making it challenging to achieve rapid evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. To this end, we propose BARE (Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion), a humanoid reflexive evasion framework guided by human motion priors that enables rapid local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. A risk-guided motion adapter is designed to select reference motions from a retargeted human evasive motion library based on the threatened body region and to adjust their temporal phases based on collision urgency, allowing the robot to reach evasive postures before potential contact. Conditioned on the adapted reference and link-level collision risk, a reflexive evasion policy learns through reinforcement learning to coordinate local body adjustments with whole-body stabilization. We validate BARE in simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating its ability to perform targeted local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability.

</details>


### [506] [DexWAC: A Unified World-Actor-Critic Model for Dexterous Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32654)
*Hongjia Liu,Dacheng Zhou,Minghao Fu,Chuanjun Guo,Tianze Wang,Qingtao Liu,He Wang,Li Yi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 DexWAC，一个统一的世界-演员-评论家模型，在单阶段机器人预训练中联合学习动作策略、动作条件世界模型和自举评论家，并利用想象 rollout 或评论家引导选择改进策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人演示不仅提供可模仿动作，还揭示动作如何改变世界并促成任务成功。现有世界-动作模型仅把未来预测作为策略学习的辅助损失，而多数策略改进方法将动力学与价值分开建模，导致训练开销大且表征共享不足。

Method: DexWAC 基于图像编辑骨干，对每个动作块预测其终点的视觉潜变量与本体感觉，以及奖励和延续信号，从而由世界模型高效生成完整想象转移而无需生成中间视频帧。随后在真实 rollout 上适配世界模型和评论家，并通过想象 rollout 上的 PPO 或评论家引导的 best-of-N 选择改进预训练演员。

Result: DexWAC 在仿真中超过大规模预训练 VLA 和 WAM 基线；在两个真实任务上平均成功率达 75%，而 π0.5 为 45%。其世界模型比基于视频的基线更准确且更快，消融实验确认联合学习动力学和价值能提升策略。

Conclusion: 视觉预测鼓励控制相关特征，价值监督促进任务相关表征，二者共同塑造适合策略学习的表征。统一联合学习世界模型、评论家和演员是有效且高效的机器人策略学习方向。

Abstract: Robot demonstrations provide more than actions to imitate: they reveal how actions change the world and how those changes contribute to task success. Recent world-action models (WAMs) extend vision-language-action (VLA) models with the first signal by jointly predicting actions and future observations, yet this predictive ability serves only as an auxiliary loss for policy learning. Meanwhile, most policy improvement methods learn dynamics and values in separate models, increasing training overhead and limiting representation sharing between these complementary objectives. We introduce DexWAC, a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single robot pretraining stage. Our key insight is that visual prediction encourages control-relevant features, while value supervision promotes task-relevant representations; together, they shape a representation suited to policy learning. Built on an image-editing backbone, DexWAC predicts, for each action chunk, the visual latent and proprioception at its endpoint together with its reward and continuation, so the world model alone efficiently yields complete imagined transitions without generating intermediate video frames. After adapting the world model and critic on real rollouts, we improve the pretrained actor through either PPO on imagined rollouts or critic-guided best-of-$N$ selection. DexWAC surpasses the large-scale pretrained VLA and WAM baselines in simulation and achieves 75% average success on two real-world tasks, compared with 45% for $π_{0.5}$. Its world model is more accurate and faster than video-based baselines, and ablations confirm that learning dynamics and value together improves the policy.

</details>


### [507] [DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32665)
*Sichen Wu,Qian Sun,Mengfan Liu,Weikai Qin,Bike Zhu,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

</details>


### [508] [ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32639)
*Haoyuan Li,Wei Huang,Jiehong Lin,Shengrong Zhang,Chenzhi Liu,Shengchao Zhou,Hehe Fan,Xiaojuan Qi,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 处理失败


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理失败

Method: 处理失败

Result: 处理失败

Conclusion: 处理失败

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables vision-language-action policies to improve through environmental interaction. However, in long-horizon manipulation, sparse success/failure feedback provides little information about where policies encounter bottlenecks. Moreover, repeated full-task rollouts also leave these bottlenecks weakly analyzed and insufficiently practiced. To this end, we introduce ReFocus, a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that alternates between Global and Local RL to identify task-specific bottlenecks and allocate additional practice to them. Specifically, during Global RL, we decompose each task into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of subtasks. Then a DAG-based Progress Reward is leveraged for both policy training and bottleneck diagnosis. Based on the identified bottlenecks, ReFocus selects Adaptive Practice Windows, defining task segments from an entry stage to a target stage. It allocates additional interaction to these segments during Local RL while updating the entire policy. After that, it evaluates the policy to perform the full task for the next round of RL, forming an iteration between Global and Local RL. Experiments on LIBERO-Long and RoboCasa365 show that ReFocus achieves success rates of 97.8% and 51.3%, respectively, compared with 90.6% and 39.3% for the $π_{0.5}$ baseline. Furthermore, we evaluate a real-world adaptation on three long-horizon tasks. On BreadBaker, ReFocus achieves 95% success, compared with 30% for the $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://refocus-robotics.github.io.

</details>


### [509] [Semidefinite Programming for Cold-Start GNSS Doppler-Based Alignment: A Comparison with Nonlinear Least Squares](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32715)
*Baoshan Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文比较非线性最小二乘（NLS）与半正定规划（SDP）在GNSS多普勒初始姿态对齐中的表现，并提出将模块化对偶SDP证书器附加到流形NLS求解器上的方法，以兼顾全局精度、低时延和原生协方差输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多传感器融合导航在联合处理全局与局部量测前，需要完成局部导航坐标系与ECEF坐标系之间的初始姿态对齐。基于GNSS多普勒的方法无需载波相位模糊度固定或多天线硬件，但该非凸问题用局部NLS易陷入局部极小，而直接SDP松弛时延高且不输出局部协方差。

Method: 在统一的最大似然多普勒目标下，系统比较NLS与SDP；通过蒙特卡洛仿真和三个真实驾驶数据集评估；提出在标准流形NLS求解器上附加模块化对偶SDP证书器，用拉格朗日对偶验证固定NLS候选是否达到全局下界，而无需调用完整SDP求解器。

Result: 附加对偶SDP证书器后，方法在0.001度以内恢复直接SDP的全局精度；将真实场景95百分位偏航误差从超过86度降至2.88至4.70度；中位求解时间最多缩短一个数量级，同时保留NLS原生雅可比协方差。

Conclusion: 候选驱动的证书机制能够连接局部估计与全局优化：SDP松弛扩大可行域并保持提升后的代价，使对偶验证可在不完整求解SDP的情况下确认NLS候选的全局最优性；同时该架构非侵入、可直接接入现有导航流程，保留切空间协方差输出和低典型时延。

Abstract: Initial attitude alignment between local navigation frames and the Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) frame is a critical prerequisite for multi-sensor integrated navigation, such as Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)/inertial/odometry fusion, before global and local measurements can be jointly processed. While GNSS Doppler-based alignment eliminates the need for carrier-phase ambiguity resolution or multi-antenna hardware, solving this non-convex problem via local nonlinear least squares (NLS) suffers from local minima, whereas direct semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation incurs high latency and omits local covariance outputs. This study systematically compares NLS and SDP on a unified maximum-likelihood Doppler objective across Monte Carlo simulations and three real-world driving datasets. We demonstrate that attaching a modular dual SDP certifier to a standard manifold NLS solver recovers the global accuracy of direct SDP within 0.001 degrees, reduces real-world 95th-percentile yaw errors from over 86 degrees down to 2.88 degrees to 4.70 degrees, and cuts median solve times by up to an order of magnitude while preserving native Jacobian covariances. We conclude that candidate-driven certification bridges local estimation and global optimization due to two structural advantages: (1) our theoretical comparison reveals that SDP relaxation enlarges the feasible region while preserving the lifted cost, allowing Lagrangian duality to verify whether a fixed NLS candidate attains the global lower bound without invoking a full SDP solver, and (2) the candidate-driven architecture acts as a non-intrusive module that plugs directly into existing navigation pipelines without replacing the local estimator, preserving native tangent-space covariance outputs and low typical latency.

</details>


### [510] [DeCoNav-Act: Benchmarking Collective Physical Capability in Multi-Robot Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32683)
*Yunzi Wu,Sunyao Zhou,Xiaotao Zhang,Yucheng Deng,Yuehao Huang,Lin Qian,Xuanrui Cui,Xinhai Li,Chenjia Bai,Hongqing Chu,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 DeCoNav-Act，一个在共享物理仿真中评估语言引导多机器人移动操作协作能力的基准，重点关注机器人是否为队友留下可用的物理状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多机器人基准多关注任务分配和技能排序，很少测试协作后形成的物理状态是否可被队友使用，因此需要评估团队的集体物理能力。

Method: 构建 350 个同构和 150 个异构任务，均通过联合参考执行验证；覆盖共享空间并行负载和物理依赖两类协作机制；除团队成功率外，还测量路径效率、交接覆盖与成功率，并基于验证过的交接前状态进行诊断；评估 ASPIRE、RAX 的传感器适配版本及作者提出的 CoMoMa。

Result: 使用 GPT-5.6-luna 时没有方法完成任务，最多 8.8% 的依赖条件被达到，即使从交接前状态开始也没有完成交接；使用 GPT-6.1-sol 时，CoMoMa 在 26.5% 的试验中建立条件，但仅 4.1% 成功。

Conclusion: 当前方法在多机器人物理协作和交接方面表现很弱，DeCoNav-Act 揭示了共享物理状态可用性方面的关键差距，强调需要提升机器人团队的协调与交接能力。

Abstract: Robot teams can split workloads or combine complementary bodies, but only if each robot leaves the shared world in a state its teammate can use. Existing multi-robot benchmarks emphasize task allocation and skill sequencing, rarely testing whether the resulting physical states are usable. To evaluate collective physical capability, we introduce DeCoNav-Act, a benchmark for language-guided multi-robot mobile manipulation in a shared physics simulation. Its 350 homogeneous and 150 heterogeneous tasks, each verified by joint reference execution, span two coordination mechanisms: parallel workloads in shared space and physical dependencies in which one robot establishes a condition for a teammate to use. Beyond team success, DeCoNav-Act measures path efficiency and handoff coverage and success, and adds a diagnostic from verified pre-handoff states. Evaluating sensor-grounded adaptations of ASPIRE and RAX and our agent CoMoMa, we find that with GPT-5.6-luna no method completes a task, at most 8.8% of dependencies are reached, and even from pre-handoff states no handoff is completed; with GPT-6.1-sol, CoMoMa establishes the condition in 26.5% of trials, but only 4.1% succeed.

</details>


### [511] [Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32718)
*Itai Mizlish,Boaz Ben-Moshe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文将深度基础模型部署到 Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-8L 的整型加速器上：先证明直接量化 Depth Anything V2 会因注意力 softmax 权重低于 int8 步长而显著失效，再通过蒸馏训练无注意力的 ResNet-34 U-Net 学生模型，实现实时、高精度且可支撑导航栈的深度感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型地面机器人只能携带一个相机和几瓦算力，而可把相机变成距离传感器的深度基础模型通常是面向 GPU 的视觉 Transformer，难以在 Raspberry Pi 5 与 Hailo-8L 这类全整型加速器上运行。

Method: 作者分析 Depth Anything V2 在 Hailo-8L 上量化失败的原因：449 个 token 时 91% 的 softmax 权重低于一个 int8 步长，却承载 17-33% 的注意力质量。因此不采用量化，而是从 Depth Anything V2-Large 蒸馏一个无注意力、24.5M 参数的 ResNet-34 U-Net 学生模型；并用地面交点测距、建图、hybrid-A* 规划和 SLAM 在 Pi CPU 上运行。

Result: 学生模型在芯片上达到 27.1 FPS，int8 输出与浮点版本高度一致（Pearson 0.99993）；在模拟场地的留出场景上 AbsRel 为 0.269，优于 0.354-0.530 的其他芯片上深度网络；在真实户外驾驶的 1000 个立体校验点上与厂商 Depth Anything V2-Small 无显著差异，但更快（27.1 vs 21.6 FPS）。硬件在环高斯泼溅重建测试中，10 个场景无碰撞到达目标 7.9±1.1 次，精确障碍物为 9.2±0.4 次，自定位加模拟轮式里程计为 7.7±0.7 次，真实 Pi 与 Hailo-8L 在环为 8.2±0.4 次。

Conclusion: 对小型机器人上的深度基础模型，蒸馏成无注意力学生模型比直接整型量化更可行；该方案能在低成本边缘加速器上实时输出可用深度，并支撑建图、规划与 SLAM 导航栈。

Abstract: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.

</details>


### [512] [AG-WAM: Attention-Guided World Action Model for Accurate and Efficient Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32722)
*Hongcheng Zhang,Lei Sun,Songxuan Liu,Tengteng Pan,Yuqiang Zhai,Xianglong Xu,Jianya Guo,Xiao Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出AG-WAM，通过显式注意力引导统一原则改进世界动作模型，提升机器人操作预测与控制的准确性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型虽联合预测未来观测和机器人动作，但内部注意力分配多为隐式学习，缺乏显式的动作相关注意力引导，限制了模型性能。

Method: 提出端到端Attention-Guided WAM框架，引入三个即插即用的注意力引导模块：内容自适应预测注意力、引导点视觉注意力和状态条件文本注意力，直接重构WAM内部注意力范式，且不依赖外部插件模块。

Result: 在LIBERO-X、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin-2.0等多个公开机器人操作基准上取得新的最优性能，显著优于其他方法，甚至超过使用大量私有具身训练数据的方法，同时提升训练和推理效率。

Conclusion: 显式注意力引导可作为释放世界动作模型能力的统一原则，AG-WAM在不使用私有具身数据的情况下实现了更强性能与更高效率，验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Recently developed World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and robot actions, providing predictive context for control. However, existing WAMs typically learn implicit attention allocation with limited explicit action-relevant attention guidance, leading to limited performance. To unleash strong capabilities of WAMs, we introduce explicit attention guidance as a unifying principle and propose our Attention-Guided WAM (AG-WAM), an end-to-end framework with three plug-and-play attention guidance modules that directly reformulate internal attention paradigm in WAMs: the Content-Adaptive Predictive Attention module, the Guidance-Point Visual Attention module, and the State-Conditioned Text Attention module. Without any external plugin module adopted, our end-to-end framework with the unifying principle of explicit attention guidance boosts the accuracy and efficiency of WAMs. Without using any private embodied training data, our AG-WAM establishes new state-of-the-art performance on multiple public robotic manipulation benchmarks including LIBERO-X, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin-2.0, significantly outperforming other methods, even those using massive private embodied training data by a notable margin, meanwhile notably improving training and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [513] [Support2Sim: Visually Faithful Real2Sim with Stable Object Supports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32727)
*Samarth Chopra,Ankit Prabhu,Akshayan Nagarajah,Sumer Murthy,Pratik Chaudhari,Vijay Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Support2Sim是一个从单张RGB图像重建可仿真场景的Real2Sim系统，重点恢复空间布局与物体间支撑关系，并在有限时间内生成稳定、可仿真的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理仿真需要场景的空间布局和支撑关系，但现有从图像重建场景的方法往往难以同时保证源图像保真、支撑关系实现和仿真稳定性，且需在实用时间预算内完成。

Method: Support2Sim推断支撑图，利用接触引导的姿态初始化器为多支撑物体提出候选姿态，并按几何匹配和源图像一致性排序；随后采用由粗到细的优化器，在固定搜索预算下通过物理仿真评估姿态更新，接受更新后在更细的平移和旋转尺度上继续搜索。

Result: 在覆盖四个数据集的50个场景上，相比最强基线，Support2Sim在10秒后源掩码IoU提升21.4个百分点，预期支撑实现率从73.2%提升到87.1%，平均物体漂移从79.6毫米降至45.3毫米。

Conclusion: Support2Sim能够在实用时间预算内从单张图像重建兼具源保真、支撑关系实现和仿真稳定性的场景，优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Reconstructing a scene for physics simulation requires recovering its spatial layout and the support relationships that govern its behavior. We present Support2Sim, a Real2Sim system that reconstructs simulation-ready scenes from a single RGB image. Our design objective is to maximize source fidelity, support realization, and stability within a practical time budget for scene generation. Support2Sim infers a support graph, which a contact-guided pose initializer uses to propose poses for objects with multiple supports. The initializer generates and ranks candidates by geometric fit and source-image agreement. A coarse-to-fine refiner allocates a fixed search budget across supported objects and evaluates pose updates with physics rollouts. After an accepted update, it searches from the new pose at a finer translation and rotation scale. We benchmark our method on 50 scenes spanning four datasets. Compared with the strongest baseline, Support2Sim improves source-mask IoU after 10 seconds by 21.4 pp, realizes 87.1% versus 73.2% of intended supports, and reduces mean object drift from 79.6 to 45.3 mm. See our project page at https://support2sim.github.io for more details.

</details>


### [514] [Risk-Informed Path Planning: Collision and Grounding Avoidance Application for Autonomous Surface Vessels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32760)
*Emir Cem Gezer,Ozan Kaya,Ingrid B. Utne,Roger Skjetne*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种风险知情的RRT*路径规划器，集成贝叶斯信念网络作为在线风险模型，用于海上自主水面船舶的在线风险评估与决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上自主水面船舶需要在运营前和运营中证明安全性，因此需要在线风险评估来指导海上决策。

Method: 使用BBN评估危险事件的概率和严重度分布，并聚合为有界标量风险指数；在RRT*搜索过程中沿候选边采样点评估该风险指数；规划器优化由路径距离、航向变化惩罚和累积风险组成的复合代价，并受风险接受上限硬约束；每个搜索树顶点存储对应状态的BBN后验，使树可作为可解释的风险地图；同时定义BBN作为风险模型的设计要求，并引入运行时模型将重规划截止时间转化为单次风险计算时间的严格限制。

Result: 在包含碰撞和搁浅危险的模拟港口进入场景中进行演示，测得运行时间验证了规划器在运行时模型预测的单次重规划周期计算边界内运行。

Conclusion: 该风险知情RRT*规划器能够在计算约束内完成在线风险感知路径规划，并通过存储BBN后验提供可解释的风险地图，支持海上自主水面船舶的安全决策。

Abstract: Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) must demonstrate safety before and during operations, necessitating online risk assessment to guide decision-making at sea. This paper presents a risk-informed Rapidly Exploring Random Tree Star (RRT*) path planner that integrates a Bayesian Belief Network (BBN) as an online risk model. The BBN evaluates the probability and severity distribution of hazardous events, which are aggregated into a bounded scalar risk index. During the search, this risk index is evaluated at sample points along candidate edges. The planner optimizes a composite cost function comprising path distance, heading change penalties, and accumulated risk, subject to a hard constraint enforcing a risk acceptance limit. Each search tree vertex stores the BBN posterior at its state, enabling the tree to function as an explainable risk map for individual hazards. We define design requirements for the BBN to serve as the risk model in this context and introduce a runtime model that translates replanning deadlines into strict limits on single risk calculation times. The planner is demonstrated in a simulated harbor entry scenario involving collision and grounding hazards. Measured run times validate that the planner operates within the computational bounds predicted by the runtime model for a single replanning cycle.

</details>


### [515] [Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32786)
*Tingting Liao,Mingjia Huo,Hao Li,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric P. Xing,Guangyi Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SimPWM 将场景表示为显式可扰动的模拟代理：机器人用3D模型、可抓取物体用3D点表示，由无训练参数的规则模拟器根据动作更新状态，再由视频模型渲染。作者通过冻结模拟物体来检验视频是否真正遵循代理状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人视频世界模型常以模拟或渲染的场景代理为条件，并假设生成视频会反映代理内容；验证这一假设需要一个状态显式且可扰动的代理。

Method: 给定标定相机，SimPWM仅从首帧构建机器人3D模型和物体3D点；规则模拟器在动作下移动它们，视频模型渲染结果。随后在DROID片段上冻结模拟物体、保持机械臂按记录运动，检查视频是否仍显示物体被抬起，并与端到端模型及不同基础视频模型比较。

Result: 机械臂能较好跟随代理，机器人IoU为0.75-0.78，高于端到端模型最高0.69；仅渲染机器人即可获得该效果。加入模拟物体状态后，漏检抓取从54%降至38%。视频是否遵循物体状态取决于基础模型：冻结刚性物体使MiniMax-H3抬升率从42%降至10%，而LTX-2.3仅从57%降至49%；MiniMax-H3剩余抬升中超过一半是布和绳，模拟器将其按刚性处理。

Conclusion: 模拟状态能准确记录模拟器行为；扰动动作下视频与模拟状态不一致可揭示视频忽略了模拟状态。视频模型对物体状态的利用程度因模型而异，部分模型可能从机械臂运动推断抓取而非遵循代理。

Abstract: Video world models for robots are increasingly conditioned on a simulated or rendered proxy of the scene, on the assumption that the video will show what the proxy shows. Testing this assumption requires a proxy whose state is explicit and can be perturbed. We present SimPWM (Simulator-as-Proxy World Model): given a calibrated camera, it represents, from the first frame alone, the robot by its 3D model and the objects the gripper may touch as 3D points; a rule-based simulator with no trained parameters moves them under the actions, and a video model renders the result. SimPWM returns the realistic video together with the simulated state. We then freeze the simulated objects while the arm moves as recorded and check whether the video still shows the object lifted. On DROID episodes from unseen setups, the answer differs for the arm and for the objects. With each of three base video models, the arm follows the proxy (robot IoU 0.75-0.78, against at most 0.69 for end-to-end models); rendering the robot alone already gives this. What the simulated objects add is the object state: against a robot-only proxy, they cut missed pick-ups from 54% to 38%, and the video follows them only with some base models: on rigid objects, freezing them lowers the lift rate of MiniMax-H3, fine-tuned on episodes whose simulation agrees with the real video, from 42% to 10%, but that of LTX-2.3, trained on the same episodes, only from 57% to 49%, as if it inferred the grasp from the arm motion; more than half of the remaining lifts of MiniMax-H3 are of cloth and rope, which the simulator carries rigidly. With any base model, the simulated state records what the simulation did; under perturbed actions, a video that disagrees with it reveals that the video ignores the simulated state.

</details>


### [516] [Keypose or Dense? A Controlled Comparison of Action Representations for Stage-Structured Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32788)
*Haizhou Ge,Mengshuo Wang,Zhixing Chen,Lei Han,Chen Wang,Lu Shi,Guyue Zhou,Ruqi Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文比较了动作分块模仿策略中的密集动作表示与关键位姿动作表示，发现在演示被扰动时关键位姿更稳健，但其性能高度依赖执行器与演示的匹配程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可分阶段的操作任务中，密集动作分块对演示变化较敏感；作者希望评估关键位姿表示是否能提升对演示扰动和任务变化的鲁棒性。

Method: 在多个仿真操作任务和真实机器人上，以相同分块长度、匹配演示、观测、策略架构和更新预算比较两种表示；仿真中在调参场景选择各自执行规则，并测试演示减速、暂停、改路线、物体尺寸和位置变化及稀缺干净演示；真实机器人学习从人类演示开抽屉。

Result: 仿真中演示被减速、暂停和改路线时，密集表示成功率大幅下降而关键位姿大致保持，跨三种策略架构成立，并在物体尺寸和位置偏移下领先；干净演示下，关键位姿仅在演示稀缺时领先，否则接近或落后于密集，若执行规则不适配则远低于密集。真实机器人上密集更常成功，关键位姿仅在执行器旋转和前进速度按演示调整后显著改善。

Conclusion: 关键位姿表示以对执行偏离演示的敏感性换取对演示变化的鲁棒性；其效果取决于执行器与演示及执行规则的匹配。

Abstract: Most imitation policies that predict chunks of future actions use the dense action representation, in which the chunk holds one control target per step. In stage-structured manipulation, where a task can be divided into stages with definable endpoints, the keypose action representation instead sets each step of the chunk to the endpoint of the stage that step belongs to, and a speed-capped servo supplies the motion. We compare the two in several simulated manipulation tasks and on a real robot, with the same chunk length and matched demonstrations, observations, policy architectures and update budgets; in simulation, each one's execution rule is selected on tuning scenes. When the simulated demonstrations are slowed, paused and rerouted, dense success falls sharply while keypose stays roughly level, across three policy architectures and with endpoints extracted from the recorded demonstrations; keypose also leads under object-size and position shift. With clean demonstrations, keypose leads only when they are scarce and is otherwise close to or behind dense across the simulated tasks, provided that the demonstrations and execution rule suit its executor; when they do not, it falls far below dense. The same dependence on the executor appeared on a real robot learning to open a drawer from human demonstrations: dense succeeded more often, and keypose improved substantially only after its executor's rotation and forward speed were adjusted to the demonstrations. These results suggest that keypose trades sensitivity to such variation in the demonstrations for sensitivity to execution that departs from them.

</details>


### [517] [Supply Geometry, Learn Execution: Screw Attention for Zero-Shot Policy Transfer in Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32797)
*Aly Magassouba*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Screw Attention Policy 几何中心操作框架，显式提供任务几何、仅学习执行；仅需3万可学习参数，在仿真单臂训练后实现新布局泛化、零样本跨机器人本体迁移和真机直接部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为大规模操作策略学到的许多内容是几何结构，而这些结构可以通过感知和机器人模型显式提供，从而减少策略需要学习的内容。

Method: 策略以物体位姿、相对 SE(3) 变换和关节螺旋轴为输入，这些由感知和机器人模型提供；策略只学习执行部分，参数约 30K，并完全在仿真中用单一机械臂训练。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上达到 96% 成功率，布局变化下 85.8%，在五种未见机械臂上平均 80.2%，真机 24 次试验成功 21 次，且无需适应或微调即可部署。

Conclusion: 结果表明，操作策略在规模化学习中学到的很大一部分几何结构可以被显式供给，从而用极少参数实现强泛化、零样本跨本体迁移和真机部署。

Abstract: We present the Screw Attention Policy, a geometry-centric manipulation framework that supplies task geometry explicitly and learns only execution. The policy operates on object poses, relative SE(3) transforms, and joint screw axes provided by perception and robot models. The policy requires only 30K learned parameters. Trained entirely in simulation on a single robot arm, the policy generalises to new scene layouts, transfers zero-shot across robot embodiments, and deploys directly on a real robot, without adaptation or fine-tuning. It achieves 96% success on LIBERO, 85.8% under layout changes, 80.2% across five unseen robot arms, and 21 of 24 trials on a real robot. These results suggest that much of what manipulation policies learn at scale is geometric structure that can instead be supplied.

</details>


### [518] [Atomic Policy: Composing Atomic Manipulation Skills with Agentic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32813)
*Kaidi Zhang,Pengyuan Guo,Zhengtong Xu,Caiyi Zhang,Huayi Gou,Guanlin Huang,Aaron Lim,Anas Rafei,Yu She*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Atomic Policy 框架，将视觉语言模型、PDDL 规划器与多种操作策略结合，通过技能级接口实现长时程操作中的规划、执行反馈、验证与重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程操作需要机器人根据场景变化把任务意图转化为物理交互；VLM 擅长语义和空间推理，视觉运动策略擅长精细控制，但目标模糊、动作依赖复杂，二者集成仍具挑战。

Method: Atomic Policy 通过 VLM 估计符号状态和目标，由 PDDL 求解器生成技能计划；使用代理式框架以语言、视觉指向或二者结合来引导每个技能，并验证执行结果以驱动阶段转换和重规划；采用统一的阶段级接口支持专用策略和通用动作模型。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人实验表明，Atomic Policy 提升了任务遵循能力，并能在复杂长时程操作中支持恢复与重规划。

Conclusion: 将语义规划与技能级策略执行通过统一接口和反馈验证结合，可有效提升长时程机器人操作的鲁棒性和任务完成能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to translate task intent into physical interactions as the scene changes. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic and spatial reasoning, while visuomotor policies provide fine-grained control. Yet ambiguous goals and dependencies between actions make their integration challenging. We introduce Atomic Policy, a framework that composes learned manipulation skills through grounded steering and execution feedback. A VLM estimates the symbolic state and goal, and a PDDL solver constructs a skill plan. An agentic harness steers each skill through language, visual pointing, or both, and verifies its outcome to guide phase transitions and replanning. A common phase-level interface supports specialized policies and generalist action models. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show how Atomic Policy improves task following and supports recovery in complex, long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

</details>


### [519] [MRBench: Benchmarking Physical Necessity Reasoning in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32803)
*Yanzhe Chen,Zhijun Cao,Ruihe An,Chang Gong,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出多机器人操作中的“物理必要性推理”问题，并发布 MRBench 基准与 MRScissors 方法，用于判断完成任务真正需要哪些机器人或资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多机器人协调方法虽能完成任务，但无法说明哪些机器人是真正必要的；当机器人能力、可用资源或物体支持发生变化时，同一任务可能需要不同团队。

Method: 构建 MRBench 基准，包含 8 个具有不同并发与可达约束的任务，每个任务在 5 种资源配置下评估；并提出 MRScissors，将任务需求与实测物理能力分离，通过约束搜索识别最小可行团队。

Result: 现有协调智能体在参考团队下表现良好，但在机器人形态变化或被动物体可替代机器人支持时表现下降。MRScissors 在两种模型骨干上分别达到 85.4% 和 91.2% 的团队选择准确率，比最强基线高 10.4 和 9.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了“协调机器人”与“理解机器人物理必要性”之间的关键差距；可靠的多机器人操作需要显式的物理必要性推理。

Abstract: Recent advances in multi-robot manipulation have shown how robots can collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. However, successful coordination does not reveal which robots are actually needed. The same task may require different teams as robot capabilities change, resources become unavailable, or objects replace robotic support. We argue that reliable multi-robot manipulation requires physical necessity reasoning: understanding what a task demands, which resources can fulfill those demands, and which are truly necessary. We introduce MRBench, a benchmark for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation. It comprises eight tasks with distinct concurrency and reach constraints, each evaluated under five configurations that change the required resources while preserving the task goal. Our evaluation reveals that existing coordination agents perform well with reference teams but struggle when robot embodiments change or passive objects can replace robotic support. To address this gap, we propose MRScissors, which separates task requirements from measured physical capabilities and identifies minimal feasible teams through constrained search. Across two model backbones, MRScissors achieves 85.4% and 91.2% team-selection accuracy, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 9.5 points, respectively. Together, these findings expose a critical gap between coordinating robots and understanding their physical necessity.

</details>


### [520] [What Does a Skill Vocabulary Cost? A Closed-Loop Decomposition over Demonstrated Motions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32858)
*Maximilian Xiling Li,Nils Blank,Paul Mattes,Pankhuri Vanjani,Rudolf Lioutikov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Movement Prototype Quantization（MPQ），将示范运动库放在已训练策略之后而非策略内部，用最近邻库元素替换动作块并在界限内校正，从而为离散技能选择器提供可归因的参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散技能策略通常将技能词汇表作为潜码本，与选择器和解码器联合学习；闭环失败时难以区分问题来自词汇表、技能选择还是技能执行。

Method: MPQ 不训练参数，而是在训练好的策略后放置示范运动库：将预测的动作块替换为最近库元素，并在一定范围内朝原预测校正；在六种架构（含7B视觉-语言-动作模型）上评估，并通过逐个替换选择器组件进行归因分析。

Result: 包装后的策略与原策略统计等价。在 LIBERO-90 上，三个骨干网络的选择器实验显示：量化几乎无成本，技能选择最多损失2分；选择器自身的放置与校正解释了剩余差距的几乎全部，最高达12分。离线重建无法预测这些差异，并会误判库大小、设计和跨基准迁移。

Conclusion: 通过运动库执行的参考策略可作为同一库上任意选择器的基线，组件替换能有效归因选择器不足；离线重建不是评估此类离散技能策略差异的可靠指标。

Abstract: Discrete skill policies execute motions drawn from a finite vocabulary. In most current methods, this vocabulary is a latent codebook learned jointly with a selector and a decoder. When such a policy fails in closed loop, the failure cannot be traced to the vocabulary, to the choice of skill or to its execution. We present Movement Prototype Quantization (MPQ), which places a library of demonstrated motions after a trained policy instead of inside it. MPQ replaces each predicted action chunk with its nearest library element, corrects that element toward the prediction within a bound, and trains no parameters. Across six architectures, including a 7B vision-language-action model, the wrapped policy is statistically equivalent to the original. A reference policy executed through the library is therefore a baseline for any selector over the same library. Substituting a selector's components one at a time attributes its shortfall to them. On LIBERO-90, with selectors on three backbones, quantization costs nothing and the choice of skill costs at most 2 points under the reference's placement and correction. The selectors' own placement and correction account for nearly all of the remaining gap, up to 12 points. Offline reconstruction predicts none of these differences and misjudges library size, design and transfer across benchmark suites. Project page: https://intuitive-robots.github.io/mpq.

</details>


### [521] [CAPER: PartGround and PlanRefine for Reliable Manual-Guided Robotic Assembly Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32986)
*Hanzhao Xi,Zhonghao Li,Suxuan Liu,Shanghan Zhou,Zesheng Chen,Qiufeng Wang,Yaran Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出CAPER框架，利用手册引导视觉语言模型生成机器人装配流程，通过部件对齐与计划精炼提升零件识别可靠性和库存一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在机器人装配任务规划中虽能理解单个装配动作，但会混淆零件身份、预测不存在的Part ID，或在不同装配步骤中使用不一致的零件。

Method: CAPER包含两个模块：PartGround将步骤级手册证据与产品库存及零件参考信息对齐，确定准确的Part ID和数量，并写入共享的Assembly IR；PlanRefine基于有限库存审查PartGround分配，移除置信度最低的分配，并将不确定身份案例标记待复核。

Result: 在IKEA Assembly in the Wild数据集上，CAPER达到83.33%的有限库存一致性率，未观察到库存外Part-ID；PlanRefine将所有观察到的库存过度使用配对从9降至0，超额单元从51降至0。

Conclusion: PartGround和PlanRefine提升了零件可靠性、有限库存一致性和局部预测准确率。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) used in robot task planning to derive assembly procedures from existing manuals may correctly interpret individual assembly actions yet confuse exact part identities, predict unsupported Part IDs, or produce inconsistent parts across assembly steps. Thus, we propose CAPER (Capacity-Aware Part-grounding and Evidence Refinement), a manual-guided robotic assembly framework that enables VLMs to generate assembly procedures with two modules--PartGround and PlanRefine. PartGround aligns step-level manual evidence with product-specific inventory and part-reference information to identify exact Part IDs and quantities, transforming free-form hardware prediction into evidence-guided assignments represented in a shared Assembly Intermediate Representation (Assembly IR). PlanRefine audits PartGround assignments against finite inventory by removing the lowest-confidence assignments. Uncertain identity cases remain marked for review in the Assembly IR. We evaluate CAPER on the IKEA Assembly in the Wild (IAW) dataset. Experiment results show that CAPER reaches a Finite-inventory Consistency Rate of 83.33% and produces zero observed out-of-inventory Part-ID occurrences. At the plan level, PlanRefine removes all observed inventory-overuse pairs (9 -> 0) and excess units (51 -> 0). Overall, the results indicate that PartGround and PlanRefine improve part reliability, while also enhancing finite-inventory consistency and local prediction accuracy. Project page and video: https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/

</details>


### [522] [Self-Sensing Compliant Anthropomorphic Hand for Speed-Dictated Shared Force Control in Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32937)
*Huijiang Wang,Yu Zhang,Rui Chen,Tristan Bonato,Jaemin Eom,Kai Junge,Cheng Pan,Benhui Dai,Yue Xie,Josie Hughes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出利用柔性欠驱动机械手的弹性传动实现自感知，并构建接触感知共享控制框架用于VR遥操作，从而在无触觉反馈条件下改善抓取力控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉遥操作机械手缺乏触觉反馈，操作者难以调节抓取力；在手指加装触觉传感器又会增加布线、成本和集成复杂度。因此需要一种无需外部传感器、利用机械柔顺性本身提供感知信息的方案。

Method: 在腱驱动拟人柔性手的腱路由中加入串联弹簧，并通过前臂电机盒中的电位器读取弹簧形变，从而估计关节状态和手指力；基于该自感知能力，设计VR遥操作中的接触感知共享控制框架：接触前按操作者手部运动映射控制，检测到接触后切换为手指级力控制，并以操作者抓取速度设定力目标，同时可将控制权分配给单指。

Result: 实验验证了系统能够估计手指力，并在抓取易碎和重物时相比直接遥操作提高了抓取成功率。

Conclusion: 机械柔顺性不仅可用于被动适应和安全抓取，还可作为机器人本体固有的感知资源，用于物理人机协作和共享控制遥操作。

Abstract: In vision-based teleoperation of robotic hands, the operator receives no haptic feedback and therefore struggles to regulate the grasp force, while adding tactile sensors to the fingers increases wiring, cost and integration complexity. Compliant hands offer an alternative, as their mechanical compliance, usually treated only as a passive property for safe and adaptive grasping, can also serve as a source of information. Here, we show that the elastic transmission of a compliant, tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand can itself act as the sensor for shared-control telemanipulation. Series springs in the tendon routing are read by potentiometers in a forearm-mounted motor box, from which the hand estimates its joint states and finger forces without any external sensors. Building on this self-sensing, we develop a contact-aware shared-control framework for VR-based teleoperation. The robot hand is controlled through a mapping from the operator's hand kinematics until a contact is detected proprioceptively. Control then switches to a finger-level force controller whose set point is determined by the operator's grasping speed, and control authority can be allocated to individual fingers. Experiments validate the system's force estimation and increased grasp success rate compared with direct teleoperation for fragile and heavy objects. These results show that compliance can serve not only for passive adaptation but also as an intrinsic sensing resource for physical human-robot collaboration.

</details>


### [523] [At the Limit: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting under Generative Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33040)
*Jie He,Meixun Qu,Cheng Hu,Lei Xie,Ezio Bartocci,Radu Grosu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向自主漂移的在线强化学习方法，结合SDE采样探索与基于价值的策略优化，并在F1TENTH数字孪生平台上验证了圆形和八字形漂移控制效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主漂移面临轮胎力饱和与高度非线性车辆动力学，需要敏捷且鲁棒的控制方法。

Method: 提出面向流策略的在线强化学习方法，将随机微分方程（SDE）采样用于探索，并与基于价值的策略优化结合；支持从零训练和基于专家演示预训练策略的微调；训练后可用SDE或常微分方程（ODE）生成控制动作。

Result: 在F1TENTH数字孪生平台的圆形和八字形漂移实验中，两种训练策略均能实现有效的实时漂移控制，并获得更紧的轨迹跟踪、更高的成功率和更好的噪声鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 结合SDE采样与价值优化的在线强化学习方法能够有效实现自主漂移控制，并支持从零训练与专家演示微调两种实用路径。

Abstract: Autonomous drifting requires agile control despite tire-force saturation and highly nonlinear vehicle dynamics. We propose an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling for exploration with value-based policy optimization. This method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning a policy pretrained on expert demonstrations. After training, control actions can be generated using either SDEs or ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Experiments on circular and eight-shaped drifting in an F1TENTH digital twin platform show that both training strategies can achieve effective real-time drift control, with tighter tracking, higher success rates, and better robustness under noisy conditions.

</details>


### [524] [EmbodiSafety: Benchmarking Risk Understanding and Response in Embodied AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33054)
*Erfei Cui,Shengjia Zhao,Yan Qin,Kaixuan Wang,Junming Chen,Ping Luo,Tianxing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 EmbodiSafety 基准，用于评估具身基础模型在短时和长时任务中的物理安全决策能力，并构建安全对齐数据提升小模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身模型进展多以任务成功率衡量，物理安全决策关注不足；以规则遵循和二元判断为中心的安全评估难以判断模型是否理解环境风险并做出安全决策。

Method: 构建包含 844 个视觉场景、1,092 个快照任务和 540 个轨迹任务的 EmbodiSafety；覆盖直接执行、拒绝、澄清、受限执行、自主恢复、人工升级六种响应模式；评估模式正确性、风险识别和可操作处理，并以全部适用检查通过作为完整决策准确率；另开发数据构建流程并整理 4 万条安全对齐样本进行监督训练。

Result: Claude-Opus-5.5 在参考模型中完整决策准确率最高，快照任务为 56.1%，轨迹任务为 61.5%；使用该安全对齐语料监督训练可提升 Qwen3.5-2B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 的完整决策准确率。

Conclusion: EmbodiSafety 将自主恢复与人工干预区分开，使安全自主边界成为显式评估目标；结果表明当前模型安全决策能力仍有限，但安全对齐数据训练可带来改进。

Abstract: Progress in embodied foundation models is largely measured by task success, while the physical safety of their decisions remains underexamined. Safety evaluations centered on rule following and binary judgments do not adequately assess whether embodied models understand environmental hazards and make safe decisions. We introduce EmbodiSafety, comprising 1,092 snapshot tasks and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 visual scenarios to assess safety over short and long horizons. Six response modes cover direct execution, refusal, clarification, constrained execution, autonomous recovery, and human escalation. Distinguishing recovery from human intervention makes the boundary of safe autonomy an explicit evaluation target. Our protocol assesses mode correctness, risk identification, and actionable handling, with complete decision accuracy requiring all applicable checks to pass. Claude-Opus-5.5 achieves the highest complete decision accuracy among reference models, reaching 56.1% on snapshots and 61.5% on trajectories. We further develop a data construction pipeline and curate 40k examples for safety alignment. Supervised training on this corpus raises the complete decision accuracy of Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B.

</details>


### [525] [DynaMimic: A Physics-Informed World Model for Humanoid Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32944)
*Chaoyue Xing,Linyi Huang,Yiting He,Yixuan Yin,Siqi Hou,Yi Zhang,Liyuan Pan,Miaomiao Liu,Daqi Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DynaMimic 是一种用于人形机器人全身运动跟踪的可微分世界模型，通过显式建模接触力与广义残差力，并结合拉格朗日前向动力学预测下一状态，从而降低训练成本并提升跟踪精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无模型强化学习方法要么将运动专家蒸馏为单一策略而损失性能，要么依赖大规模算力训练通用策略。SuperMimic 用可微分世界模型降低计算成本，但其隐式物理建模在支撑切换附近会积累误差，影响想象 rollout 中跟踪策略的训练。

Method: 提出 DynaMimic 可微分世界模型，在状态预测中显式引入共享物理。网络预测每个候选支撑链上的接触力旋量以及残差广义力，再通过闭式拉格朗日前向动力学计算下一状态。

Result: 在 60 个完整 LAFAN1 运动上，DynaMimic 相比 SuperMimic 将平均每关节位置误差 MPJPE 降低 18.6%。在地形跟踪中，相比地形条件化 SuperMimic，A3 Parkour 上 MPJPE 从 66.15 mm 降至 56.28 mm，降低 14.9%；GRAIL 地形片段上从 141.88 mm 降至 126.57 mm，降低 10.8%。在真实 A3 人形机器人上，学习到的策略可完成倒地恢复、侧手翻和箱体翻越等多样技能。

Conclusion: 显式引入接触与动力学物理约束能提升可微分世界模型的状态预测精度，减少误差累积，并在降低计算成本的同时实现多样化的真实人形机器人全身运动跟踪。

Abstract: Whole-body motion tracking enables humanoid robots to reproduce diverse skills from human demonstrations. Existing model-free reinforcement learning methods either distill motion specialists into a single policy at the cost of performance or train a generalist policy directly using cluster-scale computation. SuperMimic reduces this computational cost through a differentiable world model that implicitly learns the physics shared across motions by predicting the next state from the current state and action. However, this implicit formulation may not fully capture the underlying physical processes. Errors around changes of support can accumulate over imagined rollouts used to train the tracking policy. To address this challenge, we introduce DynaMimic, a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates shared physics into state prediction. Specifically, its network predicts a contact wrench at each candidate support link and a residual generalized force. DynaMimic then uses these predictions to compute the next state through closed-form Lagrangian forward dynamics. Across 60 full LAFAN1 motions, DynaMimic reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 18.6% relative to SuperMimic. For terrain tracking, we give both methods the same local height maps. Relative to terrain-conditioned SuperMimic, DynaMimic reduces MPJPE by 14.9% on A3 Parkour (66.15 to 56.28~mm) and by 10.8% on GRAIL terrain clips (141.88 to 126.57~mm). On a real A3 humanoid, the learned policies can perform diverse skills, such as floor recovery, cartwheel and a box vault.

</details>


### [526] [Neural Implicit Representation for Bathymetry Estimation using Sidescan Sonar Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33118)
*Tianxiang Lin,Sacchin Sundar,Fenghao Liu,Onur Bagoren,Katherine A. Skinner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种用于侧扫声纳（SSS）的可微神经渲染框架，以从SSS测量中有效估计水下地形（水深）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多波束测深仪（MBES）精度高但受水面船只部署限制，深水空间分辨率不足；SSS可搭载AUV靠近海底获得高分辨率声学成像，但测量固有歧义和覆盖范围有限会降低现有SSS测深方法的性能。

Method: 构建基于SSS几何的测量模型，显式考虑其宽仰角孔径及相关歧义，并将其融入可微神经渲染框架中进行测深估计。

Result: 在合成数据和真实数据集上评估，相比替代方法表现出更好的鲁棒性和准确性。

Conclusion: 该框架能够有效利用SSS测量估计水下地形，并提升复杂条件下的测深性能。

Abstract: Bathymetry measurement and estimation is critical for understanding the structure of underwater environments. While multibeam echosounders (MBES) provide accurate depth measurements, their deployment on surface vessels limits spatial resolution in deep water. Sidescan sonar (SSS), in contrast, can be deployed on autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) to operate closer to the seafloor, enabling high-resolution acoustic imaging. However, the inherent ambiguity in measurements and the limited observation coverage of sonar datasets degrade the performance of state-of-the-art methods for underwater bathymetry estimation from SSS. In this paper, we propose a differentiable neural rendering framework for SSS that enables effective estimation of bathymetry from SSS measurements. Our approach incorporates a measurement model based on SSS geometry, explicitly accounting for its wide elevation aperture and associated ambiguities. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating improved robustness and accuracy compared to alternative approaches.

</details>


### [527] [Exploratory Midtraining for Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33130)
*Kshitiz,Zheyuan Hu,Robyn Wu,Yizhou Li,Yunchu Zhang,Vattanary Tevy,Kavya Tayal,Shawn Yin,Aykut Onol,Kushal Arora,Dhruv Shah,Abhishek Gupta,Zackory Erickson,Aviral Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究一种“midtraining”方法，通过收集覆盖多样低层行为的数据，使机器人策略在挑战性状态与可继续推进状态之间建立连通覆盖，并提升下游适应与在线改进能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人策略主要从人类示范的“胜任行为”中学习，数据覆盖不足，尤其缺乏支持自主改进所需的低层行为覆盖。

Method: 提出β-Data数据集，通过对抗式遥操作收集：人类对抗者可逆地扰动环境，操作者不重置地继续完成任务。随后用自然语言标注轨迹片段的局部结果，并微调一个以近期动作历史为条件的预训练策略。

Result: 策略持续使用更多低层行为；在仿真操作任务和三个真实机器人平台上，相比标准示范训练，获得更有利的数据缩放规律、更好的零样本泛化和更有效的额外 rollout 时间利用；在线微调时所需 rollout 更少即可收集成功经验，并达到更高成功率。

Conclusion: midtraining可帮助机器人策略同时获得更稳健的任务执行能力和持续自主改进的潜力。

Abstract: Robot policies predominantly learn from human-collected data emphasizing competent behavior, limiting coverage of the low-level behaviors needed to support autonomous improvement. We study how a form of midtraining can be used to build coverage over diverse low-level behaviors that connect challenging states of the robot and its environment to states from which further progress is possible ("connected behavioral coverage"). We also examine how this coverage supports downstream adaptation and online improvement. To this end, we introduce $β$-Data, a dataset collected via adversarial teleoperation, where a human adversary reversibly perturbs the environment while a human operator continues toward completion without resetting. We relabel trajectory segments with local outcomes in natural language and finetune a pretrained policy conditioned on recent action history. The resulting policy exhibits sustained use of more low-level behaviors. Across manipulation tasks in simulation and on three real-robot platforms, our approach yields more favorable data scaling laws, better zero-shot generalization, and more effective use of additional rollout time than training on standard demonstrations. During online finetuning, these policies need fewer rollouts to collect successful experience and reach higher success rates, suggesting that midtraining can prepare robots for both more robust task execution and continued autonomous improvement. Our project page and robot videos are available at https://kshitiz-1225.github.io/exploratory-midtraining-robot-policies/.

</details>


### [528] [PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33144)
*Feixiang Ruan,Guodong Lv,Kewei Zhang,Wenbo Huang,Yintianrun Zhang,Qiang Wang,Ruiyang Si,Shunyu Yang,Shulong Jiang,Weicheng Duan,Rui Ni,Jianxin Bi,Lekai Wang,Yuze Fan,Haobo Li,Zeliang Fu,Jiankun Zhang,Duomin Wang,Enze Xie,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 PyRUA-Dex 框架，让编程智能体无需高质量演示即可通过程序化策略学习灵巧操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作学习受限于高质量演示稀缺：人类视频重定向不精确、遥操作缺乏力反馈、外骨骼采集难以扩展。

Method: 采用两阶段程序化策略开发：探索阶段多个智能体并行探索任务技能及组合方式，并由蒸馏智能体将成功尝试归纳为任务库和单个程序；精炼阶段通过随机化布局提升鲁棒性和执行效率。

Result: 在仿真中，Bench2Dex 得分 72.9 达到 SOTA，DexJoCo 全随机化下成功率 81.0%，均优于所有训练策略；在双臂 22 自由度手平台上学习弹钢琴、写书法等任务，从乐谱学习新曲目最快约 30 分钟。

Conclusion: PyRUA-Dex 是在缺乏高质量灵巧操作演示时，利用编程智能体开发灵巧操作策略的有效框架。

Abstract: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations. The programmatic policy is developed in two stages: during exploration, multiple agents explore in parallel for task skills and ways to compose them, and a distilling agent condenses the successful attempts into a task library and one program. During refinement, this program is improved through randomized layouts for enhanced robustness and execution efficiency. In simulated environments, PyRUA-Dex achieves SOTA on Bench2Dex with a score of 72.9 and reaches 81.0% success on DexJoCo under full randomization, ahead of every trained policy on both benchmarks. In real world experiments on a bimanual platform with two 22-DoF hands, PyRUA-Dex learns to play piano, write calligraphy, and other tasks efficiently: learning a new piece from sheet music takes as little as 30 minutes. These results suggest that PyRUA-Dex is an effective framework for developing dexterous manipulation policies with coding agents in the absence of high quality dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

</details>


### [529] [iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33141)
*Vansh Kapoor,Max Sobol Mark,Sreyas Venkataraman,Max Simchowitz,Aviral Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: iWAM 提出一种高效的世界-动作模型推理方式：不再生成完整未来帧，而是用视频模型单次前向传播的中间特征来条件化动作策略，从而在保留泛化优势的同时显著降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）依赖预训练视频生成模型预测场景演化，但生成未来场景计算昂贵，难以满足实时控制需求。现有高效代理方法如何在不牺牲动作预测质量的前提下训练仍不明确。

Method: 作者基于“代理只需提供区分可能未来的足够信息，而非高分辨率未来帧”的设计原则，提出 iWAM。利用 flow-matching 模型的可逆动态，将每个训练未来反演为对应潜在噪声向量；由于单次速度评估未必产生有信息量的动作预测特征，进一步学习双向流映射以摊销未来生成计算。推理时从先验采样潜在噪声向量，仅用一次视频骨干前向传播即可条件化策略。

Result: 在模拟基准和真实机器人上，iWAM 恢复了 WAMs 的泛化收益，同时大幅降低推理成本。

Conclusion: iWAM 表明无需完整生成未来帧，通过单次视频模型评估的中间特征即可有效支持动作预测，为实时控制中的世界-动作模型提供高效替代方案。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.

</details>


### [530] [ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33143)
*Xingjian Ran,Xiaoye Mo,Sihao Liu,Li Luo,Taiqiang Wu,Ji Zhao,Wenqi Shao,Hongyang Li,Jiaqi Wang,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出ROAM-Bench，用于在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评估具身空间智能，区分任务结果正确性与任务要求完成情况，并揭示现有视觉语言模型的互补失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准不能充分区分正确结果与任务要求是否完成，需要在运动与碰撞约束下更严格地评估智能体的探索、交互、推理与行动能力。

Method: 构建包含250个经人工验证任务、11类任务、5个任务组和27个室内环境的基准；利用仿真状态与回合记录独立检查任务结果和任务要求，并对几何、覆盖、放置进行更强检查；测试7个前沿视觉语言模型，并进行oracle输入诊断。

Result: 人类评估者在100个抽样任务上达到84%的严格任务成功率，且所有正确结果均满足检查要求；7个视觉语言模型表现出两类互补失败模式：结果正确但任务要求未满足，以及结果错误但通过更强检查；诊断表明更完整的目标观察和校准反馈可改善最终空间判断。

Conclusion: ROAM-Bench提供了更严格的具身空间智能评估，强调结果与过程要求并重，并指出改进模型需要更完整的观察与校准反馈。

Abstract: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act.
