Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.

</details>


### [531] [OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33158)
*Xiang Fan,Yuheng Wang,Jiayuan Yan,Bohan Fang,Wisdom Oluchi Ikezogwo,Ainaz Eftekhar,Max Argus,Jason Ren,Jiafei Duan,Ranjay Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 OmniAct，一种基于机器人运动学图条件化的跨具身操作策略，通过流匹配预测相对关节运动，并在百万级程序化生成的可行机器人具身和多样仿真任务上训练，实现对不同自由度与运动学结构机器人的自适应控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一策略控制多样机器人时，不仅需要迁移任务知识，还应根据每个机器人的形态与能力调整操作策略。现有共享动作表示未必能体现机器人形态差异如何影响操作策略，因此需要一种显式建模机器人运动学与场景关系的跨具身方法。

Method: OmniAct 将每个机器人在具体场景中的运动学表示为运动学图，包含关节位置、运动轴及与视觉观测的连通关系；策略直接以该图条件化，并使用流匹配为每个节点预测相对关节运动，从而支持不同自由度和运动学配置的机器人。为大规模学习结构如何影响行为，作者程序化设计并筛选一百万种物理可行具身，开发仿真轨迹生成算法，并在多样仿真操作任务上训练。

Result: 在 2,000 个具身-场景留出评估回合中，OmniAct 成功率为 63.0%，高于 pi 0.5 的 17.8% 和最强基线的 57.9%；在 GPT-6 Astra 评估过的任务族上达到 64.7%，高于 GPT-6 Astra 的 41.1%；在先前未见过的真实机器人上，成功率接近次优方法 MolmoAct2 的两倍。此外，OmniAct 学到利用不同形态能力并规避其限制的差异化操作策略。

Conclusion: 显式以机器人运动学图条件化并结合流匹配相对关节运动预测，可有效实现跨具身操作策略迁移与形态自适应。大规模程序化具身生成与仿真轨迹训练有助于学习物理结构对行为的影响，并在仿真与真实机器人上取得显著优于现有方法的泛化表现。

Abstract: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/

</details>

### [532] [Gaussian Process Data-Driven Hamiltonian for Probabilistic Safe Set Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31764)
*Seungseok Oh,Junho Kim,Jason J. Choi,Namhoon Cho*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出高斯过程数据驱动哈密顿（GP-DDH）框架，在动力学服从GP先验的条件下构造具有概率保证的安全集，并给出两种选择置信参数β的方法，使计算出的安全集以至少1-Δ的后验概率位于真实安全集内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hamilton-Jacobi可达性依赖精确动力学模型；数据驱动哈密顿（DDH）虽避免系统辨识，但需要未知动力学的Lipschitz界，该界难以从有限数据认证，且作为单一全局常数会使安全集过于保守。

Method: 在DDH基础上引入高斯过程先验，直接从状态-控制-速度数据下界哈密顿量，构造GP-DDH框架；提出两种选择置信参数β的方法，并从数学上保证哈密顿量被下界；从而给出安全集的后验概率保证。

Result: GP-DDH计算出的安全集以至少1-Δ的后验概率包含于真实安全集内；数值实验表明，即使DDH使用由真实动力学计算的Lipschitz常数，GP-DDH仍能恢复更大体积的真实安全集，同时保持正确的保守近似。

Conclusion: GP-DDH是一种完全数据驱动且具有概率安全性保证的方法，可缓解DDH因全局Lipschitz界导致的保守性，并在实验中取得更大的安全集覆盖。

Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability is a general framework for verifying the safety of nonlinear systems, but it relies on an accurate dynamics model. The data-driven Hamiltonian (DDH) framework avoids system identification by lower-bounding the Hamiltonian directly from state-control-velocity data. However, it requires a Lipschitz bound on the unknown dynamics which is hard to certify from finite data, and as a single global constant this bound makes the computed safe sets conservative. We propose the Gaussian process data-driven Hamiltonian (GP-DDH), a fully data-driven framework that constructs safe sets with probabilistic guarantees under a GP prior on the dynamics. Furthermore, we suggest two methods to choose the confidence parameter $β$, both mathematically guaranteed to underbound the Hamiltonian. The computed safe set lies inside the true one with posterior probability at least $1-Δ$ for any $Δ\in(0,1)$. Numerical experiments show that GP-DDH recovers a bigger volume of the true safe set than DDH while still correctly providing a conservative approximation, even when DDH is given a Lipschitz constant computed from the true dynamics.

</details>


### [533] [Heterogeneous Risk-Sensitive Evolutionary Learning in Coordination Games: Polarization, Welfare Loss, and Intervention for Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31568)
*Solaleh Mohammadi,Yiman Fong,Kaiqing Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究异质性风险态度下的有限种群协调博弈演化学习，刻画长期稳定结果，并提出干预机制以缓解无效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者关注：仅由风险态度异质性导致的演化学习，是否会使种群长期陷入低效率结果，以及如何通过干预改善。

Method: 用熵风险度量建模两类固定风险态度子种群；在带变异的风险敏感最优反应动态下，分析随机稳定状态，并设计改变个体风险参数的干预机制。

Result: 刻画了两子种群选择不同行动的极化状态成为唯一随机稳定状态的条件；该状态虽被收益占优均衡严格帕累托支配，且平均期望收益低于收益占优均衡，有时也低于风险占优均衡。干预份额足够大且干预强度足够高时，收益占优均衡成为唯一随机稳定状态；但强度不能弥补份额不足，份额也不能弥补强度不足。

Conclusion: 风险态度异质性本身可导致演化学习长期无效率；通过同时保证足够干预覆盖面和干预强度，可促使收益占优均衡成为唯一长期稳定结果。

Abstract: We study evolutionary learning in coordination games in a finite population of agents with heterogeneous risk attitudes, modeled using the entropic risk measure (ERM). The population consists of two subpopulations, each with a fixed risk attitude. Under risk-sensitive best response with mutations (BRM), we characterize the long-run outcomes of the learning process. In particular, we characterize when a polarized state, in which the two subpopulations choose different actions, is uniquely stochastically stable in terms of agents' risk attitudes and the subpopulation sizes. Notably, this polarized state is strictly Pareto dominated by the payoff-dominant equilibrium under both expected payoffs and agents' own ERM-adjusted payoffs. Moreover, its welfare, measured by average expected payoff, is always lower than that of the payoff-dominant equilibrium and can also be lower than that of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, heterogeneity of risk attitudes in learning alone can lead to an inefficient long-run outcome. To mitigate such inefficiency, we propose intervention mechanisms to modify agents' risk attitudes in learning. We show that a sufficiently large intervention share (the fraction of agents modified) and sufficiently high intervention intensity (the increase in their risk parameter) ensure that the payoff-dominant equilibrium is uniquely stochastically stable. However, greater intervention intensity cannot compensate for an insufficient intervention share, and a larger intervention share cannot compensate for insufficient intervention intensity.

</details>


### [534] [Tube-Based Robust Data-Driven Predictive Control for Linear Parameter-Varying Systems With Noisy Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31545)
*Chi Wang,David Angeli*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于管束的鲁棒数据驱动预测控制方法，用于仅利用离线含噪输入-调度-状态数据控制未知离散时间线性参数变化（LPV）系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对未知离散时间LPV系统，避免依赖精确模型辨识，并处理离线数据噪声带来的预测失配，同时保证闭环约束满足与稳定性。

Method: 建立多轨迹简化LPV基本引理，得到有限时域轨迹的集体Hankel表示；将Hankel系数约束到缩放单纯形以一致界定噪声引起的预测失配，并用容许滚动时域延续的凸包覆盖条件恢复可表示性；利用LPV数据一致性和鲁棒正不变集从含噪数据直接构造管束收紧量；在线求解二次规划。

Result: 理论上建立了递归可行性、闭环约束满足和实用输入到状态稳定性；数值结果验证了所提方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提管束鲁棒数据驱动预测控制方案能够在未知LPV系统和含噪离线数据条件下有效实现约束保证与稳定控制。

Abstract: This paper proposes a tube-based robust data-driven predictive control scheme for unknown discrete-time linear parameter-varying (LPV) systems using offline noisy input-scheduling-state data. We establish a multi-trajectory simplified LPV fundamental lemma yielding a collective Hankel representation of finite-horizon trajectories. Constraining the Hankel coefficients to a scaled simplex uniformly bounds the noise-induced predictor mismatch but may exclude relevant constrained lifted trajectories. A convex-hull coverage condition for admissible receding-horizon continuations restores the required representability. LPV data-consistency and robust positively invariant sets provide tube-tightening ingredients computed directly from noisy data. The online problem is a quadratic program, for which recursive feasibility, closed-loop constraint satisfaction, and practical input-to-state stability are established. Numerical results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

</details>


### [535] [Adaptive Robust Optimisation for Frequency-Constrained Market Clearing Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31572)
*Özlem Mahmutoğulları,Hakan Ergun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文将日前市场出清建模为两阶段自适应鲁棒优化问题，在可再生能源、负荷和HVDC换流器停运同时不确定下，比较Home Market与Offshore Bidding Zone两种市场设计对系统成本、频率安全和实时切负荷的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是日前市场需在多重不确定性下保证频率安全，并评估海上 bidding zone 边界设计是否能让线路阻塞和海上换流器停运风险在日前阶段被定价与对冲。

Method: 采用两阶段自适应鲁棒优化：第一阶段决定机组组合、能量调度和备用采购，第二阶段表示最坏情况下的平衡动作；显式加入惯性及快速频率响应约束，并允许HVDC在可用裕度内提供紧急支撑；用列与约束生成算法求解，并在包含三个同步区域、十六个陆上竞价区、五个海上风场枢纽和网状HVDC电网的八国北海测试系统上比较HM与OBZ设计。

Result: 确定性方案在最坏场景下非常脆弱，体现鲁棒性的价值；OBZ使海上分区边界让线路阻塞对日前市场可见，从而进行更有针对性的备用采购，虽提高日前成本，但显著减少实时切负荷，并使总系统成本净下降，且该优势随局部海上不确定性加剧而增大；在相同最坏停运场景下，HM无法区分海上换流器跳闸与正常运行，难以对冲风险，而OBZ可在日前考虑该风险；该优势具有季节性，随海上风电出力与HVDC线路容量之比变化，并在陆上电源主导时减弱。

Conclusion: 鲁棒日前出清能有效应对多重不确定性；OBZ设计通过暴露海上网络阻塞和停运风险，改善备用配置并降低实时切负荷，在海上不确定性较强时带来净成本优势，但其价值取决于海上风电占比、HVDC容量及电源结构。

Abstract: This paper formulates the day-ahead market clearing as a two-stage adaptive robust optimisation problem in which the first stage determines unit commitment, energy dispatch, and reserve procurement, while the second stage represents worst-case balancing actions under simultaneous uncertainty in renewable generation, load, and HVDC converter outages. Frequency security is enforced explicitly through inertia and fast frequency response constraints at the synchronous-area level, with HVDC lines allowed to provide emergency power support within their available headroom. The resulting min--max--min problem is solved by a column-and-constraint generation algorithm and applied to an eight-country North Sea test system comprising three synchronous areas, sixteen onshore bidding zones, and five offshore wind farm hubs connected through a meshed HVDC grid. We compare the Home Market (HM) and Offshore Bidding Zone (OBZ) designs on this infrastructure across different uncertainty scenarios. The results first demonstrate the value of robustness, where deterministic solutions that ignore uncertainty are severely vulnerable to worst-case realisations. Comparing the two designs, we find that OBZ's offshore zone boundaries make line congestion visible to the day-ahead market, enabling targeted reserve procurement that raises day-ahead costs but substantially reduces real-time load shedding, yielding a net reduction in total system cost that grows with the severity of localised offshore uncertainty. When both designs face the identical worst-case contingency, HM cannot distinguish an offshore converter trip from normal operation and thus fails to hedge against it, while OBZ considers the risk at the day-ahead stage. This advantage can be seasonal, scaling with the ratio of offshore wind output to HVDC line capacity and diminishing when onshore generation dominates the supply mix.

</details>


### [536] [Your bids are showing: re-identifying power plants in anonymized market data, and a differentially private alternative](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31681)
*Nikhil Ravi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文检验PJM式机组名称脱敏能否保护报价隐私，发现利用公开EIA/EPA数据可较高比例重识别机组，且精确发布燃料组汇总仍会泄露单机高价报价；提出基于零集中差分隐私的月度分燃料组、分价格区间汇总发布方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ERCOT公开含机组名称的小时报价曲线，PJM则以代码替代名称并认为脱敏可保密。作者希望用ERCOT名称公开数据作为真值，检验PJM脱敏规则的实际隐私保护效果，并寻找可替代的隐私保护发布方法。

Method: 用2024—2026年ERCOT数据按PJM公开规则进行名称脱敏，并用公开EIA和EPA数据匹配重识别；分析精确燃料组汇总下的单机报价恢复与停机日期相关性攻击；提出零集中差分隐私下的月度分燃料组、分价格区间汇总发布，加入高斯噪声并据噪声层推导单调供给曲线和份额。

Result: 脱敏机组中25%可评分单位（占容量32%）被匹配到电厂，45%进入前五猜测；精确燃料组汇总不能解决问题，知道同组其他机组可精确恢复某机组高价报价，仅知道停机日期即可使相关性达0.77，主要来自少数高价可再生能源和水电（化石机组为0.32）。差分隐私方案在每机组年ε=10时，市场供给曲线误差在11%以内，隐含出清价误差在3.0美元/MWh以内，攻击者相关性降至0.23；可用性可由“真实月度数量变化与噪声之比”预测汇总精度至0.05。

Conclusion: PJM式名称脱敏很可能无法保护报价隐私，精确汇总也会泄露单机信息。差分隐私月度汇总可保留出清价、供给斜率和联合循环容量等可用分析，但任何月度发布，无论私有还是精确，都无法回答单小时或单机组问题。

Abstract: ERCOT publishes every generator's hourly offer curve 60 days after the operating day. Market monitors, researchers and traders use these records to study the merit order and check for withholding. PJM publishes the same kind of data with unit names replaced by codes, on the view that masking keeps offers confidential. We test that view on ERCOT data from 2024 to 2026, where names are public and so provide ground truth, by masking the records under PJM's published rules. Public EIA and EPA data match 25% of the masked units we can score (32% of their capacity) to their plant, and 45% fall within the top five guesses. PJM's feed carries the same fields, so we expect masking to fail there too. Publishing exact fuel-group totals instead does not help. An attacker who knows the other units in a group recovers one unit's high-price offers exactly, and an outsider who knows only the target's outage dates reaches a correlation of 0.77, most of it from a few renewable and hydro units that offer at very high prices (0.32 over fossil units). We propose a differentially private release: monthly totals by fuel group and price bin, with Gaussian noise calibrated under zero-concentrated differential privacy so that each unit's whole year of offers is protected. It publishes an unbiased noisy layer and derives a monotone supply curve and shares from it at no extra privacy cost. At $\varepsilon=10$ per unit-year the market supply curve stays within 11% of the truth, the implied clearing price within \$3.0/MWh, and the attacker's correlation falls to 0.23. Whether an analysis still works depends on one ratio, how much the true quantity varies month to month against the noise, which predicts the accuracy of totals to within 0.05. The clearing price, supply slope and combined-cycle capacity remain usable, but no monthly release, private or exact, can answer questions about single hours or single units.

</details>


### [537] [Federated Policy Gradient for Dynamic Consensus: Gradient Dominance and Topological Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31804)
*Maryam Babazadeh*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向同质多智能体系统动态共识的联邦优化框架，通过将分布式控制理论与联邦策略梯度结合，解决通信图谱性质导致的空间异质性和去中心化控制难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态共识问题受通信图谱性质影响，会产生空间异质性，即使智能体动力学完全已知，去中心化控制仍然复杂；现有方法难以同时处理网络耦合与策略优化。

Method: 建立模态分解下的动态共识优化景观，刻画显式解耦真实聚合策略梯度与网络协方差失配的参数化次优性界；基于图拉普拉斯谱推导恢复精确梯度支配的充分条件，并给出支配系数下界；提出无模型联邦共识算法，采用零阶探索和基于二分法的折扣因子退火机制，消除对初始稳定策略的需求。

Result: 理论结果表明可获得精确梯度支配并保证收敛到全局共识策略；算法在策略优化子程序上实现线性全局收敛，并在达到动态共识前保持严格有界的外层迭代；多种网络拓扑下的仿真和可行性对比显示，该方法持续优于现有基于模型和基于数据驱动分离的技术。

Conclusion: 所提联邦优化框架能够有效处理通信图诱导的空间异质性问题，实现无模型动态共识，并在收敛性和性能上优于现有方法。

Abstract: This paper presents a federated optimization framework for dynamic consensus in homogeneous multi-agent systems. The underlying problem is challenged by the communication graph's spectral properties, which induce spatial heterogeneity and complicate decentralized control even when the dynamics of the agents are completely known. The problem is addressed in this paper by bridging distributed control theory with federated policy gradients. Accordingly, a comprehensive optimization landscape for dynamic consensus is established through a modal decomposition formulation. Specifically, a parameterized suboptimality bound is characterized that explicitly decouples the true aggregate policy gradient from the network covariance mismatch. Building on this formulation, sufficient conditions based on the graph's Laplacian spectrum are derived to recover exact gradient dominance, which guarantees convergence to the global consensus policy and establishes a lower bound on the achievable dominance coefficient. Furthermore, a Federated model-free consensus algorithm is proposed that utilizes zeroth-order exploration alongside a bisection-based discount factor annealing mechanism, successfully eliminating the need for an initial stabilizing policy. This approach achieves linear global convergence for policy optimization subroutines while maintaining strictly bounded outer iterations until dynamic consensus is achieved. Through extensive simulation studies and comparative feasibility analyses across diverse network topologies, it is demonstrated that the proposed federated approach consistently outperforms existing model-based and data-driven separation-based techniques.

</details>


### [538] [Barrier-Based Safety Filtering for Quadrotor Flight in Cluttered Environments Under Acceleration Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31889)
*Andi Rahmadiansah*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向固定高度四旋翼在障碍密集环境中的安全过滤轨迹跟踪框架，将名义跟踪控制器与高阶控制障碍约束及加速度约束二次规划结合，在保证安全间隙的同时分析跟踪性能与可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅依靠精确轨迹跟踪无法保证四旋翼在参考轨迹靠近障碍或控制权限受限时的飞行安全，因此需要在不显著破坏名义跟踪性能的前提下引入安全约束。

Method: 设计名义跟踪控制器，并叠加高阶控制障碍约束和加速度约束二次规划构成安全过滤器；当名义加速度可行时保留，当其威胁规定障碍间隙时进行最小修正。理论上分析名义指数跟踪、相容初始条件下安全区域前向不变性、二次规划持续可行性以及安全干预下的有界跟踪误差。数值实验采用理想平面平动模型，设置单个和多个静止圆形障碍，并考察参考速度和加速度限制的影响。

Result: 安全过滤器下最小间隙为0.000--0.001 m，而名义控制下为-1.594/-1.421 m；在参考速度尺度0.6--1.6范围内，跟踪RMSE由0.618 m增至0.950 m，说明安全约束下参考速度会影响跟踪精度。额外实验分析了加速度限制对控制努力和可行性的影响。

Conclusion: 该框架能够在有限控制权限下有效保障四旋翼轨迹跟踪的障碍安全，并以有界跟踪误差为代价进行安全干预；研究结果为无人机轨迹跟踪中的安全过滤器设计提供了依据。

Abstract: Accurate trajectory tracking alone does not guarantee safe quadrotor flight when the reference passes near obstacles or the available control authority is limited. This paper presents a safety-filtered trajectory-tracking framework for a quadrotor operating at a fixed altitude in obstacle-cluttered environments. A nominal tracking controller is combined with high-order control barrier constraints and an acceleration-constrained quadratic program. The safety filter preserves the nominal acceleration whenever it is admissible and modifies it only when the prescribed obstacle clearance is threatened. The analysis establishes nominal exponential tracking, forward invariance of the safe region under compatible initial conditions and continued quadratic-program feasibility, and bounded tracking error during safety intervention. Numerical experiments using an idealized planar translational model with single and multiple stationary circular obstacles show minimum clearances of $0.000$--$0.001$~m under the safety filter, compared with $-1.594/-1.421$~m under nominal control. Tracking RMSE increases from $0.618$ to $0.950$~m across reference-speed scales $0.6$--$1.6$, illustrating the effect of reference speed on tracking accuracy under safety constraints. Additional tests examine how acceleration limits affect control effort and feasibility. These findings inform safety-filter design for UAV trajectory tracking under limited control authority.

</details>


### [539] [Active road noise control using networked mean-square learning and lightweight conditional compensation experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32040)
*Xingzhao Huang,Hengzhi Zhou,Yu Shi,Ming Wu,Bin Liao,Yijing Chu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种计算高效的多通道主动道路噪声控制方法，将线性控制与条件相关的非线性残差补偿分离：先用网络化均方学习获得可自适应的FIR基线滤波器，再用多分辨率FIR专家混合模块进行非线性修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道主动道路噪声控制需在因果性和计算资源受限条件下实现有效降噪，现有方法难以兼顾降噪性能与推理计算效率。

Method: 采用FIR基线滤波器并通过网络化均方学习实现自适应；引入多分辨率FIR专家混合（MRF-MoE）模块提供非线性校正。训练包括基线初始化、样本图正则化的专家与路由器优化、联合微调。将目标通道视为连通网络节点以最小化均方误差，并用训练窗口构图正则化路由概率；每个专家结合短时稠密与长尾低秩FIR滤波，采用因果单专家路由降低推理计算。

Result: 在相同配置下，与WaveNet-VNN相比，所提方法将估计推理成本降低96.3%，同时在测试集上获得更高的降噪性能。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在满足因果性和计算约束的同时，以显著更低的推理成本实现优于WaveNet-VNN的主动道路噪声控制降噪效果。

Abstract: Multichannel active road noise control (ARNC) requires effective noise reduction (NR) under causality and computational constraints. A computationally efficient method is proposed that separates linear control from condition-dependent nonlinear residual compensation. A finite impulse response (FIR) baseline filter is obtained through networked mean-square learning that can be made adaptive, while a multi-resolution FIR mixture-of-experts (MRF-MoE) module provides possibly nonlinear corrections. Training comprises baseline initialization, sample-graph-regularized expert and router optimization, and joint refinement. Target channels are treated as nodes in a connected network for mean-square error minimization, whereas training windows define a graph for regularizing routing probabilities. Each expert combines short-time dense and long-tail low-rank FIR filtering, and causal single-expert routing reduces inference computation. Compared with WaveNet-VNN under the same configuration, the proposed method reduces estimated inference cost by 96.3% while achieving higher NR on the test set.

</details>


### [540] [Iterative Identification of Aperiodic Sampled-Data Systems via Affine LPV Models Scheduled by the Sampling Interval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32078)
*Hiroshi Okajima,Yohei Hosoe*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种从非周期采样输入输出数据中辨识稳定连续时间线性系统控制导向模型的方法，直接建立离散时间LPV状态空间模型，并用于非周期采样数据系统控制设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非周期采样会使固定LTI模型性能下降，而直接恢复连续时间矩阵较困难；因此需要一种可直接用于控制设计、能描述采样间隔变化的模型。

Method: 基于零阶保持离散化的一阶展开，构建仿射依赖于归一化采样间隔变化的离散时间LPV状态空间模型；由标准LTI子空间模型和采样数据关系得到含近似一阶项的初始LPV估计，并迭代交替进行状态序列重构与LPV参数重拟合。

Result: 数值算例表明，所辨识模型在较大采样间隔变化范围内保持较高验证精度，而固定LTI模型会退化；初始LPV状态空间结构已明显优于相同调度变量的LPV-ARX回归，迭代细化后接近状态实测基准。

Conclusion: 该方法能够直接辨识适用于非周期采样数据控制设计的LPV状态空间模型，并在采样间隔变化下优于固定LTI模型和LPV-ARX基线，迭代细化可进一步提升精度。

Abstract: This paper proposes a method for identifying a control-oriented model of a stable continuous-time linear system from aperiodically sampled input-output data. Rather than recovering the continuous-time matrices, the method directly identifies a discrete-time linear parameter-varying (LPV) state-space model that depends affinely on the measured normalized sampling-interval variation, a structure obtained from the first-order expansion of the zero-order-hold discretization. The resulting model is directly usable in control design for aperiodic sampled-data systems. An initial LPV estimate, including approximate first-order terms, is derived from a standard LTI subspace model through sampled-data relations. The method then iteratively alternates state-sequence reconstruction and LPV parameter refitting. Numerical examples show that the identified model retains high validation accuracy over a wide range of sampling-interval variations where a fixed LTI model degrades. Already at initialization, the state-space LPV structure substantially outperforms an LPV-ARX regression with the same scheduling variable, and the iterative refinement brings the model close to a state-measured benchmark, a practical upper-bound reference.

</details>


### [541] [Damping Ratio and Convergence Rate Analysis for Inverter-Based Power Systems via Root Locus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32111)
*Dan Wang,Wei Chen,Yan Jiang,Shinji Hara*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究逆变器主导电力系统的暂态频率性能，利用标量反馈系统根轨迹分析闭环极点，从而评估阻尼比和收敛速度，并给出逆变器参数整定准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源大量接入电网，仅依赖惯量中心频率已不足以分析暂态性能，尤其难以刻画振荡行为，因此需要研究逆变器基电力系统的暂态频率性能。

Method: 将网络系统分解为一组标量反馈系统，利用缩放拉普拉斯矩阵最小非零特征值到最大特征值变化时的标量反馈系统根轨迹分析闭环极点；据此推导保证期望阻尼比和收敛速度的充分条件，并提供逆变器参数整定指南，结合数值仿真验证。

Result: 分析表明，最差阻尼比出现在增益等于缩放拉普拉斯矩阵最大特征值时，最差收敛速度出现在增益等于最小非零特征值时；该结果显著简化了性能评估。

Conclusion: 所提方法可用于分析逆变器基电力系统的暂态频率性能，并为逆变器参数整定提供指导。

Abstract: As more renewables enter the grid, it becomes insufficient to rely solely on the center of inertia frequency to analyze the transient performance, especially for oscillation behaviors. Motivated by this, we study the transient frequency performance of inverter-based power systems. Two key performance criteria are considered: the damping ratio and the convergence rate, which are determined by the angles and the real parts of the closed-loop poles, respectively. By decomposing the network system into a set of scalar feedback systems, we show that the closed-loop poles can be analyzed using the root locus of a scalar feedback system as the gain varies from the smallest nonzero eigenvalue to the largest eigenvalue of the scaled Laplacian matrix of the interconnection network. Based on this, we derive sufficient conditions that ensure desired damping and convergence performance. Our analysis shows that the worst-case damping ratio and convergence rate occur when the gain equals the largest and the smallest nonzero eigenvalues of the scaled Laplacian, respectively. This result significantly simplifies the performance assessment. We further provide guidelines for tuning the inverter parameter. Numerical simulations are included to illustrate and validate the proposed approach.

</details>


### [542] [Online outlier-resilient data-driven moving horizon estimation for linear discrete-time systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32279)
*Jingshi Yao,Zenghong Huang,Xiaojie Li,Xunyuan Yin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究存在稀疏且幅值任意异常值的线性系统状态估计问题，提出一种无需显式辨识模型、基于Willems基本引理的数据驱动异常值鲁棒移动 horizon 估计方法OORD-MHE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线输出测量可能被稀疏但幅值任意的异常值污染，而现有方法通常依赖系统模型辨识；因此需要仅利用离线输入-状态-输出数据实现鲁棒状态估计。

Method: 提出OORD-MHE方案，基于Willems基本引理直接利用离线输入-状态-输出数据；对输出残差采用带截断阈值的截断二次损失，以抑制在线稀疏异常值影响。

Result: 给出了估计误差一致有界的充分条件；仿真表明该方法在存在稀疏在线异常值时仍能生成准确的状态估计。

Conclusion: OORD-MHE能够在无需显式系统辨识的情况下，对稀疏且幅值任意的在线输出异常值保持鲁棒，并获得有界误差的准确状态估计。

Abstract: This paper addresses data-driven state estimation for linear systems of which online output measurements may be corrupted by sparse outliers of arbitrary magnitude. Using only offline input-state-output data without explicitly identifying a system model, we propose an outlier-resilient data-driven moving horizon estimation scheme, termed OORD-MHE, based on Willems' fundamental lemma. The scheme employs a truncated-quadratic loss on the output residuals, parameterized by a truncation threshold, to mitigate the influence of online outliers. We establish sufficient conditions under which the resulting estimation error remains uniformly bounded. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed OORD-MHE scheme generates accurate state estimates in the presence of sparse online outliers.

</details>


### [543] [Stability and periodic switching in feedback systems with sector-bounded hybrid integrators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32421)
*Sebastiaan van den Eijnden,Kai Wulff,Christoph Weise,Johann Reger*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 研究由线性时不变过程与扇区有界混合积分器反馈互联构成的分段线性系统的稳定性，提出基于状态依赖切换序列渐近周期性的谱分析方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Lyapunov方法通常只能给出充分稳定性条件，作者希望利用切换序列渐近呈现周期行为的观察，获得更准确、可替代的稳定性分析视角。

Method: 将系统稳定性分析转化为对渐近周期极限系统的谱分析；提出渐近周期性不依赖初始条件和系统稳定性的猜想，描述极限系统并给出参数求解算法；对二阶LTI过程严格证明该性质，并基于周期极限系统的谱性质推导稳定性条件。

Result: 建立了极限系统的描述与参数获取算法；对二阶线性时不变过程严格证明了渐近周期性；并得到基于周期极限系统谱性质的充分稳定性条件。

Conclusion: 该工作为一般状态依赖分段线性系统的准确稳定性分析提供了新的谱分析视角，并展示了渐近周期性在稳定性判定中的潜力。

Abstract: We study stability of piecewise linear systems composed of the feedback interconnection of a linear time-invariant process and a sector-bounded hybrid integrator. Exploiting the observation that for such systems state-dependent switching sequences asymptotically exhibit periodic behaviour, we develop a spectral approach to stability analysis as an alternative to sufficient Lyapunov-based methods. We formulate a conjecture that asymptotic periodicity holds irrespective of the initial conditions and system stability, and provide a description of the limit system and propose an algorithm to obtain its parameters. We establish this rigorously for second-order linear-time invariant processes. Based on spectral properties of the resulting periodic limit system, we derive sufficient stability conditions. The results provide a novel viewpoint for accurate stability analysis of general state-based piecewise linear systems.

</details>


### [544] [Overparameterized Simulation-Error Minimization for Nonlinear System Identification: Horizon-Uniform Landscape and Identifiability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32441)
*Cesare Donati,Constantino Lagoa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出一种带软惩罚逐步修正的轨迹提升方法，使非线性系统辨识中的拟合损失可由梯度下降可证明地最小化，并通过最小修正选择原则恢复参数可辨识性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真误差最小化虽是非线性系统辨识的标准准则，但其损失 landscape 非凸，且条件数会随数据时域长度 N 几何级恶化，导致优化困难。

Method: 用自由的、带软惩罚的每步修正提升轨迹；在输出映射秩条件和一步 Jacobian 有界假设下，证明拟合损失满足与 N 无关的 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 不等式。采用最小修正选择原则恢复可辨识性，并提出“先对拟合损失做梯度下降，再对惩罚权重做 homotopy”的估计器。

Result: 在结构可辨识条件下，惩罚损失的全局最小点对任意正惩罚权重都返回真实参数；在噪声和未建模动态下，参数误差至多随失配线性增长。实验表明该方法能在单 shooting 失败的长记录、扩张系统和混沌系统上恢复参数。

Conclusion: 该方法将拟合与参数选择统一起来，并提供局部收敛保证，可有效缓解仿真误差最小化在长时域下的优化与可辨识性问题。

Abstract: Simulation-error minimization is a standard criterion in nonlinear system identification, but its landscape is nonconvex and its conditioning can degrade geometrically with the data horizon N. We propose to lift the trajectory with a free, softly penalized per-step correction, which yields a fit loss that gradient descent provably minimizes: under a rank condition on the output map and a bound on the one-step Jacobian, it satisfies a Polyak-Lojasiewicz inequality with an explicit constant independent of N. A zero-loss model leaves the physical parameter undetermined. Identifiability is restored by a minimal-correction selection principle: under structural identifiability, the global minimizer of the penalized loss returns the true parameters for every positive penalty weight, and under noise and unmodeled dynamics the parameter error grows at most linearly with the mismatch. The resulting estimator, gradient descent on the fit loss followed by a homotopy in the penalty weight, reconciles fit and selection, with a local convergence guarantee. In experiments, it recovers the parameters on long records of expanding and chaotic systems on which single shooting fails.

</details>


### [545] [Automated Design and Evaluation Pipeline for Optimal Control Transcriptions in Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32558)
*Fabio Schneider,Peter Kötting,Renato Loureiro*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种自动化流程，用于设计和评估MPC的最优控制转录策略，结合伪谱Legendre-Gauss-Radau方法与贝叶斯优化，并在在轨服务航天器运动规划与闭环控制场景中验证性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPC的计算负担限制其广泛实时部署，而转录策略选择是影响计算效率的关键因素，但识别高性能转录需要大量工作和领域知识。

Method: 定义计算时间、闭环性能等自定义多目标设计指标并由流程最小化；采用伪谱Legendre-Gauss-Radau转录，统一包含前向欧拉及低阶/高阶隐式配点方法；参数化不同网格配置；使用贝叶斯优化搜索最优转录配置。

Result: 该流程能够评估不同数值方法和网格配置，并在涉及航天器运动规划与闭环控制的在轨服务场景中展示MPC性能改进。

Conclusion: 自动化管道可有效设计并选择高性能最优控制转录，减少对领域知识的依赖，有助于提升MPC计算效率并促进实时应用。

Abstract: The computational burden of Model Predictive Control represents a bottleneck limiting its widespread deployment in real-time applications. The selection of the optimal control transcription strategy for a given MPC formulation is a key driver of computational efficiency. Identifying performant MPC transcriptions requires significant effort and domain knowledge. We propose an automated pipeline for the design and evaluation of performant optimal control transcriptions for a given MPC formulation. Custom multi-objective design metrics, such as computation time or closed-loop performance, can be specified and are minimized by the pipeline. As a transcription method, a pseudospectral Legendre-Gauss-Radau method is employed. We show that it incorporates forward Euler integration and implicit collocation methods of low and high order in one formulation, leveraging the pipeline to evaluate both numerical approaches. Furthermore, different mesh configurations can be parameterized. To identify the optimal configuration of the transcription, a Bayesian Optimization framework is applied. The pipelines improvements in MPC performance are demonstrated through On-Orbit Servicing scenarios involving spacecraft motion planning and closed-loop control.

</details>


### [546] [Contract2Reach: Discretization-Induced Contractive Dynamic Programming for High-Dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32774)
*Jaeyoung Lee,Donggun Lee,Jason J. Choi,Namhoon Cho*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出 Contract2Reach，将无折扣有限时域 Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析转化为一系列收缩不动点问题，并通过时间反向推进和单次回归训练求解，在高维系统中取得与 PINN 基线相当或更好的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 PINN 方法虽可用于高维 HJ 可达性分析，但对超参数和系统动力学较敏感；作者希望构建无需折扣因子、训练更稳定且边界精度更高的替代方法。

Method: 将无折扣有限时域可达性问题重述为收缩固定点序列，结合离散时间与空间导数构造收缩映射；理论上证明当时间与空间步长趋于零时收敛到唯一粘性解；神经实现中采用基于 rollout 的值目标单次回归、自适应零水平集采样和保守目标组合。

Result: 在参数化垂直无人机、13 维四旋翼和 40 维发布-订阅系统上，Contract2Reach 与基于 PINN 的基线相比具有竞争力；在垂直无人机和发布-订阅系统上的边界评估显示更高保真度和更低学习率敏感性，并揭示了体指标可能遗漏的错误。

Conclusion: Contract2Reach 为无折扣 HJ 可达性分析提供了一种收缩固定点视角，避免对空间值梯度反向传播，提升了边界评估的可靠性和训练稳定性，适用于高维可达性分析。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) enable undiscounted Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis for high-dimensional systems, but their performance can be sensitive to hyperparameter choices and the underlying system dynamics. We introduce Contract2Reach, which recasts undiscounted finite-horizon reachability as a sequence of contractive fixed-point problems solved by backward time marching. Our formulation combines discretized temporal and spatial derivatives to construct a contractive mapping without introducing a discount factor. Under standard assumptions, we prove that the exact scheme converges to the unique viscosity solution as both the temporal and spatial step sizes tend to zero. Unlike PINNs, our training fits rollout-based value targets via a single regression, without backpropagating through spatial value gradients. In the neural implementation, adaptive zero-level-set sampling and conservative target combination address high-dimensional sample sparsity and false positives, respectively. Experiments on a parameterized vertical drone, a 13D quadrotor, and a 40D publisher-subscriber system show competitive performance against PINNs-based baselines. Boundary evaluations on the vertical drone and publisher-subscriber systems demonstrate improved fidelity and reduced learning-rate sensitivity, revealing errors that volume-based metrics can miss.

</details>


### [547] [Space Postman and ATLAS: Enabling Startup Participation in the Orbital Logistics Economy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32814)
*Omer Burak Iskender,Kaan Göktürk*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出轨道物流规划服务 Space Postman 与载荷无关拖船概念 ATLAS，将目标清单、航天器和时间预算转化为定价且经核验的任务规划，并用两个案例和公开基准验证其可行性与成本优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 碎片清除、在轨服务、加油、末端配送、在轨回收和星座部署等业务都依赖同一规划难题：单航天器需在推进剂和截止时间约束下访问多个轨道面漂移的目标。此类规划需要轨道动力学与优化专业能力，而载荷、拖船或星座公司通常缺乏该能力，导致新运营者难以进入或依赖昂贵手工排程。

Method: 开发 Space Postman 规划服务，输入目标列表、航天器和时间预算，输出定价方案；对交会巡游给出经验证的任务规划。提出 ATLAS 拖船概念，其载荷舱可携带碎片套件、客户航天器或推进剂。通过 DEXTER 后续任务式案例（十个同轨道壳高风险上面级）和八客户拼车释放案例开展研究，并与公开碎片清除基准比较。

Result: 十目标巡游中仅等待无法完成，时间均分会使推进剂成本增加约三分之一，时间成为任务关键货币；八客户拖船案例中交付顺序决定推进剂是否足够，并按需到达轨道面为每次交付定价。规划引擎在相应保真度下复现公开基准获胜方案，并在相同发射条件下为多数目标规划出更便宜轨迹。

Conclusion: 经校准的规划器与载荷无关拖船结合，可为新运营者进入轨道物流提供实用路径；但规划结果必须按其获得时的保真度解读。

Abstract: Debris removal, in-orbit servicing and refuelling, last-mile delivery, in-space recycling and constellation deployment are separate businesses built on one planning problem: a single spacecraft must visit many targets whose orbital planes drift apart under Earth's oblateness, within a propellant tank and a deadline. Solving it well takes orbital dynamics and optimisation expertise that is rarely the core business of payload, tug or constellation companies; this keeps young operators out of orbital logistics or leaves them with costly hand-made schedules. This paper presents Space Postman, a planning service that turns a target list, a spacecraft and a time budget into a priced and, for rendezvous tours, verified mission plan, and ATLAS, a tug concept whose payload bay takes debris kits, client spacecraft or propellant. As most start-ups fail when the money runs out, the offer starts with software and adds the vehicle later. Two case studies show what it changes. For a notional follow-on to the DEXTER project, which develops ways to turn scrap aluminium into propellant, it plans a tour of ten high-risk upper stages that share one orbital shell: waiting alone cannot close the tour, an even split of the time costs a third more propellant, and time is the currency of the mission. For a tug that releases eight clients from one rideshare, the delivery order decides whether the tank suffices, and the plan prices each delivery by the plane it must reach. The planning engine reproduces the published winning solution of a public debris-removal benchmark at that solution's fidelity and, given the same launches, plans cheaper trajectories for most of them: an independent check for operators and investors. A calibrated planner paired with a payload-agnostic tug offers new operators a practical way into orbital logistics, provided its numbers are read at the fidelity at which they were obtained.

</details>


### [548] [Adaptive Electromagnetic Transient-level Digital Twins for Data Centers via In-Context Learning with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32882)
*Amit Jena,Bin Wang,Aoxia Chen,Brad Chadwell,Billy Yancey,Le Xie*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于大语言模型上下文学习的自适应数据中心电磁暂态级数字孪生，用于快速、准确预测电磁暂态并适应配置变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI负载快速增长推高数据中心功耗，运行与配置变化会引发电磁暂态；高保真EMT求解器计算成本高，而现有数据驱动数字孪生非自适应，配置变化后泛化能力不足。

Method: 将EMT预测建模为参数不确定性下的系统辨识问题，构建基于GPT-2的上下文学习框架，利用少量EMT轨迹样本在推理时适应未见的数据中心配置，无需模型重训练；在三个代表性EMT场景中验证，并与三个非自适应基线数字孪生比较。

Result: 所提框架表现出更高的预测精度、更强的未见运行工况适应能力，以及相较传统高保真EMT仿真显著的计算加速。

Conclusion: 基于上下文学习与大语言模型的自适应EMT级数字孪生能够兼顾预测精度、配置适应性和计算效率，有助于数据中心可靠运行与维护。

Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) workloads has significantly increased data center (DC) power demand. Frequent operational and configurational changes, such as load surges caused by dynamic workload allocation, can induce electromagnetic transients (EMTs) whose accurate prediction is critical for reliable DC operation and maintenance. Although high-fidelity EMT solvers are widely adopted for transient analysis, their computational cost limits large-scale and multi-scenario studies. Digital twins address this computational bottleneck by emulating the behavior of a physical system and enabling fast prediction in place of expensive high-fidelity simulation. However,data-driven digital twins are non-adaptive and fail to generalize once the DC configuration changes. To address this limitation, this paper proposes an adaptive EMT-level digital twin for DCs based on in-context learning (ICL) with large language models (LLMs). We formulate the EMT prediction task as a system identification problem under parametric uncertainty and develop a GPT-2-based framework that adapts to unseen DC configurations at inference time from a small set of EMT trajectory samples, without model retraining. The proposed framework is validated on three representative EMT scenarios and benchmarked against three baseline non-adaptive twins. Results demonstrate superior prediction accuracy, improved adaptability to unseen operating conditions, and substantial computational speedups compared to high-fidelity EMT simulation.

</details>

Abstract: The development of cyber-physical systems (CPS) proceeds through iterative design revisions, and compliance with safety requirements must be re-established after every revision, typically based on a system model. Conventional models, however, predict only the most likely behavior, leading to model-plant mismatch that often surfaces only during late-stage testing, when redesign is most expensive. This article presents reachset-conformant modeling as a framework for managing uncertainty throughout the development process: instead of a single trajectory, a reachset-conformant model predicts a set of behaviors, calibrated from data to conservatively enclose the true system behavior with a statistical guarantee. Safety properties established on the model therefore transfer to the realized system. Beyond a practical introduction to reachset-conformant identification and its benefits for CPS development, our main theoretical contribution is a closure result: reachset conformance is preserved under serial composition, parallel composition, and feedback interconnection, and hence under any architecture assembled from these primitives. Subsystem models identified independently from local measurements can thus be substituted into the system architecture, and the interconnected model inherits a coverage guarantee from the subsystem guarantees. We complement this result with update strategies that adapt the uncertainty sets after design changes without restarting the identification workflow. Experiments on an automotive brake-system test bench demonstrate that a) a single model covers all operating conditions and hardware variants, b) late-stage modifications are absorbed by uncertainty set updates, c) a black-box hydraulic unit is conservatively abstracted from input-output data alone, and d) independently identified subsystem models form a conformant model by construction.

</details>

Abstract: Level 4 autonomous vehicles require fault-tolerant architectures that preserve critical driving functions under sensing, computing, communication, power, and actuation failures. As these systems progress toward industrial scalability, architectural complexity, validation burden, integration effort, and lifecycle cost become increasingly relevant. This study proposes an Operational Design Domain (ODD)-based, safety-constrained systems-engineering framework for architecture rationalization. ODD-specific capabilities, physical fault assumptions, post-fault operational policies, and spatial sensing requirements are propagated through an integrated safety-feasibility gate. Architecture transformations, including removal, relocation, functional reassignment, and consolidation, are evaluated only within the resulting safety-feasible design space, followed by lifecycle-cost sensitivity and robust multiobjective Pareto analysis. A generic, synthetically parameterized Level 4 architecture is used as a demonstrative computational case study. Within this modeled design space, direct ablation showed limited rationalization potential, whereas directional redistribution and functional consolidation generated a broader set of safety-feasible candidates. Under the illustrative lifecycle-cost model, the best nominal candidate achieved a 5.55% normalized cost reduction and remained cost-reducing across all 5,000 sampled points in the prescribed uncertainty domain. The analysis identified 15 non-dominated architecture-policy solutions representing seven physical transformations. The results support capability-based, policy-conditioned, and lifecycle-aware architecture rationalization under the stated assumptions, with safety retained as a non-compensatory feasibility constraint. The reported transformations are design candidates rather than validated production architectures.

</details>

### [551] [Reliability-Aware and Anatomy-Preserving Replay for Continual Echocardiographic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31270)
*Zahid Ullah,Sieun Choi,Jihie Kim*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文提出可靠性感知回放网络 RAR-Net，用于持续超声心动图分割，缓解灾难性遗忘、域偏移和不完整解剖标注问题，并在多个数据集上取得优于对比持续学习方法的最终平均精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续超声心动图分割面临灾难性遗忘、成像分布变化以及解剖监督不完整等挑战；现有持续学习方法在有限回放记忆和不完整标注下难以兼顾旧知识保持与新分布适应。

Method: 提出 RAR-Net 持续分割框架，集成多因素样本优先级、受保护的任务感知记忆、遗忘条件自适应回放和结构感知监督；利用类别、边界、图像、解剖和时间可靠性筛选历史样本，并调节其在顺序训练中的贡献。

Result: 在 CAMUS、CardiacNet 和 EchoNet-Dynamic 上的实验表明，RAR-Net 在所评估持续学习方法中取得最高最终平均精度，旧知识保留具有竞争力，分割性能接近离线联合训练参考。

Conclusion: 协同可靠性引导的记忆管理、遗忘条件回放和解剖特定监督，有助于在异构超声心动图数据序列中实现知识保留与适应。

Abstract: Continual echocardiographic segmentation remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting, domain shifts, and heterogeneous anatomical supervision. Existing continual-learning methods often struggle to preserve previously acquired knowledge while adapting to new imaging distributions, particularly under limited replay memory and incomplete anatomical annotations. To address these challenges, we propose the Reliability-Aware Replay Network (RAR-Net), a continual segmentation framework integrating multi-factor exemplar prioritization, protected task-aware memory, forgetting-conditioned adaptive replay, and structure-aware supervision. RAR-Net combines class, boundary, image, anatomical, and temporal reliability criteria to prioritize informative historical examples, while adaptive replay regulates their contribution during sequential training. Structure-aware supervision further reinforces previously learned anatomical knowledge when subsequent datasets provide incomplete annotations. Extensive experiments performed on CAMUS, CardiacNet, and EchoNet-Dynamic demonstrate that our RAR-Net achieves the highest final average accuracy among the evaluated continual-learning methods, with competitive historical knowledge retention and segmentation performance approaching the offline joint-training reference. These findings indicate that coordinating reliability-guided memory management, forgetting-conditioned replay, and anatomy-specific supervision can support knowledge retention and adaptation under the evaluated sequence of heterogeneous echocardiographic datasets.

</details>


### [552] [GeoCANO: A Geometry-Conditioned Adaptive Neural Operator for Physical-Field Prediction on Varying Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31274)
*Biao Chen,Xinrui Zhou,Xianlin Jin,Jing Wang,Jifa Zhang,Chen Zhai,Wei Liu,Miao Zhang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出几何条件自适应神经算子GeoCANO，将完整三维几何映射为坐标相关场函数，实现跨分辨率复用的气动场快速预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业设计需反复评估候选构型；积分性能指标无法揭示关键局部现象，高保真仿真昂贵；现有物理场代理常通过预设网格拓扑耦合几何表示与坐标评估，限制跨分辨率复用。

Method: 用基于无序表面坐标的注意力编码器提取几何状态，结合多分辨率轴因子化哈希编码与逐查询稀疏专家混合解码器增强多尺度表达；先构建场表示再引入输出坐标，使一次几何编码可跨区域复用；在10484个翼身短舱几何的RANS数据集上评估跨声速气动场预测。

Result: 对未见构型，GeoCANO在全表面预测、高梯度压力重建和压阻恢复上优于基线；压力系数MAE相对最强基线降低77.9%，并在有限壁面法向距离范围保持优势；消融显示几何调制坐标编码以更少参数达到相当精度；路由分析显示空间结构化、查询相关的专家专业化。

Conclusion: 结果表明GeoCANO提供了可复用的连续坐标表示，可用于变化几何上的快速物理场评估。

Abstract: Industrial design requires repeated evaluation of candidate configurations. Integral performance measures alone do not resolve critical local phenomena, while high-fidelity simulation remains costly. Existing physical-field surrogates often couple geometry representation and coordinate evaluation through prescribed mesh topologies, limiting reuse across resolutions. We propose the Geometry-Conditioned Adaptive Neural Operator (GeoCANO), which maps a sampled complete three-dimensional geometry to a coordinate-dependent field function. An attention-based encoder extracts a geometry state from unordered surface coordinates. A multiresolution axis-factorized hash encoding and query-wise sparse mixture-of-experts decoder enhance multiscale expressiveness. GeoCANO constructs the field representation before introducing output coordinates, allowing one geometry encoding to be reused across regions without rebuilding the graph for each output topology. We evaluated GeoCANO on transonic aerodynamic-field prediction over complete aircraft configurations using a Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes dataset of 10,484 wing-body-nacelle geometries. For unseen configurations within the sampled design family, GeoCANO outperformed baselines in complete-surface prediction, high-gradient pressure reconstruction, and pressure-drag recovery. It reduced pressure-coefficient mean absolute error by 77.9% relative to the strongest baseline and retained an advantage over a finite range of wall-normal distances. Ablation studies showed that geometry-modulated coordinate encoding achieved comparable accuracy with substantially fewer parameters than conventional three-dimensional hash encoding. Routing analysis indicated spatially structured, query-dependent expert specialization. These results demonstrate a reusable continuous-coordinate representation for rapid physical-field evaluation over varying geometries.

</details>


### [553] [Exact Volume-Preserving Diffeomorphic Shear Splitting: Continuous-Discrete Geometric Bounds, Reversible Memory Backpropagation, and Expressivity Frontiers in Volumetric Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31343)
*Alvaro Garcia-Casas*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于级联坐标剪切的精确保结构三维可变形配准框架，通过解析可积的剪切阶段构造体积保持且无折叠的微分同胚映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有速度场方法（SVF、LDDMM）只能通过数值ODE积分或软惩罚近似不可压缩性，存在体积漂移、迭代网格求逆和随层数增长的线性反向传播内存开销等问题。

Method: 将无散度李代数sdiff(Ω)分解为六个坐标剪切生成元，使每个基本阶段解析积分为闭式三角剪切，并具有机器精度逆映射；多阶段复合生成连通体积保持群SDiff_0(Ω)。理论部分给出全局微分同胚证明、Dirichlet边界约束引理、各向异性黎曼相似不变性、Sobolev H^2谱预算及精确可逆反向传播；采用palindromic Strang分裂提升轨迹精度。

Result: 在16^3至64^3网格上证明二阶O(h^2)亚体素收敛；Strang分裂轨迹误差较Lie-Trotter降低468.1倍，体积漂移不超过2.22e-16；相较SVF执行速度快2.1至4.0倍，GPU显存降低78.4%，且无需存储O(L)中间激活。在ACDC和OASIS-1上Dice分别为0.884和0.841，同时保持0.0000%折叠和零体积漂移。

Conclusion: 该框架以解析、可逆且保体积的坐标剪切复合实现精确结构保持的三维配准，在精度、效率、内存和拓扑/体积保持方面优于传统速度场方法。

Abstract: Incompressible diffeomorphic registration requires continuous spatial mappings that preserve local tissue volume (det(DΦ) = 1) without topological folding (det(DΦ) > 0). Standard velocity-field methods (SVF, LDDMM) approximate incompressibility via numerical ODE integration or soft penalties, exhibiting numerical volume drift (~10^-4 to 10^-1), iterative grid inversions, and linear backpropagation memory O(L * N_vox).
  We formulate an exact structure-preserving framework for 3D registration based on cascaded coordinate shears. By decomposing the divergence-free Lie algebra sdiff(Ω) into six coordinate-shear generators whose convective non-linearities vanish identically, each elementary stage integrates analytically to a closed-form triangular shear with det(DS_k) = 1 and exact machine-precision inverse requiring zero iterations and zero spatial interpolations. Multi-stage compositions generate the connected volume-preserving group SDiff_0(Ω). We establish: (i) an unconditional global diffeomorphism proof closing the Hadamard-Caccioppoli injectivity gap; (ii) a Dirichlet boundary confinement lemma; (iii) an anisotropic Riemannian similarity invariance; (iv) a Sobolev H^2 spectral budget preventing chaotic mixing; and (v) an exact reversible backpropagation engine eliminating O(L) trajectory storage (0.00 MB intermediate activations).
  We prove second-order O(h^2) sub-voxel convergence across 16^3 to 64^3 lattices and second-order trajectory accuracy for palindromic Strang splitting (468.1x error reduction vs. Lie-Trotter; drift |det(DΦ)-1| <= 2.22e-16). Execution is 2.1x-4.0x faster than SVF with 78.4% GPU memory reduction. On cardiac cine-MRI (ACDC, N=100) and brain MRI (OASIS-1, N=414), our model achieves competitive Dice (0.884 and 0.841) while strictly maintaining 0.0000% folding and zero volume drift.

</details>


### [554] [InterGS+: Inter-Frame Gaussian Splatting Compression with Geometry-Aware Transformer Prediction and Adaptive Residual Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31482)
*Muhammad Talha,Zhu Li,Joel Jung*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出 InterGS+，一种面向动态 3D Gaussian Splatting 的轻量级帧间编解码器，通过改进时间预测与残差编码降低存储和传输成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态 3DGS 虽可实时逼真渲染，但每帧使用大量高维属性不规则高斯基元，存储与传输开销大；同时高斯基元跨帧不保持固定身份，难以直接利用时间冗余。

Method: 先对当前帧几何用 G-PCC 编码并重建，以保证编解码端时间邻域一致；属性预测采用轻量 KNN、双边预测器及几何感知 Transformer 预测球谐外观，并进行逐高斯模式选择；残差按属性分别编码：SH 在共享 PCA 域中用量化加细化，透明度和尺度在激活 gamma 压缩域中编码，旋转用规范化四元数创新结合向量量化与细化。

Result: 在 MPEG 动态序列上，InterGS+ 相对 G-PCC Amd.1 平均 BD-rate 降低 45.48%，相对 InterGS-Lite 降低 7.78%；对应 BD-PSNR 增益分别为 9.98 dB 和 1.10 dB；平均解码复杂度为 0.049 ms/Gaussian。

Conclusion: InterGS+ 能有效提升动态 3DGS 的帧间压缩效率，并保持较低解码复杂度，适合可流式传输的动态 3DGS 压缩。

Abstract: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides real-time photorealistic rendering, but representing each frame as irregular Gaussian primitives with high-dimensional attributes creates substantial storage and transmission cost. Exploiting temporal redundancy is challenging because Gaussian primitives do not preserve fixed identities across frames. We propose InterGS+, a lightweight post-hoc inter-frame codec that jointly improves temporal prediction and residual representation. Current-frame geometry is coded with G-PCC and reconstructed before prediction, enabling consistent temporal neighborhoods at encoder and decoder. Attributes are predicted using lightweight KNN and bilateral predictors together with a geometry-aware transformer for spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance, with per-Gaussian mode selection. Residual coding is adapted to each attribute: SH innovations are coded in a shared PCA domain using vector quantization with refinement, opacity and scale in activated gamma-companded domains, and rotation as canonicalized quaternion innovations using vector quantization and refinement. On MPEG dynamic sequences, InterGS+ achieves average BD-rate reductions of 45.48% over G-PCC Amd. 1 and 7.78% over InterGS-Lite, with corresponding BD-PSNR gains of 9.98 dB and 1.10 dB. Average decoding complexity is 0.049 ms/Gaussian, demonstrating efficient streamable dynamic 3DGS compression.

</details>


### [555] [Characterizing Datasets to Anticipate Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Performance for Radiographic Pneumonia Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32360)
*Iftakhar Hossain,Md. Imran Hasan,Salahuddin Ahmed,Eric D. McCollum,Abdullah H. Baqui,Taufiq Hasan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究分析胸片肺炎检测中无监督域适应的性能差异，发现源域和目标域的数据集类别可分性会以相反方向影响适应效果，并提出可在适应前用于数据集选择的评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习肺炎检测模型跨机构应用时准确率下降，而无监督域适应性能依赖源域和目标域数据集特性，且不同数据集配对间收益不对称，因此需要找出能预测适应性能的结构属性。

Method: 使用冻结的DenseNet-121提取胸片特征，以Silhouette Score为主、Fisher Ratio为辅刻画5个数据集的类别可分性；对全部20个有向源-目标配对使用DANN进行域适应，并与无适应直接迁移比较；同时计算7种已发表的迁移性估计器作为对照。

Result: 适应性能受源域和目标域相反影响：目标域可分性越高，AUC越高（r=0.934，p=0.042）；源域可分性越高，AUC越低（r=-0.922，p=0.017）。两方向间的可分性差值与AUC差值相关（r=-0.932，p=0.017），并在10/10个配对中识别出更优迁移方向（p=0.001）。所提描述符在目标域评估上与最佳已发表估计器相当。

Conclusion: 源域和目标域在域适应中具有相反的结构作用：高类别可分性使数据集更适合作为测试集，但不一定适合作为训练源。该框架可在低资源场景下无需完整适应实验即可指导数据集选择。

Abstract: Deep learning models for pneumonia detection from chest radiographs exhibit degraded accuracy when applied across institutions, which motivates Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA). We observe that UDA performance depends on the properties of both the source and target datasets, and that performance gains are asymmetric with respect to dataset pairs. We investigate which structural properties of chest X-ray datasets are the most important predictors of UDA performance, and whether they can be measured before adaptation is attempted.
  Five chest radiograph datasets were characterized by the class separability of their features, obtained from one forward pass of a frozen DenseNet-121 and summarized by the Silhouette Score, with the Fisher Ratio as a supporting measure. All twenty directed source-target pairs were adapted with a Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (DANN), while direct transfer without adaptation was also evaluated. Seven published transferability estimators were computed on the same representation for comparison.
  We found that adaptation performance depended on both endpoints in opposite directions. More separable target datasets attained higher AUC scores ($r=0.934$, $p=0.042$), whereas more separable sources produced lower AUC scores ($r=-0.922$, $p=0.017$). The signed difference in separability tracked the signed difference in AUC between the two directions of a pair ($r=-0.932$, $p=0.017$) and identified the better direction in 10 of 10 pairs ($p=0.001$). The proposed descriptor was comparable to the best published estimators on target evaluation.
  Source and target datasets play opposite structural roles in adaptation: higher class separability makes a dataset easier as a test set but not as a training source. This framework can guide dataset selection for adaptation in low-resource settings without running full experiments.

</details>
